title: Kerala Underground
summary: Kerala Underground is an Indian Malayalam-language hip-hop reality television series that premiered on Zee 5 in 2026. The series follows ten contestants, selected through open auditions, competing in rap performances over ten episodes for the title of Kerala's underground hip-hop champion. It is hosted by Aathira Rajeev and directed by Lendrick Kumar.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text: Contestants receive guidance from four mentors drawn from Kerala's hip-hop scene: Dabzee, MC Couper, Imbachi and Parimal Shais, who work with participants on writing, performance and personal style over the course of the competition. The series was filmed at locations across Kerala.

Ahead of the premiere, Zee Music Company released a promotional single, "Entha Haal", written and performed by MC Couper, Imbachi and Dabzee, with music by Parimal Shais and mixing by Akash Shravan.

title: Kuheli
summary:
Kuheli is a 2026 Indian Bengali crime thriller web series directed by Aditi Roy. Written by Koel Sreejib, it has been produced by Green Grip Films. The series stars Priyanka Sarkar, Susmita Dey, Ridhima Ghosh, Angana Roy and Kaushik Sen in the lead roles. The series is about a murder investigation of a police officer by her colleague. It marked the OTT debut of television actress Susmita Dey.
Principal photography took place in North Bengal in February 2024, with most scenes being filmed in around Darjeeling. Some of the scenes were shot in Sikkim and Kolkata. Nabarun Bose composed the music of the film. Ramyadip Saha did the cinematography while Subhajit Singha handled the editing. The series was streamed on the Bengali OTT platform Hoichoi on 15 May 2026.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: The series is set in the town of Kuheli and follows the investigation into the murder of police officer SP Rana Singha. DSP Agni Basu is assigned to investigate the case and finds that Rana was killed by someone known to him. The investigation brings suspicion on Rana's widowed wife Radhika and her two sisters, Debika and Ishika. As Agni looks into their relationships with Rana, details about their past connections to him are unveiled. The series follows the investigation as Agni tries to find out who was responsible for Rana's death.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Parama Dasgupta of Aajkal reviewed the series and wrote "Kuheli is captivating among the five other well-known murder mysteries of Bengali OTT. In addition, in this series, directed by Aditi Roy, the mountain slopes and picture-like scenes captured in drone shots have provided excellent accompaniment." She praised the strong screenplay, lack of unnecessary dialogues and subplots, Aditi Roy's direction, the editing, the performance of the actors and the chemistry between the three sisters but bemoaned Angana's overacting in certain scenes, unnecessary rowdiness in Priyanka's character and the lack of proper backstories for the characters.
Swati Chatterjee Bhowmik of Sangbad Pratidin reviewed the series and opined "Kuheli maintains the thrill throughout. Every actor has adapted to his character wonderfully. Kaushik, Sushmita, Angana, Ridhima, Shubhrajit, Priyanka and Durbar have kept the audience hooked in the series with their impeccable performances. Nabarun Bose's background music is appropriate." She appreciated the performance of the actors, the cinematography, the editing, the background score and the usage of mist to add an element of mystery but bemoaned the presence of loopholes in the plotline, dented screenplay, rushed episodes and the unnecessary cliffhanger at the climax.

title: Kaakee Circus
summary: Kaakee Circus is an Indian Tamil-language fantasy comedy-thriller web series written and directed by Ameen Barif. The series stars Munishkanth, Subash Selvam, and Rajesh Madhavan in lead roles. The seven-episode series is set to premier on 10 April 2026.
plot: Set in a sub-jail in a fictional coastal town, the story follows a book-loving jailer and an enthusiastic young constable. Their routine is disrupted when a mysterious and eccentric thief attempts an impossible feat: breaking into the high-security jail. The thief's objective is to steal a temple donation box stored within the premises, leading to a chaotic series of events involving the local police force and the town's residents.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was written and directed by Ameen Barif. During its early development stages, the project was titled Once Upon a Time in Kayamkulam before being officially renamed to Kaakee Circus.

episodesList.title: The Walls
episodesList.summary: In a faraway sub-jail, Constable Arjun struggles to manage thieves and learn the ways of the jail from Jailer Anbuselvan. Outside the jail, a mysterious break-in leads to chaos in the silent town.

episodesList.title: The Shadow of the Tree
episodesList.summary: Hari, a man in the village, witnesses disturbing signs and coincidences that trouble his family. Meanwhile, more unusual thefts rattle the town, making everyone suspect each other.

episodesList.title: Two Petty Thieves
episodesList.summary: Varghese, a coffin maker dealing with a troubled past and a failed marriage, becomes embroiled in the town's turmoil. Meanwhile, Arjun and Anbuselvan investigate the mystery of the undiyal money.

episodesList.title: The Passenger's Deception
episodesList.summary: Arjun’s suspicions shift with each individual he encounters. The missing funds from the jail, online rumours, and new clues assist in piecing together the puzzle, yet the mystery remains unresolved.

episodesList.title: Manoj's Yesterday
episodesList.summary: A closer look into the lives of the town’s residents reveals struggles that could have pushed them to steal. Arjun’s job becomes harder, as he can’t draw a line between the victim and the culprit.

episodesList.title: The Rising Heat
episodesList.summary: Arjun grows restless as the investigation leads to dead-ends and every clue comes with a twist. Anbuselvan urges him to be patient, but Arjun is confident the culprit is hiding in plain sight.

episodesList.title: The Escaping Shadow
episodesList.summary: Arjun gets closer to a breakthrough, but a series of incidents leave the case shattered. Anbuselvan questions his ideals, while Arjun doubts his abilities. Can the two find the culprit in time?

title: Kaptaan
summary:
Kaptaan is a 2026 Hindi-language crime, drama, thriller television series directed by Jatin Satish Wagle under banner of Baweja Studios. It stars Saqib Saleem, Anushka Kaushik, Arif Zakaria, Kavita Kaushik, Siddharth Nigam and Varun Badola in lead roles.
The series premiered on 3 April 2026 on Amazon MX Player.
reception: Abhishek Srivastava of The Times of India rated the series 3.5/5 and writes "Some plot points raise questions and feel poorly thought out." Sriva A of Moneycontrol writes "Certain plot points stretch logic, particularly when a key informer is exposed and killed, yet the sharp-minded officer at the center fails to connect the dots." A reviewer from Aaj Tak rated the series 2.5/5.

title: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain
wikiTitle: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain
summary: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain (transl. Because The Forms of Relationships Change Too) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that premiered on Star Plus on 20 March 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms, it is a spin-off of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 and stars Tanisha Mehta and Rohit Suchanti in lead roles.
plot: Angad and Vrinda Virani start off on a secret mission in Jamshedpur after they send their kids to boarding school.
reception: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain was in the second position of BARC rating list in its launch week with a TRP of 1.9 and had a reach of 2.3 million impressions and in the third position in its second week of week 12. The show fell to sixth position in week 13. In week 14, the show ranked at fifth place and recorded a 1.7 TRP and 2.3 TVR. In May, it maintained a rating of 1.4 and continued to be in top 10 shows. The series saw a decline in ratings and got a 1.2 TVR at ninth place in week 21 of June 2026.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Following a positive response to the reboot version, a separate storyline featuring Angad and Vrinda, initially as an extension of Kyunki Saas... , was launched which was telecasted in the later part of the episodes.
It was rumoured that the show would eventually replace the parent series. However, the channel debunked these rumours by issuing an official statement clarifying that the claims were false and that Kyunki Saas... was not ending anytime soon.
Amid rumours surrounding a proposed spin-off of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, along with the circulation of unauthorised promotional content suggesting her involvement, Smriti Irani issued a legal warning against the misuse of her name and image. Irani clarified that she is not involved in any such project.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Rohit Suchanti and Tanisha Mehta initially entered the spin-off as Angad and Vrinda under secret identities while investigating issues at the Jamshedpur plant. Kushagre Dua was signed to play the negative lead, Vikrant Thakur, while Pradeep Singh Toor joined the cast in a pivotal role as a factory worker. In April 2026, Tanish Mahendru re-entered the series as Ranvijay. Later, Aman Gandhi, Prachi Singh, Shriya Tiwari, and Navein Prakash joined the spin-off, reprising their respective roles from the original series. In June 2026, Shakti Anand and Prachi Kowli, portraying Advocate Hemant and Pooja Virani respectively, also shifted to the show.
In July 2026, the show took a leap of 10 years along with the parent show. Gaurav S Bajaj joined the show to portray Mr. Kartik Patel, a businessman opposite Tanisha Mehta. Het Thakkar was cast as grown-up Akshay Virani. Barkha Bisht returned to the spin-off as Noina.
In August 2026, Aman Gandhi who played Hritik Virani, left the show as well as the parent show Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 for his new project. Actor Shubh Karaan Bhopal was then cast to replace Gandhi as Hritik. In mid-August 2026, Aditya Khurana joined the show as Gopu Gokhale.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain was in the second position of BARC rating list in its launch week with a TRP of 1.9 and had a reach of 2.3 million impressions and in the third position in its second week of week 12. The show fell to sixth position in week 13. In week 14, the show ranked at fifth place and recorded a 1.7 TRP and 2.3 TVR. In May, it maintained a rating of 1.4 and continued to be in top 10 shows. The series saw a decline in ratings and got a 1.2 TVR at ninth place in week 21 of June 2026.

episodesList.title: A New Path for Angad, Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad get emotional after leaving Akshay and Madhavi at the boarding school. Vrinda enters the Jamshedpur plant as the new boss. How will their new beginnings unfold?

episodesList.title: Mangal Strikes Angad
episodesList.summary: Mangal, in anger, hits Angad when he stops him from teasing Bharati. After some time, Bharati assures Angad that she will help him get a job in the factory.

episodesList.title: Angad's Tough Choice
episodesList.summary: Vrinda informs Angad that Vikrant expelled Nandu from the factory for allegedly stealing money. Soon, Biku Dada agrees to help Angad get a job if he strikes Vrinda with a stone.

episodesList.title: Nandu Confronts Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda agree to endure personal pain to prevent further factory losses. Nandu questions Angad for hitting Vrinda and risking their jobs.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Recruits Angad
episodesList.summary: Vrinda hires Angad to work at the factory. Meanwhile, Bharati spins a story about being with him, as Biku Dada and others question Angad about his whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Angad And Vrinda Caught Together
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda sneak out to meet Akshay and Madhavi at their boarding school and get emotional. On their way back to Jamshedpur, Biku Dada catches them together in the car.

episodesList.title: Ram Navami Preparations
episodesList.summary: Vrinda covers up smoothly and brings everyone together for Ram Navami celebrations. The chit system for Ram and Sita roles surprises all by making Angad Ram.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Share a Moment
episodesList.summary: Among the factory workers and management, discussions continue about the Ram Navami celebration play. Angad sneaks into Vrinda's room, sharing a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Bharati Shares Her Wish with Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad grows anxious as Bharati reveals her intentions to become Sita, and he asks Vrinda to help. The next morning, Angad and Vrinda are disguised as Ram and Sita.

episodesList.title: Ram Navami at the Factory
episodesList.summary: Ram Navami celebrations begin as Angad and Vrinda enter the factory dressed as Ram and Sita. Soon, Nandu reveals that someone is stealing stock from the factory.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Suspects Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Mangal accuses Angad of the factory scam and joining hands with the management. Meanwhile, Vrinda doubts Vikrant as the factory CCTV footage is deleted.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Hidden Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Bharati grows suspicious about Vrinda calling Angad late at night. Elsewhere, Vikrant secretly plots to become Viranis' son-in-law.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Faces a Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is shattered on realising she missed her daughter's birthday. Bharati confronts Angad over his hidden link, while Madhavi's sudden arrival leaves them panicked.

episodesList.title: Bharati Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Bharati's unannounced visit and probing questions unsettle Vrinda. Angad and Vrinda put on a front to dismiss her suspicions and share a brief birthday moment for Madhavi.

episodesList.title: Angad Under Bharati's Scrutiny
episodesList.summary: Vrinda appreciates Angad's smart handling of the situation. Bharati digs deeper into his hidden link, her growing obsession revealing a disturbing intensity.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Confession to Angad
episodesList.summary: Bharati admits her love for Angad, making Mangal furious. Later, Angad tries to talk to Vrinda about Bharati, but finds her busy with work.

episodesList.title: Angad's Compelled Choice
episodesList.summary: To save his job, Angad agrees to marry Bharati at Biku Dada's insistence. Bharati celebrates while Angad feels torn as he thinks about Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Bharati Faces Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad has a frightening dream of Vrinda's outburst upon learning that Bharati loves him. He then tries to explain to Bharati that he can't reciprocate her feelings.

episodesList.title: Angad Fears for Bharati
episodesList.summary: Angad stresses about Bharati's false hopes of marrying him. Soon after, Vrinda grows anxious about Angad's whereabouts and goes to meet him.

episodesList.title: Mangal Strikes a Deal
episodesList.summary: Vrinda urges Angad to obtain workers' signatures on a memorandum of understanding. Mangal demands an advance bonus in exchange for signing the agreement.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Doubts Angad's Intentions
episodesList.summary: Angad chooses duty over power, but a small moment creates big doubts in Vrinda's heart. As she distances herself, Vikrant steps in and changes everything.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Shocking Offer to Mangal
episodesList.summary: Angad grows insecure when Vikrant holds Vrinda's hand, and he alerts her. Then, Bharati pressures Mangal to sign the memorandum, promising to marry him in return.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Bharati's gesture sparks a misunderstanding, leaving Vrinda heartbroken, and she shuts Angad out. When Angad secretly sneaks in, Vikrant's claim about a thief adds tension.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Probes Workers
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad feel insecure and confront each other over their concerns. Vikrant investigates the workers to identify who sneaked into Vrinda's house the previous day.

episodesList.title: Bharati Saves Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad is caught injured, but Bharati saves him with a quick cover-up. Mangal talks to Biku Dada about his wedding with Bharati, while she denies it.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Heart Breaks in Silence
episodesList.summary: As Biku Dada announces Angad and Bharati's roka, Vrinda is left heartbroken watching it unfold. But Angad's bold refusal sparks hope, as he promises to set things right.

episodesList.title: Trouble Deepens for Angad
episodesList.summary: A wrong call to Malti lands Angad in deeper chaos as he seeks her help to fix things. Vrinda faces a shocking situation at the empty factory and is disheartened.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Heartbreak at Angad's Roka
episodesList.summary: Vrinda walks into Angad's Roka and agrees to stay as family, hiding her pain. But as the ceremony unfolds, seeing Angad with Bharati together breaks her completely.

episodesList.title: Angad and Bharati's Roka Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is left shattered when she's asked to perform the Roka rituals for Angad and Bharati. Malti questions Angad about the sudden alliance, and he seeks her support.

episodesList.title: Angad's Heartfelt Apology to Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Realising it was his and Vrinda's anniversary, Angad buys a cake and goes to her place. He apologises, but Vrinda remains upset over his Roka ceremony with Bharati.

episodesList.title: Bharati Stands Up for Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad tells Vrinda about import and export activities at the factory. Bharati defends Angad when Vikrant accuses him of hurting the watchman.

episodesList.title: Ranvijay's Shocking Entry
episodesList.summary: Angad shares last night's truth with Biku Dada as his engagement with Bharati is finalised. Tension rises when Vrinda and Angad see Ranvijay at the factory.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Uncover the Plot
episodesList.summary: Biku Dada rushes preparations for Angad's and Bharati's engagement. Meanwhile, Vrinda and Angad uncover Mangal's link to Ranvijay, raising suspicions.

episodesList.title: Bharati Plays a Smart Move
episodesList.summary: Angad tries to convince Bharati to cancel the engagement, but things don't go as planned. Bharati secretly takes matters into her hands by sharing Malti's number with Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Bharati Stunned by Vrinda's Actions
episodesList.summary: Angad calls Mangal from another phone, urging him to stop his wedding to Bharati. He tries to cover up when questioned by Bharati, who is shocked to see Vrinda caring for Angad.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Plan Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Bharati invites Vrinda to her engagement with Angad. Angad confirms his intent to marry Bharati. Meanwhile, Vrinda plots to ruin the engagement by exiting Jamshedpur.

episodesList.title: Angad and Bharati Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Angad secretly slips out of his engagement to meet Vrinda, unaware that she has met with a tragic accident. He returns and gets engaged with Bharati while Malti arrives.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada Is Stunned by Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Malti plants fear in Biku Dada's mind, claiming that Angad is Manglik, risking Bharati's life. Vrinda arrives injured and is devastated to learn about the engagement.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Guides Angad
episodesList.summary: The priest advises Angad to marry a tree first to cleanse his sins. Hrithik informs Angad that Ranvijay is involved in factory scams with the help of the management.

episodesList.title: Angad Reassures Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad asks Vrinda to trust him one last time so he can expose the factory scam. Angad secretly regrets hurting Vrinda by marrying Bharati.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Tracks the Factory Scam
episodesList.summary: After the watchman alerts Vrinda, she uncovers leads about the factory scam. Malti plans to break Angad and Bharati's wedding by demanding dowry from Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Malti's Plan Crumbles
episodesList.summary: Malti's plan backfires as Biku Dada decides to sell his property to fund Bharati's dowry. Vrinda confides in Angad about following the consignment to reach the scammer.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Record Mangal's Con
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad follow Mangal as he deals with stolen factory goods and record the scam. Vrinda confronts Mangal about the scam, but he stands fearless against her.

episodesList.title: Ranvijay Trapped by Angad-Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Ranvijay confronts Vrinda and threatens her to delete his video. Angad steps in to protect her and Ranvijay is stunned when Angad presents solid proof exposing his crimes.

episodesList.title: Angad's Ultimatum to Ranvijay
episodesList.summary: Angad demands that Ranvijay transfer all his shares to Virani Industries. Meanwhile, Hrithik passionately insists that Vrinda keep her shares, declaring them her rightful due.

episodesList.title: Mangal Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: While the police arrive to arrest Mangal, Biku Dada fumes at Mangal for creating a scam. Angad and Vrinda decide to reveal the truth about their relationship to Biku Dada.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada's Critical Condition
episodesList.summary: Bharati is devastated as Biku Dada suffers a heart attack and needs urgent surgery. She struggles to stay strong while Vrinda and Angad are shocked to find an unexpected note.

episodesList.title: Biku Dada's Sudden Demise
episodesList.summary: As Biku Dada's condition turns critical, Bharati reveals his last wish to see her married to Angad. Angad fulfils the ritual in the hospital, and Biku Dada passes away.

episodesList.title: Angad Performs the Final Rites
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is shocked to see Bharati with sindoor and tells Malti about it. Angad performs Biku Dada's final rituals, leaving Bharati emotionally broken.

episodesList.title: Angad Loses Vrinda's Trust
episodesList.summary: Vikrant warns employees that Angad is becoming the workers' union leader. Meanwhile, Angad tries to convince Vrinda that he did not apply vermilion to Bharati's hair.

episodesList.title: Angad Struggles to Reveal the Truth
episodesList.summary: Determined to end the confusion, Angad decides to finally confess the truth to Bharati, with Malti supporting him. Meanwhile, the workers decide to make Angad their union leader.

episodesList.title: Angad Fights for Justice
episodesList.summary: All the factory workers protest for injured Lalan. Angad demands Vrinda compensate him and boldly accuses Vikrant of mismanagement as tensions erupt at the factory gates.

episodesList.title: Angad Leads a Hunger Strike
episodesList.summary: Angad demands compensation for Lallan, but Vrinda's harsh behaviour sparks tension between them. As Vikrant fuels the conflict, Angad takes a bold step by leading a hunger strike.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Caught in Emotional Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Vrinda worries about Angad and the differences between them as he sits on a hunger strike. Malti urges Angad to resolve his issues with Vrinda and reveal the truth to Bharati.

episodesList.title: Bharati Saves Angad from Jail
episodesList.summary: The workers continue their strike as the police arrive to arrest Angad, leaving tensions at the factory. Bharati arranges Angad's bail, and after his release, he confronts Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Suspects Vrinda's Truth
episodesList.summary: Stunned by learning about Vrinda's pregnancy, Vikrant decides to uncover the truth. Elsewhere, Vrinda urges Angad to confess everything to Bharati before complications arise.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Under Secret Trail
episodesList.summary: As Vikrant questions Vrinda about the school invitation, she grows anxious. To uncover the truth, Vikrant and Bharati secretly follow Vrinda and Angad to the school.

episodesList.title: The Clever Catch: Angad and Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns that Vrinda is married, and Bharati is shocked that Angad already has a wife. Vrinda and Angad sense that Vikrant and Bharati are suspicious of them.

episodesList.title: Bharati Confronts Angad
episodesList.summary: Angad apologises to Vrinda for his past mistakes and plans to reveal the truth at the factory. Bharati fiercely questions Angad about his wife, already knowing the truth.

episodesList.title: Bharati Learns Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Vrinda confronts Vikrant for secretly following her, while Angad reveals the truth about his marriage to Vrinda. In a moment of rage, Bharati attacks Angad with a knife.

episodesList.title: Angad's True Identity Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Vrinda apologises to Bharati for hiding the truth and hurting her feelings. A shocker hits Vikrant and the workers when Vrinda reveals Angad's real identity.

episodesList.title: Bharati Is Overwhelmed with Emotion
episodesList.summary: As Nandu declines the union leader role, Vrinda and Angad suggest that Bharati take it up. Devastated, Bharati misses Biku Dada and recalls their past moments together.

episodesList.title: Angad Exposes the Real Culprit
episodesList.summary: Vrinda backs Bharati as the new union leader but falls ill, and Vikrant rushes her to the doctor. Meanwhile, Angad investigates the missing bank papers and uncovers the culprit.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Walks Free by Blame Game
episodesList.summary: Vikrant frames Suresh for fraud and pretends to be emotional in front of Vrinda and Angad. Angad loses his temper and fires the women spreading gossip about Vrinda and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Angad Fires Vikrant
episodesList.summary: A sweet moment between Angad and Vrinda turns tense as she feels dizzy. Vikrant records before Angad gets furious at him and dismisses him from his job.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad's Heated Argument
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Angad and Vrinda clash over Vikrant's removal from the job. After a while, gossip about Vrinda's pregnancy leaves Angad disturbed.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Move Angers Angad!
episodesList.summary: DGP Sangram storms into the factory to arrest Angad for firing Vikrant unfairly. Angad gets furious after Vrinda takes Vikrant back on the job.

episodesList.title: Bharati Guides Angad
episodesList.summary: Vrinda resigns from the company, while Bharati advises Angad to support her. Everyone at the factory eagerly awaits who Angad will choose to replace Vrinda's position.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Surprise Plan for Angad
episodesList.summary: Vrinda agrees to Vikrant's idea of planning Angad's birthday surprise, unaware of his motives. Mangal reveals Vikrant's role in the factory loss, raising Angad's doubts.

episodesList.title: Angad's Special Birthday Bash
episodesList.summary: Vrinda surprises Angad with a birthday celebration, making him happy. During the dance, Kripa intentionally pushes Vrinda onto Vikrant, causing chaos at the party.

episodesList.title: Angad Hides the Truth from Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad convinces Vrinda to repeat her tests as he struggles with the burden of hiding the truth about the paternity test from her. He gets the test done and breaks down emotionally.

episodesList.title: Angad Faces an Emotional Storm
episodesList.summary: Angad struggles to process the shocking paternity test results. Mangal and Vikrant are pleased as their plan succeeds, and Vikrant reveals how he altered the reports.

episodesList.title: Angad's Hidden Test Shocks Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad shares the test report with Bharati, while a voice note of Vikrant's and Vrinda's conversation fumes him. Shocked to learn about the paternity test, Vrinda confronts Angad.

episodesList.title: Trust Breaks Between Angad, Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Angad confronts Vrinda with evidence against her, but she insists it is false and pleads her case. Overwhelmed by doubt, Angad breaks down before Bharati.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Seeks Vikrant's Help
episodesList.summary: Vrinda confides in Vikrant about the fake voice recording and seeks his support. However, Angad learns the truth from Vikrant, deepening his pain and triggering a confrontation.

episodesList.title: Angad's Demand Sparks a Clash
episodesList.summary: Angad demands that Vrinda abort her pregnancy, sparking a bitter clash. As guilt and memories haunt him, Angad confronts Mangal over the voice recording.

episodesList.title: Angad and Vrinda Seek Separation
episodesList.summary: A misunderstanding surrounding a lawyer's visit pushes Angad and Vrinda closer to divorce. Their lives take an unexpected turn when Hrithik and Munni suddenly arrive.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad's Secret Exposed
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda perform the pooja at the factory, but their strained behaviour raises suspicions. Angad walks away in the middle of the pooja and reveals the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Rebukes Angad
episodesList.summary: Hrithik condemns Angad for making allegations against Vrinda. Meanwhile, Vrinda confides in Munni and Saloni about her pain and her decision to separate from Angad.

episodesList.title: Will Angad, Vrinda Reconcile?
episodesList.summary: Angad and Vrinda get into a heated argument about their chaotic relationship. Munni and Hrithik discuss how to stop Vrinda and Angad's fight and bring them closer together.

episodesList.title: Munni's Lie Hurts Vrinda
episodesList.summary: After learning about Munni's lie, an upset Vrinda confronts her. Later, Munni and Hrithik urge Vrinda and Angad to attend the awards for the company's reputation.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Wins a Prestigious Award
episodesList.summary: Vrinda receives the Business Entrepreneur Award and credits Angad for her success. However, Angad shocks everyone by refusing to pose for a media photo.

episodesList.title: Hrithik's Advice to Angad
episodesList.summary: Hrithik counsels Angad to give Vrinda a second chance and rebuild their bond. Elsewhere, Vikrant begins his plan to create rifts between Vrinda and Angad.

episodesList.title: Dev Fumes at Shaloni
episodesList.summary: Dev vents his frustration about their relationship to Shaloni. Angad and Vrinda reassure a frightened Akshay that Dev and Shaloni will not get divorced.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda's Divorce Crisis
episodesList.summary: A nostalgic moment brings joy to Vrinda and Angad, but reality soon hits. Soon, divorce papers arrive, leaving Akshay and Madhavi devastated.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad worry as Akshay and Madhavi go missing. Seizing the opportunity, Vikrant decides to use Akshay and Madhavi to deepen the rift between Vrinda and Angad.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda Reconcile
episodesList.summary: Bharati recounts how she found Akshay and Madhavi. Angad and Vrinda decide to stay together for Akshay and Madhavi and promise Akshay they will not divorce.

episodesList.title: Hemant Chooses Vrinda to Lead
episodesList.summary: Hrithik announces the client's confirmation of the order, sparking celebrations. Soon, Hemant's arrival delights the family as he entrusts the project responsibility to Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Trapped in a Room
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda goes to the storeroom for files, Vikrant has Kripa lock it. Then, Angad saves Vrinda from falling, only to find they are stuck inside the room together.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Plan for Angad Backfires
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's attempt to create doubts in Angad about Vrinda fails when he finds them together. Meanwhile, Munni confronts Kripa for locking the storeroom.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Bags a Business Deal
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise when Angad criticises Vrinda's designs as middle-class during a meeting. Determined to prove herself, she impresses the client and locks the deal.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Dazzles Amid Chaos
episodesList.summary: Trouble brews for Vrinda at the launch event when the models fail to show up. Amid the crisis, Vrinda dazzles in a showstopper bridal outfit, but Vikrant's move creates chaos.

episodesList.title: Pooja Surprises the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Pooja pays a surprise visit to the Viranis, while a drunk Angad clashes with Vrinda over Vikrant. Dev taking money from the office without making an entry leads to conflicts.

episodesList.title: Hemant Slams Angad
episodesList.summary: Hemant confronts Angad for doubting Vrinda. Hrithik urges Munni to prioritise her health, while Pooja stops Hemant from revealing Angad and Vrinda's issues to Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Munni and Saloni's Bond
episodesList.summary: Munni, Vrinda, and Saloni embrace, reaffirming their friendship with a promise of support. Five months later, Angad consults a lawyer about divorcing Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Arrives for Her Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: As the family prepares for Vrinda's baby shower, Angad returns home drunk. While Nitin and Supriya celebrate the baby's arrival, Munni lovingly prepares Timsi for the newborn.

episodesList.title: Tension Rises at the Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: The family celebrates the baby shower of Vrinda, Munni, and Saloni with joyful rituals. While everyone enjoys the celebrations, Vikrant arrives and Angad grows aggressive.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Hides Dev's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad tells his lawyer that he wants to cancel his divorce from Vrinda. Dev fears his factory theft will be exposed, but Vikrant hides the truth from the family.

episodesList.title: Angad Sees The Truth?
episodesList.summary: Vrinda questions Vikrant about Kripa's pregnancy, but Dev secretly records their conversation. He later uses the video to drive a wedge between Angad and Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Angad, Vrinda's Rift Deepens
episodesList.summary: Influenced by Parth's words, Dev stirs Angad's distress. Vrinda's joy fades as Angad confronts her, showing a video of her and Vikrant, and Kripa's move leaves her stunned.

episodesList.title: Virani Bahus in Trouble!
episodesList.summary: An emergency forces Hemant and Pooja to leave for Mumbai. The Virani Bahus struggle through labour pains, with no one present to come to their aid.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Destiny Takes a Dark Turn
episodesList.summary: Hrithik is overwhelmed as he meets Munni and their baby, while Dev and Saloni cherish their newborn. The family's joy ends as the doctor reveals Vrinda's baby couldn't be saved.

episodesList.title: The Virani Bahus Hide a Big Secret
episodesList.summary: The Virani bahus secretly exchange their newborns and vow to keep the truth hidden. As the family celebrates the babies' arrival, Vrinda accuses Angad of pushing her.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: After signing the divorce papers with Angad, Vrinda resigns from the factory. However, before leaving the house, she confronts Kripa over her betrayal.

episodesList.title: Angad Confronts Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Angad hits Vikrant for driving a wedge between him and Vrinda. Later, Vrinda receives Angad's letter stating he is leaving and has transferred all his property to her name.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Shapes Aarav's Values
episodesList.summary: Hemant requests Vrinda to stay back for the sake of the children, while Angad regrets his actions. Ten years later, Vrinda nurtures Aarav with family values and bonds with him.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Digital Dream
episodesList.summary: As Madhavi aspires to pursue a career in content creation, Akshay and Vrinda insist that she prioritise her studies. Then, Hemant introduces the Virani family members to Karthik.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Priyanka grows anxious about her wedding alliance with Karthik, and the family try to calm her. The family are shocked when Karthik reveals he likes Vrinda, not Priyanka.

episodesList.title: Timsi, Madhavi on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Hemant tries to convince Vrinda to marry Karthik, while Timsi and Madhavi secretly call Karthik to learn more about him. Dev tells Saloni that Karthik would benefit his business.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Business Deal with Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Hemant tells Vrinda that Karthik is coming to the office for a client meeting. Impressed by Vrinda's presentation, Karthik looks forward to doing business with her.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Refuses Karthik's Invitation
episodesList.summary: Karthik invites Vrinda to the AV singing concert, but she refuses. Vrinda later tells Hemant that Karthik offered them the tickets to help coordinate their business deal.

episodesList.title: Karthik Cares for Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Hrithik insists that Vrinda keep her professional and personal life separate. Karthik urges the management to provide excellent care and hospitality for Vrinda and her family.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for the Viranis
episodesList.summary: The Viranis arrive at AV's concert, unaware that the performer is Angad. They are later stunned when Karthik introduces Noina as his business associate.

episodesList.title: Angad's Presence Felt by Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Vrinda senses Angad's presence when AV offers her tissues, awakening old emotions. Hemant tells Dev they'll cut ties with Karthik's firm if Noina is involved in business.

episodesList.title: Akshay Spots Angad?
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda feels pain in AV's voice, Akshay catches a glimpse of a man and suspects he is Angad. Moments later, a fight breaks out, leaving Akshay injured.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Ultimatum to Karthik
episodesList.summary: Angad disguises himself as a doctor to escape the hospital. Hemant tells Karthik he can't do business with him if Noina is involved, deepening the rift.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Plot for Vrinda
episodesList.summary: For Vrinda's sake, Hemant strikes a business deal with Karthik. He and Dev scheme to bring Vrinda and Karthik closer, hoping for their reconciliation.

episodesList.title: AV Steals Vrinda's Credit
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is shocked to hear AV singing her song on the FM that she wrote online. When she demands credit, her voice is drowned out as everyone turns against her and blindly supports AV.

episodesList.title: Hrithik's Thankful Heart with Munni
episodesList.summary: Grateful for Munni's unwavering support, Hrithik finds solace in her understanding. Hemant's frustration boils over as he's seated with Noina at the business table.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Secret Attraction
episodesList.summary: As Karthik pampers Aarav and steals glances at Vrinda, he begins falling for her. Meanwhile, Munni teaches Timsi an important lesson in kindness after she misbehaves with a waiter.

episodesList.title: Timsi Praises Munni
episodesList.summary: Timsi opens up to Vrinda about feeling grateful to have Munni as her mother. As the business meeting falls flat, Karthik joins everyone in a dance to lift the mood.

episodesList.title: Mitali Insults Vrinda
episodesList.summary: AV faces questions about stealing song lyrics in an interview. Mitali accuses Vrinda of cheating on Angad and poisons Karthik's mind against Vrinda's family.

episodesList.title: Vikas Seeks Angad's Truth
episodesList.summary: Angad reads an online poem written by Vrinda, unaware of its author. Meanwhile, Vikas urges Angad to reveal his true identity instead of hiding behind the masked AV persona.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's New Assignment
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is asked to accompany Karthik to Delhi for a business meeting, while Mitali lures Dev into turning against Vrinda. Vikas insists Angad head to Delhi for his concert.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Cross Paths
episodesList.summary: Vrinda leaves for Delhi with Karthik after arranging donations for an orphanage. At the hotel, she unknowingly returns Angad's lost bracelet as they stay under the same roof.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Is Annoyed by AV's Music
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Timsi that Vrinda deserves better than Karthik. Elsewhere, Vrinda discovers AV is staying in the room next to hers and leaves him a note slamming his music.

episodesList.title: Karthik Gets Love Advice
episodesList.summary: Unaware of each other's connection to Vrinda, Angad encourages Karthik to confess his love at AV's concert. Meanwhile, Karthik plans to accompany Vrinda to the NGO.

episodesList.title: Karthik Proposes Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Dev and Mitali discuss the scheme they carried out against Vrinda. At AV's concert, Karthik proposes to Vrinda, but tension rises as the police arrive to arrest Vrinda.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Lands Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is arrested on money laundering charges, leaving the Virani family shocked. While Hemant stands by her, Noina forces Karthik to choose between her and the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Hemant Seeks Noina's Help
episodesList.summary: Noina agrees to help Hemant examine the accounts to trace the scammer. Mitali taunts Vrinda in jail, while Angad misses Vrinda and senses her presence around him.

episodesList.title: Karthik Proves Vrinda's Innocence
episodesList.summary: The Viranis await Vrinda's court hearing as Hemant and Noina fail to find any evidence. Meanwhile, Karthik uncovers crucial proof, secures Vrinda's release, and brings her home.

episodesList.title: Vrinda accepts Karthik's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Urged by her family, Vrinda accepts Karthik's proposal for the sake of her children. As the Viranis prepare for their engagement, Angad silently struggles with his emotions.

episodesList.title: Vrinda's Emotional Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Karthik invites Mitali to his engagement, leaving her stunned. As the families prepare for the ceremony, Vrinda struggles to move on from Angad and embrace her new future.

episodesList.title: Angad Shocks the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Karthik's engagement takes a dramatic turn when Angad arrives unexpectedly and reveals his identity. His sudden appearance leaves everyone stunned and Vrinda furious.

episodesList.title: Aarav's Request to AV
episodesList.summary: Angad struggles to hide his emotions as memories of Vrinda overwhelm him. Meanwhile, Aarav requests AV to stay and sing a song for the celebration.

episodesList.title: Karthik and Vrinda's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Angad is heartbroken as he watches Vrinda and Karthik exchange rings at the engagement. Sensing Vrinda's sadness, Karthik gently asks what's troubling her and offers comfort.

episodesList.title: Karthik Comforts Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Karthik comforts Vrinda as she admits she cannot move on from Angad. Later, Vrinda accuses AV of stealing the lyrics and using it under his name for the concert.

episodesList.title: Akshay Opens Up to AV
episodesList.summary: Gopu's words leave Akshay worried about losing Vrinda after her marriage to Karthik. Later, Akshay tells AV about the happy family he once had with Vrinda, Angad and Madhavi.

episodesList.title: Karthik's Offer to AV
episodesList.summary: As Vrinda struggles to move on after her engagement, Angad silently reads her emotional post. Soon, Karthik plans to sign AV as the company's international brand ambassador.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Stands by AV in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Vrinda defends AV amid public protests over the alleged theft of lyrics. Meanwhile, Noina opposes Karthik's decision to appoint AV as his company's brand ambassador.

episodesList.title: AV Signs Karthik's Contract
episodesList.summary: Hemant schemes to exploit AV's unyielding honesty for their latest brand strategy. Binding his fate to Karthik's empire, AV signs the fateful ambassador contract.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Suspects AV Is Angad
episodesList.summary: After chatting with AV online, Vrinda grows suspicious when his actions remind her of Angad. Her doubts intensify when she notices familiar traits and follows him.

episodesList.title: Mitali's Strategy Fails
episodesList.summary: Vrinda is stunned to learn that AV isn't Angad, while Mitali tries to turn Karthik against her. Later, Vrinda comforts Akshay after his exam is cancelled.

episodesList.title: Viranis Panic Over Missing Kids
episodesList.summary: The Viranis panic when Akshay, Madhavi and Timsi go missing, unaware that they are at a college protest. Meanwhile, the family searches nearby and contacts their friends.

episodesList.title: AV Admires Akshay
episodesList.summary: Akshay opens up to AV about his sacrifices, gaining heartfelt appreciation. As protests spiral into chaos, Vrinda frantically searches for Akshay, Madhavi, and Timsy.

episodesList.title: Vrinda, Angad Chat Anonymously
episodesList.summary: Vrinda and Angad talk online using different names, unaware of each other's identities. Later, Saloni grows concerned as Vrinda becomes overprotective of Aarav.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Brings AV Just in Time
episodesList.summary: Vrinda brings AV to the press conference, raising questions about how she found him. As Angad thanks her for saving the day, they get trapped together in a lift.

episodesList.title: Karthik Confronts the Media
episodesList.summary: Karthik fumes at the media for spreading rumors about AV and Vrinda's relationship. Angad apologises on Karthik's behalf and manages to control the situation.

episodesList.title: Angad Sets Out to Expose Karthik
episodesList.summary: Angad grows suspicious of Karthik and decides to expose his true intentions to Vrinda. Meanwhile, Saloni confronts Vrinda for making her insecure about Aarav's upbringing.

episodesList.title: Karthik Seeks Vrinda's Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Karthik apologises to Vrinda, who confronts him about his insecurities, reminding her of Angad. Elsewhere, Mitali asks Dev to deliver a saree to Karthik.

episodesList.title: Karthik Faces a Crucial Task
episodesList.summary: Noina urges Karthik to recheck the crucial Ranchi files before the business meeting. Meanwhile, Dev advises him to impress Vrinda with a special date and a saree.

episodesList.title: Karthik Invites Vrinda for Dinner
episodesList.summary: Karthik's romantic dinner invitation surprises Vrinda, who agrees to meet him. Meanwhile, Mitali's decision to wear Vrinda's saree creates an unexpected twist.

episodesList.title: Noina, Hemant Face Hotel Trouble
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are stunned to see Mitali and Karthik together, leaving Vrinda heartbroken. Meanwhile, Noina and Hemant struggle after being forced to stay at a low-rated hotel.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Returns the Ring
episodesList.summary: Karthik struggles to prove his innocence to Vrinda, but the Viranis accuse him of misbehaving with Vrinda. Heartbroken, Vrinda returns his engagement ring.

episodesList.title: AV Withdraws The Contract
episodesList.summary: Karthik informs Hemant and Noina that AV has withdrawn from the brand deal, shocking everyone. Meanwhile, Vrinda confronts AV, but he refuses to reconsider his decision.

episodesList.title: Dev Disguises Himself as AV
episodesList.summary: With AV refusing to attend the launch, Dev secretly disguises himself as him. However, the media soon exposes the deception, leaving the Viranis in chaos.

episodesList.title: Angad's Hurtful Realisation
episodesList.summary: Angad sneaks into Vrinda's room and then feels hurt, thinking Madhavi and Akshay have lost respect for him. Later, at the family's request, Vrinda agrees to go shopping.

episodesList.title: Mitali Belittles Vrinda
episodesList.summary: Karthik introduces Vrinda to clients, while Mitali spills juice on Vrinda and insults her. Aarav expresses his interest in music, but Dev opposes his choice.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Discovers AV's Mask
episodesList.summary: Timsi and Madhavi tamper with Mitali's makeup, leaving her furious. Later, Vrinda discovers AV's mask in her room while she shuts Mitali down with a befitting reply in the meeting.

episodesList.title: Vrinda Confronts AV

title: Kasaragod Embassy
summary: Kasaragod Embassy is a 2026 Indian Malayalam-language crime thriller web series directed by Atish and written by Heeraj. Produced by Uma Nir under the Legendary Movies banner, the series features Kabir Duhan Singh and Sudheesh in prominent roles. The seven-episode series premiered as a ZEE5 Original on 20 March 2026.
plot: Set in the late 2000s in the coastal town of Kasaragod, the story follows two cousins, Azi and Chemmu, who are living in extreme poverty. In a desperate attempt to improve their financial situation, they are lured into an illegal passport forgery and gold smuggling racket operated by their uncle, Razak Mama. As they descend deeper into the criminal underworld controlled by a powerful figure named Dammanna, the duo faces escalating moral dilemmas and life-threatening consequences.
reception:
Sreejith Mullapilly of The New Indian Express rated the series 1.5/5 stars, stating it "stereotypes Kasaragod and its people" and fails to immerse the audience in its world. While noting the novelty of a series about the fake passport business, Mullappilly found the execution "way off the mark" and noted that most of the cast appeared "way out of their depth" due to one-note writing.
Sreeju Sudhakaran of Rediff.com was highly critical, describing the show as "ineptly put-together" with "nothing redeemable." Sudhakaran criticized the weak writing and amateurish execution, noting that the series felt like a "poorly made YouTube sketch" that lacked the storytelling depth and technical proficiency seen in similar genre works like The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang.

title: Killadi Jodis
summary:
Killadi Jodis is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language celebrity stunt/dare-based reality television series based on the American series Fear Factor and  is part of Mr & Mrs Khiladis. It premiered on Zee Tamil on 25 January 2026 and aired on every Sunday at 20:30 and streams digitally on ZEE5. The show is hosted by Sanjeev Venkat.
The finale was held on 26 June 2026. The show's five finalist jodis are Karana and Indhu, Sangavi and Raanav, Thangapandi and Chandhini, Hamaranath and Gayathiri, and Yogesh and Myna Nandhini. The show was won by Hamarnath and Gayathri, and received 15 lakhs, while Yogesh and Myna Nandhini were the runner-up of the show. Several guests that were included in the grand finale are Baba Bhaskar and Alya Manasa. The show also celebrates 30 years of host Sanjeev Venkat.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text: The show is about 8 real and reel celebrity couples from television, cinema, and social media to face high-pressure situations that challenge their trust, strength, resilience, love and teamwork.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
It is an adaptation of Mr & Mrs Khiladis and was launched on 28 May 2016 . After the Single Pasanga show ended, Killadi Jodis began on 25 January 2026 as scheduled. On 5 January 2026, a first teaser was released on Zee Tamil's social media platforms.
The show host by actor Sanjeev Venkat, who returns to the small screen after an eight-year hiatus. This season was filmed and shot across spectacular international locations including Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Thailand, and the Maldives. On 22 February, the anchor Manimegalai was cast as special anchor for episode 5.

title: Kaalipotka
summary:
Kaalipotka is a 2026 Indian Bengali-language action thriller web series directed and written by Abhirup Ghosh. Produced by Edgy Entertainment, the series stars Swastika Mukherjee, Anirban Chakrabarti, Sreya Bhattacharya, Shruti Das, and Himika Bose in the lead roles. The series premiered on ZEE5 on 23 January 2026.
The series centres on four women from marginalised backgrounds whose lives intersect following an accidental death, leading them into a violent conflict involving organised crime and law enforcement.
plot: The narrative follows Srima, Rani, Rinku and Minoti—four women from disparate socio-economic backgrounds—who are drawn together by the accidental death of Minoti's husband. In their attempt to conceal the incident, they become entangled with Rana, a violent former convict, while simultaneously facing pressure from the local police. As events escalate, the women are forced to confront issues of power, survival and systemic exploitation.
reception:
Reviewing the series for The Times of India, Poorna Banerjee gave it 3.5 out of 5, remarking that the narrative loses momentum in its middle stretch but recovers toward the end. She described Kaalipotka as a compelling watch for audiences interested in bleak, female-centric storytelling.
Aratrika Dey of Ei Samay observed that the series is not without flaws, but highlighted its performances and language as key strengths, adding that its impact builds slowly over the course of the narrative.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was produced by Abhirup Ghosh under the banner of Edgy Entertainment. Principal photography was conducted in West Bengal, with Subhadeep Naskar serving as the director of cinematography. The title track, also titled Kaalipotka, features vocals by Jojo Mukherjee, along with rap performances by the lead actresses Swastika Mukherjee, Shruti Das, Himika Bose and Sreya Bhattacharya.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The official trailer of the series was released on 16 January 2026. Kaalipotka began streaming on ZEE5 from 23 January 2026.

title: Karma Korma
summary:
Karma Korma (transl. Karma Korma) is a 2025 Indian Bengali psychological culinary thriller web series directed by Pratim D. Gupta, in his directorial debut for a Bengali web series. Produced by Mahnedra Soni under the banner of Shree Venkatesh Films and Fish Curry Movies, the series stars Sohini Sarkar, Ritabhari Chakraborty and Ritwick Chakraborty in the lead roles.
The series revolves around a chef whose culinary expertise becomes a tool for delivering metaphorical justice and Karma to his guests. 22 Pally had composed the music and background score for the series. The cinematography was done by Prosenjit Chowdhury while Sanglap Bhowmik handled the editing. The series was released on 12 December 2025, on the Bengali OTT platform Hoichoi.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: Jhinuk is a dubbing artist. She belongs from a middle-class background and struggles with her alcoholic husband, Gopal. On the other hand, Shahana belongs from an affluent family but suffers from loneliness in her marriage. Jhinuk and Shahana met at a cooking workshop in Kolkata and slowly develop a close bond over shared recipes and domestic grievances. One day, in a moment of mutual frustration, they jokingly struck a deal to murder each other's husbands. This dark fantasy turned into a nightmare when Gopal was found dead on the street. Shahana claimed credit for the murder and demanded Jhinuk to honour their agreement by killing her husband, Arjun. As Jhinuk gets pushed to her limits, Inspector Bhupen Bhaduri begins investigation regarding the suspicious death. The series uses culinary metaphors that represent emotional manipulation and the inescapable cycle of karma.

articleSections.title: Announcement and development
articleSections.text:
Karma Korma was announced by Hoichoi as a part of its 2025 festive season releases, titled as "#UtshoberNotunGolpo", on 12 September 2025. Sohini Sarkar and Ritabhari Chakraborty were cast in the lead roles. The first look poster for the series was released on 14 November 2025. It revealed the characters played by Sarkar and Chakraborty. The second poster released from the series on 14 September 2025, revealed Ritwick Chakraborty in the role of a police inspector.
Ritabhari Chakraborty shared in an interview the brief that she got from the director — "Imagine Gayatri Devi’s grace paired with the psyche of a psychopath." She said that it was enough to make her agree to do the series. This marked Ritabhari's collaboration with Sohini, 15 years after the television soap opera Ogo Bodhu Shundori (2010).

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series was shot in the second half of 2025. The major part of the filming was done at Beliaghata in Kolkata. For Ritabhari's costumes, a lot of her personal sarees and jewellery were being used in the film for her role because she had a dressing sense similar to the character played by her in the series.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The teaser of Karma Korma was released on 22 November 2025 and the trailer was dropped on 1 September 2025. It was initially scheduled to be streamed on 5 December 2025. After being postponed for a week, the series was finally streamed on the Bengali OTT platform Hoichoi on 12 December 2025.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Agnivo Niyogi of The Telegraph reviewed the series and wrote "Karma Korma does not play by the established rules of the conventional Bengali web thriller. It borrows the ingredients — crime, revenge, broken marriages, and a police investigation — but cooks up a dish that feels fresh." He praised the balance between comedy and seriousness, the commanding performance by Ritabhari and Sohini, Ritwick's "unpredictable" acting, the cinematography, lighting and the curiosity being maintained till the last episode but bemoaned the fantasy sequences and imaginary scenarios.
Atreyee Poddar of Indulge Express reviewed the film and opined "Karma Korma doesn’t look or feel like standard hoichoi content. It’s restrained, uncomfortable, and quietly confident. Not perfect, but undeniably ambitious." She applauded Ritwick's calm intelligence and subtle authoritative presence in his silent moments, Ritabhari's restrained acting, Sohini's performance, the discomfort in the plot, the spaced writing, the end, the music and the purposeful occasionally misleading sound design.
Mimi Chakraborty reviewed the film on behalf of t2Online and noted "Karma Korma is a series that starts off with a gripping dramatic tension and gradually settles into a raw, grounded realism that almost feels too close to life." She praised the metaphorical usage of food as an emotional connector, the interplay between gastronomy and storytelling, Sohini's nuanced performance, Ritabhari's complex screen presence, Ritwick's unpredictability, the cinematography, climax, background score and the colour palette but bemoaned the over-stretched surveillance on Sohini's character during the investigation scenes and slow pace in the initial episodes.
A critic from Digit Binge rated the series 6.8/10 stars and highlighted "With Ritwick Chakraborty adding spice to this dangerous mix, Pratim D. Gupta serves a thriller where trust burns, emotions boil, and karma is cooked to perfection." Taslima Nasrin heavily criticized the series and quoted "Since when have Bengalis been making such low-quality movie series! Director Pratim D Gupta fed us Korma, Biryani, Rezala, Nihari, etc. one by one. I couldn't eat any of it. The spices were not mixed with the oil, the rice was not cooked, the meat was not boiled. Everything was raw. It is not right to start making movies or series with such raw hands. If you want to make Bengali culture delicious, cook it with seasoned hands."

title: Kammattam
summary: Kammattam is a 2025 Indian Malayalam-language crime thriller streaming television series directed by Shan Thulasidharan and starring Sudev Nair in the lead role. The series is produced for ZEE5 and is based on real events involving a large-scale financial scam in Thrissur.
plot: The series revolves around a shocking financial scam that unfolds in Thrissur. Sudev Nair plays the lead investigator who attempts to unravel the conspiracy and expose the truth behind the bank-linked crime.
reception:
Kammattam received mixed to positive reviews from critics. Performances and technical aspects were praised, while its rushed pacing and writing drew criticism.
The Indian Express rated the series 1.5 out of 5, describing it as "unpolished" with underwhelming visuals and flawed writing. The review argued that the series "never truly manages to make use of its premise and ends up as yet another inflated crime thriller that tries too hard to appear sleek," though Jeo Baby’s performance as Samuel was highlighted as a positive.
Bhawana Tanmayi of Moneycontrol wrote that "Kammattam has all it needs to be a good movie: a strong central case, a talented ensemble, and inspiration from real-life crime. But it doesn't stand out in Malayalam's already great criminal thriller scene because the tale is rushed and not very deep. Fans of the genre will like it once, but it doesn't live up to the standards set by its predecessors."
Shilpa Nair Anand of The Hindu said, "Kammattam is interesting, the series has all the elements of a thriller, and it works, largely. But there is something lacking, is it the pace or rather the quickness of it? You could probably still watch it for Sudev Nair’s performance, at the very least."
Firstpost remarked that the series "scores due to its performances" and appreciated its technical finesse, but observed that it could have delved deeper into the complexities of its central crime.
The Times of India described it as "a fair police drama that’s worth a one-time watch," commending its cinematography and mystery setup, while noting that the narrative became confusing towards the end due to an overload of villains.
OTTPlay rated the series 2.5 out of 5, describing it as brisk and watchable but "abrupt." The review appreciated Sudev Nair and Jeo Baby’s performances but noted that the rushed 11-day shoot may have compromised narrative cohesion.
Trisha Bhattacharya of Mint wrote that "despite a promising setup, the series doesn’t quite stick the landing. One of the most noticeable flaws is the camerawork—certain zoom-ins and angles feel abrupt and out of place, pulling the viewer out of the moment instead of drawing them in. These visual choices feel more distracting than deliberate."
Vishal Menon of The Hollywood Reporter India observed that "Kammattam could have benefited a lot from a minimal mood, depth for its characters and the patience to give their story the sprawl it demands."
Filmfare gave it 3 out of 5 stars, calling it "a taut, watchable crime procedural" with an effective central performance by Sudev Nair and strong production design. However, it also noted that the series sacrificed emotional resonance and moral exploration due to its fast pacing.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Director Shan Thulasidharan revealed that Kammattam was inspired by a true financial scam that took place in Thrissur.
In interviews, the director mentioned that the team deliberately took risks in terms of fast-paced filming to maintain authenticity and realism.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
Kammattam premiered on ZEE5 on 5 September 2025. The series was initially scheduled for 29 August but was postponed by a week.
The series has been described as ZEE5’s first Malayalam crime thriller series.

title: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2
wikiTitle: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2
summary:
Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 (transl. Because Even a Mother-in-Law Was a Daughter-in-Law Once 2) is an Indian Hindi-language television series premiered on 29 July 2025 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. It is a sequel and reboot of the Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi. Smriti Irani and Amar Upadhyay returned to portray the leads, Tulsi and Mihir Virani.
Following a positive response to the reboot version, a separate storyline featuring Angad and Vrinda, initially as an extension of Kyunki Saas... , was launched and subsequently developed into a standalone spin-off titled Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain.
plot:
''''
Twenty-five years later, Tulsi remembers Amba and Savita with fondness as Mihir gifts her a luxury car on their 38th anniversary. Mihir and Tulsi's children Gautam, Shobha and Karan have all shifted abroad. Karan, Nandini and Shobha visit for the anniversary party. Tulsi had adopted and raised her late cousin Kesar and her husband Anupam's children—Angad, Paridhi, and Hrithik. Mihir's aunt Daksha still loves gossiping about films. Mihir's other aunt, Gayatri, berates Tulsi and questions her son Hemant's place in the family. Later, Mihir and Tulsi celebrate their anniversary, where Mihir openly expresses his immense love for her.
Trouble begins when Paridhi confesses about her love-interest Ranvijay, who lives in a chawl and Mihir initially disapproves of him. While Angad is also arrested on charges of hit and run. Here enters Vrinda Gokhale, a girl from humble background who witnessed the actual accused Viren Mehta, a man who also beats his wife Sandhya Parekh. Vrinda helps Angad to prove his innocence by revealing about her brother Nitin being pressured to falsely accuse Angad which helps her land a job in wing managed by Angad. Soon Noina Sarabhai, an NRI businesswoman and Mihir's college friend enters and through her Paridhi marries Ajay Parekh, brother of Sandhya, when Ranvijay ditches her after the shares of Mihir's company dropped and the Parekh family has Viren arrested for troubling Angad and assaulting Sandhya.
Unbeknownst to everyone, Noina always loved Mihir one-sided which Paridhi learns of and plots to separate her parents by fueling to Noina's hidden feelings. Meanwhile, Ranvijay reconnects with Paridhi and to be with him she falsely accuses Ajay and his family in domestic violence case leading to their arrests. But Tulsi learns of it and testifies in their support just like she killed her son Ansh to protect Nandini. Noina's niece Mitali develops a crush on Angad and fixes her alliance with him while Vrinda's marriage is fixed to Ranvijay's abusive friend Suhas. Angad and Vrinda's friendship blossoms into love while Suhas and Mitali plot against them. Vrinda finally breaks the alliance when Suhas tries to molest her and Angad does so when he discovers Mitali's plot about fooling her friends by pretending that she is possessed to escape her gambling loan. However, Mitali tries to blackmail him into marriage, leading him and Vrinda to elope and be banished from Shantiniketan.
Noina becomes obsessed and plots against Mihir and in one such plot, she feigns suicide after Angad's marriage and a drunk Mihir saves her and spends night with her. While the family maid Manjuri Sinha aka Munni falls for Hrithik and starts chatting with him as "Munmun". After the truth reveal, Tulsi sends her to a hostel sponsoring her further education. A guilt-ridden Mihir transfers his property to Tulsi's name while his brother Kiran repeatedly encourages him for a divorce. Tulsi and Mihir's attempt to stop Paridhi and Ranvijay's marriage fails when Tulsi learns about Noina and Mihir and leaves home leaving behind the whole property and a letter ensuring the family about her safety and shifts to ancestral home of Amba in Anjar, which she transferred on her name before dying and vows to start off her life again from there.
Six years later, Tulsi has established her handloom textile start-up Bandhej Cooperative Business in Amba's ancestral home with several poor girls and leads it with Vaishnavi, a girl working there as designer while Noina has taken control of Shanti Niketan and made life of Gayatri, Daksha, Maharaj, the family cook and other members of family miserable which made Gayatri repent. Mihir yearns for Tulsi but does not allow Noina to cross her boundaries outside professional meetings and taunts her for her plotting against Tulsi and family. Paridhi repents her earlier behaviour with Tulsi as Ranvijay actually beats her and is careless for their daughter Garima too while Ritik is also in a loveless marriage with Mitali and has a daughter, Timsi, whom she ignores. While quarrels have become a routine in Shantiniketan. Angad and Vrinda happily inhabit a chawl with their children, Akshay and Madhavi. Meanwhile, Manjuri has now the become District Collector of Mumbai. Mihir along with Noina, Ritik, Mitali and Parth visit to Anjar for handicraft designs for their business where Noina spots Tulsi but prevents Mihir from meeting her.
Tulsi and her team is invited to Mumbai for an exhibition-cum-competition. With much reluctance, Tulsi agrees for her team not knowing that Viranis are also participating in the same exhibition. Tulsi meets Angad and Vrinda who take her to their home. Soon, Karan's son Parth locks horns with Vaishnavi while Sahil's son Dev, who is spoilt by Noina, develops a crush for her.
Tulsi and Mihir finally meet after six years but hiding his true feelings, Mihir fakes love for Noina so that Tulsi can move on and win the competition. Ritik fails to get permission from Manjuri for their new factory and blames Tulsi for his failure. He slits his wrist but Tulsi saves him. Gayatri and Shobha meet Tulsi at hospital where Gayatri apologizes for her past behaviour. Angad visits Ritik after his suicide attempt but both get into a heated argument as Ritik calls Angad a gold digger who is jealous of his brother and holds Vrinda responsible for breaking their family.
Tulsi discovers that the Viranis are in big financial crisis and even Shanti Niketan is mortgaged to her grandfather-in-law Govardhan's friend and businessman Prataprai Dhangiri of Surat. She even discovers Ranvijay's plot of taking over Virani Industries. Ranvijay tries to manipulate Angad for transferring shares of Virani Industries in his name. Prataprai calls Mihir and orders him to attend his great-grandson's wedding with Tulsi and entire Virani family. Gayatri requests Tulsi to accompany them for the wedding as Prataprai is very conservative man who will not accept Tulsi and Mihir getting separated. He holds Tulsi in very high esteem and only she can convince him to give them some time to repay the loan. Tulsi agrees to visit Surat and fake her relationship with Mihir to be normal for the sake of her kids and Shanti Niketan. On the way to Surat, insecure Noina taunts Tulsi for her relationship with Mihir but Tulsi is unaffected. Mihir and Tulsi get some time alone but Tulsi avoids talking with him.The twist of events led Tulsi to know about the truth of Ranvijay about whom she warned Pari before. All of it ends up with Dev marrying Prataprai's granddaughter Saloni. Here Pari meets Ajay and repents for her behaviour and shows her insecurity towards the safety of her daughter Garima. Various acquaintance led Ajay to confess his feelings to Pari, who refuses feeling embarrassed about her past behaviour.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Ekta Kapoor, the producer of the show, plans to infuse the story with a modern sensibility to resonate with the younger audience. The first promo featuring Smriti Irani was released by Star Plus on 7 July 2025. She made it clear that season two would not chase TRPs but aim to impact, entertain, probe thoughts, and inspire while raising important questions, sparking conversations, and standing out in a time dominated by visual gimmicks.
Sumanta Bose, Head of Cluster, Entertainment, JioStar said, "It's a show which is just not only about entertainment. It was a character who fought patriarchy, who taught how to do right parenting. So, it was so ahead of its time and the new storyline that we have embarked on creating, it's going to reshape the way India looks at content."
In December 2025, the show introduced a six-year time leap, depicting Tulsi and Mihir living separately after the revelation of Mihir and Noina's extramarital affair.
Since 20 March 2026, a separate storyline featuring Angad and Vrinda, operating under changed identities to investigate the conspiracies in the Jamshedpur plant, has been introduced and telecast in the latter half of the episodes. There were several speculations regarding whether it was an extension or a spin-off. The show was eventually developed as a spin-off. However, the channel debunked these rumours by issuing an official statement clarifying that the claims were false and that the series was not ending anytime soon.
In July 2026, the show announced a 10-year time skip. A promo was released showcasing Tulsi being released from jail after serving her sentence for apparently killing Parth. The promo shows the house divided between Karan and Gautam, with a partition line drawn between the two sections. When Tulsi expects a warm welcome, she is instead denied entry into the house.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Smriti Irani and Amar Upadhyay returned to reprise their roles as Tulsi Virani and Mihir Virani. Hiten Tejwani and Gauri Pradhan also returned to portray Karan Virani and Nandini Virani. Other returnees are Shakti Anand as Hemant Virani, Ritu Chaudhary as Shobha Virani, Ketki Dave as Daksha Virani and Kamalika Guha Thakurta as Gayatri Virani. Shagun Sharma, Rohit Suchanti and Aman Gandhi were introduced as the new generation characters. Tanisha Mehta was cast as Vrinda Gokhale.
In October 2025, it was confirmed that Sakshi Tanwar and Kiran Karmarkar would reprise their iconic roles as Parvati Agarwal and Om Agarwal from Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii to celebrate the show's 25th anniversary in a special crossover with Kyunki... The crossover aimed to finally resolve the long-standing season one cliffhanger, revealing Baa's last wish – for her property to go to Tulsi through Parth.
In October 2025, Bill Gates also made his Indian television debut on Kyunki... to promote the Gates Foundation and raise awareness about child and maternal health, in connection with a baby shower ceremony of Tulsi's servant's daughter in the show.
In January 2026, Sumeet Sachdev returned to play Advocate Gautam Virani, the elder son of Mihir and Tulsi. In February 2026, Ravee Gupta returned to play Damini Gautam Virani, replacing Riva Bubber for the second time in the show. Daksh Sharma was cast in play Nakul Virani, Gautam and Damini's younger son, replacing Naman Shaw.
In April 2026, Akashdeep Saigal returned to play Riyansh Virani, the illegitimate son of Ansh Gujral. Netizens mocked Saigal's entry as Tulsi Virani's grandson, criticizing the unrealistic age dynamic as the actor appeared older than his on-screen grandmother and too mature for the role of a young man he was portraying on screen.
In July 2026, Shagun Sharma, who portrayed Pari Virani in the series, took a temporary break to participate in the reality television show Khatron Ke Khiladi 15. To accommodate her absence, the makers wrapped up Pari's storyline by depicting her marrying Ajay Parekh and moving abroad. Following the completion of her stint on Khatron Ke Khiladi 15, Sharma confirmed that she would not be returning to Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2, officially marking her departure from the series. Nirvaan Anand who portrayed Ajay Parekh, Paridhi's husband also left the show, commenting on her farewell post on Instagram " “And then Pari and Ajay lived happily ever after!”.
In July 2026, Sandeep Baswana returned for the third time in the show to reprise his role as Sahil Virani. Suvarna Jha also returned to the show marking her return after a long break of 18 year's from the TV Industry to portray Tripti Virani. It also marks the much-awaited reunion between Tripti and Tulsi, a dynamic that was one of the defining aspects of the original series. Their face-off is expected to play a significant role in the episodes ahead as old rivalries resurface in a new chapter.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
The show recorded over 1.659 billion minutes of watch time across television and streaming platforms. The show received 31.1 million television viewers in just four days. Out of which 15.4 million viewers had tuned in for the premiere episode alone, according to a press release by the channel. The channel added, "The reboot season also witnessed 17,300 mentions across social media platforms."
The latest count makes Smriti Irani led Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 the highest-rated fiction launch across general entertainment channels in recent times and the biggest-ever GEC fiction debut across both television and digital in India, the release added. According to BARC, Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 recorded a 2.5 TVR on its launch day in the HSM Urban market (MF15–50 ABC demographic).

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
India Today noted that the first episode serves as "a nostalgic trip down memory lane, bringing back iconic characters and moments without much new development."
Some critics argued that the reboot relied too heavily on nostalgia rather than offering fresh storylines. India Today observed that while it successfully revived iconic characters, the premiere "brought little new development beyond sentimentality." Mid-Day similarly noted that the show leaned on "sanskaar and kalesh" tropes without significant innovation, framing it as a sentimental but formulaic return. NDTV highlighted that while Smriti Irani's performance brought gravitas, the show risked "rehashing themes already explored two decades ago" instead of adapting to contemporary family dynamics.
