articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Rambo Visual Works, a new production company headed by M.B. Gowrish began the production of its first serial Kannedhirey Thondrinal on Kalaignar TV.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Actress Malavika Avinash was cast as Rudhra, a woman from a wealthy family. Newcomer actor 'Jeevan G Vaa' was cast as the male lead Shiva. Actress Jayshri was cast Main Antagonist as Anitha. On 10 March, Vadivukkarasi was cast as Abirami.
Actor Kovai Babu was cast as Manivannan, but was replaced by Arvind Venkat in May 2023. Vaishu Jayachandhiran was selected to portray a supporting role as Dhivya but in October 2023 she quit the show. Actress Kavya Amira was replaced her role. In June 2023, actor Raaghav entered the show as Surya, Sakthi's new love interest.
In September 2023, Actor Ravikumar joined the cast to play a supporting role, will play the role of Sakthi's grandfather. On 25 November 2023, Actress Papri Ghosh joined the cast to play the Doctor for a new story track. In end of November, Kavya Amira was replaced by Dhanalakshmi as Dhivya.
On 24 December 2023, actress Jayshri Jue was replaced by Ramya Balakrishna as Anitha. Jayshri Jue returned as Anitha on 19 May 2024, replacing Ramya Balakrishna. In February 2024, singer and actor Mohan Vaidya joined the cast to play a supporting role.

title: Khelna Bari
summary: Khelna Bari is a 2022 Indian Bengali-language romantic thriller drama television series that aired on Zee Bangla. The show premiered on 16 May 2022 and concluded its final episode on 23 November 2023. It was produced by Zee Bangla and starred Aratrika Maity and Biswajit Ghosh.

title: Kuthukku Pathu
summary: Kuthukku Pathu (transl. fight for a fight)  is an Indian Tamil-language Comedy Drama web series produced as an original for Aha Tamil, directed by Vijay Varadharaj. Produced by D Company the series stars Shah Ra, Vijay Varadharaj, Abdool Lee, Samyuktha, Bose Venkat and Aadukalam Naren. The series comprised seven episodes and was released on Aha Tamil on 13 May 2022.

title: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal
summary:
Kana Kaanum Kaalangal (transl. Periods of Dreaming) also known by the initialism KKK, is a 2022 Indian Tamil-language television series that airs on Disney+ Hotstar. It is a reboot of the 2006 television series of the same name, which aired on Star Vijay. The story revolves around the struggles of a group of high school students and what they face during their secondary school life such as jealousy, rivalry, misunderstandings, arguments and personal grudges.
The first season of Kana Kaanum Kaalangal which consists of 132 episodes, was released through the streaming service Disney+ Hotstar on 22 April 2022 ended on 8 December 2022. The second season was released on 21 April 2023 and ended with 112 episodes from 27 October 2023. The third season premiered on 30 August 2024 and ended with 102 episodes from 14 February 2025.
The series stars Teja Venkatesh, Raja Vetri Prabhu, Aravinth Seiju and Deepika Venkatachalam, Aashik Gopinath Bryan, while Sangeetha Sai, Irfan, Rajesh, Bharath Kumar, Deepika Venkatachalam, Akshathaa Ajit, Pranika Dhakshu, Pragatheeswaran a.k.a. Yugaa Pragathees, Aegan, VJ Kalyani, Surendar VJ, Parvez Musharaf and others appear in supporting roles. Filming for the series commenced in mid-June 2021. The series premiered on 21 April 2022. It also aired on Star Vijay from 26 December 2022 on Monday to Friday at 5:30 PM.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first teaser for the show was released in January 2022 and it was officially set to launch in February 2022, however due to some technical error during the shooting for the show, the release date was pushed to 22 April 2022.

episodesList.summary: Guna, Gowtham, Kalai and Kicha wake up from a worst nightmare. Guna worries about his students, while Raju, Gopi and Abi fear their results. Hotel Master supports Kalai's dream.

episodesList.title: The Result
episodesList.summary: While Siragugal school rejoices, Modern school's result takes a diverse turn. As Abi reminds Kalai of their bet, Gowtham meets Nandini, leaving her mother dubious and Swetha upset.

episodesList.title: Time To Celebrate
episodesList.summary: Malar and Guna share a moment. Bullet consoles an emotional Guna, and Nandini gets warned by her mother. Raju plans a trip as Gowtham and the gang decide to party.

episodesList.title: Family Comes First
episodesList.summary: Nandini makes a promise to her mother. Kalai, Abi, Stella and their friends go to Kulandhai's farm to celebrate. Gowtham and his squad meet an unexpected person. They have a blast.

episodesList.title: Failed Attempts
episodesList.summary: After several attempts, Gowtham and his gang finally hit the bottle and get clicked. Abi tries to make Kalai speak his mind but in vain. Guna and Bullet play a prank on Sagayam.

episodesList.title: New Entries
episodesList.summary: The gang's attempt to rag new students fails. A new teacher walks in as Guna and Malar worry about the staff's salary. Nachiyappan tries to learn about Siragugal's position.

episodesList.title: New Friends, New Enemies
episodesList.summary: New teacher Thilothama impresses her students. Praveen and Naveen try to sneak in weed. After Guna taunts Nachiyappan about Siragugal's success, he finds ways to malign the school.

episodesList.title: The Lab Accident
episodesList.summary: Guna's staff supports his request for some time to settle their salary. His happiness is short-lived when he learns about the lab catching fire. Poochi blames Mani for the incident.

episodesList.title: Roses on Thorns
episodesList.summary: Rekha, a mother who lives on thorns, wishes to give a life filled with flowers to her daughter, Maha. But fate has other plans when a man they trust betrays them.

episodesList.title: Gates of Hope
episodesList.summary: As Maha waits for Guna, he is thrilled when Malar shares good news with him. Sakthi overhears his mother talking to his father, an underrated cop, about his lost promotion.

episodesList.title: Best Enemies
episodesList.summary: Kasi beats up Rekha to reveal Maha's location. Sakthi is disappointed to see his father being mistreated by his rival Karthick and his dad.

episodesList.title: New Class, New Stories
episodesList.summary: It's the first day of school, and the students of Grade 11-A go through introductions, spats and emotional moments. Meanwhile, Guna introduces a new class teacher to them.

episodesList.title: Different Parenting
episodesList.summary: Kasi forces Rekha to accept Malar's call. Nikitha's parents scold her harshly for singing in front of everyone. Karthick insults Sakthi's father in school, enraging the latter.

episodesList.title: Rep Elections
episodesList.summary: Elections to choose the class representative become the hot topic in Siragugal. All is not well at home for Yamini and Madhi. Sakthi's father asks him about his first day.

episodesList.title: Haunted Hostel
episodesList.summary: Karthick asks his father for a motorbike with his mother's help. Sasi and Ekambaram settle in the boys' hostel and get unsettled. Danger approaches Maha after she falls asleep.

episodesList.title: Double Twin Flames
episodesList.summary: Yamini and Madhi talk about their choice for the rep election. Sasi and Ekambaram are introduced to the 'friendly' Santhosh Sir. Guna receives a strange parcel.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Candidates
episodesList.summary: Guna is disturbed by Nachiappan's threats. The rep election rules bring forth unlikely candidates. Kasi is still hunting for Maha, keeping Rekha captive.

episodesList.title: Physics vs Chemistry
episodesList.summary: A timetable mix-up leads to an argument between Class 11-A's chemistry and physics teachers. Karthi's mother blames Sakthi for her son's inability to contest the election.

episodesList.title: Family Promises
episodesList.summary: Kasi tries to find Maha's whereabouts through the other women. Ekambaram remembers his promise to his father when he sees Priya alighting from a fancy car.

episodesList.title: Sakthi or Maha?
episodesList.summary: The rep election results are out, and Sakthi and Maha get equal votes. Kasi's goons get a lead on Maha's location. Will they find her?

episodesList.title: Bullet Is Back
episodesList.summary: Guna feels elated as Bullet returns from his village. As Sakthi's friends celebrate his win, Karthick's attempt to talk to Maha fails. Will Bujji's prank on Sasikumar prove fatal?

episodesList.title: Reality Check
episodesList.summary: Karthick makes Sakthi's first day as the class rep difficult. Guna receives a notice regarding the school. Priya's dad reminds her about their life. Karthick's parents surprise him.

episodesList.title: Bitter Past
episodesList.summary: Sakthi shares the news about becoming the class rep with his father. Janani's painful past makes her bond with her friends stronger. Priya finds it hard to accept the reality.

episodesList.title: How to Save Siragugal?
episodesList.summary: Guna seeks legal help to save his school. Worried, Rekha informs Malar about Kasi's efforts to find Maha. The school committee agrees with Jeeva's idea regarding the road situation.

episodesList.title: Attack Mode
episodesList.summary: When Kasi's search for Maha fails in Chennai, he reaches Kanchipuram. Guna and Madan get into a tiff with Kasi's goons while Karthik vents his fury by hurting Sakthi with his bike.

episodesList.title: Consequences
episodesList.summary: Karthick's father punishes Sakthi's dad for the rift between the boys. Sakthi's dad reports a gang making illicit liquor. Maha gets upset as her friends enjoy her mom's dance on TV.

episodesList.title: The Spotlight
episodesList.summary: Madan organises a street play to create awareness about the school's issue. While Maha refuses to act, Nikitha breaks down when her dad warns her not to participate in the play.

episodesList.title: Impactful Street Play
episodesList.summary: Karthick enters the boy's hostel with Bujji. The students deliver an amazing street play and create awareness about their school's situation. But what happens when Kasi spots Maha?

episodesList.title: Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Maha smartly evades Kasi in the crowd. Nachiappan mocks Guna about the street play. Karthick's friends refuse to believe him that Maha was holding his hand during the street play.

episodesList.title: Hunger Strike
episodesList.summary: Guna's decision to conduct a hunger strike as his next move to save Siragugal School is accepted by the staff. A pregnant Malar too joins the strike along with the students.

episodesList.title: The Boys are Back
episodesList.summary: The ex-students from Siragugal extend their support by joining the strike. Everyone is shocked when Karthick's father gets his police force to clear the crowd at Siragugal.

episodesList.title: The Sacrifices
episodesList.summary: To everyone's surprise, Karthick's father lends his support to the cause. Dinakaran handles the pressure from his higher officials. Meanwhile, Sagayam's health deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Court Order
episodesList.summary: A court's stay order brings relief to Guna and the students. Rekha spots Maha on a news channel, and worries about Kasi seeing it. Meanwhile who saved the school at the last minute?

episodesList.title: Conceited Attitude
episodesList.summary: Guna honours Inspector Dinakaran for extending his support to the school. Sakthi feels his father Palani's efforts are neglected. A proud Karthick gets into a dispute with Ranjith.

episodesList.title: Bold Class Rep
episodesList.summary: Karthick tries to impress Maha with home food. Jeeva's sad past does not stop him from spreading fun in his class. Sakthi stands up for his friends when Santhosh Sir thrashes them.

episodesList.title: Eavesdropping
episodesList.summary: Sakthi's bold move earns everyone two days to study. Bujji overhears Guna telling the staff about Siragugal School drafting the quarterly exam question papers for the entire district.

episodesList.title: Bujji's Efforts
episodesList.summary: Sakthi agrees to teach physics to Madhi and Yamini. Bujji's father warns him and gives him the last chance to pass his exams. Perturbed, Bujji seeks his uncle's help.

episodesList.title: Insulted Father
episodesList.summary: Karthick gets punished by Dinakaran when his senior insults him for giving him a bike. He is warned to score better marks than Sakthi. Nikitha gets angry as her parents push her to study.

episodesList.title: The Question Paper
episodesList.summary: Madhi and Yamini feel excited to learn from Sakthi. Bujji discreetly shares the question paper with Karthick, John, Ekambaram and Sasi. Doubting Bujji, Mahesh and Ranjith question him.

episodesList.title: Exam Preparations
episodesList.summary: Santhosh Sir punishes a student for his rude behaviour. Dinakaran gifts a pen to Karthick, who resolves not to cheat in the exams. Nikitha gets upset as her dad argues with a neighbour.

episodesList.title: Exam Day
episodesList.summary: While Bujji's friends thank him for the question paper, Karthick does not tell them that he did not cheat in the exams. Later, he reminds Sakthi about his challenge.

episodesList.title: Manipulated Scores
episodesList.summary: Guna gets a call from the police station regarding his students. Santhosh Sir's letter to Bujji surprises everyone. Guna challenges Nachiappan when he tries to defame his students.

episodesList.title: Cheaters Always Losers
episodesList.summary: Amazed by their good scores, the class starts to rejoice. But Malar breaks the news about a gang cheating in the exams. Bujji and his pals get pulled up for their misdeed.

episodesList.title: Suppressed Truth
episodesList.summary: Karthick feels dejected as his truth gets stifled. The parents of students who cheated are asked to attend the PTA in school. Sakthi informs his father of what transpired in school.

episodesList.title: The Parents' Meeting
episodesList.summary: It is the day of the dreaded meeting. With a heavy heart, Guna informs the parents about what happened. Karthick tries to convince Guna once again that he didn't cheat.

episodesList.title: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
episodesList.summary: Bujji's father beats him for cheating in the exams. Heartbroken to hear about his son, Dinakaran thrashes Karthick in front of everyone. Karthick breaks down as no one believes him.

episodesList.title: Silenced by Punishment
episodesList.summary: Bujji and Ekambaram's fathers get into a fight. Guna plans to hold a cultural event. When Dinakaran punishes Karthick, Bujji, Ekambaram and Sasi welcome him to their hostel.

episodesList.title: Humiliation and Shame
episodesList.summary: Maha feels sad for Karthick. While Madan Sir shows his anger through his actions, Karthick maintains that he is innocent. Shakthi is selected as the secretary of the cultural event.

episodesList.title: The Ignored Gang
episodesList.summary: Bujji and his friends plan to partake in the cultural event, but Guna and Malar refuse them. Nikitha gets upset as her father warns her not to participate in the singing competition.

episodesList.title: The Cultural Event
episodesList.summary: Sakthi and his friends begin their practice sessions. Madhi gets angry as Yamini also brings food for Sakthi. The students feel excited as Agni Siragugal 2024 is inaugurated.

episodesList.title: Impromptu Speech
episodesList.summary: Guna gives an impactful inaugural speech. Nachiappan mocks Guna that his school will not win the cup. Sakthi is declared winner for his impromptu speech in the elocution competition.

episodesList.title: Intellectual Theft
episodesList.summary: Janani's moving poetry bags her the medal. Maha conveys her story beautifully in her drawing and wins first place. Desperate, Modern School students steal Sakthi and team's concept.

episodesList.title: Authoritative Parenting
episodesList.summary: Guna arranges lodging for all the participants in the school hostel. Maha dedicates her medal to Karthick. Malar calls Nikitha's father as he stops her from partaking in the contest.

episodesList.title: Caged Bird
episodesList.summary: Karthick gets mocked for writing a drama script. Nikitha's friends save her when her dad locks her at home. She is declared the winner for her performance, but is it worth the risk?

episodesList.title: Failed Efforts
episodesList.summary: Sakthi and his team are shocked as their script gets stolen. Maha suggests Karthick's script, but Guna rejects it and announces that Siragugal will not partake in the drama contest.

episodesList.title: Never Give Up
episodesList.summary: After Maha convinces everyone to accept Karthick's script, he guides the team, and they give a brilliant performance. Sakthi's act touches every heart, including Karthick's.

episodesList.title: Overall Trophy
episodesList.summary: Though upset with Malar for defying him, Guna acknowledges the student's victory. Karthick feels hurt as Guna ignores his efforts. Kasi and Rekha get to perform in Kanchipuram.

episodesList.title: Shattered Reality
episodesList.summary: Kasi grows wary when Rekha accepts the show. Nikitha lashes out at her parents for being unsupportive. Maha feels dejected about not being able to share her victory with her mother.

episodesList.title: Still Not Friends
episodesList.summary: Dinakaran feels touched to see his son's photo in the papers. Karthick thanks Maha for trusting him, unlike his friends. Sakthi intercedes when Mahesh and Ranjith fight with Karthick.

episodesList.title: Misunderstood By Friends
episodesList.summary: Karthick gets mocked for his friendship with Maha. Nikitha shares her grief with her pals while Guna warns Karthick as he beats John for wrongly accusing him.

episodesList.title: Lonesome
episodesList.summary: Karthick's father berates him when he returns home after the hostel incident. Maha scolds John and his team for not supporting Karthick. Madhi and Yamini get lunch for Sakthi.

episodesList.title: Trouble Child
episodesList.summary: Karthick's friends tease him, but when they get into trouble, he saves them, earning his father's ire. Sakthi informs Bujji and the others about Karthick's plight at the police station.

episodesList.title: Bonding With Friends
episodesList.summary: Maha learns of her mom's visit to Kanchipuram. Karthick's friends apologise to him for their mistakes, but Dinakaran is called to the school for his misconduct. Kasi suspects Rekha.

episodesList.title: Risky Wish
episodesList.summary: When Maha desperately tries to meet her mother, Janani calls Karthick for help. Bujji and his friends create commotion and help Maha leave the hostel with Karthick on his bike.

episodesList.title: The Great Escape
episodesList.summary: With their friends' help, Maha and Karthick arrive at the temple festival to meet Rekha. The next challenge they face is hoodwinking Kasi and his goons.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Curious about Karthick and Maha, Palani talks to Sakthi. Sasi's dad invites him and his friends to a village festival. Singer Srilekha calls Malar and asks about Nikitha.

episodesList.title: Supportive Friends
episodesList.summary: Malar talks to Nikitha about the competition, only to get a surprising response. Karthick asks Maha about her secret meeting with her mom. Sasi invites the teachers to his village.

episodesList.title: The Invite
episodesList.summary: Nikitha's friends coax her to join the talent show. Sasi invites the whole class, except Sakthi and his gang. When Guna and Malar are invited, he has a condition.

episodesList.title: Parent's Consent
episodesList.summary: The students are elated when their parents sign the no-objection letter and permit them to go to Sasi's hometown. Surprisingly, Nikitha's parents also allow her to join the trip.

episodesList.title: Boarding Time
episodesList.summary: Sasi hands over the no-objection letters to Jeeva Sir. Everyone assembles at the bus stop to leave for Madurai. Mahdi and Yamini reserve a seat each for Sakthi. Who will he sit with?

episodesList.title: The Journey
episodesList.summary: The journey to Madurai begins. Bujji gets into trouble with the driver. The students enjoy and play fun games. Madhi feels disappointed when Sakthi sits with Yamini.

episodesList.title: Sasi's Girl
episodesList.summary: The students receive a warm welcome at Sasi's house. Sasi introduces Pooja to his grandmother and his dad narrates the family history. The girls impress all with their ethnic wear.

episodesList.title: Disappointing Menu
episodesList.summary: While everyone eagerly waits for the non-veg feast, Sasi's father has news for them. The kids play Truth or Dare with some surprising results.

episodesList.title: No Religious Barriers
episodesList.summary: Sasi gives everyone a taste of how the day starts in the village. Tension rises when John's presence in the temple is questioned by the priest. Pooja meets the sacrificial goat.

episodesList.title: Movie Time
episodesList.summary: Because of Pooja, Sasi feels conflicted about the sacrificial ceremony. He organises a village-style movie screening, which becomes a different experience for everyone.

episodesList.title: The Missing Goat
episodesList.summary: When Sasi tries to console Pooja, she tells him that if he saves the sacrificial goat, he will be her favourite person. What he does next causes utter chaos.

episodesList.title: Supernatural Search
episodesList.summary: Pooja corners Sasi and forces him to reveal the truth. Although Sasi's father goes to the police to find the goat, the villagers persuade him to seek help from a higher power.

episodesList.title: Loving Granny
episodesList.summary: When Sasi's uncle announces a significant reward for finding the goat, Sasi gets furious but his friends are elated. Distressed by the missing goat, his grandmother falls sick.

episodesList.title: Granny's Unexpected Decision
episodesList.summary: Pooja drowns in guilt and reveals the truth to her friends. Sasi's grandmother's health worsens, making his father order the sacrifice of 100 goats.

episodesList.title: Sasi's Ear Piercing
episodesList.summary: Sasi's dad has another event planned, much to the boy's distress. As the trip comes to a close, Nikitha gets a call from the talent show.

episodesList.title: Surprise Trip
episodesList.summary: Sasi's mother gets emotional as the students leave for Chennai. His grandmother blesses each one of them. Seeing everyone sad, Sasi surprises them with a trekking trip.

episodesList.title: Thug Life
episodesList.summary: Sakthi tends to Madhi and Yamini's wounds as everyone treks to the top of the hill. After reaching the camping spot, unexpected visitors try to create trouble for the students.

episodesList.title: Eerie Stories
episodesList.summary: Settling the girls in the tents, the boys go fishing and return with a good catch. After dinner, Mahesh, Madhi, and Ekambaram fuel the eerie atmosphere with horror stories.

episodesList.title: Arson
episodesList.summary: The drunk men seek revenge for the insult by setting the tents on fire and putting everyone's lives at risk. The rescue team arrives to save the team, but Nikita's condition worsens.

episodesList.title: Shattered Parents
episodesList.summary: Sakthi consoles Nikita's parents as her condition leaves them shattered. Later, Nikitha is declared out of danger, but Sasi feels guilty for putting everyone's life at risk.

episodesList.title: Master Returns
episodesList.summary: The teachers get furious. Malar takes the students to task during assembly. When they blame Sasi for the mishap, Sakthi stands by him. They panic when Santhosh sir returns to school.

episodesList.title: New Feelings
episodesList.summary: Nikitha has an emotional moment with her parents. The teachers refuse to pardon the students. Sakthi shares his feelings for Nikitha with Mahesh. He feels happy to spend time with her.

episodesList.title: Gang Reputation
episodesList.summary: Sasi and his friends are humiliated in the hostel. Nikitha receives a warm welcome in school. Karthick and the team persuade Nikitha to take up Singer Sriram's singing show offer.

episodesList.title: Acceptance
episodesList.summary: Nikitha's friends convince her parents to let her sing in the competition. Her parents accompany her for the audition in Chennai. Yamini learns about Madhi's feelings for Sakthi.

episodesList.title: Broken Bond
episodesList.summary: Nikita clears the audition, but Malar puts forth a condition. Sakthi scolds Madhi and Yamini for forcing him to eat. The students realise how much trouble they have caused the school.

episodesList.title: Growing Distance
episodesList.summary: The students get scolded in the Tamil class. Sakthi brings a gift for Nikita. Madhi and Yamini's mothers worry about their rift. The Super Singer team arrives to shoot Nikitha.

episodesList.title: Is It Love?
episodesList.summary: Malar gives permission to shoot in the school premises. Nikitha's friends rejoice when her show is aired on TV. While Sakthi phones Nikita to wish her, Madhi is unable to reach him.

episodesList.title: Budding Director
episodesList.summary: Madhi takes care of an ailing Yamini. Hesitant at first, Maha agrees to act in the Karthick-directed short film for a state-level competition. Malar allows him to shoot in the school.

episodesList.title: Madhi's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Sakthi waits with Nikitha as she practices. Sakthi's reply stuns Madhi after Priya urges her to voice her feelings to him. Karthick completes his short film with the help of his friends.

episodesList.title: The Super Singer
episodesList.summary: Nikitha's parents are elated after her performance in the Super Singer show. Yamini feels hurt to know that Sakthi loves someone else. Maha admires Karthick after watching his film.

episodesList.title: A Short Film by Karthick
episodesList.summary: Karthick's film is nominated for the film festival award. Malar is stunned after watching it. Nikitha's friends celebrate her win. Nachiappan challenges Malar to a science exhibition.

episodesList.title: The Abduction
episodesList.summary: Karthick's film garners attention all over. When it reaches Kasi's gang, Maha gets kidnapped from the school premises. Everyone suggests Karthick get his father's help to find her.

episodesList.title: Helpless Maha
episodesList.summary: Guna and Malar inform Dinakaran about Maha's situation. He gets furious to learn that Karthick is in love with Maha, who is the daughter of a dancer. Unfortunately, Maha reaches Kasi.

episodesList.title: Locked Up
episodesList.summary: Maha is in trouble in Kasi's custody. Dinakaran locks Karthick in the house, but he escapes. When Sakthi learns shocking news from his father, he and Karthick decide to look for Maha.

episodesList.title: Smart Thinking
episodesList.summary: Karthick and Sakthi call Kasi for Maha's whereabouts. Sakthi's father decides to help in their search. Karthick's smart idea helps find the location of the goons. Will they find Maha?

episodesList.title: Brave Souls
episodesList.summary: Kasi and his gang get arrested after Sakthi and Karthick rescue Maha with Palani's aid. Karthick chooses to return to the hostel and his son's hatred for him leaves Dinakaran shattered.

episodesList.title: Reap What You Sow
episodesList.summary: Guna praises Sakthi and Karthick in the school assembly. Palani is promoted to inspector, while Dinakaran gets transferred. The class is shocked to see Karthick and Sakthi's bond.

episodesList.title: Science Projects
episodesList.summary: Guna agrees to the student's request to attend a science exhibition at the Modern School. Madhi's mother reminds her daughter and Yamini of the value of their friendship.

episodesList.title: Best Friends Forever
episodesList.summary: Yamini and Madhi realise their mistake and get back together. However, Sakthi's answer about the love of his life shocks them. Nachiappan insults Siragugal students at the exhibition.

episodesList.title: The Innocent Suspect
episodesList.summary: Dharshini, a Modern School student, slaps Sakthi when he mistakenly runs into her. Later, she jumps from the terrace. Palani is shocked when Sakthi is arrested for her death.

episodesList.title: The Truth
episodesList.summary: Guna fumes as the school's name gets tarnished. Dinakaran is appointed as the investigative officer in Sakthi's case. Sakthi's friends learn a shocking truth about the Modern School.

episodesList.title: A Bold Move
episodesList.summary: The girls share the truth about Dharshini's death with Karthick. While Palani assures his wife, the girls make a plan to save Sakthi and execute the first step to catch the culprit.

episodesList.title: The Confession
episodesList.summary: The incident becomes a hot topic in the news. The police are pressurised to take action. The girls manage to get a confession from the Modern School students against their teacher.

episodesList.title: Truth Alone Triumphs
episodesList.summary: Nachiappan spurns his students' complaints against the teacher. Nikitha motivates them to go to the cops, who promptly take action.

episodesList.title: Friendship is the Real Treasure
episodesList.summary: Palani apologises to Sakthi for his helplessness. Sakthi's friends give him a warm welcome in school. Guna, Malar and Jeeva talk to their students.

title: Kudumbashree Sharada
summary: Kudumbashree Sharada is an Indian Malayalam language drama television series airing on Zee Keralam which premiered from 11 April 2022. It stars Sreelakshmi, Mersheena Neenu and Prabhin in lead roles. The show is a remake of Telugu series Radhamma Kuthuru, which aired on Zee Telugu. It is one of the longest-running soap opera in Malayalam.
plot: Sharada gives birth of three daughters named Sharika, Shalini and Shyama. sharada's husband Gopal, who desperately wanted a son, decides to marry Rajeshwari and leaves Sharada and three daughters. Shalini vows to become an IAS officer to avenge her mother. She marries Vishnu, a local goon who is the son of Sathyabhama, a wealthy money lender. Sathyamma and her niece Sushmita tries to separate vishnu and Shalini. Sharika married her professor while Shyama maaried Rohit. The story portrays Sharadamma's struggle to safeguard her Shalini's life. Shalini gives birth of twin daughters. Shalini became IAS . New Avatar Shivan comes as a local goon like Vishnu.

title: Katakuti
summary:
Katakuti is a 2022 Indian Bengali language crime and thriller web series directed by Raja Chanda and written by Arnab Bhaumik.
The web series is produced under Raja Chanda Films, Angel Digital and Ediview. Sourav Das, Manasi Sengupta, Devtanu, Paean Sarkar, Abhijit Guha and Sirsha Rakshit are in the mail role in the web series.
plot: Aditya, a shy young man, and Kaushani are set to get married when a tragic catastrophe prevents it. Aditya, who is devastated, must accept the loss of his sweetheart. Kousani was slain after being gang-raped. He learns about the three criminals responsible for the heinous crime, which leaves him devastated. One of them was a close family friend of Kousani's. Aditya, a typically reserved youngster, undergoes a drastic transformation and sets out to exact cruel retribution on Kousani and her family.
reception: Katakuti received mixed to positive reviews from critics.

episodesList.title: Starting From Zero
episodesList.summary: The Mukherjees are eager to marry off their son Aditya. Matchmaker Kamal is also at it. In the midst of all of this chaos, Aditya and Smriti meet. Even if they don't end up getting married, they remain lifelong friends.

episodesList.title: Phool Panjika
episodesList.summary: Phool is Aditya's pet name! His nuptials to Kaushani, a female, are finally scheduled. Each enjoys the other. Everyone is content.

episodesList.title: The Victim
episodesList.summary: Aditya visits Kaushani's aunt to meet her before getting married but has the shock of his life. His fiancee was brutally killed. Who committed this vile crime?

episodesList.title: The Transition
episodesList.summary: Aditya decides to tackle the law on his own. Vicky is no more. The innocent youngster is transformed into this vengeful figure by the circumstances of life.

episodesList.title: The Chase
episodesList.summary: Aditya goes to the police and tells them everything. He asserts that he has dealt with all of the defendants and that he was aware of the identity of the killer of his fiancée.

episodesList.title: Black Rose
episodesList.summary: The information is shared with the police. The killers' actions, punishment, and treatment at the hands of Aditya. He understood that he had stolen his fiancé's justice because Aditya had not received it.

title: Kaun Banegi Shikharwati
summary: Kaun Banegi Shikharwati is an Indian Hindi-language comedy-drama web series streaming on ZEE5. It is written and directed by Gauravv Chawla and Ananya Banerjee. The series has been produced by Applause Entertainment and Emmay Entertainment. This ten-episode web series was released on 7 January 2022. It stars Naseeruddin Shah, Raghubir Yadav, Lara Dutta, Soha Ali Khan, Kritika Kamra and Anya Singh in the lead roles.
plot: It is the story of Raja Mrityunjay Singh Shikharwat, who is broke and owes the Indian government a hefty amount of in unpaid property taxes. To come out of this scenario, he fakes sickness and summons his four estranged daughters, Devyani, Gayatri, Kamini, and Uma. He plans to hold a nine-rounds tournament amongst them, each with a job for the princesses to complete. At the end of this tournament, the winner will be crowned Queen.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: ZEE5 announced the launch of a trailer on 23 December 2021 and the series was released on 7 January 2022.

articleSections.title: Critical reviews
articleSections.text:
Archika Khurana of The Times of India has given 3.5/5 stars stating that the series is a fun, breezy take on a dysfunctional royal family. Due to its simple writing and weird characters, it is a fine blend of humour and drama. Do not be fooled by the tracksuit and games; the series is not as gory as ‘Squid Game’, but it is a light-hearted dramedy that will bring a smile to your face.
Saibal Chatterjee of NDTV has given 2.5/5 stars stating that the series is a patchy dramedy. It is a mildly diverting, inoffensive parody of the repercussions of power wielded without responsibility. It does not scale any peak, but it is entertaining enough not to sink into a low work that it cannot find its way out of with a little bit of help from the actors.
Shubham Kulkarni of Koimoi has given 2/5 stars stating that the series is a dramedy about a dysfunctional family that falls prey to repetitiveness and confused tonality. The actor Naseeruddin Shah is prolific, but the character becomes repetitive. All the other actors have made justice to their respective roles. The web series like this with more evolved humour deserved depth too. The bar for dramedies about families raised four decades ago by some prolific filmmakers will struggle to live up to them.

episodesList.title: Strokes of Genius
episodesList.summary: After the government's notice, Mishraji devises a plan to reunite King's four estranged daughters, Devyani, Gayatri, Kamini and Uma. The sisters return home and learn about the Navrasa Royal Games.

episodesList.title: The Game Begins
episodesList.summary: In the past, the sisters humiliate each other in public and leave the palace. In the present, the Navrasa Royal Games begin, and the sisters face a cooking challenge, but it ends in a bitter squabble.

episodesList.title: A Common Enemy
episodesList.summary: The next game is a stage play performance, but Devyani converts it into a roast on the king, and they make embarrassing jokes about him. King feels he can still save his family as his daughters reunite.

episodesList.title: Fear Is the Key
episodesList.summary: The king recreates a horror night to unite his daughters with the common fear of darkness. Mishraji urges King to tell the princesses about the tax problem, but he declares the games will continue.

episodesList.title: Earth, Wind and Fire
episodesList.summary: The next game is based on the four elements of nature. Kamini faces trouble during the fire round but is rescued by Veer Singh. Devyani's husband Harsh arrives at the palace with their twins.

episodesList.title: Nightmare?
episodesList.summary: Kamini reconnects with Uma. At the palace, the sisters perform the queen’s famous Holi pooja in tandem. Meanwhile, tax officials discuss an infamous officer, who has been given a task related to Shikharwati.

episodesList.title: Heart-Speak
episodesList.summary: An old man claims that the king owes him money for a job he had done 30 years ago that helped him hide a treasure. Gayatri's confession shocks everyone. Roop Singh's real purpose is revealed.

episodesList.title: Clue-Less
episodesList.summary: Roop speculates where King must have hidden the treasure. Kamini wins her first game but is shocked to learn that Veer is leaving for Mewar. Later, she and King have a heart-to-heart conversation.

episodesList.title: Treasure Hunt
episodesList.summary: The sisters must face their deepest fears in the next game. King admires his daughters, but the moment is interrupted by an unknown man pointing a gun at the king. Roop decides to raid the palace.

episodesList.title: All That Glitters Is Not Gold
episodesList.summary: During the final game, Uma has an allergy attack, following which the sisters unite. Roop Singh arrives with his team to raid the palace, but the king has the last laugh as he announces his decision.

title: Kabhi Kabhie Ittefaq Sey
summary: Kabhi Kabhie Ittefaq Sey (transl.  Sometimes by Chance) is an Indian drama television series that premiered on 3 January 2022. It was aired on StarPlus and is digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar. It stars Yesha Rughani and Manan Joshi. It is a loose Hindi adaptation of Star Jalsha's Khorkuto. The series went off-air on 20 August 2022. It was replaced by Rajjo in its timeslot.
plot: Riddhima "Gungun" Bhatnagar lives with her father, Riddhesh and her aunt, Garima, so she does not know the joy of living in a big family like Anubhav "Anu" Kulshreshth. Anu and Gungun have opposite personalities; but fate still wants them to complete the love that they are lacking in their lives.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The casting commenced in October 2021 and actors Delnaaz Irani and Rajiv Kumar were the first to be cast as pivotal recurring characters. Later, Mehul Nisar, Kanwarjit Paintal, Shilpa Kadam and several others actors too were roped in to play pivotal roles.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The pre-production began in July 2021. Shooting commenced in October 2021 and various sequences were shot in Lucknow.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first promo was released on 1 November 2021, featuring the leads Yesha Rughani and Manan Joshi.

title: Kaamnaa
summary: Kaamnaa (transl. Desire) is an Indian Hindi-language television series that premeried on 15 November 2021 on Sony TV. Produced by Cockcrow and Shaika Entertainment, it starred Abhishek Rawat, Manav Gohil, Chandni Sharma and Ramnitu Chaudhary. The initial story of Kaamnaa was inspired by the hit Pakistani television series Meray Paas Tum Ho. The series ended on 29 July 2022.
plot:
Manav, a hardworking and straightforward government officer, follows his principles with complete honesty. In contrast, his wife Akanksha desires to lead a luxurious life with everything she wants. Despite not getting everything, they wish for, the two are happy with their son, Yatharth. All goes well until a businessman, Vaibhav Kapoor, who believes anything can be bought by money, falls in love at first sight with Akanksha, his Kaamnaa (translation: wish or desire) as he likes to call her, without knowing her real identity.
Manav transfers from Bhopal to Indore and patches things up between Akanksha and her family. Akanksha shares her past with Manav and reveals that she was once Miss Indore, but only because her father bribed the judges. Vaibhav gets closer to Akanksha by buying her old bungalow and even offering her a job to model his company with extra perks. Still, Manav disapproves of this as he suspects Vaibhav's intentions. After some time, Akanksha falls in love with Vaibhav, leaving Manav shattered.
Akanksha's leave worsens Yatharth's mental health, where Sakshi, his school counselor, helps him. Sakshi's husband, Prateek, and son, Parth, died in a car accident and has affected her since. Sakshi sees Parth in Yatharth, forcing her to leave the school after interfering with Manav and Akanksha's sole guardianship of Yatharth. After losing everything, Manav feels guilty and lets Sakshi and her mother-in-law, Malti stay with them for the sake of Yatharth.
Manav wins legal guardianship of his son after Mr. Holkar shows sympathy for him and realizes his past mistakes. Akanksha gets paranoid when she can't find any way to get Yatharth to be with her, even after asking Vaibhav for help which he denies since he hates kids. Things get chaotic after she kidnaps Yatharth at school and eventually makes way to the court. Vaibhav hates Akanksha for ruining his image when he left for America while Akanksha pretends to still love Vaibhav but actually wants to get 50% of his property and wealth. They make a mutual agreement to stay together only for the sake of getting revenge on Manav. After facing many false accusations, with the help of a retired and blind lawyer, Mr. Shenoy, Manav wins the case.
Manav moves into a new house and becomes the chief executive officer (CEO) of Holkar Industries to get revenge on Vaibhav for ruining Mr. Holkar and Ayesha's lives after Niharika's dismay. Manav finds out about Prateek and Parth from Malti aunty and tells him how they lost Prateek and Parth during a car accident. Manav is shocked to hear Sakshi went through so much. After a lot of convincing Sakshi moves in with Manav and Yatharth. All goes well until someone announces Sakshi as Manav's wife. Yatharth and Ayesha's plans on bringing them closer but all in vain. Manav and Sakshi find out about this, and they decide to part ways. Sakshi realizes she has feelings for Manav, but she doesn't say anything. Yatharth's mental health decreases drastically and stops attending school and breaks his friendship with Ayesha. Manav panics when he can't find a balance between work and his personal life and realizes how desperately he needs Sakshi.
Akanksha does whatever it takes to get Yatharth with her but fails desperately. Manav and Sakshi become friends after he warns her about her future groom, after having an awkward meeting with him. Things take a drastic turn when Yatharth has a bike accident and Vaibhav takes advantage and burns all of the files against him. At this point, Manav feels helpless, but a priest brings his hopes high after informing him that Niharika is alive. Manav and Mr. Holkar discovers that Vaibhav has hidden Niharika for seven years at an abandoned place for safekeeping. The day has come for Vaibhav and Akanksha's wedding where strange things occur, but this doesn't stop Akanksha from marrying Vaibhav. Everyone finally sees that Niharika is alive, and this was all part of Manav's plan. Vaibhav, having no choice, expels Akanksha from the house and office. Vaibhav is jailed and Akanksha visits him. At last, Vaibhav tells Akanksha his evil deeds to obtain her, but in reality, she is worthless. Despite everyone's warnings, Akanksha continues to interfere in Manav and Yatharth's lives as she has nowhere else to go. Manav and Sakshi realize their love for each other and gets engaged. Akanksha deliberately gets into a road car accident which Manav is blamed for and is arrested after Vaibhav informs the police about him trying to murder her. Akanksha gets Manav out of jail by giving a statement in his favor to gain entry into his life again. Vaibhav tries to strangle Niharika to death but she catches him doing so immediately. After Niharika explains to him about his obsession towards money and has left him with nothing, Vaibhav reforms himself and leaves to repent for his sins. Akanksha realizes her mistakes and leaves the house. Manav marries Sakshi.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Abhishek Rawat as Manav Bajpayee – Akanksha's ex-husband; Sakshi's second husband; Yatharth's father (2021–2022) * Ramnitu Chaudhary as Sakshi Verma Bajpayee – Prateek's widow; Manav's second wife; Parth's mother; Yatharth's teacher/adoptive mother (2022) * Chandni Sharma as Akanksha "Akku" Awasthi/Kaamnaa – Swati's younger daughter; Karan and Kavita's sister; Manav's ex-wife; Yatharth's mother; Vaibhav's ex-fiancée (2021-2022) * Manav Gohil as Vaibhav Kapoor – Akanksha's ex-fiancé; Niharika's ex-husband; Ayesha's step-father (2021–2022) * Tanmay Rishi Shah as Yatharth "Yathu" Bajpayee – Akanksha and Manav's son; Sakshi's student/adopted son (2021–2022)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Abhishek Rawat was cast to portray the lead Manav.
Chandni Sharma was cast as the lead Akanksha, her character later turns negative. Ramnitu Chaudhary was then cast as the new lead Sakshi.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Kaamnaa premeried on 21 November 2021 on Sony Entertainment Television. The promos of the show were directed by actor Gajraj Rao.

episodesList.title: Middle-Class Values
episodesList.summary: Manav and Akansha's views about success and happiness are poles apart. How will this married couple with conflicting ideologies coexist together?

episodesList.title: Broken Relationship
episodesList.summary: Manav and Akansha discuss the merits of divorce in a broken relationship. Vaibhav is obsessed with Akansha and is desperate to find out more about her.

episodesList.title: Zameer Ka Sauda
episodesList.summary: Manav's job is at risk when he refuses to support his senior's corrupt acts. Meanwhile, Vaibhav continues to collect more information about Akansha.

episodesList.title: Suspension Ki Talvaar
episodesList.summary: Manav and Akansha try to cheer up Yatharth while the threat of suspension looms over their heads. Can the Bajpai family find their way out of this problem?

episodesList.title: Manav's Promotion
episodesList.summary: Manav gets the opportunity of being promoted to a senior-level job in Indore. However, Akansha is against the idea of shifting there. Will Manav be able to convince her?

episodesList.title: Naya Sheher Nayi Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Akansha agrees to shift to Indore and the Bajpais are on their way. However, a nasty surprise awaits Akansha when she arrives at her new home.

episodesList.title: Indori Swagat
episodesList.summary: Manav arranges a candlelight dinner for Akansha to make it up to her. Meanwhile, Akansha tries to adjust to her new life and starts setting up her home.

episodesList.title: Blast From The Past
episodesList.summary: Akansha is confronted by her past as her mother and sister come to visit her. Meanwhile, Manav's duty pits him against Vaibhav Kapoor and his company.

episodesList.title: Beeta Hua Kal
episodesList.summary: Sangini confronts Vaibhav and threatens to expose him in the media. Meanwhile, Akansha tells Manav about her rocky history with her family.

episodesList.title: Heere Ki Parakh
episodesList.summary: Akansha and Manav attend a pooja in their locality. Coincidentally, Vaibhav also arrives at the pooja as a special guest.

episodesList.title: Miss Indore
episodesList.summary: Akansha is distressed as everyone at the pooja finds out about her past as Miss Indore. Meanwhile, Manav and Vaibhav have a run-in with each other, but things start on an unpleasant note.

episodesList.title: Vaibhav Ki Kaamnaa
episodesList.summary: The Bajpais decide to go on a tour of Indore. Meanwhile, Vaibhav hires a professional to find out more about Akansha.

episodesList.title: Khatirdaari Ka Mauka
episodesList.summary: Manav's senior takes him to Vaibhav's house to work out a deal between them. Meanwhile, Akansha's past comes to haunt her once again.

episodesList.title: Sapno Ka Bojh
episodesList.summary: Manav tries to talk about Akanshas past with her, but she is not willing to share. Meanwhile, Vaibhav gets a new lead that helps him find out more information about Akansha.

episodesList.title: Following The Rules
episodesList.summary: Akansha breaks down in front of Manav and tells him about her insecurities. Meanwhile, Vaibhav learns a key detail about Akansha from her ex-manager.

episodesList.title: Manav's Surprise
episodesList.summary: Manav plans a surprise for Akansha to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Vaibhav asks Rane to find out about Akanshas family.

episodesList.title: Naye Ghar Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: Manav plans to buy a new house for Akansha. The Bajpais head out for house hunting. Meanwhile, Vaibhav has a run-in with the woman of his dreams.

episodesList.title: Sentimental Value
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav tasks Tomar with monitoring Akansha and following her every step. Meanwhile, Manav asks his boss for a loan to buy the new flat.

episodesList.title: Manhoos Bungalow
episodesList.summary: Akansha comes across her old bungalow, which brings back memories from her past. Now she wants Manav to purchase that bungalow instead. What will Manav do?

episodesList.title: Kimati Yaadein
episodesList.summary: Akansha approaches Vaibhav Kapoor to enquire about the Bungalow. Will things fall in place according to Vaibhav's plan?

episodesList.title: Out Of Budget
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav agrees to sell the bungalow to Akansha. Now she only needs Manav's approval to seal the deal. But will Manav agree?

episodesList.title: Sapno Ka Ghar
episodesList.summary: Manav is not willing to buy the bungalow for Akansha. Meanwhile, Vaibhav accidentally sends an embarrassing text message to Akansha, confessing his feelings. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sarkari Naukar
episodesList.summary: Manav refuses to take any favours from Vaibhav to purchase the bungalow. Vaibhav feels insulted and uses some underhanded tactics to get back at him.

episodesList.title: Manav Ke Usool
episodesList.summary: Akansha gets a panic attack when she finds out that Vaibhav is selling the bungalow to someone else. With time running out and an acute shortage of cash, how will Manav fulfil Akansha's wish?

episodesList.title: Rishwat Ka Phanda
episodesList.summary: Manav is forced to take the bribe money to fulfil Akansha's demands. But now, he can't even look at himself in the mirror. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Clean Bowled
episodesList.summary: Manav is unable to live with himself, knowing that he has taken a bribe. He decides to return the money and clear his conscience. How will Akansha react when she hears about this decision?

episodesList.title: Akansha's Secret Santa
episodesList.summary: Akansha and Riya arrive at Vaibhav's party and get treated like VIPs. Meanwhile, Manav finds a way of arranging money for the bungalow. Will Manav's efforts be enough for Akansha?

episodesList.title: Dil Ka Khel Dimag Se
episodesList.summary: Manav arranges the money for the bungalow and locks the deal at Vaibhav's office. Vaibhav comes to the bungalow unannounced to meet Akansha and walks straight into the bedroom. What will happen when Manav sees this?

episodesList.title: Bin Bulaya Mehmaan
episodesList.summary: Manav is in a rage when he sees Vaibhav Kapoor in his bedroom. Vaibhav feels humiliated by Manav and vows to get back at him. What will he do to retaliate?

episodesList.title: Modelling Contract
episodesList.summary: Manav and Akansha face another crisis as the costs for renovation begin to pile up. Meanwhile, Akansha's ex-agent, Maya Xaviers, offers Akansha a new modelling contract. Is this all a part of Vaibhav's plan?

episodesList.title: Dosti Ka Haath
episodesList.summary: Manav warns Vaibhav to stay away from him and his family. However, things are starting to look up for Vaibhav as Akansha signs the contract.

episodesList.title: Daraar Ka Beej
episodesList.summary: Akansha makes a comeback on the modelling scene by signing a contract with Vaibhav Kapoor. Meanwhile, Manav gets threatened by loan sharks to repay the loan as soon as possible. What will he do?

episodesList.title: Pita Ka Vaada
episodesList.summary: Manav catches onto Vaibhav's plan and doesn't want Akansha to work with him anymore. Manav decides to sell his car to pay for Yatharth's school trip. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Yatharth's Trip
episodesList.summary: Manav somehow manages to sell his old car to send Yatharth for the trip. Meanwhile, Vaibhav calls up Akansha and delivers some bad news. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Fame Ka Zaika
episodesList.summary: Akansha panics when she sees her fame slipping away. She resents Manav for his actions and behaviour. Will things turn out in Vaibhav's favour?

episodesList.title: Out Of Track
episodesList.summary: Akansha is distressed after losing the modelling contract. At Akansha's request, Vaibhav sits down with Manav and hopes to make a deal with him.

episodesList.title: Vaibhav's Offer
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav extends a hand of friendship towards Manav and wants to put their differences behind. Will Manav accept Vaibhav's friendship?

episodesList.title: Dinner With Vaibhav Kapoor
episodesList.summary: Manav agrees to accept Vaibhav's offer and put his differences aside for Akansha's happiness. To celebrate this deal, Vaibhav invites Manav and his family for dinner at his house.

episodesList.title: Manav Ka Shak
episodesList.summary: Manav notices that something is off in Vaibhav's behaviour around Akansha. Will Manav finally catch onto Vaibhav's true intent?

episodesList.title: Zor Azmaish
episodesList.summary: Manav pieces together past events, and his suspicion turn into surety. Meanwhile, Vaibhav decides to take a different approach to achieve his ultimate goal.

episodesList.title: Niyat Ka Sawal
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav wins over Akansha with his words and his business pitch. Meanwhile, Pathan pressurizes Manav to repay the loan within two days. Will Manav give his approval to Akansha for working with Vaibhav?

episodesList.title: Once In A Lifetime Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Akansha is distraught when Manav prohibits her from working with Vaibhav. Meanwhile, Manav passes out from the pressure of paying back the loan and gets admitted to a hospital. How will the Bajpais arrange such a large sum of money now?

episodesList.title: Akansha Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Akansha signs the contract with Vaibhav to pay off the loan. Manav is shocked and enraged to learn about Akansha's actions. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Natak Ki Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Akansha begins rehearsals for the stage play. Manav reaches the rehearsal hall, where he gets insulted and is told to leave. Will Vaibhav succeed in tearing down Manav's life?

episodesList.title: Vaibhav's Cupid
episodesList.summary: Maya decides to play cupid for Vaibhav and Akansha. Meanwhile, Akansha forgets to inform Manav about picking up Yatharth from school, and Yatharth gets stuck outside the house.

episodesList.title: Loose Character
episodesList.summary: Differences between Manav and Akansha continue to grow. Meanwhile, Maya plays her tricks to bring Vaibhav closer to Akansha.

episodesList.title: Method Acting
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav takes over as the male lead of the play. Akansha starts visiting Vaibhav's house for the rehearsals. Meanwhile, Yatharth and Manav have a tough time coming to terms with these new circumstances.

episodesList.title: Adhura Rishta
episodesList.summary: Yatharth joins the new school where he gets bullied by the kids. Meanwhile, Vaibhav grows closer to Akansha by using his tricks.

episodesList.title: Pyaar Aur Takraar
episodesList.summary: Manav gets a call from Yatharth's school and he rushes there. Vaibhav's plan seems to be working as Akansha starts seeing him in a different light.

episodesList.title: Bharose Ki Dorr
episodesList.summary: Akansha feels horrible about her neglectful actions when she learns about Yatharth's injury. She promises Manav that she will always be faithful to him and her family. But will Manav trust her words?

episodesList.title: Fuel To The Fire
episodesList.summary: Akansha slaps Vaibhav and leaves the play after he tries to kiss her. However, Vaibhav is confident that Akansha will return to him. Is this all a part of Vaibhav's master plan?

episodesList.title: Love Struck
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav is sure that Akansha is in love with him, and he invites her home to prove his point. Will Vaibhav's assessment be true, or will he stand corrected?

episodesList.title: Dil Ki Baazi
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav finally confesses his love for Akansha. He offers her to begin a new life with him. Between her family and Vaibhav, what will Akansha choose?

episodesList.title: Sapno Ki Chalaang
episodesList.summary: Manav heads out to confront Vaibhav at his office. Meanwhile, Akansha chooses to live with Vaibhav and accepts her feelings for him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Yatharth's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Akansha agrees to stay back for Yatharth's birthday party. How long can Akansha and Manav hide the truth about their crumbling marriage?

episodesList.title: Paisa Aur Pyaar
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav comes to pick up Akansha, and she leaves with him. Manav is overwhelmed with emotions of anger and loss, while Vaibhav welcomes Akansha into his house.

episodesList.title: Marzi Aur Majboori
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav and Akansha begin a new chapter in their life together. Meanwhile, Manav contemplates how to tell Yatharth about Akansha's truth.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Phase
episodesList.summary: Manav has a hard time dealing with the responsibilities of a single working parent. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha prepare to go on their honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Bajpai Family Problems
episodesList.summary: Now that Vaibhav has attained his goal, he decides to cancel the play. Meanwhile, Manav and Yatharth struggle to move on with their lives without Akansha.

episodesList.title: Magic Hands
episodesList.summary: Yatharth gets hospitalized after getting into a terrible accident. Manav tells Akansha that he will never let her get back into Yatharth's life. Can Manav handle the weight of the household all by himself?

episodesList.title: Yatharth's New Teacher
episodesList.summary: Manav takes up the responsibility of teaching Yatharth in Akansha's absence. Meanwhile, Vaibhav cuts Akansha off from her past and tries to control her life. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Queen Akansha Kapoor
episodesList.summary: Kaushal spots Akansha with Vaibhav, and questions Manav about it. Meanwhile, Vaibhav boosts Akansha's ego by making her a part of his business.

episodesList.title: A New Low For The Bajpai Family
episodesList.summary: Yatharth learns the truth about his mother, and Manav gets thrown into jail for beating up Kaushal. How will father and son navigate through these dire circumstances?

episodesList.title: A Golden Dawn
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav gains Karan's favour with bribes. Kaushal takes back his complaint and frees Manav from jail. Yatharth wipes his father's tears and decides to take care of him on his own.

episodesList.title: Masoom Sach
episodesList.summary: Akansha's brother approves her decision of moving in with Vaibhav. Meanwhile, Akansha comes to Yatharth's school to meet him.

episodesList.title: Yatharth's Mental Health
episodesList.summary: Manav gets a call from the school to meet Sakshi Verma, the school counsellor. Sakshi informs Manav about Yatharth's deteriorating mental health.

episodesList.title: Welcome To The New CEO
episodesList.summary: Karan tries to take Yatharth away and make him meet Akansha. However, Manav confronts him in time and gives him a stern warning. Meanwhile, Vaibhav decides to make Akansha the new CEO of his company.

episodesList.title: Burning Bridges
episodesList.summary: Akansha comes to Yatharth's school to meet him, but Yatharth runs away to avoid her. Meanwhile, Manav confronts Akansha and warns her to stay away from Yatharth.

episodesList.title: Best Father In The World
episodesList.summary: Manav and Yatharth have an emotional confrontation, and they decide to live their life happily without Akansha.  Meanwhile, the school counsellor Sakshi Verma invites Akansha and Manav for a much-needed therapy session.

episodesList.title: Out Of Hand
episodesList.summary: Things quickly get out of hand during Manav and Akansha's counselling session. Akansha arrives at the colony to meet Yatharth. But instead of greeting her with open arms, Yatharth runs away from her and locks himself inside the house.

episodesList.title: Bewafai Ki Saza
episodesList.summary: Akansha's mother gets hospitalised after having a heart attack. Meanwhile, Yatharth and Manav throw a party and announce that they will be a family of two from now on.

episodesList.title: Odd One Out
episodesList.summary: Manav and Yatharth make a shocking announcement during the colony party. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha arrive at Yatharth's school to take him home.

episodesList.title: Yatharth Disowns Akansha
episodesList.summary: Akansha reaches the school but gets a very cold reaction from Yatharth. Akansha swears to get revenge on Manav for turning Yatharth against her.

episodesList.title: Gaslighting
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav threatens to take Yatharth away from Manav. However, Yatharth is clear that he wants to stay with Manav. What will Vaibhav do to separate the father and son?

episodesList.title: Termination Of The Student Counselor
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav pulls some strings and terminates Sakshi from her job. Manav and Yatharth arrive at Sakshi's house, where they learn this shocking truth. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha celebrate their win.

episodesList.title: Ek Naya Toofan
episodesList.summary: Sakshi loses her job and her house in a single night. Vaibhav and Akansha are busy celebrating this victory while Manav and Yatharth search for Sakshi. What does fate have in store for them next?

episodesList.title: Insult To Injury
episodesList.summary: Akansha insults Sakshi after getting her terminated from her job. Meanwhile, Aisha and Yatharth meet with the school chairman in hopes of getting Sakshi her job back. Will they be able to convince him?

episodesList.title: Golden Touch
episodesList.summary: Yatharth and Aisha are unable to get Sakshi's termination reversed. Meanwhile, Manav goes out to look for Sakshi as well. Will he be able to find her?

episodesList.title: Mantra For Happiness
episodesList.summary: Manav and Yatharth convince Sakshi to stay with them at their home. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha prepare for the school board meeting to gain Yatharth's custody.

episodesList.title: Yatharth's Guardianship
episodesList.summary: The battle to determine Yatharth's true guardian gets underway. Will Manav's love win over Akansha's greed?

episodesList.title: Sole Guardian
episodesList.summary: Manav and Akansha raise their points in front of the board to gain the upper hand. The board decides to take a vote to make the final decision. Will their verdict be in Manav's favour?

episodesList.title: Khushaal Ghar
episodesList.summary: The school board surprisingly votes in favour of Manav and Yatharth. Father and son decide to celebrate while Vaibhav and Akansha are left to lick their wounds. Will Vaibhav give up after this defeat?

episodesList.title: Victory Celebration
episodesList.summary: The celebration begins at the Bajpai house. Yatharth and Aisha honour Sakshi on the occasion of women's day. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha also arrive at the party uninvited.

episodesList.title: Yatharth Ki Strength
episodesList.summary: Vaibhav and Akansha arrive at the Bajpai house and wish to meet Yatharth. Manav and the others motivate Yatharth to face his fears head-on. Will Yatharth be able to take a stand against his own mother?

episodesList.title: By Hook Or By Crook
episodesList.summary: Akansha arrives at Yatharth's school and forcefully takes him away with her. Manav finds out, and he contacts the police. Will Manav be able to find Yatharth?

episodesList.title: A Sore Loser
episodesList.summary: Manav receives the news that Yatharth and Akansha got into an ugly accident. Manav rushes to check on them at the accident site. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Search For Yatharth
episodesList.summary: Manav and the others search for Yatharth near the accident site. Meanwhile, Akansha kidnaps Yatharth and tries to rekindle her relationship with him.

episodesList.title: Manav Saves Akansha
episodesList.summary: Manav walks out of a burning building with Akansha in his arms. Manav gets convinced not to file an FIR against Akansha so that it doesn't affect Yatharth's mental health. Later, Vaibhav yells at Akansha for making stupid decisions.

episodesList.title: Yatharth's Nightmares
episodesList.summary: Yatharth's nightmare makes him wet the bed again. Akansha tries to woo Vaibhav by making breakfast but he tells her that she needs to get rid of her middle-class tendencies.

episodesList.title: Negligence At Work
episodesList.summary: In Vaibhav's absence, Akansha tries to show off her office to Manav, but right then, Rane comes with the news of a mishap. Manav hears this and gets in touch with Kaushal, while Rane tells Akansha to take this seriously.

plotHtml:
Manav, a hardworking and straightforward government officer, follows his principles with complete honesty. In contrast, his wife Akanksha desires to lead a luxurious life with everything she wants. Despite not getting everything, they wish for, the two are happy with their son, Yatharth. All goes well until a businessman, Vaibhav Kapoor, who believes anything can be bought by money, falls in love at first sight with Akanksha, his Kaamnaa (translation: wish or desire) as he likes to call her, without knowing her real identity.
Manav transfers from Bhopal to Indore and patches things up between Akanksha and her family. Akanksha shares her past with Manav and reveals that she was once Miss Indore, but only because her father bribed the judges. Vaibhav gets closer to Akanksha by buying her old bungalow and even offering her a job to model his company with extra perks. Still, Manav disapproves of this as he suspects Vaibhav's intentions. After some time, Akanksha falls in love with Vaibhav, leaving Manav shattered.
Akanksha's leave worsens Yatharth's mental health, where Sakshi, his school counselor, helps him. Sakshi's husband, Prateek, and son, Parth, died in a car accident and has affected her since. Sakshi sees Parth in Yatharth, forcing her to leave the school after interfering with Manav and Akanksha's sole guardianship of Yatharth. After losing everything, Manav feels guilty and lets Sakshi and her mother-in-law, Malti stay with them for the sake of Yatharth.
Manav wins legal guardianship of his son after Mr. Holkar shows sympathy for him and realizes his past mistakes. Akanksha gets paranoid when she can't find any way to get Yatharth to be with her, even after asking Vaibhav for help which he denies since he hates kids. Things get chaotic after she kidnaps Yatharth at school and eventually makes way to the court. Vaibhav hates Akanksha for ruining his image when he left for America while Akanksha pretends to still love Vaibhav but actually wants to get 50% of his property and wealth. They make a mutual agreement to stay together only for the sake of getting revenge on Manav. After facing many false accusations, with the help of a retired and blind lawyer, Mr. Shenoy, Manav wins the case.
Manav moves into a new house and becomes the chief executive officer (CEO) of Holkar Industries to get revenge on Vaibhav for ruining Mr. Holkar and Ayesha's lives after Niharika's dismay. Manav finds out about Prateek and Parth from Malti aunty and tells him how they lost Prateek and Parth during a car accident. Manav is shocked to hear Sakshi went through so much. After a lot of convincing Sakshi moves in with Manav and Yatharth. All goes well until someone announces Sakshi as Manav's wife. Yatharth and Ayesha's plans on bringing them closer but all in vain. Manav and Sakshi find out about this, and they decide to part ways. Sakshi realizes she has feelings for Manav, but she doesn't say anything. Yatharth's mental health decreases drastically and stops attending school and breaks his friendship with Ayesha. Manav panics when he can't find a balance between work and his personal life and realizes how desperately he needs Sakshi.
Akanksha does whatever it takes to get Yatharth with her but fails desperately. Manav and Sakshi become friends after he warns her about her future groom, after having an awkward meeting with him. Things take a drastic turn when Yatharth has a bike accident and Vaibhav takes advantage and burns all of the files against him. At this point, Manav feels helpless, but a priest brings his hopes high after informing him that Niharika is alive. Manav and Mr. Holkar discovers that Vaibhav has hidden Niharika for seven years at an abandoned place for safekeeping. The day has come for Vaibhav and Akanksha's wedding where strange things occur, but this doesn't stop Akanksha from marrying Vaibhav. Everyone finally sees that Niharika is alive, and this was all part of Manav's plan. Vaibhav, having no choice, expels Akanksha from the house and office. Vaibhav is jailed and Akanksha visits him. At last, Vaibhav tells Akanksha his evil deeds to obtain her, but in reality, she is worthless. Despite everyone's warnings, Akanksha continues to interfere in Manav and Yatharth's lives as she has nowhere else to go. Manav and Sakshi realize their love for each other and gets engaged. Akanksha deliberately gets into a road car accident which Manav is blamed for and is arrested after Vaibhav informs the police about him trying to murder her. Akanksha gets Manav out of jail by giving a statement in his favor to gain entry into his life again. Vaibhav tries to strangle Niharika to death but she catches him doing so immediately. After Niharika explains to him about his obsession towards money and has left him with nothing, Vaibhav reforms himself and leaves to repent for his sins. Akanksha realizes her mistakes and leaves the house. Manav marries Sakshi.
tagline: Manav, a hardworking and straightforward government officer, follows his principles with complete honesty.

title: Kaliveedu
summary: Kaliveedu (transl. The House of Entertainment) was an Indian Malayalam-language soap opera directed by Dileep Kumar. The show aired from 15 November 2021 to 22 September 2024 on Surya TV. It stars Rebecca Santhosh and Nithin Jake Joseph in lead roles along with Gayathri Mayura, Uma Nair, Krishna Prabha and Sreelatha Namboothiri in pivotal roles. It is an official remake of Tamil TV series Roja.
plot:
Pooja is raised in an orphanage, Snehasadhanam by her foster-father Vishwanathan and has a sweet, kind disposition. She, in reality, is Anu, the long-lost daughter of Nandagopan and the late Arunima. She was separated from her family following an accident which killed her mother and supposedly her too. The accident was plotted by her paternal uncle, Shankar Ram for inheriting her father's wealth. She comes across her living father, Nandagopan and develops a bond with him, though unaware of their relationship. Arjun, humble despite his wealth, is a leading criminal lawyer. Pooja and Arjun meet several times and develop a mutual dislike for each other due to their contrasting personalities.
Vishwanathan rejects the business offer of Sakshi, a crooked businesswoman who wishes to buy Snehasadanam ashram. To get rid of Vishwanathan, she frames him for the murder of Theja with the help of Priya, another inmate of Snehasadanam. Nandagopan takes up the case. Priya masquerades herself as the long-lost Anu and returns to Nandagopan. Due to Pooja and Priya's varying statements on the Theja murder Case, Nandagopan backs off from the case, causing Pooja to look for another lawyer. Pooja attempts to hire Arjun but he backs off citing that his remuneration is beyond her capacity.
Arunima's family reunites with fake Anu and decides to get her married to Arjun, who is her cousin. Arjun who loathes love and marriage refuses but eventually has to relent due to the family's pressure. To break the marriage, he puts a condition ahead of Pooja to enter a one-year contract marriage with him in return for him acquitting her father without any fees. Without another choice, Pooja accepts the offer. The two secretly marry in a temple on Arjun's engagement day and pretend like a married couple in front of the family. Priya and Arjun's aunt, Madhumita, who hates Pooja because of a past incident, try to discredit and endanger Pooja several times but fail in every attempt. Over time, Arjun and Pooja develop a good friendship bond and fall for each other.
Akhil falls in love with a feisty girl, Sneha and secretly marries her when the family decides to get him married to Priya. Arjun and Pooja discover that Arunima was alive all along and is living as a nurse after suffering memory loss and reunite her with the family.
reception: The show received positive response from the audience.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The show's launch was planned for April 2021 but was delayed until November due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It was reported in October 2021, that Kaliveedu is an official remake of the popular Tamil soap opera Roja.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is mainly filmed Thiruvananthapuram and its whereabouts.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Rebecca Santhosh was cast as the protagonist while Nithin Jake Joseph was roped in to play the male lead.
Neena Kurup and Baby Ameya made cameo appearances in the first episode. Veterans Sethu Lakshmi, Kochu Preman and Raghavan also featured in the show.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first promotional video of Kaliveedu featuring lead actress Rebecca Santhosh was released in September 2021. The show premiered on Surya TV on 15 November 2021. It is telecasted every day at the 9:00 p.m. (IST) time slot. On the digital platform, Kaliveedu is available for viewing on the app Sun NXT.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: Reviewing the first episode of the show for The Times of India, Radhika Nair thought the show had an "Interesting storyline but lacked lustre". She further wrote: "the show lacks an X-factor to leave the telly audiences wanting for more".

plotHtml:
Pooja is raised in an orphanage, Snehasadhanam by her foster-father Vishwanathan and has a sweet, kind disposition. She, in reality, is Anu, the long-lost daughter of Nandagopan and the late Arunima. She was separated from her family following an accident which killed her mother and supposedly her too. The accident was plotted by her paternal uncle, Shankar Ram for inheriting her father's wealth. She comes across her living father, Nandagopan and develops a bond with him, though unaware of their relationship. Arjun, humble despite his wealth, is a leading criminal lawyer. Pooja and Arjun meet several times and develop a mutual dislike for each other due to their contrasting personalities.
Vishwanathan rejects the business offer of Sakshi, a crooked businesswoman who wishes to buy Snehasadanam ashram. To get rid of Vishwanathan, she frames him for the murder of Theja with the help of Priya, another inmate of Snehasadanam. Nandagopan takes up the case. Priya masquerades herself as the long-lost Anu and returns to Nandagopan. Due to Pooja and Priya's varying statements on the Theja murder Case, Nandagopan backs off from the case, causing Pooja to look for another lawyer. Pooja attempts to hire Arjun but he backs off citing that his remuneration is beyond her capacity.
Arunima's family reunites with fake Anu and decides to get her married to Arjun, who is her cousin. Arjun who loathes love and marriage refuses but eventually has to relent due to the family's pressure. To break the marriage, he puts a condition ahead of Pooja to enter a one-year contract marriage with him in return for him acquitting her father without any fees. Without another choice, Pooja accepts the offer. The two secretly marry in a temple on Arjun's engagement day and pretend like a married couple in front of the family. Priya and Arjun's aunt, Madhumita, who hates Pooja because of a past incident, try to discredit and endanger Pooja several times but fail in every attempt. Over time, Arjun and Pooja develop a good friendship bond and fall for each other.
Akhil falls in love with a feisty girl, Sneha and secretly marries her when the family decides to get him married to Priya. Arjun and Pooja discover that Arunima was alive all along and is living as a nurse after suffering memory loss and reunite her with the family.
tagline: Pooja is raised in an orphanage, Snehasadhanam by her foster-father Vishwanathan and has a sweet, kind disposition.

title: Kashibai Bajirao Ballal
summary: Kashibai Bajirao Ballal is an Indian historical drama based on Kashibai. It premiered on 15 November 2021 on Zee TV with Aarohi Patel as Young Kashi Bai and Venkatesh Pandey as Young Bajirao. On 21 March 2022, the story moved on several years and Riya Sharma portrays the lead role of Kashibai opposite Rohit Chandel who essays the role of Bajirao. It went off air on 19 August 2022, after completing 201 episodes.

title: Kayal
summary:
Kayal is a 2021 Indian Tamil language television series starring Chaitra Reddy and Sanjeev Karthik.
The series premiered on 25 October 2021 on Sun TV and is also available on the digital platform Sun NXT. It is directed by P. Selvam and produced by Vision Time India Private Limited in association with Sun Entertainment.
plot: Abandoned by her father Muthuvel & coping with an alcoholic brother Moorthy, Kayal works as a nurse to become her family's sole provider. She finds happiness in her sacrifice to meet the needs of her brother: Moorthy and Anbu & sisters: Devi and Anandhi.
reception:
Kayal became one of the most-watched Tamil television programs from its launch week in 2021. In the BARC era of Tamil serials, it is the only show to claim the No. 1 position in its launch week itself.
The show climbed into the top 5 most-watched programs across all GECs within just a few weeks of its launch. It also gave strong competition to Bharathi Kannamma aired on Star Vijay.
