episodesList.summary: Panjiri, Prema and the others decide to catch Kanhaiya red-handed while he smokes. Overhearing Kanhaiya's conversation with his friend, they assume that he is going out for a smoke.

episodesList.title: A Huge Disappointment For Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's wives spy on him, assuming that he went out to smoke. Kunti faints as she thinks that Kanhaiya smokes and consumes alcohol!

episodesList.title: Kunti Worries About Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: Kunti fears the consequences of confronting Kanhaiya about his smoking habit. Pratap convinces Kanhaiya to play the roll of a drunkard. Kunti and Panjiri panic after they overhear Kanhaiya's conversation with Khatru.

episodesList.title: Pratibha Discloses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Kunti sets out to speak about Kanhaiya's smoking addiction in her speech. Meanwhile, Pratibha tells the other bahus that Kanhaiya is neither a drunkard nor is he addicted to smoking.

episodesList.title: Kunti Realises Her Folly
episodesList.summary: Kunti realises her folly and apologises to Kanhaiya after Kamal tells everyone that Kanhaiya helped him quit his smoking habit. Later, Pratibha, Prema and Kunti are unable to find Kanhaiya!

episodesList.title: Kunti Worships Lord Shiva
episodesList.summary: Kunti feels distressed after hearing Kanhaiya's problem with the dance rehearsals. She worships Lord Shiva to grant her son a boon.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Gets Special Powers
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya receives a special power after he survives an electric shock. Later, his wives are exhausted after they practice dance with him for the Sangeet ceremony while Kanhaiya remains active!

episodesList.title: Pratap Gets an Electric Shock
episodesList.summary: Over the breakfast, Pratap gets an electric shock when he accidentally touches Kanhaiya. The situation worsens when one of Kanhaiya’s customers receives an electric shock.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya has Superpowers!
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's wives learn that he has some superpowers. They prevent Kunti from hugging Kanhaiya while Pratibha proves that he is 'Bijli Man'.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Stay In His Shop
episodesList.summary: Khatru refuses to help Kanhaiya when he seeks his help regarding his peculiar problem. He suffers an electric shock when he hugs Kanhaiya. Later, Kanhaiya decides to stay in his shop.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Troublesome Powers
episodesList.summary: The news about Kanhaiya being the Bijli Man goes viral. Kunti and Pratibha get tensed on learning that Vimala's son's marriage got called off.

episodesList.title: Power House, Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: When the power goes off in Kanhaiya’s house, he helps his wives and his mother in different ways using his powers. Later, Kanhaiya saves a man from getting robbed by electrocuting the thugs.

episodesList.title: Kunti Falls Unconscious!
episodesList.summary: Kunti decides to worship Lord Shiv to help Kanhaiya from the electrifying scenario. Everyone is shocked as Kunti falls unconscious. The doctor confirms Kunti has kicked the bucket!

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Life is In Danger
episodesList.summary: A sage warns Kanhaiya that a naagin will hunt him down within nine days to take her revenge. What has Kanhaiya done?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya In a Weird Situation
episodesList.summary: Chaurasiya informs Kunti that to counter the nagin's wrath, Kanhaiya has to pretend to be a snake for a day. On the other end, the nagin keeps an eye on Kanhaiya.

episodesList.title: A Naagin In Kunti Nivas
episodesList.summary: A naagin visits Kunti Nivas in the disguise of Naina, a salesgirl. Panjiri suspects that Naina is a naagin. Kanhaiya drinks milk like a snake. Later, Panjiri frets when she enters Kanhaiya's room. Why?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Turns Into a Coconut?
episodesList.summary: Naagin rests on a snoozing Kanhaiya and fizzles as his family members watch in horror. Later, Panjiri breaks into tears as she believes Kanhaiya has turned into a coconut.

episodesList.title: A Snake Around Kanhaiya's Neck
episodesList.summary: Khatru gets scared when he notices a snake around Kanhaiyas neck. Later, Naagin visits Kanhaiyas house. But, why?

episodesList.title: Pratap, The Scapegoat
episodesList.summary: Pratap fears for his life as Kanhaiya's wives bait him to catch the naagin. Panjiri is alarmed as she witnesses Kunti hissing in distress. Has naagin taken the form of Kunti?

episodesList.title: Naagin Confronts Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: Panjiri, Prema and Pratibha suspect that Kunti is a naagin and try to clarify their doubts about the same. Meanwhile, at Kanhaiya's shop, a naagin, thirsty for revenge, confronts him.

episodesList.title: Kunti Gives a Chance to Pratap
episodesList.summary: Kunti compels Pratap to work as a peon when he asks her for money. However, on Kanhaiya's insistence, she decides otherwise and asks him to leave the house if he fails to repay her within two days.

episodesList.title: A Shock Awaits Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kunti is determined to oust Pratap if he fails to repay her. However, Pratap makes a shocking claim when Kunti demands the money he had borrowed from her.

episodesList.title: Pratap's Move Against Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kunti tells everyone that she did not receive any money from Pratap and decides to expose him. Meanwhile, Pratap comes up with a clever plan to foil her attempts.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: Kunti is shocked when Pratap tries to prove that she is having a short-term memory loss. Kanhaiya and his wives are worried about Kunti's situation. Will Kunti be able to prove Pratap wrong?

episodesList.title: Pratap Targets Kunti
episodesList.summary: Pratap misleads Kunti into believing that there will be a flood. Later, he tricks Prarthana and Panjiri into believing that Kunti is extremely absent-minded.

episodesList.title: Shock Treatment For Kunti!
episodesList.summary: Pratap stops the doctor from taking Kunti to the mental hospital. He feels hassled as the doctor decides to subject Kunti to shock treatment to revive her memory! What will Pratap do now?

episodesList.title: Panjiri In Trouble!
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's wives are scared to find out that Muhnochwa is terrorising their city. Kanhaiya is reluctant to believe that Muhnochwa exists. Meanwhile, Muhnochwa tries to attack Panjiri!

episodesList.title: Khatru Ki Jaan Khatre Mein
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and his family members are alarmed as an unknown creature attacks Khatru. Kunti is shocked to learn the reason behind the creature's visit.

episodesList.title: What will Ram Prasad do Now?
episodesList.summary: The police inform Kunti that Ram Prasad will be felicitated with a bravery award on Independence Day for facing the dangerous creature. Will he become the creature's next target?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Nab Muhnochwa
episodesList.summary: Kunti fears that Muhnochwa will attack her. Kanhaiya and others assure Kunti that they will protect her. Later, Kanhaiya devises a plan to nab Muhnochwa.

episodesList.title: The Bahus Protect Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and family panic on noticing a threatening message stating that Muhnochwa will return to target Kunti. The bahus determine to protect Kunti. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Kunti's Altered Identity
episodesList.summary: The evil severed hand attacks Pratap who disguises himself as Kunti. Later, Kunti's daughters-in-law come up with a plan to save her, with a new identity.

episodesList.title: Kunti Provokes Muhnochwa
episodesList.summary: Learning that Muhnochwa is attacking others in his attempt to find Kunti, she decides to come out in the open. She gives a press statement challenging him to come to Kunti Nivas!

episodesList.title: Kunti And Family Fight Back!
episodesList.summary: Kunti and her family decide to fight back against the severed hand. Everyone's fear turns into joy when a special guest visits their house.

episodesList.title: Ravi Dubey Visits Kunti Nivas
episodesList.summary: Ravi Dubey visits Kunti Nivas to promote his show, Sabse Smart Kaun? He puts Kanhaiya and his family's wit to test. Later, he tries to solve the mystery of Muhnochwa.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Solves The Mystery
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and his family solve the mystery of the severed hand with the help of Ravi Dubey. Later, Kanhaiya is shocked when Kusum demands an expensive gift on the occasion of Rakshabandhan.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya is Threatened
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya gets a threat note, asking him to stop the Rakshabandhan sari discount sale in his shop. Who is threatening Kanhaiya?

episodesList.title: Kusum Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: The situation gets scary for Kunti and her family members when they receive too many threatening notes. Next morning, Kusum gets abducted from her doorstep.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya has a Plan
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya comes up with a plan to teach Kusum a lesson after he learns that she planned her own kidnapping just to get a new phone.

episodesList.title: Devaki, Kanhaiya's Real Mother?
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya’s wives find it difficult to get a haircut for him as he starts laughing at the sounds of the scissors. Meanwhile, Kunti meets Kanhaiya’s real mother, Devaki.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya gets upset when he learns that he is Kunti’s adopted child. Meanwhile, Devaki tells Kunti that she wants to meet him. Will Kunti oblige her?

episodesList.title: Kunti Disappoints Kanhaiya?
episodesList.summary: Kunti asks Devaki to meet Kanhaiya on Krishna Janmashtami. Kanhaiya is upset on learning that Kunti doesn’t remember any of his childhood incidents. Later, he decides to ask Kunti about his biological parents.

episodesList.title: Shocking News For Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya is utterly shocked as he eavesdrops on Kunti's conversation and learns that he's Kunti's adopted son. Who is Kanhaiya's real mother?

episodesList.title: Kunti to Send Kanhaiya Away
episodesList.summary: Kunti decides to send Kanhaiya to Hoshangabad for good. Kanhaiya and his wives are tensed as they learn about it. Will Kanhaiya abide by Kunti's words?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Feels Relieved
episodesList.summary: Kunti clarifies Kanhaiya and her Bahus misunderstanding regarding Devaki. Kanhaiya is relieved to learn that Kunti is only his biological mother and not Devaki. Later, Kunti buys silver bangles for her Bahus.

episodesList.title: Kunti Wants Compensation
episodesList.summary: Kunti seeks compensation from Lord Shiva for misunderstanding her and giving her five bahus. She asks him to grant her five shops. Later, Kunti is hassled as Panjiri refuses to recognise her!

episodesList.title: Panjiri Forgets Kunti, Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: Panjiri refuses to recognise anyone from Kanhaiya's family except Prarthana. Lord Shiv tells Kunti that he will let Kanhaiya have only one wife as he owns a single shop. What will Kunti do now?

episodesList.title: Kunti is In Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: Kunti worries about the consequences of her allegations and thinks twice before talking to Kanhaiya's wives. After Panjiri's memory loss, another Bahu falls prey to Kunti's words.

episodesList.title: Pratibha to Get Married Again?
episodesList.summary: Kunti, Kanhaiya and Pratap go to Pratibha's home to bring her back. They get hassled on learning that Pratibha's parents are planning to get her married to someone else!

episodesList.title: Prarthana, Panjiri Take a Stand
episodesList.summary: Pratap talks to Pratibha's parents against getting her married again. After Kunti scolds Prarthana, she refuses to recognise her and Kanhaiya. Panjiri and Prarthana go away from Kanhaiya's house with their uncle.

episodesList.title: Kunti Prays to Lord Shiv
episodesList.summary: Kunti requests Lord Shiv to let all her Bahus stay with her as she wishes to celebrate Teej with them. Kanhaiya learns that Panjiri and Prarthana's parents are planning to get them married. What will he do now?

episodesList.title: Pari Leaves Kunti Nivas
episodesList.summary: After Kunti scolds Pari, she forgets that she is married to Kanhaiya. Paying no heed to Kunti's request, she leaves Kunti Nivas with her mother.

episodesList.title: Will Lord Shiva Agree?
episodesList.summary: Kunti asks Lord Shiva to get Kanhaiya’s wives back into his life. Will Lord Shiva listen to Kunti's plea?

episodesList.title: Kunti Dotes On Her Bahus
episodesList.summary: Kunti is elated to see her five Bahus celebrating the Teej festival. Pari has a disturbing dream. Mistaking a scorpion for ginger, Panjiri holds it in her hand!

episodesList.title: Kunti Stung By a Scorpion?
episodesList.summary: Kunti’s bahus fret, assuming that a scorpion has stung her. As part of the treatment, they stop her from falling asleep. However, why is Kanhaiya feeling uneasy?

episodesList.title: Kunti, Bahus Play Antakshari
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya is unable to believe that a scorpion stung him. Kunti's Bahus challenge her to win against them in a game of antakshari to keep her awake the entire night.

episodesList.title: Antakshari At Kunti's House
episodesList.summary: Kunti, Kanhaiya and his wives play antakshari to keep Kunti awake. The next morning, Kanhaiya and the bahus come up with a unique idea to prevent Kunti from sleeping.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya is Not Fine
episodesList.summary: While Kanhaiya is unwell, Pratibha and the others assume that he is pretending according to their plan to prevent Kunti from falling asleep!

episodesList.title: Kunti, Bahus Pray For Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: The effect of poison takes a toll on Kanhaiya and he collapses. Kunti and his wives learn that he is stung by a scorpion and pray fervently for his recovery.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Plans For Ganesh Utsav
episodesList.summary: Kunti and Kanhaiya, with their neighbours, plan to celebrate Ganesh Mahotsav. Kunti intends to make Sarla feel jealous.

episodesList.title: Pratap Commits a Blunder
episodesList.summary: Pratap mistakes that the box containing Kunti’s expensive ornament has prasad in it and offers it to Lord Ganesh at the Ganesh Mahotsav puja!

episodesList.title: A New Problem For Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kunti worries about losing a costly jewellery after offering it to Lord Ganesh during the festival. Few burglars decide to loot the valuables. Will Kunti get back her jewellery?

episodesList.title: Kunti Seeks a Solution
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya sets out to buy jewellery for Kunti. Meanwhile, Kunti seeks a solution from Lord Shiv for her problem. She and her bahus are upset to learn about the stolen offerings.

episodesList.title: Kunti Feels Relieved
episodesList.summary: Kunti heaves a sigh of relief as she finds her expensive ornament. Later, she compels a reluctant Kanhaiya and Pratibha to send her to Banaras.

episodesList.title: Kunti to Visit Banaras
episodesList.summary: Kunti leaves for Banaras. Later, Kanhaiya and his family worry about her after they contact someone in Banaras.

episodesList.title: Kunti is Missing!
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and his wives are hassled as they are unable to track Kunti's whereabouts after she goes to Banaras. Kanhaiya seeks help from the police to find her.

episodesList.title: Kunti is Abducted!
episodesList.summary: Panjiri, Pratibha and Pari search for Kunti. Meanwhile, Kanhaiya panics when Kunti’s abductors call him to demand a ransom.

episodesList.title: The Police Suspect Pratap
episodesList.summary: The police suspect that Pratap has abducted Kunti. The fake kidnappers plan to collect ransom from Kanhaiya and inform him that Kunti is in their captivity!

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Spots Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya sets out to pay the ransom. Seeing Kunti, he refuses to pay the fake abductors but, they try to take away the money.

episodesList.title: Pratibha Misleads Her Uncle
episodesList.summary: Pratibha tries to mislead her uncle that she is still unmarried and runs an old age home. She and the others make a plan to achieve this.

episodesList.title: Pratibha is In a Soup!
episodesList.summary: Prarthana and the others help Pratibha mislead her uncle. Pratibha frets when her uncle extends his stay in her house.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya, a Thief?
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya panics when Kunti insists that she wants to return home immediately. Later, Pratibha's uncle, Tejpal suspects Kanhaiya to be a thief!

episodesList.title: Kunti Learns Pratibha's Plan?
episodesList.summary: Pratibha's plan is at risk as Kunti returns home. Kunti confronts Tejpal when she sees him at her house!

episodesList.title: Panjiri And Team Help Kanhaiya
episodesList.summary: After Tejpal suspects Kanhaiya's identity, Panjiri and the others set up a tea stall for Kanhaiya and help him mislead Tejpal that he supplies tea.

episodesList.title: Pratibha Confesses to Tejpal
episodesList.summary: Pratibha defends Kanhaiya when Tejpal accuses him of theft. She also reveals to him that Kanhaiya is her husband!

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Faces Business Issues
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya is hassled as he faces loss in his business. Kunti worries about him. Pratap's problems get resolved after taking a suggestion from a baba.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Pushed to The Wall
episodesList.summary: Kunti compels Kanhaiya to marry a buffalo as per a pandit's suggestion. Will this resolve Kanhaiya's business problems?

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Marry a Buffalo
episodesList.summary: Kunti tries her best to convince Kanhaiya to get married to a buffalo. She also takes a look at a buffalo named Chameli to be Kanhaiya's bride.

episodesList.title: Kunti Search For a Buffalo
episodesList.summary: Kunti asks one of her relatives to get his buffalo married to Kanhaiya. However, he mistakes that she wants to get his daughter married to Kanhaiya.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Marry Pushpa!
episodesList.summary: Kunti gets the proposal of Pushpa, the buffalo, fixed for Kanhaiya. Prema comes up with an idea to identify Pushpa when she goes missing.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Marry Pushpa!
episodesList.summary: Kunti gets the proposal of Pushpa, the buffalo, fixed for Kanhaiya. Prema comes up with an idea to identify Pushpa when she goes missing.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya, Pratibha Team Up
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya, Pratibha and Chaurasiya expose the fake Baba's misdeed and stop Kunti from getting Kanhaiya married to Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Kunti is Angry At Her Bahus
episodesList.summary: After learning about the misuse of the house funds, Kunti accuses her bahus of stealing the money. She vows to find the thief and oust her.

episodesList.title: Kunti Suspects Panjiri
episodesList.summary: Kunti suspects that Panjiri is misleading her and stealing money from the house expenses. She determines to catch her red-handed.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Kunti asks Kusum to create a situation so that Panjiri's lies will get revealed. But her plan backfires.

episodesList.title: Pratibha is Put to Test
episodesList.summary: Pratap pretends to be mentally ill. Kunti suspects Pratibha to be a thief and puts her credibility to trust. Will Pratibha disappoint Kunti?

episodesList.title: Kunti Confronts Pratibha
episodesList.summary: Kusum and Kunti gather evidence against Pratibha. Kunti confronts Pratibha for stealing money and asks her to leave Kunti Nivas.

episodesList.title: Kunti Appreciates Pratibha
episodesList.summary: Kunti appreciates Pratibha after learning the reason behind her act. Later, Kunti, Pratibha and Prema fret due to Pari's deed!

episodesList.title: Panjiri Defies Kunti's Sister
episodesList.summary: Kunti’s sister lashes out at her on learning about Pari’s deed. Panjiri ends up defying Kunti's sister! What will the consequences be?

episodesList.title: Kunti Gets Insulted
episodesList.summary: Upset with the behaviour of the bahus, Kunti’s sister criticises and belittles her for not having daughters-in-law with good qualities. What will Kunti do now?

episodesList.title: Pari has a Daughter?
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiv grants Kunti's bahus all their wishes. Later, a girl named Budhi comes to Kunti Nivas and claims Pari to be her mother!

episodesList.title: Prema, Pari Remain Puzzled
episodesList.summary: Prema and Pari visit the school to drop the girl but return home with another girl who claims Prema to be her mother.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Five Grandchildren
episodesList.summary: Kunti is shocked as her bahus accept their children and thank Lord Shiv for granting their wishes. Lord Shiv asks Kunti to take care of her grandchildren.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya interacts with the kids after learning about the incident from Kunti. Next day, Kunti's bahus feel exhausted trying to wake up their daughters.

episodesList.title: The Bahus Disappoint Kunti
episodesList.summary: Despite Kunti's guidance, her bahus fail to send their kids to school on time. A clever Kanhaiya has a plan to help his wives.

episodesList.title: Pratibha's Wise Advice
episodesList.summary: Pratibha advises the children to follow their heart and figure out what they wish to do. Later, Buddhi's sisters restrict themselves from going to school.

episodesList.title: Kunti Finds a Solution
episodesList.summary: Kunti decides not to scold the children anymore and asks her daughters-in-law to agree to all their demands.

episodesList.title: Will Panjiri's Strategy Work?
episodesList.summary: Panjiri suggests a new strategy to tackle the mischievous kids. Dhairya shreds Kunti’s new sari while, Budhi plans to save her.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Plan For The Kids
episodesList.summary: Kunti and her bahus come up with a new strategy to tackle the mischievous kids. Kanhaiya too gets an idea to increase the sale of saris in his shop.

episodesList.title: Will Kunti Listen to The Kids?
episodesList.summary: The kids are all upset about the ban on crackers. They decide to ask Kunti to convince the association to lift the ban but, they are in for a shock.

episodesList.title: Budhi is a Mean Girl
episodesList.summary: Budhi blackmails Chanchal to do all the household chores after stopping her from getting into trouble with Kunti.

episodesList.title: Chanchal Gets a Warning
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and his daughters celebrate Diwali in a unique way. He threatens to send Chanchal to a hostel if she doesn't mend her ways.

episodesList.title: Problem Ahead For Chanchal
episodesList.summary: Chanchal is hassled as the teacher asks her to bring Kanhaiya to school to complain about her prank. Prarthana tries to speak in Hindi!

episodesList.title: Pratap's New Role
episodesList.summary: The kids convince Pratap to come to their school in disguise of their father. Elsewhere, Prathana requests Panjiri to teach her Hindi.

episodesList.title: The Kids Blackmail Pratap
episodesList.summary: The kids blackmail Pratap to disguise himself as their school teacher to mislead Kanhaiya and Prarthana about Chanchal.

episodesList.title: Pratap, Kids are In a Soup!
episodesList.summary: Pratap and the kids fret when the PT teacher decides to visit Kunti Nivas to speak with Kanhaiya.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Speaks In Hindi!
episodesList.summary: Prarthana surprises everyone by talking fluently in Hindi. She manages to put sense into the kids and they realise their folly.

episodesList.title: Chanchal, Shakti At Loggerheads
episodesList.summary: After failing to resolve the differences between Chanchal and Shakti, Kanhaiya seeks Pratap's help to put an end to their constant quarrels.

episodesList.title: Prarthana And Prema Quarrel!
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya and his wives' plan to make Chanchal and Shakti realise their folly goes for a toss. Later, Prarthana and Prema quarrel.

episodesList.title: Chanchal, Shakti have a Plan
episodesList.summary: Chanchal and Shakti come up with a plan to settle the dispute between Prarthana and Prema.

episodesList.title: Pratap is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Shakti sneaks into a haunted mansion as she intends to meet a ghost. Pratap gets locked inside a cupboard which belongs to the haunted haveli.

episodesList.title: Kunti to Fight a Ghost
episodesList.summary: Kunti decides to fight back the ghost present inside the cupboard. Panjiri tries to stop her fearing that she will learn the truth.

episodesList.title: Panjiri's Clever Move
episodesList.summary: Panjiri tactfully saves Pratap when he gets into trouble. Shakti decides to visit the haunted haveli and apologise to the ghost.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Motivates The Kids
episodesList.summary: On learning that the kids are scared of the ghost, Kanhaiya and Prema take them to the haunted haveli and motivate them to face their fears.

episodesList.title: Kunti Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Pratibha and the others try to make Kunti realise that she is setting a bad example for her granddaughters. Later, Kunti faces an embarrassing situation.

episodesList.title: Kunti In Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Kunti lies to her family that she had defeated Balvanti in a wrestling match. Later, the Bahus fix a wrestling match between Kunti and Balvanti.

episodesList.title: A Shocker For Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kunti is misled into believing that her opponent in the wrestling challenge is a weakling. Later, she is shocked to learn the real identity of her opponent.

episodesList.title: Pratibha's Tricky Plan
episodesList.summary: Pratap compels Kunti to practice for the wrestling match. Further, Pratibha shares her plan with Kunti to call off the wrestling match.

episodesList.title: Kunti Fights With Balvanti
episodesList.summary: Kunti reveals the truth about her wrestling experience to her family. Later, she faces Balvanti in the arena.

episodesList.title: Kunti to Defeat Balwanti
episodesList.summary: Balwanti is determined to defeat Kunti in the wrestling match. Meanwhile, Budhi suggests a clever strategy to Kunti to defeat Balwanti.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya’s Daughters Seek Justice
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya’s daughters accuse their mothers of criticising them for being childish and not behaving like grown-ups. They seek justice for themselves from Kunti.

episodesList.title: Role Reversal In Kunti Nivas!
episodesList.summary: On Pratibha's insistence, Kunti announces that the kids will pretend to be their mothers and take up all the responsibilities while the parents will act like kids!

episodesList.title: Budhi, Dhairya Run The Shop
episodesList.summary: Kunti sends Budhi and Dhairya to handle the shop business while Chanchal and Shakti perform household chores. Later, Budhi and Dhairya try to work hard.

episodesList.title: The Role-reversal Comes to an End
episodesList.summary: The children are unable to perform the household chores and fail to make the arrangements for Dhairya's birthday party. Later, Kunti relieves them from their roles as elders.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Kids On a Strike
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya continues to protest against the construction of a statue in the market while the children declare a hunger strike against drinking milk.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Kids are Adamant
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's kids start a hunger strike to protest against drinking milk. Later, Pratibha and Prarthana try to reason with them but, fail.

episodesList.title: Kunti Accepts The Demands
episodesList.summary: Kunti feels worried for the kids as they don't stop their protest. Later, the kids cheer up after finally convincing Kunti to accept their demands.

episodesList.title: Kunti Tricks The Kids
episodesList.summary: Kunti tricks Kanhaiya's kids into promising that they will drink milk every day. Later, she convinces her son-in-law to accept a job offer.

episodesList.title: Pratibha, Pari Face a Situation
episodesList.summary: Pratibha and Pari face a problem when they try to take the kids to the school. Later, Kunti's family members regret not knowing how to drive a car.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Driving Class
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya tries to teach Prarthana how to drive a car. Kunti scolds Prema for misguiding the kids after she notices Shakti and Surili wasting food.

episodesList.title: Kunti In a Tight Spot
episodesList.summary: Kunti is in a tight spot as the children innocently distribute the barfis. She also reprimands Pratibha for her inability to learn driving.

episodesList.title: Pratibha is In a Soup
episodesList.summary: A milkman demands money from Kunti, holding Pratibha responsible for his cow's odd condition. Later, a jeweller too demands monetary compensation from Pratibha.

episodesList.title: Pratibha, Kanhaiya to Find The Truth
episodesList.summary: Pratibha and Kanhaiya take up the task of verifying the authenticity of the jeweller's allegations.

episodesList.title: The Kids are Upset With Kunti
episodesList.summary: The kids are upset with Kunti's disciplinarian behaviour. Shakti and Chanchal ignore her instructions and set out to play board games with Pari's mother.

episodesList.title: Kunti is Perturbed
episodesList.summary: Kunti tries to find a way to gain the attention of the kids while Pari's mother continues to be their favourite grandmother.

episodesList.title: Kunti Vs Pari's Mother
episodesList.summary: Kunti participates in a game with Pari's mother and challenges her to win it. Meanwhile, Kishan impresses Kanhaiya by his smart work.

episodesList.title: The Kids Abandon Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's kids decide to stay with Pari's mother. Later, Kanhaiya consoles a dejected Kunti.

episodesList.title: Kunti Makes a Team Plan
episodesList.summary: Kunti feels low when Kanhaiya's kids go to Nani's house. Later, Kunti makes a plan with Prema and Pratibha to bring them back.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Kids Return Home
episodesList.summary: Kunti is delighted as the kids return home. Later, Pratap receives applaud for his acting skills.

episodesList.title: Prema Proposes a Plan
episodesList.summary: The owner of the company puts forth a shocking demand before Pratap. Later, Prema proposes a plan to solve the confusion regarding Dhairya's tooth.

episodesList.title: Gifts For The Kids
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's kids dance in joy when Prema promises to give a gift for Dhairya's fairy tooth. Meanwhile, Pratap outsmarts Chakma Seth.

episodesList.title: Prema Comes Up With a Plan!
episodesList.summary: Prema comes up with the plan to make Dhairya wish for a pressure cooker from the tooth fairy. Meanwhile, Chakma Seth finds Pratap and demands for his tooth.

episodesList.title: Prema is In a Soup!
episodesList.summary: Prema, Panjiri and the others are hassled to know what the children are wishing as a gift from the tooth fairy. Pratap schemes to tackle Chakma Seth.

episodesList.title: Pratap Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: The wives try to convince the kids against wishing for an elephant from the tooth fairy. Pratap overhears Chakma Seth's evil plans.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: After learning about kids' wish from the tooth fairy, Kunti decides to ensure that their wish gets granted!

episodesList.title: Kunti Circumvents The Obstacle
episodesList.summary: Kunti uses a trick to fulfil the kids' wish of receiving an elephant from the tooth fairy. Later, Budhi proposes that her sisters visit her in Manali.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Kids to Convince Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya's kids try to convince Kunti to plan a trip to Manali. Later, Kunti gets furious when she tastes an odd sweet.

episodesList.title: A Plan In Pratibha's Mind!
episodesList.summary: Kunti gets puzzled when all her bahus fail to find out the culprit who ripped off the sofa cover. Meanwhile, Pratibha finds a way to catch the offender.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya's Clever Move
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya assures the kids that he will not let Kunti cancel their Manali trip but, on a condition.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Kunti and Kanhaiya find the culprit who spoilt their sofa. Kanhaiya comes up with a plan to cheer up the kids.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya Disappoints Surili
episodesList.summary: Prarthana asks Kanhaiya to buy similar mugs for all the kids to ensure that none of them feels hurt. However, Surili gets upset with Kanhaiya.

episodesList.title: Kusum has a Wicked Plan
episodesList.summary: Prema comes up with a plan to do something special for Surili. Kusum proposes a plan to spy on the wives to find out who is more partial to the kids.

episodesList.title: Kanhaiya to Surprise Surili
episodesList.summary: Kanhaiya decides to take Surili to a mall when the other kids are asleep. Kunti plans to test Kanhiya's wives!

episodesList.summary: Kunti and Kusum apply tricks to find out the biased bahu while Kanhaiya's kids decide to test him to learn who is his favourite daughter.

episodesList.title: Pratibha Advises Surili

episodesList.title: Kunti Surprises The Kids

episodesList.title: Sarla Misleads Kunti
episodesList.summary: Sarla suggests Kunti some ideas so that her bahus never assign her any household work. Later, Kunti applies the same on the kids.

episodesList.title: The Bahus Surprise Kunti
episodesList.summary: Kunti tests Sarla's idea to check whether her bahus allocate her any job. Later, the bahus surprise Kunti by cancelling their trip.

cast.name: Maninder Singh
cast.role: Mr. Kanhaiya Paanchal: Kuntidevi and Kailash's son; Kusum's brother; Pari, Prarthana, Panjiri, Prema and Pratibha's husband; Buddhi, Chanchal, Dhairya, Shakti and Surili's father. He is a 37-years-old, successful, saree shop owner in Meerut. He often has to sort out the problems faced by his family, mainly of his mother and wives. He doesn't believe in superstitious beliefs, unlike his mother and his four wives (excluding Pratibha).

cast.name: Kanchan Gupta
cast.role: Kunti Devi Paanchal: Kailash's widow; Kanhaiya and Kusum's mother; Buddhi, Chanchal, Dhairya, Shakti and Surili's grandmother. She is a loving-yet-greedy and possessive mother who asks a boon from Lord Shiva, of a daughter-in-law who has all the five talents, i.e. she should be beautiful, saintly, culinarian, tender-hearted and intelligent. Instead, she gets five daughter-in-laws, each with one desired quality. She falls into traps of superstitious beliefs. She gets easily irritated by the antics of her bahus (mainly Pari), Kusum's habit of sleeping and Pratap's habit of asking her money.

She often doesn't understand the things told to her and does them in a comical way. She is called "Akal ki Mallika"( The girl with brains: which in a sense is to indicate that she has no brain but gives ideas like one) by Kunti.

plotHtml: This story is based on how a mother, Kunti Devi's desire turns into disappointment. The five qualities she requires in her daughter-in-law are beauty, wisdom, romance, culinary skills and religious devotion. With the blessing of lord Shiva, Kanhaiya was married to Pari (meaning fairy- beautiful), Prarthana (meaning prayer), Panjiri (a kind of north Indian food), Prema (meaning love) and then Pratibha (intelligence) - with qualities matching with their names. The plot is inspired by the story of Draupadi, who had requested Lord Shiva in her previous life to be granted a husband with great qualities, but erred by repeating each quality five times and therefore was granted the boon of five husbands. As a result, the band of Mr.Kanhaiya and his mother Kunti is played. The Paanchal family lives in Meerut. The Second Season (Second Innings) was going on air from 23 October 2018 to 21 January 2019, where Kunti's new greed of having another quality in each of her bahu leads to Lord Shiva fulfilling it by giving a boon of 5 children to the daughters-in-law that is Buddhi (means intelligence) to Pari, Chanchal(means mischievous) to Prarthana, Dhairya (means patience) to Panjiri, Shakti (means strength) to Prema and Surili (means Sweet Voice) to Pratibha.
tagline: This story is based on how a mother, Kunti Devi's desire turns into disappointment.

title: Karunamoyee Rani Rashmoni
summary:
Karunamoyee Rani Rashmoni (lit. 'Compassionate Queen Rashmoni') was an Indian Bengali historical drama television series which aired on Bengali Entertainment Channel Zee Bangla and is also available on the digital platform ZEE5. It was premiered on 24 July 2017. The serial was earlier produced by Subrata Roy and then it was produced by Zee Bangla. One of the longest running Bengali television soap opera, the series completed 1,000 episodes on its third birthday (24 July 2020) and 1,500 episodes on 26 December 2021. After a successful run of 4+1⁄2 years, Karunamoyee Rani Rashmoni went off-air on 13 February 2022.
The show starred Ditipriya Roy in the title role as Rani Rashmoni, the deeply spiritual and liberal-minded "Rani" of 19th century, Gazi Abdun Noor and Gourab Chatterjee among others. The show was received well by the audience.
On July 4, 2021, Rani Rashmoni's character came to end showcasing her death. The show got revamped into a new season titled "Karunamoyee Rani Rashmoni - Uttar Porbo"   focusing on the life of Ramakrishna Paramahamsa (portrayed by Sourav Saha) - his spiritual journey and marriage with holy mother Sarada Devi (portrayed by Sandipta Sen).
plot: Rani Rashmoni (best known for being the founder of the Dakshineswar Kali Temple and for her untamed zeal and fight against the aggression of the British East India Company in 19th century at Bengal) and narrates the events of her life, starting from her being a young girl of 11, named "Rani", residing with her Vaishnav father and aunt in her ancestral village Halisahar to marrying ‘Babu Rajchandra Das’ of Janbazar, Kolkata; and how she becomes an extraordinary woman fighting against all odds during the then British ruled patriarchal society. The show upholds the quest of her life with the backdrop of the famous Marh family of Janbazar.
reception: In week 50 of 2020, the series has risen to fifth place with 4.701 million impressions for the most watched television series in Bengal.

plotHtml: Rani Rashmoni (best known for being the founder of the Dakshineswar Kali Temple and for her untamed zeal and fight against the aggression of the British East India Company in 19th century at Bengal) and narrates the events of her life, starting from her being a young girl of 11, named "Rani", residing with her Vaishnav father and aunt in her ancestral village Halisahar to marrying ‘Babu Rajchandra Das’ of Janbazar, Kolkata; and how she becomes an extraordinary woman fighting against all odds during the then British ruled patriarchal society. The show upholds the quest of her life with the backdrop of the famous Marh family of Janbazar.

title: Kundali Bhagya
summary: Kundali Bhagya (transl. The Fate of Our Horoscope) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series created by Ekta Kapoor and produced by Balaji Telefilms. A spin-off of Kumkum Bhagya, it premiered on 12 July 2017 on Zee TV. One of the longest running Indian television soap opera, the show featured Shraddha Arya, Dheeraj Dhoopar, Manit Joura, Shakti Arora, Shakti Anand, Paras Kalnawat, Sana Sayyad, Baseer Ali, and Adrija Roy. The series ended on 6 December 2024.
plot:
The Arora sisters, Preeta and Srishti, move to Mumbai to fulfill their father’s dying wish of reuniting with their mother, Sarla. Preeta becomes a physiotherapist for Bani Luthra, the matriarch of the Luthra family. While the elder grandson, Rishabh, shares a cordial bond with her, the younger one, Karan, a cricket star, has a strained relationship with her. Preeta and Karan, though initially at loggerheads and bickering, start to slowly develop a friendship with each other that turns into love, though neither confesses their feelings.
Rishabh is set to marry Sherlyn, but Preeta and Karan discover that Sherlyn is having an affair with Preeta's fiancé, Prithvi. Despite their attempts to stop the wedding, Sherlyn manipulates the situation, and Karan, influenced by misunderstandings, starts hating Preeta. On the day of Preeta’s wedding to Prithvi, Karan takes his place, marrying her out of spite but soon abandoning her. Kareena arranges for Karan to marry Mahira, his obsessive childhood friend. Preeta then replaces Mahira and marries Karan to protect his family from Mahira and Sherlyn's plots. Despite their reconciliation, Karan and Preeta face more obstacles as Sherlyn and Prithvi continue to scheme against them.
Three months later, Preeta and Karan adopt a child, Pihu. Sonakshi, Karan’s college friend, tries to separate them due to her obsession with Karan. Sonakshi arranges for a goon to cause an accident that results in Pihu’s death. Preeta is blamed for the accident and removed from the Luthra house, while Karan expels Sonakshi for coercing him into marrying her.
Two years later, Preeta returns to Mumbai from her hometown. She meets Mahesh, who is now mentally unstable after being tortured by Prithvi. She learns that Prithvi has taken control of the Luthra business and is exploiting the family after having married Karan's cousin, Kritika. With Mahesh’s will, Preeta re-enters the Luthra mansion and exposes Prithvi’s schemes and restores the family's wealth. She helps Rishabh return from Dubai, where he had been trapped by Prithvi, and they both expose Sherlyn and Prithvi. Sherlyn and Natasha try to convince Karan that Preeta and Rishabh are having an affair. Karan is manipulated into believing this, and he is later pushed off a dam by Natasha and Roxy. He is presumed dead. Preeta, who is pregnant with Karan's child, marries Rishabh for the child’s legitimacy. Preeta gives birth to a daughter, Kavya.
Five years later, Karan is revealed to have survived the accident but suffered memory loss and undergone plastic surgery. He returns as Arjun Suryavanshi and is engaged to Nidhi Hinduja, who saved him. As Arjun, Karan tries to destroy Preeta and Rishabh, believing they pushed him off the dam. Eventually, after learning Karan's true identity, Preeta and Rishabh prove their innocence through CCTV footage. Karan regains his memory and reconciles with Preeta. He severs ties with Nidhi. After a few months, Karan and Preeta have fraternal twin sons, Rudraksh and Shaurya. Nidhi's sister, Anjali, who is obsessed with Karan, kidnaps Rudraksh. However, after a series of events, she dies in a confrontation. Preeta is once again blamed for the chaos and leaves the family, but she saves Rudraksh. It is presumed by the Luthras that Preeta and Rudraksh have died.
Twenty years later, Preeta and Srishti have relocated, and Srishti has raised Preeta’s son, Rudraksh, whom she renamed Rajveer. Preeta, who lost her memories after the accident, suffers from panic attacks. Rajveer, now grown up, learns about his true parentage and returns to Mumbai with a determination to reclaim Preeta’s honor. Eventually, Srishti and Preeta end up in Mumbai as well and she meets Karan, who is delighted to learn that she survived. Nidhi is now married to Karan and she does not want to lose him, hence, she tries to separate Karan and Preeta and prevent Preeta from regaining her memories. Nidhi then attacks Srishti when she learns her truth, who ends up in a coma. Meanwhile, Rajveer gets a job at Karan’s company, and Shaurya grows insecure about Rajveer and plots against him. Rajveer and Palki fall in love, while Nidhi and Shaurya continue to plot against Rajveer and Preeta. The Luthra family slowly begins to accept Preeta again. Kavya's fiancé, Varun, is revealed to be Prithvi and Sherlyn's son, Shelly, who came to take revenge. The relationship is called off. Rajveer is appointed CEO of Luthra Industries. Soon, Preeta realizes Shaurya's scheming, and a confrontation ensues, with Nidhi blaming Shaurya's actions on Rajveer. In a fit of rage, Rakhi and Mahesh end up revealing Rajveer's true identity in front of Preeta, triggering her memory. She collapses into a coma, and the family prays for her recovery. Thus ending the show on a sad and open end note.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Due to the outbreak, the filming of television series and films was halted on 19 March 2020 and expected to resume on 1 April 2020 but could not and the series was last broadcast on 24 March 2020 when the remaining episodes were aired. After three months, the production and filming of the series resumed on 29 June 2020 and broadcast to resume from 13 July 2020.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
In late November 2020, Manit Joura's character Rishabh Luthra was temporarily written out of the story while he filmed another Balaji show, Prem Bandhan for Dangal TV. After wrapping up the Dangal TV show and a brief hiatus, he returned to Kundali... in February 2021. Again in November 2021, he made an impromptu decision to officially quit the show as he felt he given everything to the character and there was no creative growth left. After an absence of roughly 7 months, he officially re-entered the show in 16 May 2022 after being impressed by a revamped script of creative changes and fresh story arcs for Rishabh.
In January 2022, Supriya Shukla who played Sarla Arora, quit the show, saying, "I had done everything as Sarla but there was not much left for me to do". In June of the same year, actor Dheeraj Dhoopar, who played Karan Luthra, also quit the series for personal reasons and was replaced by Shakti Arora. and Shakti AroraIn January 2023, a twenty-year generation leap and a new generation of leads were announced. Arora, who replaced Dhoopar as Karan, quit owing to the generation leap, stating he didn't want to play a father to grown-ups and wanted to explore other things. Arora was then replaced by Shakti Anand after the leap. Sanjay Gagnani, who portrayed Prithvi Malhotra, also announced his decisions to quit the series as he wanted to take up new opportunities. Shraddha Arya, who portrays Preeta Luthra, decided to continue as a mother to the new generation. Later in March 2023, Sonal Vengurlekar, playing Anjali Hinduja, also announced her decision to quit after the generation leap because she didn't wanted to age onscreen. Ruhi Chaturvedi, who portrayed Sherlyn Khurana, also quit right before leap as she wanted to explore more as an actress. However from June 2024 she made her appearance once again as Sherlyn.
Paras Kalnawat and Sana Sayyad were introduced as new leads with Kalnawat as one of Preeta's twin sons, Rajveer Arora Luthra and Sayyad as Dr. Palki Khurana while debutante Baseer Ali was cast as negative lead and another twin son of Preeta, Shaurya Luthra. In the same month, Rose Sardana was cast to play Mahi Khurana, Palki's sister marking her to return to television after a 3-year hiatus.
In May 2023, Anjum Fakih portraying Srishti Arora, who had initially taken a break from the show for participating in Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 13, later confirmed quitting as her role was no longer challenging after the leap, but also said that she will return if the story requires her character, and she reprised her role in July 2023, post her stint in the adventure-based reality show. However she permanently quit the series in October 2023 to explore new projects by calling it the most difficult decision, and the storyline showcased Srishti ending up in coma with severe facial and physical burns due to Nidhi's murder attempt on her.
Later Abhishek Kapoor who portrayed Sameer Luthra too quit the series to try new spaces as an actor. In June 2023, Ira Sone portraying Nidhi quit the series and Akanksha Juneja replaced her. Later in the following month, Mrinal Navell Chandra was cast to play grown-up Kavya Luthra replacing Ananya Gambhir who played Kavya's younger version, while Aashish Trivedi was cast opposite her as Varun Gill and Guneet Sharma was cast to play his brother Rahul. But later on in June 2024 Varun's character was revealed to be Prithvi and Sherlyn's son Shelly Malhotra. In the following month, Shalini Mahal joined the cast as Palki's sister Shanaya Khurana.
In August 2023, Ananya Panday and Ayushmann Khurrana made cameo appearances to promote their movie Dream Girl 2 whereas the Luthra family is getting ready for Kavya’s (Mrinal) sangeet with Rakhi Maa (Anisha) arranging a surprise visit for Param and Pari at the Luthra House.
In February 2024, Manit Joura portraying Rishabh Luthra quit after being a part of the show for seven long years saying that he realized his journey in the show was over and an intelligent actor knows where to stop. While Rajesh Sharma replaced Farooq Khan as Goutam Gill in same month. In May 2024, Sana Sayyad portraying Palki quit the series due to her pregnancy and Adrija Roy stepped into her shoes opposite Paras Kalnawat. In same month Baseer Ali playing Shaurya Luthra was rumoured to quit the show but the actor denied so. However he confirmed about him serving his notice period required prior quitting the series in following month. The following month Mayanka Sharma Patel replaced Naina Gupta as Roma Gill who earlier replaced Gayatri Soham in February 2024. Meanwhile Sanjana Phadke too reprised her role of Sanjana Khurana in same month after 2 years hiatus.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: On 19 November 2024, it was announced that the show would go off-air after a run of seven and a half years, with the final episode airing on 6 December 2024, hours after Shraddha Arya confirmed quitting the show due to her due date approaching. Actors Shakti Anand and Paras Kalnawat revealed that it was a '"sudden and shocking move by the channel and production house", and that they were not informed or prepared for this decision until the last moment.

articleSections.title: Impact
articleSections.text:
Kundali Bhagya is the second longest-running Indian television series of Zee TV after its sister show, Kumkum Bhagya. It took its generation leap on 16 March 2023 and completed its 1500 episodes on 10 April 2023.
Anjum Fakih's character was slated to be negative after three months from the day of premiere of the show, but the love of audience to her positive character made the production revoke their decision.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
Kundali Bhagya maintained a consistent viewership profile on Zee TV, regularly leading the Hindi General Entertainment Channel (GEC) landscape. The series premiered on July 12, 2017, with an initial Television Rating Point of 2.9, making it one of the network's highest-rated fiction launches in that time slot. The show went on to become the most popular show within a month and also topped the TRP charts for several years. Driven by the core storyline and the initial pairing of Dheeraj Dhoopar and Shraddha Arya, popularly named as "Preeran" and also Arya receiving critical acclaim for her performance the program reached the number one rank nationwide within its first month of broadcast. Following the resumption of television production after the COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in July 2020, the series immediately reclaimed the top position on television, placing ahead of its sister series Kumkum Bhagya, which occupied the second position.
Between 2018 and late 2020, the series frequently ranked as the highest-rated Hindi fiction show on Indian television, maintaining a stable weekly average of 3.5 TRP, with high-drama wedding episodes peaking at 3.8 TRP. Following late 2020, the show faced increased competition from newly launched soaps on rival networks, specifically Star Plus's daily drama Anupamaa, which assumed the top spot. Despite this, the program maintained a steady presence on the charts, frequently securing the second position nationwide with stable ratings ranging between 2.8 and 3.1 TRP, while continuing to outperform Kumkum Bhagya.
To refresh the long-running storytelling arcs, the production house introduced narrative transitions. A 5-year leap in 2021 and a subsequent 2-year jump in 2022—accompanied by casting changes including the introduction of Shakti Arora, initially stabilized the show's metrics within a 2.2 to 2.5 TRP range, achieving a top-five rank. In March 2023, the show executed a major 20-year second-generation leap, shifting the primary focus onto characters played by Paras Kalnawat, Baseer Ali, and Sana Sayyad. Following this transition and the eventual departures of original lead actors, the show experienced a gradual shift in urban audience retention, settling into a 1.5 to 1.9 TRP range during its multi-cast adjustments. By late 2023, the series averaged 1.8 TRP and moved to the number ten position overall. Due to programming reschedule, the network later shifted the series from its original 9:30 p.m. slot into a 10:00 p.m. time slot. The brand equity kept the show within a top-ten placement before concluding its nearly 8 year run of 2000+ episodes.

plotHtml:
The Arora sisters, Preeta and Srishti, move to Mumbai to fulfill their father’s dying wish of reuniting with their mother, Sarla. Preeta becomes a physiotherapist for Bani Luthra, the matriarch of the Luthra family. While the elder grandson, Rishabh, shares a cordial bond with her, the younger one, Karan, a cricket star, has a strained relationship with her. Preeta and Karan, though initially at loggerheads and bickering, start to slowly develop a friendship with each other that turns into love, though neither confesses their feelings.
Rishabh is set to marry Sherlyn, but Preeta and Karan discover that Sherlyn is having an affair with Preeta's fiancé, Prithvi. Despite their attempts to stop the wedding, Sherlyn manipulates the situation, and Karan, influenced by misunderstandings, starts hating Preeta. On the day of Preeta’s wedding to Prithvi, Karan takes his place, marrying her out of spite but soon abandoning her. Kareena arranges for Karan to marry Mahira, his obsessive childhood friend. Preeta then replaces Mahira and marries Karan to protect his family from Mahira and Sherlyn's plots. Despite their reconciliation, Karan and Preeta face more obstacles as Sherlyn and Prithvi continue to scheme against them.
Three months later, Preeta and Karan adopt a child, Pihu. Sonakshi, Karan’s college friend, tries to separate them due to her obsession with Karan. Sonakshi arranges for a goon to cause an accident that results in Pihu’s death. Preeta is blamed for the accident and removed from the Luthra house, while Karan expels Sonakshi for coercing him into marrying her.
Two years later, Preeta returns to Mumbai from her hometown. She meets Mahesh, who is now mentally unstable after being tortured by Prithvi. She learns that Prithvi has taken control of the Luthra business and is exploiting the family after having married Karan's cousin, Kritika. With Mahesh’s will, Preeta re-enters the Luthra mansion and exposes Prithvi’s schemes and restores the family's wealth. She helps Rishabh return from Dubai, where he had been trapped by Prithvi, and they both expose Sherlyn and Prithvi. Sherlyn and Natasha try to convince Karan that Preeta and Rishabh are having an affair. Karan is manipulated into believing this, and he is later pushed off a dam by Natasha and Roxy. He is presumed dead. Preeta, who is pregnant with Karan's child, marries Rishabh for the child’s legitimacy. Preeta gives birth to a daughter, Kavya.
Five years later, Karan is revealed to have survived the accident but suffered memory loss and undergone plastic surgery. He returns as Arjun Suryavanshi and is engaged to Nidhi Hinduja, who saved him. As Arjun, Karan tries to destroy Preeta and Rishabh, believing they pushed him off the dam. Eventually, after learning Karan's true identity, Preeta and Rishabh prove their innocence through CCTV footage. Karan regains his memory and reconciles with Preeta. He severs ties with Nidhi. After a few months, Karan and Preeta have fraternal twin sons, Rudraksh and Shaurya. Nidhi's sister, Anjali, who is obsessed with Karan, kidnaps Rudraksh. However, after a series of events, she dies in a confrontation. Preeta is once again blamed for the chaos and leaves the family, but she saves Rudraksh. It is presumed by the Luthras that Preeta and Rudraksh have died.
Twenty years later, Preeta and Srishti have relocated, and Srishti has raised Preeta’s son, Rudraksh, whom she renamed Rajveer. Preeta, who lost her memories after the accident, suffers from panic attacks. Rajveer, now grown up, learns about his true parentage and returns to Mumbai with a determination to reclaim Preeta’s honor. Eventually, Srishti and Preeta end up in Mumbai as well and she meets Karan, who is delighted to learn that she survived. Nidhi is now married to Karan and she does not want to lose him, hence, she tries to separate Karan and Preeta and prevent Preeta from regaining her memories. Nidhi then attacks Srishti when she learns her truth, who ends up in a coma. Meanwhile, Rajveer gets a job at Karan’s company, and Shaurya grows insecure about Rajveer and plots against him. Rajveer and Palki fall in love, while Nidhi and Shaurya continue to plot against Rajveer and Preeta. The Luthra family slowly begins to accept Preeta again. Kavya's fiancé, Varun, is revealed to be Prithvi and Sherlyn's son, Shelly, who came to take revenge. The relationship is called off. Rajveer is appointed CEO of Luthra Industries. Soon, Preeta realizes Shaurya's scheming, and a confrontation ensues, with Nidhi blaming Shaurya's actions on Rajveer. In a fit of rage, Rakhi and Mahesh end up revealing Rajveer's true identity in front of Preeta, triggering her memory. She collapses into a coma, and the family prays for her recovery. Thus ending the show on a sad and open end note.
tagline: The Arora sisters, Preeta and Srishti, move to Mumbai to fulfill their father’s dying wish of reuniting with their mother, Sarla.

title: Kalakka Povathu Yaaru? Champions
summary:
Kalakka Povathu Yaaru? Champions or KPY Champions is a 2017 Indian Tamil-language reality stand-up comedy television show that airs on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar. Over six years, KPY Champions has aired three seasons. Grace Karunas, Thadi Balaji and Ma Ka Pa Anand were the judges for the first two seasons.
The first season premiered on 18 June 2017.

title: Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat
summary: Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat is a Hindi web series created and produced by Ekta Kapoor for ALTBalaji and  ZEE5. It stars Ram Kapoor and Sakshi Tanwar. The series is about two opposite people falling in love with each other. The series was launched on Zee TV on 25 March 2020 as a substitute to the Zee TV shows whose broadcast had to be stopped by the channel due to COVID-19 pandemic.
plot: Karan Khanna is a superstar and recovering alcoholic who takes a detox trip to Mahabaleshwar with his new counselor Dr. Tripurasundari Nagrajan (Tipsy/Tanpura/Tirumalai Express/Nagarjuna), who he dislikes because of her strictness. The story takes a turn when he attends his estranged daughter's wedding and discovers that opposites can truly attract. The show explores how romance blossoms between the distinctly different personalities of Karan and Tipsy.
reception: Gursimran Kaur Banga of The Times of India wrote, "The story is fast-paced and there are no slow moments. It is the quick succession in the plot that keeps you hooked and makes you look forward to the story. The winner in the web series is the fabulous chemistry shared by Ram Kapoor and Sakshi Tanwar."

episodesList.summary: Karan is faced with a sudden choice between love and unforeseen responsibilities. Will this be the end of Karan and Tipsy's newfound understanding?

episodesList.title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
episodesList.summary: Three months have passed since Karan and Tipsy last saw each other. Tipsy is busy fulfilling her to-do list in Europe. But is she happy? Before she can figure this out, Sherry calls her back to Mumbai urgently. Tipsy is shocked to see Karan at a local court. Will she ignore him or talk to him?

episodesList.title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
episodesList.summary: Karan Khanna tries to understand and get close to Tipsy. But he fears what will happen when Tipsy learns that Radhika is living with him. To Karan’s delight, Tipsy unites with him to solve Sherry and Vishal’s problems. However, Karan is less than delighted to see Tipsy meet her ‘date’ at a café.

episodesList.title: Pehla Nasha
episodesList.summary: Chitti and Amma arrive at the airport and Karan hopes to impress them. But its not easy to impress Chitti. While shopping, Trisha is accused of shoplifting and an unlikely messiah comes to her rescue. Radhika’s legal battle for Prabuddha’s property is set to get more complicated.

episodesList.title: Kambakht Ishq
episodesList.summary: Romila is back! And so is more drama in Karan’s life. Will this create more distance between Karan and Tipsy or bring them closer? Meanwhile, Palash discusses his past with Karan even as he risks crossing paths with it. In her next meeting with Palash, Radhika brings Karan along with her. Will Karan and Palash continue to remain friends?

episodesList.title: Pyar Tune Kya Kiya
episodesList.summary: Radhika and Karan’s meeting with Palash doesn’t go well. Karan accuses him of being cold-hearted. In his attempt to impress Chitti, Vishal gets trashed, literally. Complicating matters further, Chitti considers who among Vishal and Addu is a suitable match for Tipsy. Even though Radhika decides to move out of Karan’s house, the distance between Tipsy and Karan increases.

episodesList.title: Dil Hai Ki Maanta Nahin
episodesList.summary: This is the season of confrontations for Tipsy and Karan. Tipsy wants to know what does Radhika mean to Karan? An upset Tipsy meets Addu and Karan walks in. He gets more upset in return. When Tipsy visits Karan’s home to placate him, she is not ready for what she sees.

episodesList.title: Baaton Baaton Mein
episodesList.summary: In a hilarious turn of events, a newly married Sherry meets another prospective groom. Vishal is having a hard time handling the situation. Tipsy’s apartment turns into a headquarter of chaos. At Trisha’s birthday party, the photo booth captures not just pictures but some major drama. Rohan learns something that Trisha has been over-looking all these days.

episodesList.title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
episodesList.summary: Tipsy and Karan get an opportunity to spend some time alone as Amma and Chitti are not at home. But will they make this moment special? Karan rushes to help Radhika get her boutique back. But Palash refuses every amicable proposal. Tipsy’s new patient is admitted in a serious condition.

episodesList.title: Jiya Laage Na Tum Bin
episodesList.summary: Palash battles for his life and Tipsy tries her best to save him. She fears getting dragged into his complicated life. She contemplates telling Karan all about her past. Will he understand? Palash pulls an elaborate plan to get close to Tipsy.

episodesList.title: Jab Koi Baat Bigad Jaye
episodesList.summary: Tipsy experiences shock and delight simultaneously at the inauguration event of Veda Rehab Clinic as Palash and Karan both present themselves. The event proves to be a moment of bitter realization for both the men. Tipsy is left hurt and upset. An adamant Palash offers a deal that leaves Karan fuming. What is the future of Karan and Tipsy?

episodesList.title: Picture Abhi Baaki Hai
episodesList.summary: Karan wants to help Tipsy but is unable to and on the other hand Tipsy wants to talk about Palash but can’t get herself to do it. She fears that their respective past is preventing their future from taking any shape. To make matters worse, Palash plots to keep the two apart. Meanwhile, Radhika doesn’t answer calls from her anyone.

episodesList.title: Do Dil Mil Rahe Hain
episodesList.summary: Everyone is excited as there is a wedding. But not Tipsy, who is anxious about Karan. On the other hand, Karan feels hopeful about the possibility of a future with Tipsy. Meanwhile, Palash hasn't forgotten his old love yet.

episodesList.title: Aa Gale Lag Ja
episodesList.summary: Amidst the wedding celebrations, Karan is nursing his broken heart. He decides to leave, but not before making Chitti realise her mistake. When Sherry confronts Tipsy about her shocking decision, she shows no signs of changing her mind. But there is something that Tipsy wants Karan to know. Will Tipsy manage to talk to Karan before he leaves?

episodesList.title: Kya Yahi Pyaar Hai
episodesList.summary: In a surprising turn of events, several hearts unite. Tipsy and Karan have made many sacrifices but finally declare their love for each other. Is this the beginning of a beautiful journey for Karan and Tipsy? Meanwhile, Trisha has other plans for her parents, Karan and Radhika.

title: Kings of Comedy Juniors
summary:
Kings of Comedy Juniors (Tamil: கிங்ஸ் ஆப் காமெடி ஜூனியர்ஸ்) is a 2017 Indian Tamil-language children's stand-up comedy reality television show that airs on Vijay TV. The first season of the show began airing on 8 April 2017, and ended 17 September 2017 after airing 49 episodes. That aired every Saturday and Sunday on June 24, 2017, The judges are comedy actor Robo Shankar, actress Rambha and Sindhu.
The second season of the show aired from 28 July 2018 to 24 November 2018 every Saturday and Sunday. The judges are actors Robo Shankar and Vani Bhojan, and TV anchor Erode Mahesh.

title: Kya Qusoor Hai Amala Ka?
summary: Kya Qusoor Hai Amala Ka? (transl.What Is Amala's Fault?) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series, which started telecasting from 3 April 2017 on Star Plus. Kya Qusoor Hai Amala Ka is an adaptation of the Turkish drama series Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?, which tackles the sensitive subject of sexual violence faced by women. The series is produced by 24 Frames Media. The series ended on 30 September 2017 with the discontinuation of the Star Plus afternoon programming block.
plot:
Amala is a young and beautiful town girl, who lives in a small town of Dharamshala. She lost her parents at an early age, thus she lives with her elder brother Raghu and his wife Mandkini. She is engaged to her childhood friend Dev and is waiting to get married. She dreams of having her own house, where she can live her life according to her will.
Abeer is a well mannered guy who lives with his adoptive mother Karuna, who is a healer of herbal medicines. One night, Amala on the way to see off her fiancé who is departing for a working trip was caught and gang-raped by Abeer's rich friends Suveer, Evan and Viraj under the influence of drugs & alcohol. While Abeer is unaware of the reality, he finds himself guilty for the incident.
Abeer is forced to marry Amala by the powerful family of his rich friends. Amala and Abeer move to Mumbai, after marriage, to start a new life. Raghu and Mandakini, along with their kid Mannu, reach Mumbai to stay with Amala and Abeer. They are later joined by Abeer's adoptive mother, Karuna. Dev too reaches Mumbai with a motive to seek answers to his questions from Amala. He calls Abeer and threatens to kill him as he snatched away his love from him. Amala falls ill and Mando is suspicious if she is pregnant. Amala performs the test at home, and it comes out to be positive. This comes as a shock to them with Amala in a deep pain, and Abeer tensed, not knowing what to do. Karuna takes Amala to the hospital to get the test done again. The reports come out negative, and it is revealed that Amala is not pregnant, which comes as a relief to everyone. Fearing that Dev might turn into a criminal by taking his vengeance from Amala's culprits, Amala asks Abeer to leave her forever as she doesn't want him to destroy Dev's life, like he destroyed her life. Abeer wants to leave Amala and move abroad, for her own good, but at the same time his increasing concern and love for Amala is shown. A guilt-stricken Viraj tells Abeer the truth of his innocence, and him not being a rapist like them, on realising how he betrayed his own friend due to his selfishness. Abeer gets heartbroken by the truth, and later, decides to tell this to Amala. After several unrewarding attempts to express his innocence to Amala, Abeer gets successful in telling her this truth, but Amala ends up blaming him more. She tells how him and his friends have broken her beyond repair. She says that she hates herself and her life, and also, she has nothing but hatred for him too. Mando & Karuna leave for Dharamshala. Abeer accompanies Amala for her nephew's school admission. He convinces the principal to give the child a seat in the school. On their way back, Dev sees Amala but does not approach her. Abeer is slowly falling in love with Amala despite her hatred for him. The next day Raghu is lost in the shopping mall and Abeer goes looking for him. Meanwhile, Evan and Viraj are out of jail. Viraj is guilt stricken and resorts to drinking to forget his crimes. Surveer & Mahi's wedding is postponed by Manvendar. Mahi wants to find out the truth so she goes to Amla. After Abeer supports Amla, she finally gets the courage to expose her rapists because she does not want Mahi's life to get ruined because she didn't tell her the truth. At this time, Evaan has figured out that Amla is coming to expose them, he hires goons to come and kill Abeer and Amla. Abeer and Amla successfully fight the goons back and they reach the wedding venue, the Malik house. There the Maliks have set up extra security in order for them to not enter the wedding. Amla successfully exposes the three rapists and the wedding is called off. Later Evaan marries Mahi to revenge from Rishan. Also Amla files a case against Evaan, Suveer, and Viraj. Abeer has no action taken against him because he was innocent and he supported Amla. All three of the guys and sentenced to life time imprisonment. Rishan Malik, Suveer's father, shoots himself because of his sons actions and the humiliation he would have to face. Amla finally gets justice and Abeer and Amla live happily together.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Popular Turkish series Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne? was dubbed in Hindi and broadcast in India in 2016 on Zindagi TV after the success of teen-age romance drama Feriha. Both the series achieved a rating success which in turn caused many other popular Turkish shows like Kuzey Guney, A Love Story and Little Lord to be shown in India in dubbed form. Subsequently 24 Frames television production company acquired rights of the series from Eccho Rights to be remade in India with show's original creators giving important input for the remake. The show was developed by Purnendu Shekhar, Nandita Mehra and Bhairavi Raichura of 24 Frames.Pankhuri Awasthy Rode of Razia Sultan fame was cast as the lead role of Amala (Fatmagul) and debutant Rajveer Singh was cast as the male lead role of Abeer (Kerim).

title: Koi Laut Ke Aaya Hai
summary: Koi Laut Ke Aaya Hai is an Indian suspense psychological thriller television series that was broadcast on Star Plus in 2017. Backed by Sphere Origins, it starred Surbhi Jyoti, Shoaib Ibrahim, Sharad Kelkar, Shaleen Malhotra, Rajsingh Verma and Varun Buddhadev. In June 2021, the series was released as "The Return" on Disney+ Hotstar.
plot: Rishabh is a blind person who lives with his Rajput family. His sister, Geetanjali falls in love with the military officer Abhimanyu. As Rishabh refuses this alliance, Geetanjali disobeys him and marries Abhimanyu. Though initially outraged, he later accepts Abhimanyu who later dies in a car crash.
reception:
India Today stated, "Koi Laut Ke Aaya Hai is a spellbinding psychological thriller that captivates its viewers with interesting plots and thrilling twists. And a welcome change from the ongoing supernatural shows."
The Times of India stated that the plot of this series resembles that of the film Woh Kaun Thi?.

articleSections.title: Six years later
articleSections.text:
As Abhimanyu's body was never found, Geetanjali waits for his return. Her childhood friend, army officer Rajveer Malhotra, reveals that the Indian Army hasn't found any trace of Abhimanyu's survival so he is considered dead. Geetanjali meets a 6 year-old Priyam. Claiming to be Abhimanyu's reincarnation, Priyam is tested to know his identity but surprisingly passes. His greedy parents permit him to be adopted by Rishabh for Geetanjali's sake in exchange for a handsome sum.
Ragini, a stranger claims to be related to Geetanjali. It turns out that Abhimanyu is alive, and finally Geetanjali catches him, who says he betrayed her for revenge against her family. Ratna, Geetanjali's stepmother reveals how she was raped by Abhimanyu's father Bhavani when she was pregnant with his child but he got her married to the widower Rajesh Shekhari, Geetanjali's father. Kavya is in fact Bhavani and Ratna's daughter.
Now, the biggest truth comes out that not Abhimanyu, it is his identical twin Aditya who is seeking revenge from his own family, as Bhavani wanted to kill him in past when it was predicated Aditya would cause his death. But Aditya was saved and raised by another guy with the story of Bhavani's abandonment etched into his soul. So it was Aditya's plan to snatch Abhimanyu's place as he holds him responsible for his abandoning.
Geetanjali plans to rescue Abhimanyu. Rishabh reveals both families had have long enmity between them and how he loved Ragini, who was pregnant with his child and he'd to betray her to believe he had played with her for the pride of his family. Priyam turns out to be their real son Varun. As Bhavani's men had killed Ragini after she gave birth to Varun, he diverted the blame on Rishabh for revenge.
An alive Abhimanyu and Aditya jump from a cliff and fight near jail. Aditya murders Bhavani and tries to kill Geetanjali too, but Rishabh saves her and dies, while she shoots Aditya to death. Rajveer bids adieu saying he got transferred. Geetanjali and Abhimanyu reunite forever and start living happily ever after.

articleSections.text:
On 26 January 2017, the first promo of the show Clock was released by Star Plus on YouTube. On 4 February 2017, the second promo of the show mystery behind the song was released by Star Plus.
The series is set in the backdrop of Rajasthan. Some of the initial scenes were shot in Bikaner, Rajasthan. Some were also shot in Gajner fort.

title: Katturumbu
summary:
Katturumbu (Malayalam: കട്ടുറുമ്പ്) is a Malayalam children television show, broadcast on Flowers TV. The show features children from four to nine years. The children showcase various dubsmash, skits, dance performances and many other talents. The show was initially hosted by actress and VJ Pearle Maaney. 
Later, it was hosted by Swasika show aired its first season from 2017–2018. The show also had a spin-off which was titled as Kathukuthan Katturumbu  which was simultaneously aired with season one in the channel. It was a live game show for kids hosted by Swasika. The second season was broadcast in 2023.

title: Khatmal E Ishq
summary:
Khatmal E Ishq is an Indian comedy show produced by Aswini Dheer under the banner of Garima Productions. Khatmal E Ishq...Kaat Lega, the first series of the show premiered on 13 December 2016 on Sony SAB. It starred Vishal Malhotra and Umang Jain. This first series ended on 20 January 2017.
Khatmal E Ishq - Biwi Ke Nakhre... Offo is the second series of the show which began airing from 23 January 2017. Third season named Khatmal E Ishq - Do Phool Ek Maali began airing on 8 March 2017.
plot: Khatmal-E-Ishq is a romantic comedy narrating short stories of ageless love –The love which is beyond imagination & which can change your life forever. When this ishq ka khatmal bites, your life takes an unprecedented romantic turn. This light hearted comedy will introduce multiple lovable characters in multiple heart-warming situations.

title: Karmaphal Daata Shani
summary: Karmaphal Daata Shani (transl. Shani, the divine judge of deeds) is an Indian dharmic devotional television series, which aired from 7 November 2016 to 9 March 2018 on Colors TV. The series was produced by Swastik Productions of Siddharth Kumar Tewary.
plot:
The story of the series is based on the life of God Shani Dev, who is known for his justice and wrath. The serial also shows Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva as Shani's mentors. It also shows Shani's tough childhood, getting the title of karmaphaldaata, his downfall, his return to Suryalok, marriage, getting his wife's curse and finally his return as Karmphaldaata. The story is about Shani, son of Suryadev and Chaaya who is the shadow form of Sandhya, first wife of suryadev and with Sandhya, suryadev has two children namely Yama and Yami, when Sandhya cannot bear Suryadev's Heat she created Chaaya, to take Care of her Children until she returns from a tap, she Warns her not to get close to her husband but Chaaya did so against Sandhya, Shanidev was born as dark but Suryadev later accepts his colour. Sandhya hates Chaaya and her son Shani, because she thinks that Chaaya Cheated her By getting close to her husband. So, she creates much trouble for Shani and his mother Chaaya with help of Indradev. But Shani faced all this with help of his karmapal power and his karma. Later, Shani exposes Sandhya's evil character in front of Suryadev, so Suryadev chases out Sandhya and announced Chaaya as his official wife. Due to this, Chaaya Get Pregnant Again and they got a second baby named Badhra but actually because of Sandhya's evil plan Bhadhra became against for everyone and finally she killed herself but unfortunately the blame goes to Shani himself and as a result, Chaaya started to hate Shani and she took shani's karmalpal position from himself. Later, frustrating Shani forgave everything and went away and the years had gone.
10 years later, Shani returns and now he marries Dhamini due to some situation and even he earns lot of enemies namely Ravana, Indra and Rahu. However, Shani faces all and tries to keep the situation normal, but due to sevvai, Dhamini curses Shani as he never sees anyone's face, because they were getting far instead of consummating their marriage. To avoid these kind of situations, Shani must to take over his karmapal power again but Shani refused. Later, Chaaya understood Shani by Dhamini's proof and speech. Finally, Ravana took a war on Suryaloka to capture all navagrahas but Shani tried to stop him as much as he can. By the end, Shani retakes his karmapal power and even released from bane which Dhamini gave and defeat Ravana and joins with his family. Further he continues his karmapal to everyone.

By the end, Shani retakes his karmapal power and even released from bane which Dhamini gave and defeat Ravana and joins with his family. Further he continues his karmapal to everyone.
