title: Kuch Toh Hai Tere Mere Darmiyaan
wikiTitle: Kuch Toh Hai Tere Mere Darmiyaan
summary:
Kuch Toh Hai Tere Mere Darmiyaan (transl. There Is Something Between You and Me) is an Indian serial drama television series, which aired on Star Plus from 28 September 2015 to 2 January 2016, ending after 83 episodes. It was re-broadcast on Star Utsav in February 2020.
Produced by Balaji Telefilms, the series was based on The Book of Life and starred Gautam Gupta, Asha Negi and Aly Goni in lead roles. Asha Negi replaced actress Shritama Mukherjee and Aly Goni replaced Vibhav Roy, in lead roles. The series is about love and friendship and starts in Jamshedpur.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text:
Koyal is a young woman from Jamshedpur who believes that there are two types of people: people who live for someone, and people whom they live for. Madhavan, Raj and Koyal are best friends. Madhavan (Maddy) is the best student in the town, hard-working and caring. He is in love with Koyal and can do anything for her happiness. Raj is a flirt and dreams of becoming a movie star. Koyal is in love with Raj and she does everything for him.
At an annual function, a famous director insults Raj and selects Koyal as his heroine. Raj tells Koyal that she can never be a star. Koyal decides to go to Mumbai to prove Raj wrong, but at the last moment, Raj stops Koyal by faking an injury. Maddy is upset for Koyal.
However, Raj and Koyal, even after facing so many difficulties, fall in love with each other. But, destiny has other things written for them when Raj gets framed in Shubhod's "Shubho" murder. Shubho was actually pushed off the terrace by Samar, for having discovered the latter's conspiracies. Raj is unable to prove his truth and is sent to Jail for Shubho's murder.
Later, Koyal's sister, Taani's marriage is fixed with Maddy's brother Surya and Koyal's parents want her to marry Maddy. When Koyal tells Maddy she doesn't want to get engaged, a selfless Maddy breaks off the alliance himself. Koyal learns that Taani being an adopted child and shares it with Raj. During Taani's engagement ceremony, Raj discloses the truth to everyone and Surya calls off the engagement. Koyal is upset with Raj and tells him that she never wants to see his face not realising that Taani was in on the plan with Raj.
Maddy proposes to Koyal who finally tells him that she loves Raj. When Koyal learns about Taani and Raj's plan, she brings Raj home and says that she wants to marry him. Raj also admits that he loves Koyal. Their alliance is fixed but Koyal's parents are not happy. They try to break the alliance and make Koyal patch up with Maddy. There is something which Koyal's parents are hiding and no one knows about it. It's revealed that Koyal is the adopted child and not Taani. Koyal is really Taani and Taani is really Koyal.
The story ends with Koyal reuniting with Maddy.

title: Kula Deivam
summary: Kula Deivam is an Indian Tamil-language soap opera directed by Thirumurugan and starring T. S. B. K. Moulee, Vadivukkarasi, Nikitha Murali and Srithika Saneesh. It was broadcast on Sun TV from Monday to Saturday from 11 May 2015 to 13 April 2018 for 897 Episodes.
plot:
It follows the story of the couple Sundram and Gnanambal who stays together with their children and grandchildren. Problems arise in their close-knit family when the different generations clash with each other.
Gnanambal lives in a village with her daughter Alamelu, who loves her very much. In the same village, resides her other two elder children, Doraipandi and Mangalasundari. Doraipandi is married to Nirmala and has two sons, Amudhan and Vetrivel. Mangalasundari is married to Karunakaran who works in the ships, and they have two daughters, Kayalvizhi and Velvizhi. Both Doraipandi and Mangalasundari hate their mother Gnanambal, believing her to be a woman of low-dignity, due to a misunderstanding in an incident in the past. Gnanambal longs for their love, but they have no respect for her. They are also not fond of Alamelu staying with her, and forbid their children from meeting or interacting with her. Doraipandi believes that his mother’s actions are the reason that their father, Sundaram left them.
In reality, Sundaram, lives as Arunachalam in Chennai, and is a big businessman. He has two children, Keshav and Kalpana. Keshav is married to Aarti, and have to children, the spoilt brat Rohit and Ananya. Kalpana is married to Agustine and they have 3 daughters, Shreya, Shruti and Shewtha. Actually, Sundram assumed the name Arunachalam after his friend. Years ago, Sundaram left Ganambal and his children in search of work. He meets Arunachalam, a street vendor and works in his shop and befriends him. Arunachalam married a woman, against her parents’ wishes, and both eloped. They have two children Keshav and Kalpana, whom he had not met yet. He is due to meet them in a few days time. In a turn of events, Arunachalam is killed by his village people and Sundaram, wearing glasses just like Arunachalam, is assumed as their father by Keshav and Kalpana. Not wanting to hurt the children’s feelings, Sundaram becomes Arunachalam.
Not knowing any truth, Alamelu works in Arunachalam’s office. Slowly the truth comes out. The grandchildren are happily united. Doraipandi and Managala too get to know that their mother was framed by a worker in the past and unite with her. While Kalpana turns over a new leaf and agrees to share the property with Doraipandi, Mangala and Alamelu, Keshav resists. Many events occur and in the end the family reunites and the show ends with Alamelu’s marriage with Aadhavan.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Speaking about the series, director Thirumurugan said, "Unlike Nadhaswaram, which was entirely shot in a small village, Kula Deivam will have a city connect. There are two families -one is in the rural areas and the other is from the city. How these two families function differently is the main plot of this mega series. I have also sketched characters from three different generations. How they connect with each other is also one of the plots."

articleSections.text: It was written by lyricist Palani Bharathi, composed by music director Sanjeev Rathan, and was sung by Anand, Anitha Karthikeyan.

articleSections.text: According to BARC ratings (Tamil Nadu + Puducherry)' Mega Serial household television ratings, the pilot episode week of That's Kula Deivam earned a averaging 13.8% rating. While the final episode week scored an 8.5% rating. It became one of the most watched tamil television program. In week 42 of 2017 and the following week, it was at fifth and fourth position.

title: Kalash – Ek Vishwaas
summary:
Kalash – Ek Vishwaas is an Indian soap opera that premiered on 23 March 2015 on Life OK. The show was produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor under their banner Balaji Telefilms. The show stars Aparna Dixit and Krip Suri. The show is named after Ekta Kapoor's soap opera Kalash that aired on Star Plus from 2001 to 2003. The show ended on 17 March 2017.
Reruns of the show also aired on Star Utsav under the title Devika...Ambe Maa Ki Ladli. This show is being re-telecasted on Shemaroo TV from 8 April 2021.

articleSections.title: Plotline
articleSections.text:
Devika, a devout follower of Ambe Maa, struggles against her oppressive family. Despite her grandmother Savitri's constant discouragement of Devika's ambitions, she remains determined to pursue education and a career. Her life intersects with Ravi, an ambitious man who deals with his own family's financial struggles. Meanwhile, Savitri pressures Devika to marry Saket, a wealthy politician, to secure a political alliance. Devika faces a difficult dilemma between following her dreams and the expectations of her family.
She eventually begins her job at Rakesh Luthra’s company but faces challenges, particularly from Ravi, who becomes her competitor. Meanwhile, Saket pressures her to marry and Ravi is romantically pursued by his boss, Nivedita Luthra. In the midst of Devika's wedding preparations, Ravi uncovers Saket’s affair with Ananya, who is pregnant with his child. But Saket kills her to bury the secret, forcing Ravi to swap places with him on the wedding altar to marry Devika and save her from a miserable life.
Despite objections from her family, Devika decides to stay with Ravi. Tension builds as Devika’s in-laws, especially her mother-in-law, Manju, begin eyeing her property, seeing it as a solution to their financial struggles. Misunderstanding a conversation, Devika accuses Ravi of marrying her for her wealth, which strains their relationship. During their honeymoon, Saket manipulates the situation to drive a wedge between them, even going as far as framing Ravi in a fraud case, leading to his temporary arrest. Meanwhile, Devika and Ravi mend their relationship amidst further schemes from a vengeful Saket and a lovesick Nivedita which are not nearly over.
The tension peaks when Saket, Manju, and Nivedita plot against Devika, pushing her off a cliff. Ravi desperately searches for her, unsure of whether she’s alive. Devika, presumed dead, is saved by Janki Raichand, a powerful and influential woman. Believing Ravi betrayed her, Devika, under the guise of Ambika Raichand, vows revenge. Ravi clings to memories of Devika, hoping for her return. Meanwhile, Nivedita burns the Garewal house to erase Devika from Ravi’s life, hoping he will forget her.
Nine months later, Devika (now Ambika) reappears, confronting Ravi and Nivedita at their engagement. Ravi is emotionally confused, and Nivedita is temporarily arrested for her past actions. Ambika seeks revenge while hiding her feelings for Ravi. After a series of confrontations, Saket kidnaps her, but Ravi rescues her, and Saket is arrested. Ambika then secretly replaces Nivedita at Ravi’s wedding, revealing her true identity. Despite Ravi claiming innocence, Ambika initially distrusts him, believing he was involved in her death. After a dangerous fall, they reconcile, and Ambika accepts Ravi's love.
Two months later, Ravi wins "Architect of the Year," crediting Devika. At a celebration, Devika discovers she's pregnant but waits to share the news. Nivedita returns, apologizing, but doubts remain. After a confrontation, Monty is shot, and Ravi is arrested. Devika uncovers evidence proving someone else shot Monty, leading her to expose Nivedita and Saket as the real killers. They are arrested, and Ravi is cleared. Devika reveals she's pregnant, and they embrace, ready for their new chapter together.

episodesList.title: Kalash...Ek Vishwaas
episodesList.summary: This episode portrays the significance of Navratri and the miraculous powers of Goddess Durga. A girl child, Devika, is worshipped in the form of Kumari during the festival. She is shocked witnessing the atrocities against the women. Will Devika be able to fight the injustice?

episodesList.title: Dadi has plans for Devika
episodesList.summary: Devika aspires to build her career and wants to continue with her academics. However, her orthodox Dadi strictly forbids Devika from pursuing studies and insists that she get married. Destiny does not favour Devika as she fails in the college exam.

episodesList.title: Devika is upset with Savitri
episodesList.summary: Savitri announces Devika's marriage with Rajesh while Devika tries to cancel it. Devika is shocked noticing Savitri supporting Sanjay to pursue his academics, but not her. However, Devika gets a chance to reappear for her college exam and is motivated by Dadaji.

episodesList.title: Devika's marriage is called off
episodesList.summary: Dadaji plays a prank on Savitri. He makes Savitri realise that Devika needs her support to study further. Later, Savitri cancels Devika's marriage with Rajesh. A passionate Ravi aspires to start his own business. Devika pays her gratitude to Dadaji.

episodesList.title: Devika is proved innocent
episodesList.summary: An invigilator accuses Devika of cheating in the examination, but she is proved innocent. Devika's family prepares for Ajay and Tanu's upcoming wedding ceremony. Vikas is hired to look after the arrangements and he seeks financial help from Ravi. Ravi is keen to know about Devika.

episodesList.title: Ravi rescues Devika
episodesList.summary: Ravi is upset with Devika for spoiling his date with Dipa. Devika and her family celebrate Ajay and Tanu's wedding ceremony. Dipa vents her anguish after Ravi ignores her. A fire breaks out at the wedding venue and Ravi rescues Devika.

episodesList.title: Savitri deceives Vikas
episodesList.summary: Vikas is disappointed with Savitri for not paying him for the wedding contract. Later, Vikas' mother raises her voice against Savitri for being unjust to Vikas and the two confront each other. Ravi is keen to become an industrialist. Savitri forbids Devika from working.

episodesList.title: Devika-Ravi attend an interview
episodesList.summary: Dadaji uses his trick and makes Savitri realise that Devika needs to work. Later, Savitri motivates Devika to look for a job. Devika and Ravi aspire to become architects. The two visit the same company for an interview. Ravi attempts to get Devika out of his way, but fails.

episodesList.title: An MLA frees Savitri
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Savitri and Ravi's mother for creating a ruckus in a crowded market. Later, an MLA, Saket, frees Savitri and Ravi manages to bail out his mother. Ravi regrets not being an influential person and vows to become a famous industrialist. Devika dislikes Ravi.

episodesList.title: Ravi is an atheist
episodesList.summary: Manju wants to take revenge on Savitri and her family, and strives to get back the money which Vikas had invested in the wedding contract. Ravi intends to compete with Devika for the architectural designs. Devika is shocked to know that Ravi is an atheist!

episodesList.title: Devika ruins her own prospects
episodesList.summary: Devika ruins her designs during the interview to help Ravi bag the job, and tries to make him realise that Goddess Durga is helping him and his family. However, Ravi, who is an atheist, refuses to believe her and celebrates for getting the job.

episodesList.title: An MLA wants to marry Devika!
episodesList.summary: Dadaji insists that Devika find a job within a week while Savitri is desperate to get Devika married to an influential person. MLA Saket wishes to marry Devika and manages to clear his name in a case, Shekhar filed against him. Devika hates Ravi for flirting with a girl and regrets supporting him.

episodesList.title: Ravi rescues Tanu
episodesList.summary: Savitri approaches MLA Saket to get Devika married to him. Devika is worried about Tanu as she gets stuck at the market during the wee hours. Later, a few boys attempt to molest Tanu but Ravi fights them and rescues her. Devika misunderstands Ravi for misbehaving with Tanu.

episodesList.title: Devika does not want to marry
episodesList.summary: Savitri desperately searches for Devika as she is nowhere to be found. Devika hides Tanu's incident from her family and manages to sneak into her house. She is upset as Savitri insists that she marry Saket. On the flipside, Saket is eager to tie his knot with Devika.

episodesList.title: Saket takes Devika home
episodesList.summary: MLA Saket tries to make Devika and her family realise about his political powers. Savitri considers Saket as a trustworthy and an influential person and allows him to spend some time with Devika. However, Dadaji is upset with Savitri's gesture and is worried after Saket takes Devika to his house.

episodesList.title: Devika accuses Ravi
episodesList.summary: Saket thanks Ravi for rescuing Devika from a fire. Devika accuses Ravi of ill treating Tanu. Ravi tries to make her realise that he rescued Tanu while a few boys were trying to molest her. Saket and his family don't want Devika to work, while Ravi tries to support her.

episodesList.title: Devika mistrusts Ravi
episodesList.summary: Saket tries to mislead Devika about Ravi and his family. On Devika's insistence, Saket assures her of helping her to seek a job. However, Savitri objects Devika from working and is keen to get her married to Saket. Devika is unsure about Ravi being a trustworthy person and thinks about him.

episodesList.title: Saket creates trouble for Devika
episodesList.summary: Ravi rescues Devika from an accident. MLA Saket creates ruckus in a company where Devika has applied for a job. He threatens the company director and warns him against hiring Devika. Ravi learns that Devika helped him in getting the job. Savitri is desperate to tie Devika's knot with Saket.

episodesList.title: Ravi wants Devika's happiness
episodesList.summary: Saket is eager to marry Devika at the earliest. A shocked Ravi tries to cancel their marriage for Devika's good. Ravi seeks the help of his boss to recruit Devika in his organisation. Devika is thrilled to get a job. However, Savitri stops her from working.

episodesList.title: Saket held up on engagement day
episodesList.summary: Saket proceeds to attend his engagement ceremony with Devika. However, he gets stuck on the way due to a storm. Savitri is worried about Saket's whereabouts while Devika and her family reminisce Ajay and Tanu's wedding ceremony. Manju intends to take revenge on Savitri.

episodesList.title: Manju takes revenge on Savitri
episodesList.summary: The Deol family performs Ajay and Tanu's wedding rituals, while Savitri is anxious to get Saket and Devika engaged. During the ceremony, Manju brings the police to get Savitri arrested. Ravi and Devika strive to clear their misconceptions about each other.

episodesList.title: Saket frees Savitri
episodesList.summary: Devika and Ravi are shocked to learn that Manju has filed a police case against Savitri. Ravi condemns Devika and her family for their disgraceful acts, leaving Devika disappointed. MLA Saket frees Savitri and a grateful Savitri hopes that he will soon be engaged to Devika.

episodesList.title: Saket to ruin Devika's job?
episodesList.summary: Devika panics on recalling the incidents that happened with her family and thinks about Ravi. On the other hand, Savitri provokes MLA Saket to ruin Devika's job. Saket visits a company with his miscreants and attempts to cancel Devika's appointment. Ravi hesitates to work with Devika.

episodesList.title: Ravi-Devika dislike each other
episodesList.summary: Ravi stops Saket from creating nuisance in the office and is shocked to learn about his intention of ruining Devika's work. Ravi manages to bring the situation under control. Saket asks Ravi to take care of Devika, while Savitri is desperate to get Devika married. Devika and Ravi dislike each other.

episodesList.title: Ravi spoils Devika's day
episodesList.summary: Devika feels dejected as Ravi troubles her in the office on the very first working day. Manju is shocked to learn about Savitri released from jail and they confront each other. Saket is eager to meet Devika. Ravi regrets troubling Devika.

episodesList.title: Saket spends time with Devika
episodesList.summary: Saket interacts with Devika's father. Dadaji slams Savitri for being eager to get Saket engaged to Devika. Saket gets to spend some quality time with Devika and intends to know about her personal life. However, Devika holds herself back as she is against marrying Saket.

episodesList.title: Saket leaves Devika alone
episodesList.summary: Saket is busy spending time with Devika when he gets to know about his mother getting stuck in a heavy storm and he rushes to rescue her. On Saket's insistence, Ravi agrees to take care of Devika finding her alone in the wee hours. Later, Ravi and Devika have a tiff.

episodesList.title: Ravi rebukes Devika
episodesList.summary: Ravi and Devika get stuck in the market at wee hours and confront each other. Saket manages to locate them and drops Devika home. Ravi rebukes Devika for lighting incense sticks at the office and stops her from worshipping Devi Durga. On the other hand, Saket is desperate to contact Devika.

episodesList.title: Ravi is jealous of Devika
episodesList.summary: The Managing Director, Amit, is impressed with Devika's designs while Ravi feels jealous of her. Amit announces about a designing contest. Further, Devika and Ravi challenge each other for the contest. Saket strives to marry Devika.

episodesList.title: Amit is impressed with Ravi
episodesList.summary: Ravi and Devika get stuck in the lift, but later, manage to come out. Saket's mother and Dadaji criticise Savitri's gesture. Amit is impressed with Ravi and motivates him for the design contest. Sheily strives to win Ravi's love while Saket is eager to spend some time with Devika.

episodesList.title: A wedding ring for Devika
episodesList.summary: Devika is suspicious of Ravi's gesture and expresses her hatred for him. Ravi confronts Sheily and asks her to stay away from him. Saket is elated to present a wedding ring to Devika! Devika urges Saket to allow her to continue with her job after marriage.

episodesList.title: Savitri Devi confronts Vikas
episodesList.summary: The Deols are elated to meet Sakshi. Sakshi assures Devika of her support. Savitri Devi confronts Vikas, but Ravi and Saket manage to placate her. On Saket's insistence, Vikas takes the contract of his wedding ceremony. Ravi vows to make the arrangements for the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Devika-Ravi reconcile
episodesList.summary: Sakshi is glad to meet the Deols. Ravi expresses his hatred for Sheily and proves to Devika that he is trustworthy. Further, Ravi and Devika clear their misconceptions. Manju does not want Ravi to support the Deols. Devika and Ravi pay their gratitude to each other.

episodesList.title: The Deols are worried
episodesList.summary: Savitri praises Saket and believes him to be trustworthy while Ravi is upset with Saket for not dealing properly with Devika. The Deols are worried about Devika's engagement. However, Ravi assures them of his support. Sakshi expresses her hatred for Saket and prays for the wellbeing of her family.

episodesList.title: Saket-Devika's wedding prep
episodesList.summary: The Deols appreciate Ravi for arranging for Devika's wedding ring. Amit conducts the design contest and declares Ravi the winner. Ravi thanks Devika for guiding him. The Deols set out to make arrangements for Saket and Devika's wedding ceremony.

episodesList.title: Saket lets Devika down
episodesList.summary: Ravi makes the arrangements for Saket and Devika's engagement while Saket is furious noticing Ravi and Devika's proximity. Devika is dejected by Saket's behaviour. Sakshi misunderstands Devika to be getting engaged to Ravi but Devika clears her misconception.

episodesList.title: Saket-Devika's engagement
episodesList.summary: Ravi spends some quality time with Devika during her engagement ceremony with Saket. The engagement takes place with the blessings of the Deols and Saket's family. Savitri wants to get them married, at the earliest.

episodesList.title: Saket creates a nuisance
episodesList.summary: Sakshi persuades the Deols to dance at Devika and Saket's engagement ceremony. However, Devika is not happy about her engagement. Saket creates a nuisance during the ceremony, leaving the Deols dejected. Later, Saket's mother expresses her hatred for the Deols.

episodesList.title: Saket humiliates the Deols
episodesList.summary: Manju succeeds in creating misunderstandings between the Deols and Saket's family. Later, Saket and his mother humiliate the Deols for gifting them fake rings. Devika and Ravi are shocked by Saket's behaviour. However, Ravi manages to placate Saket and make him realise his misdeed.

episodesList.title: Saket-Devika get engaged
episodesList.summary: The Deols appreciate Ravi's concern for them and Devika. Saket apologises to the Deols for humiliating them. Devika and Ravi express their support to each other. Saket manages to unite Manju and Savitri and gets engaged to Devika.

title: Khuda Dekh Raha Hai
summary:
Khuda Dekh Raha Hai (Urdu: خدا دیکھ رہا ہے, lit. 'God is watching') is a Pakistani television drama series directed by Sabiha Sumar of Khamosh Pani fame and produced by Sadia Jabbar. It is written by Shahzad Javed and Afifa Muhammad. The series stars Sajal Aly and Agha Ali in the lead roles along with Bushra Ansari, Imran Aslam and Asad Siddiqui in supporting roles. The 20-episode serial originally aired on A-Plus Entertainment from February 19 to July 2, 2015.
At the 15th Lux Style Awards, it received two nominations including, Best TV Actress for Aly and Best TV Director for Sumar.
plot: The show highlights the people's lives in the garb of religion. Khalida, a pious yet extremist in her values, brings up her children according to her own religious boundaries and offers Istikhara for the people who come to her. Her teachings are challenged by her daughter Zoya who when she expresses her wish to marry Junaid, her boyfriend and a singer by profession. Despite knowing her wish, Khalida gets her married to Adnan, an uncaring and alcoholic person. After her marriage, Zoya faces betrayal and tries to cope with issues.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Earlier, the show was titled as Istikhara (استخارہ) but later it was changed to Khuda Dekh Raha Hai.
Apart from acting, Agha also sang the OST of the serial. It was the second on-screen appearance of Sajal Aly and Agha Ali after the drama serial Kis Se Kahoon.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: In 2015, the show was rebroadcast in Pakistan on ATV (Pakistan) under the title Amal(عمل). * It premiered again on A-Plus Entertainment on 30 January 2017 at 10:00 pm slot. * It aired on B4U PLUS of B4U Network in India and the Middle East with the same title.

title: Kojagori
summary:
Kojagori is a Bengali language television soap opera that premiered from 2 February 2015 and aired on Zee Bangla. Produced by Magic Moments Motion Pictures, it starred Raja Goswami and Aparajita Ghosh Das in lead roles.
The show revolves around Shouronil Mitta (Raja Goswami) and Phuljhuri (Aparajita Ghosh Das) who are diametrically different from each other. The success of this show inspired Magic Moments Motion Pictures to produce a show bearing a similar plotline for Zee Bangla's rival channel Star Jalsha, Khorkuto.
plot: While Phuljhuri (Aparajita Ghosh Das) is a city-bred, pampered young girl who lives life on her own terms, Saheb (Raja Goswami Om) is a well-read, upright yet grounded youth, who believes in simple living, with high ideals. But fate brings the two people together in wedlock.
reception: The serial is being ranked as one of the most watched television serial from the day it has premiered on television. It now fetches a trp of 8.0. The serial received 4 awards at the Tele Samman Awards (2014).

title: Kalyanam Mudhal Kadhal Varai
summary:
Kalyanam Mudhal Kadhal Varai (transl. From Marriage Till Love) is a 2014 Indian Tamil language soap opera that aired on Star Vijay. The show was launched on 3 November 2014 to 27 January 2017 for 600 episodes. This series was remake of Hindi series Yeh Hai Mohabbatein and stars Divyanka Tripathi Dahiya and Karan Patel portraying Dr. Ishita and Raman.
The show stars Priya Bhavani Shankar (who was later replaced by Chaitra Reddy) with Amit Bhargav in the lead roles, Whilst Nivahsni Shyam in the supporting role. The show was directed by Thai Selvam and has dialogues written by Marudhu Shankar. The music is composed by Arun Prabhakar. The show is completely based on the Hindi show Yeh Hai Mohabbatein, which is aired on Star Plus and is partly based on Manju Kapur's novel Custody and it concluded on 27 January 2017.
The pair was known as #Arjiya or #Arya on social networking sites. Unfortunately in the end of 2016, actress Priya quit the show due to her contract expiring and was replaced by newcomer actress Chaitra Reddy. Meanwhile, the ratings tanked and the show was abruptly cancelled. Set in Chennai, the show follows the love story of Priya, a Malayali and Arjun, a Tamilian who lives next door as they marry each other for Pooja, their relationship blossoms.
plot: Following a divorce from his unfaithful wife Vandhana (Vandana), after her affair with his boss Ashok, CEO Arjun Swaminathan is a bitter man, but he loves his daughter, Pooja. Dr. Priya Unnikrishnan, a dentist who lives next door, also loves Pooja. Unable to have children of her own, she has been unable to find a partner willing to marry an infertile woman. Vandhana and Ashok win custody of Aditya (called Adi), Arjun's elder son and also try to take custody of Pooja from Arjun. Priya and Arjun put aside their dislike of each other to marry to protect the little girl and ultimately win custody of the child. Ashok tries to take revenge, convincing Arjun that Pooja is not his daughter until Priya realizes what's going on and uses a DNA test to resolve Arjun's doubts.

plotHtml: Following a divorce from his unfaithful wife Vandhana (Vandana), after her affair with his boss Ashok, CEO Arjun Swaminathan is a bitter man, but he loves his daughter, Pooja. Dr. Priya Unnikrishnan, a dentist who lives next door, also loves Pooja. Unable to have children of her own, she has been unable to find a partner willing to marry an infertile woman. Vandhana and Ashok win custody of Aditya (called Adi), Arjun's elder son and also try to take custody of Pooja from Arjun. Priya and Arjun put aside their dislike of each other to marry to protect the little girl and ultimately win custody of the child. Ashok tries to take revenge, convincing Arjun that Pooja is not his daughter until Priya realizes what's going on and uses a DNA test to resolve Arjun's doubts.

title: Karuthamuthu
summary:
Karuthamuthu (transl. Black Pearl) is an Indian Malayalam-language television soap opera that premiered on Asianet on 20 October 2014. It aired for five years and ran for 1,450 episodes across four seasons, making it one of the longest ran television serials. It is a sequel to the 2011 television series Kumkumapoovu, with the narrative set after the events of the earlier series and focusing on a different family. Illekettu Namboothiri reprised his role as Satyasheelan from Kumkumapoovu.
The series was also adapted into multiple television serials in other Indian languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, and Kannada.
reception: Karuthamuthu received positive response from audiences following its premiere on Asianet. The series significantly improved the channel's 10:00 PM time slot, recording around a 400% increase in ratings within four weeks of its launch. Due to high popularity, the show was moved to primetime of 7.30 PM and for almost 4 years it maintained top 5 positions in TRP rankings. In May 2018, producer Althahir Rasheed stated that the show's sustained popularity and increasing viewership had prompted the writer to expand the storyline by introducing several new characters and extending it into a three-generation narrative. He also confirmed that the series would conclude within 1,500 episodes. From 29 April 2019, the show was moved to evening slot of 6.30 PM for final episodes.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Karuthamuthu was directed by Praveen Kadakkavoor from a screenplay by Pradeep Panicker. The series was developed around the social issue of colourism, with its central storyline focusing on a dark-skinned woman who faces discrimination because of her complexion.
In the first and second seasons, the lead actors were Kishor Satya and Richard N. J. who played Balachandran and Jayachandran respectively. The role of Karthika was the Malayalam television debut of actress Premi Viswanath while Saranya Sasi played the antagonist role, Kanya.
In December 2015, Premi Viswanath was replaced by Renu Soundar. Saranya Sasi was replaced by Lekshmi Priya as Saranya diagnosed with Cancer which caused her death in 2021. Later Kishor Satya exited from the show, as the character become sidelined.
From third season, Rini Raj, Pradeep Chandran and Darshana Das played lead roles. Niya and Shalu Menon played Middle aged Karthika and Kanya respectively.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Karuthamuthu received positive response from audiences following its premiere on Asianet. The series significantly improved the channel's 10:00 PM time slot, recording around a 400% increase in ratings within four weeks of its launch. Due to high popularity, the show was moved to primetime of 7.30 PM and for almost 4 years it maintained top 5 positions in TRP rankings. In May 2018, producer Althahir Rasheed stated that the show's sustained popularity and increasing viewership had prompted the writer to expand the storyline by introducing several new characters and extending it into a three-generation narrative. He also confirmed that the series would conclude within 1,500 episodes. From 29 April 2019, the show was moved to evening slot of 6.30 PM for final episodes.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text:
In December 2015, lead actress Premi Viswanath, who portrayed Karthika, alleged that she had been removed from Karuthamuthu without prior notice. In a Facebook post, she stated that she had paid only 1500 per day and when she demanded hike they removed from the show and claimed that the production team later cited her participation in a television programme on Flowers TV as the reason for her removal. She denied reports that she had voluntarily left the serial.
The serial's director, Praveen Kadakkavoor, denied Premi's allegations, stating that the decision to replace her had been made earlier due to production-related issues, including dissatisfaction with her performance and alleged professional conduct. He also said that her appearance on another television channel was only the contractual reason cited for her removal, rather than the primary reason.

title: Ka Re Durava
summary: Ka Re Durava (transl. Why the distance?) is an Indian Marathi language TV series which aired on Zee Marathi. It starred Suruchi Adarkar and Suyash Tilak in lead roles. It premiered from 18 August 2014 by replacing Eka Lagnachi Tisri Goshta.
plot:
Jairam "Jay" Khanolkar is a young man from an impoverished background who desires to start his own business. He is married to his college friend Aditi Dabholkar, the only child of the wealthy Anil Dabholkar. Jay and Aditi struggle to make ends meet. Anil blames Jay for causing hardship to his daughter; however, he refuses to acknowledge that Aditi married Jay of her own free will. Desperate for money, Aditi joins Dev Tours, run by Avinash Dev, despite its policy of not recruiting married employees. Few days later, due to an unfortunate circumstance, one of Jay's business deals goes awry. Jay is compelled to accept a loan of ₹5 lakh from Avinash and join his company. Due to dire financial straits, Jay and Aditi reluctantly conceal their married status and pretend to be ordinary colleagues.
Thus the couple spend their days weaving a web of lies to overcome situations. Jay and Aditi take up residence in Bandra and become close to their landlord, Dinanath Ketkar, and his wife. On one hand, due to the poor decisions of Jay's elder brother, the responsibility of the Khanolkar family gradually falls entirely on Jay's shoulders. On the other hand, a love triangle ensues in the office with Rajni and Jui falling for Jay. Avinash develops feelings for Aditi and is jealous of her closeness with Jay. During his work, Jay crosses paths with his father-in-law. Although Anil is livid upon learning the entire situation, he doesn't expose Jay, and instead, exploits it to harass him by demanding unreasonable standards at work. Jay tolerates this initially, but gradually, he becomes infuriated with Anil's behaviour. He deftly manipulates situations and becomes so successful at work that Anil can do nothing about it. Worse, Anil is eventually forced to share his cabin with Jay. However, Anil comes up with another ploy and deceives Aditi by pretending to have accepted Jay as his son-in-law. Jay does not disclose the ruse for Aditi's happiness.
Eventually, Anil discovers that Avinash's mother wishes Aditi to be her daughter-in-law. He proposes a collaboration with Avinash on a grand project, and Jay is appointed as its leader. Anil also creates opportunities for Avinash and Aditi to be together and uses that to torment Jay. On the other hand, irritated by Rajni's antagonism towards Aditi, Jay emphatically rejects her. Few days later, Jay learns of Avinash's decision to make him a business partner along with Anil Dabholkar. Later, Anil threatens Jay that if Aditi leaves Dev Tours, he will withdraw his entire investment from Avinash's dream project and pin the blame on Jay. Aditi is horrified when Avinash unexpectedly proposes to her. Later, in a desperate bid to persuade Aditi to accept Avinash's proposal, Anil reveals his threat to Jay, which upsets Aditi. Eventually the couple reveal their marital status to everyone and are forgiven because of their immense contribution. The story ends with Anil accepting Jay and Aditi's marriage.

title: Kiranmala
summary: Kiranmala is an Indian Bengali language television series which aired on Star Jalsha from 4 August 2014 to 19 November 2016. It was produced by Surinder Films and starred Rooqma Ray, Farhan Imroze and Chandrayee Ghosh. It was based on traditional folktales of the same name collected in Thakurmar Jhuli by Dakshinaranjan Mitra Majumder. The series was dubbed into Hindi, Tamil, and Odia and broadcast on Star Plus, Star Vijay and Tarantg TV. It returned in March 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The series re-aired a third time on Jalsha Movies on 13 May 2024.The series re-aired a 4th time on Colors Bangla 28 June 2026.
plot: King Bijoy is the king of Achinpur. After winning a battle, his mother/Rajmata takes him to a secret room of the palace and shows him that the imprisonment of the demons will come to an end which was given to them by his father. She also tells him that of the ancestors' prophecy that a princess named Kiranmala will be born in their royal family who will save the world from the demons. But demons Queen Paykati and her daughter Katkati learned of the prophecy and plot a plan. According to their plan, Paykati goes to the royal place as a nurse for Queen Rupmoti and at the time of Rupmoti's labour time, she switches baby Kiranmala with frogs and rats. After this she throws Kiranmala in the sea, but she is saved by a fisherman and his wife and they care for Kiranmala as their daughter along with their sons. Paykati accuses Rupmoti of being a witch and everyone, including Rajmata and the king, believe her and throw Rupmoti out of the palace. 18 years later, they start forming an entire team of demons including Pishachini, Bajramala, Donkar and Bitkel. Kiranmala falls in love with Donkar's stepbrother Kumar Prithviraj, making Donkar jealous of Prithviraj. Bajramala becomes jealous of Kiranmala because Bajramala loves Prithviraj. However, Kiranmala and Prithviraj end up married. They give birth to Alokmala, who changes the jealousy in Bajramala and Donkar's heart into love. Katkati becomes angry and tries to destroy Achinpur and Amrita Nagari. Kiranmala dies by suicide to save the world from Katkati. She and Katkati both go to Mokhsa (Kingdom of Death), where Kiranmala is rewarded with Svarga, while Katkati, Pyakati, Pishachini and Bitkel are left to suffer in Naraka.Then, Alokmala went there and brought kiranmala again.
reception:
The serial was promoted by many film personalities from Tollywood like Koel Mallick and Raj Chakraborty in the last episode of the latter serial on 3 August 2014. The series had also become popular in neighboring Bangladesh, where several people have clashed over it at a village in the Habiganj District, injuring 100 people.
At the Kolkata Book Fair, seven children from Kolkata met Rukma Roy (who plays Kiranmala) at the stall of Star Jalsha. The actress said:
Happy that the work of famed fantasy writer Dakshinaranjan Mitra Majumder will be introduced to the largely uninitiated audience of Gen Next as well as others. Replete with palace, forts and 'raj-durbar' Kiranmala by Star Jalsha will bring a change in the usual look of Bengali serials after many years.

title: Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan
summary: Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan (How Is This Friendship) is an Indian television series that premiered on MTV India on 21 July 2014. It ran for two seasons before it was cancelled at MTV. The third and fourth seasons debuted over the air on Voot in May 2018 and December 2022, respectively. The fifth season premiered on JioCinema on 2 September 2023.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Parth Samthaan as Manik Malhotra: A rock star, member of FAB5, founder of S.P.A.C.E GOA, Shrikant and Nyonika's son, Cabir's best friend, Nandini's lover turned husband and Noor's adoptive father *Niti Taylor as Nandini Manik Malhotra: Former member of NH3, astrophysicist at NSRU GOA, member Of The Space Travel Programme, Rishabh's elder sister, Navya's Best friend, Manik's lover turned wife and Noor's adoptive mother * Ayaz Ahmed as Cabir Dhawan: Member of FAB5; Raghav's ex-boyfriend, Navya's roommate, Manik's best friend and Abir's adoptive father * Veebha Anand as Navya Naveli (seasons 1–2): Former member of NH3, Harshad's ex-girlfriend, Nandini's best friend, Cabir's roommate and Abir's mother * Utkarsh Gupta as Dhruv Vedant: Member of FAB5, had a crush on Nandini; Alya's on-again-off-again boyfriend * Krissann Barretto as Alya Saxena (seasons 1-2, 4-5): Member of FAB5, Harshad's sister, Manik's ex-girlfriend and Dhruv's on-again-off-again girlfriend * Charlie Chauhan as Mukti Vardhan: Member of FAB5, Harshad's ex-girlfriend, Abhimanyu's love interest (until his death), Zubin's fiancé and wife (season 1,2,3) * Abhishek Malik as Harshad Saxena: Former leader of NH3, Alya's brother, Mukti and Navya's ex-boyfriend, and Abir's biological father * Kishwer Merchant as Niyonika Malhotra: Manik's mother and the head of S.P.A.C.E. Academy * Karan Jotwani as Aaryamaan Khurana (seasons 1–2): Soha's brother and friend of Nandini who is in love with her, unbeknownst to Nandini * Aayush Shokeen as Rishabh: Nandini's younger brother, student at S.P.A.C.E Goa (season 4), member of Vibe (season 5), and Latika's love interest * Binita Budhathoki as Seher: Noor's biological mother and student at S.P.A.C.E Goa, member of Vibe * Sagar Parekh as Yuvan: Student at S.P.A.C.E Goa, member of Vibe, Alya's love interest, Latika's friend who has a crush on her * Manan Bhardwaj as Latika: Student at S.P.A.C.E Goa, member of Vibe, Yuvaan's childhood friend, Rishabh's love interest * Janya Khandpur as Kashin: Student at S.P.A.C.E Goa, member of Vibe, and Omkar's sister * Ayush Tandon as Advait: student at SPACE Goa, Member of Vibe, Dushyant's son. * Mehul Nisar as Venkatesh Murthy, Nandini's uncle * Ritu Vashisht as Shannoo Murthy, Nandini's aunt

episodesList.title: Glowing Dreams
episodesList.summary: Nandini unites two fighting lovers. She fondly collects fireflies believing they're the harbinger of true love. Nandini shifts to Mumbai with Shannoo and Murthy for Rishabh's treatment.

episodesList.title: Big City Blues
episodesList.summary: Navya reaches Mumbai to learn singing. Kabir takes a gullible Shahid for a ride and posts his naked images online. The shame and humiliation Shahid receives drives him to kill himself.

episodesList.title: Life Savers!
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Navya intervene and save Shahid's life. This incident draws media attention towards the college. The college offers full scholarships to both of them in order to save it's reputation.

episodesList.title: Nandini And Navya Meet FAB5
episodesList.summary: Amma Maa implores Nandini to pursue her own dream rather than her father's. This makes Nandini decide to join S.P.A.C.E. where Nandini and Navya meet FAB5 for the first time.

episodesList.title: Navya Locked in a Garbage Bin
episodesList.summary: Navya can not believe it when she is invited by FAB5. Instead they lock her up in a garbage bin as a revenge for saving Shahid. Shahid tells Nandini about Kabir's video which shows Navya trapped.

episodesList.title: Nandini & Navya Get Closer
episodesList.summary: Nandini saves Navya which enrages the FAB5 even more. This incident stregthens Navya and Nandini's bond. The FAB5 wants Navya to disclose who saved her to be able to join them.

episodesList.title: Niyonika Manipulates Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Navya are shocked at their treatment by FAB5. Niyonika uses Manik to get some papers signed by Manik's father. Nandini unknowingly visit's Manik's house. Manik takes her father's pen.

episodesList.title: Nandini Wants The Pen Back
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Rishabh jump into the pool to recover the pen. When the pen isn't found, Nandini wants it back from the FAB5. They dare Nandini to do what they say to get her father's pen.

episodesList.title: Nandini Lashes Out
episodesList.summary: Nandini hits Manik in an argument. This enrages him. Dhruv asks Manik not to harass Nandini.

episodesList.title: Friendship's Day
episodesList.summary: Navya is in a dilemma as her dreams can only be fulfilled by joining FAB5. That would mean ending her friendship with Nandini. Nandini and Manik perform together on Friendship Day.

episodesList.title: Caught Unaware
episodesList.summary: Manik takes Nandini to FAB5's friendship day party at his house after the performance at the old age home. Nandini seems delighted to be at the party, but she is unaware of what is to happen.

episodesList.title: Unacceptable Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Nandini starts breaking expensive artefacts at Manik's place as she is furious with the FAB5 for having upset her. Manik is upset with Nandini as she behaves that way.

episodesList.title: The Spot Girl Contract
episodesList.summary: Manik arrives at Nandini's house. He compels Nandini to sign a contract which will bind her to act as his spot girl. Nandini isn't happy about signing the contract.

episodesList.title: Nandini is Unhappy With Manik
episodesList.summary: Manik meets Nandini. He notifies the highlights of the contracts that are the rules which she needs to follow. Nandini feels that Manik is mistreating her.

episodesList.title: Manik's Merciless Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Manik makes Nandini perform a series of chores meant for servants. At Dhruv's place, Nandini notices the star which is also drawn on her brother's bedroom wall.

episodesList.title: Nandini is Suspicious Of Rishabh & Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini tries to find out the mystery behind the star's drawing. Rishabh and Manik avoid her. Nandini is suspicious about Rishabh and Manik's behaviour towards her.

episodesList.title: Dhruv To Rescue
episodesList.summary: Manik punishes Nandini compelling her to kiss him. He makes her drink a disgusting mocktail. Dhruv stops Nandini from doing it. Nandini is elated as Dhruv comes to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Defiant Days
episodesList.summary: Nandini follows Navya's plan to get rid of Manik's torture. Nandini refuses to follow his order. Manik arrives at her place where he notices the star art also to be found at Dhruv's place.

episodesList.title: Nandini Ends Her Contract With Manik
episodesList.summary: Alya calls for a FAB5 emergency meeting where they take her side. Alya compels Manik to end his contract with Nandini. Nandini is thankful to Alya to have freed her from the despicable contract.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Irritates Nandini & Navya
episodesList.summary: Harshad, Navya, Nandini, and FAB5 are in the same pool but on the opposite ends. FAB5 leaves no opportunity to trouble Nandini and Navya. Nandini and Navya are irritated.

episodesList.title: Unlikely Trio
episodesList.summary: Manik comes to meet Nandini at her place to talk about the connection between Dhruv and her brother. Harshad surprises everyone by announcing Navya and Nandini as his band members.

episodesList.title: Nandini Is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Nandini refuses to be a part of Harshad's band. Alya sets Nandini up by having two goons force themselves on her. Nandini is yet to find out that Alya has sent those goons.

episodesList.title: Manik Regrets His Past Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Harshad messes up with FAB5 and tries breaking them apart. Mukti calls Alya and tells her that she will commit suicide as the FAB5 has separated. Everyone is worried about Mukti's threat.

episodesList.title: Threat Fret
episodesList.summary: Harshad messes up with FAB5 and tries breaking them apart. Mukti calls Alya and tells her that she will commit suicide as the FAB5 has separated. Everyone is worried about Mukti's threat.

episodesList.title: Stress Test
episodesList.summary: Harshad protests at the college to revoke Nandini's expulsion order. Manik and Nandini are stressed out on Dhruv's absence in the college. Manik and Nandini contemplate what to do next.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Knows About Alya's Evil Plans
episodesList.summary: Harshad compels the FAB5 to leave the practice room. Dhruv spots Alya paying money to the goons for harassing Nandini. Dhruv feels betrayed by Alya, as she hatched a plan against Nandini.

episodesList.title: Harshad is Worried For Alya
episodesList.summary: Nandini calls for Manik's help when she is unable to handle Dhruv's strange attacks. Harshad learns that Alya is being blackmailed by a person. Harshad is worried about Alya.

episodesList.title: Who's She
episodesList.summary: Nandini informs her uncle and aunt that she has been working in the college cafe. Kabir surprises his gang by introducing his girlfriend to them.

episodesList.title: Love is in The Air
episodesList.summary: Raghav calls for a jamming session for the participative bands. While practising, Nandini and Dhruv sneak out to secretly meet each other. Nandini and Dhruv share a good time.

episodesList.title: Goon Gone Bad
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik get locked in the store room. The goons hired by Alya start harassing her. Manik is worried about Nandini being harassed by the goons.

episodesList.title: Getting Cornered
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik are locked in the store room. Their respective band members are worried because of their absence. The band members start looking for Nandini and Manik.

episodesList.title: Lock'n Shock
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik are locked inside the store room till the night. Navya, Harshad and Alya find them. They notice Manik holding Nandini by her waist. Everyone is shocked.

episodesList.title: Raghav Punishes The FAB5
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik are teased for spending their last night together. Raghav punishes the FAB5, Nandini and Navya by asking them to look for their music instruments hidden in a forest.

episodesList.title: Treasure Hunt Turns Tragic!
episodesList.summary: The two bands are engaged in the treasure hunt. Manik and Harshad notice the final treasure. They run for it and accidentally tackle Nandini off the cliff, and chaos ensues.

episodesList.title: Punishment In Parts
episodesList.summary: Part one of Raghav's punishment has concluded. Part two consists of the bands performing live that too only with the found instruments. The bands are up for the challenge.

episodesList.title: Joining Forces
episodesList.summary: Nandini suggests the two bands to perform together as they had no time left to practise and very less instruments. This manages to impress Raghav.

episodesList.title: Half Baked Truth
episodesList.summary: Kabir comes up with a plan to unmask Harshad's true face in front of his band. He partially succeeds. But he also ends up losing trust on one of his own band member.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Secret
episodesList.summary: Manik feels betrayed as Dhruv and Alya had kept a huge secret from him. Harshad tries to defend himself in front of his band. The band members are not convinced that easily.

episodesList.title: Broken Bonds
episodesList.summary: Manik breaks up with Alya. Dhruv breaks his friendship with Nandini in order to secure his friendship with Manik. Dhruv and Manik try to bond.

episodesList.title: Fused Together
episodesList.summary: Raghav makes performing difficult for the band members by asking them to play classical Indian fusion. He also interchanges the members of the two bands.

episodesList.title: Big Bullies
episodesList.summary: FAB5 continue to bully Nandini. In the process, they end up hurting her. Dhruv turns out to be the only one mature amongst the arrogant five. He and Nandini become good friends.

episodesList.title: Competitive Spirit
episodesList.summary: Harshad calls Navya and Nandini to practise for the competition at his house. Alya calls FAB5 to her home to party. Manik wants Alya to stay away from him until the competition is over.

episodesList.title: Stranger Than Fiction
episodesList.summary: Manik overhears Kabir telling Rose to maintain the secret that she's not his girlfriend. Kabir tells the truth. Kabir evades. Both NH3 and FAB5 prepare for a face-off with music.

episodesList.title: Last Minute Letdowns
episodesList.summary: Nandini's last-minute persuation gives Navya the impetus to sing in the competition. Manik vanishes moments before his performance as he had to tend to Rishabh who suffers a panic attack at S.P.A.C.E.

episodesList.title: Letting It Be
episodesList.summary: Manik stays with Rishabh at the hospital. He performs for FAB5 through his phone. The judges declare NH3 as winners. Dhruv and Manik tide over the minor differences in their friendship.

episodesList.title: Best Kept Secrets
episodesList.summary: Manik did not forget Kabir's well-kept secret. He asks Kabir to share it. Manik also threatens Nandini to never tell anyone why he couldn't come to the competition. Navya has a crush on Harshad.

episodesList.title: Out Of Reach
episodesList.summary: Manik hides Nandini in his house to avoid his band members discovering her. The band members pour in one by one. Navya is thinking of ways to advance her relation with Harshad.

episodesList.title: Sneaking Around
episodesList.summary: With everyone inside the house, Manik tries to sneak Nandini out of his house. She finally manages to exit after every one has passed out. She suggests Manik they should help Rishabh and Dhruv.

episodesList.title: The Glue Of Love
episodesList.summary: Navya tells Nandini she is in love with Harshad. Raghav sir asks all of them to prepare for the upcoming music competition. Manik and Nandini join hands to help Dhruv and Rishabh out.

episodesList.title: Take 2
episodesList.summary: Alya finds that Mukti has started taking drugs again. Manik once again reminds Kabir to talk about his secret to him but he evades it again. Nandini feels attracted to Dhruv but he doesn't reciprocate.

episodesList.title: One Step Behind
episodesList.summary: Navya starts doubting Dhruv and Manik to be gay after she ovearhears their conversation. She tells Nandini about it. NH3 follows every member of FAB5 at every step to know their planning for Musicana.

episodesList.title: Out In Open
episodesList.summary: Nandini tells Manik about Harshad's plan. Manik is shocked to know the truth about Kabir which he had kept secret until now. Manik confronts Kabir who confesses about his sexuality.

episodesList.title: The Right Signs
episodesList.summary: Kabir tells Raghav that Manik knows about him now. Dhruv tries to learn the signs of true love. Nandini and Manik have found love in each other. Alya decides to get Manik back in her life.

episodesList.title: Better Avenues
episodesList.summary: Nandini tells Harshad they should stop following FAB5. Alya encourages Dhruv to confess his love to Nandini. Manik and Nandini come closer to each other every passing day.

episodesList.title: You & I
episodesList.summary: Manik asks Kabir who he is dating. Dhruv tells Manik that he's trying to be friends again with Nandini. This makes Manik feel jealous. Everyone come together and celebrate Raghav's birthday.

episodesList.title: Real Intentions
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Raghav continue to meet secretly. Alya decides to use Dhruv to get Manik back from Nandini. Mukti cautions Navya about Harshad's real intentions.

episodesList.title: Tips & Tricks
episodesList.summary: Alya tutors Dhruv about how to make a girl fall in love with a boy. Nandini can't trace her way back home and stays with Manik. Raghav fears his relation with Kabir will soon be found.

episodesList.title: Manik & Nandini Gets Close
episodesList.summary: Nandini is drunk and tries to kiss Manik who stops her and drops her back home. Harshad guises a woman and meets Navya and lures her with his sweet talk. Mukti is in pain and misses Harshad.

episodesList.title: Kabir & Raghav Are a Couple
episodesList.summary: Manik teases Nandini by telling her that they got intimate while she was drunk. Manik and gang discover that someone spiked the drinks in the party. Nandini is astounded to learn that Raghav is Kabir's boyfriend.

episodesList.title: Sparkling Preparations
episodesList.summary: Nandini tells Manik that Kabir's drink was purposely spiked to know his truth. Manik arranges a special Diwali party where he invites all. Alya preps Dhruv to face Nandini in the party.

episodesList.title: Boy Interrupted
episodesList.summary: Shahid interrupts as Dhruv is about to confess his feelings to Nandini at the party. Kabir is worried about Raghav. Manik tells Nandini that he and Alya have parted.

episodesList.title: Much Too Soon
episodesList.summary: Mukti hides the fact from Alya that she has resorted to taking drugs. Nandini tells Manik that Kabir and Raghav are a pair. Raghav tells Kabir that they're breaking up.

episodesList.title: Ricocheting Feelings
episodesList.summary: Mukti jumps into another relation to get over Harshad. This makes Alya question herself if she will ever forget Manik. Dhruv gets to know that Nandini has made her place in Manik's heart.

episodesList.title: Eyes Spies
episodesList.summary: Manik is enraged by the fact that Raghav dumped Kabir. Harshad spies on Kabir and comes to know of his relation with Raghav. Alya voices her concern about Mukti's drug abuse to Manik.

episodesList.title: Secret Keepers
episodesList.summary: Kabir thanks Nandini for saving a conflict between Manik and Raghav. She assures that she won't share his secret with anyone. Harshad decides to use Kabir's secret to defame FAB5 before Musicana.

episodesList.title: Blind Love
episodesList.summary: Both FAB5 and NH3 put their best feet forward once before Musicana starts. Navya asks Harshad if he really loves her. Dhruv invites Nandini to a special date. She does not know who is behind it.

episodesList.title: Special Efforts
episodesList.summary: Nandini arrives at Dhruv's special date without knowing it's planned by him. Alya fails to talk Mukti out of her drug abuse. Dhruv is getting ready to meet Nandini in the special setting.

episodesList.title: Matter Of Heart
episodesList.summary: Dhruv tells Manik how he feels about Nandini. Kabir and Raghav are filmed by Harshad. Alya loses hope of getting Manik back. The meeting between Dhruv and Nandini fails.

episodesList.title: Odd Obsessions
episodesList.summary: Manik gets obsessed about Nandini after knowing about Dhruv's feelings for her. Harshad prepares to take his revenge on FAB5. He threatens Kabir that he'll play the video during Musicana.

episodesList.title: Show Stoppers
episodesList.summary: Manik pretends that his love for Nandini was not real. He shows that it was his revenge for her. Both NH3 and FAB5 put up a great show on the day of Musicana.

episodesList.title: The Unbreakable
episodesList.summary: Nandini's performance throws NH3 out of Musicana. Dhruv consoles a heartbroken Nandini. Manik's rejection of her makes her even stronger. She tells Manik he can not break her.

episodesList.title: Coming Undone
episodesList.summary: Harshad cuts the rope during Manik's act at Musicana. He is unable to ruin his performance. FAB5 are declared as the winners. Harshad puts Kabir's video on display at Musicana as planned.

episodesList.title: Nyonika Is Criticised By Her Students
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 is dumbstruck to learn that Kabir and Raghav dating. Nyonika gets mad at Raghav for his disgusting act. Nyonika is being criticized by the students for her awful speech to cover up the incident.

episodesList.title: Tipping Over The Edge
episodesList.summary: The hate boiling between Manik and Harshad tips them over the edge. This leads to a violent fight. Nandini's suspicions prove true. She catches the culprit behind the leaked video.

episodesList.title: Abhorrent Action
episodesList.summary: Kabir manages to save his public humiliation at Musicana. Harshad and his men beat Kabir and Raghav outside. Nandini and Manik take Kabir to the hospital. Raghav denies going with them.

episodesList.title: Undying Faith
episodesList.summary: Mukti is shattered due to Harshad's video. She goes to meet him. She confesses her love for him. She believes his innocence. They get closer to each other.

episodesList.title: Battling Envy
episodesList.summary: Navya and Harshad's intimacy takes a heavy toll on Mukti. Manik battles his jealousy in light of Dhruv and Nandini's growing friendship.

episodesList.title: Breaking Down
episodesList.summary: Alya regrets the moments spent with Harshad and cries out hard. Manik calls her and shares the news about Kabir. Kabir's mother learned that he is a gay.

episodesList.title: Sunny Side Up
episodesList.summary: Things finally begin looking up for the FAB5 in the form of an unexpected call, after the recent series of bad news. Kabir tells everyone about the offer they have got from the Q Label productions.

episodesList.title: Unyielding Faith
episodesList.summary: Navya is not able to accept the fact that Harshad purposely played Kabir and Raghav's intimate video. She thinks Harshad played it mistakenly. Navya is upset.

episodesList.title: Undesirable Offerings
episodesList.summary: Dhruv's proposal comes as a shock to Nandini. It makes her remember how Manik destroyed the feeling of love for her. Nandini is upset over Dhruv's proposal.

episodesList.title: Despicable He
episodesList.summary: Manik attacks Harshad chilli powder. He then ties and drops Harshad in the water tank to die. Nandini saves Harshad. Everyone is shocked by Manik's despicable act.

episodesList.title: Alternate Routes
episodesList.summary: FAB5 think of a plan to teach Harshad a lesson for what he did to Kabir. Nandini intervenes and suggests a plan. No one, except Manik, likes her idea.

episodesList.title: Complicated Much ?
episodesList.summary: Nandini's plan is in motion. Harshad has taken the bait. Things become complicated when Harshad comes up with his own plan to teach Manik a lesson.

episodesList.title: Two Sided Problems
episodesList.summary: Harshad did everything according to the plan that Nandini had hatched. She is now into deep trouble as Nandini has to manipulate Harshad from two sides.

episodesList.title: Players Get Played
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini pretend to have fallen in Harshad's trap. In reality, Harshad is the one who is being played. Harshad is unaware of Nandini and Manik's plan.

episodesList.title: Unrequited Feelings
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik spend the night in the forest. Alya accepts that she is responsible for her breakup with Manik. Dhruv and Alya kiss. Manik accepts the truth about leaving Nandini. Dhruv consoles Nandini.

episodesList.title: Dropping Off
episodesList.summary: Manik asks Dhruv to leave the spot as Harshad might see them together. Harshad sends Navya to Manik and Nandini. Kabir's mother drugs him to sleep. Manik drops Nandini and Navya to the hostel. Nandini asks Harshad about his further plan.

episodesList.title: Changing Perspectives
episodesList.summary: Navya asks Nandini about how she befriended Manik. Navya tells Harshad about Manik asking Nandini to join Fab5. Mukti tells everyone about Kabir's health. Harshad tells Nandini about the changes in the plan.

episodesList.title: Reaching Out
episodesList.summary: Manik tries to apologize to Nandini. Nandini tells Dhruv and others about Harshad's plan. Navya confronts Harshad about their relationship. Manik tries to contact Kabir. Navya calls Nandini.

episodesList.title: A Fair Warning
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Alya try to trap Navya and Harshad with their words respectively. Manik asks Nandini to be careful. Harshad overhears Manik and Nandini's conversation. Kabir's mother takes him to the airport.

episodesList.title: Entrapment
episodesList.summary: Harshad calls Nandini and asks her to come to the drama room. Dhruv, Alya, and Mukti rescue Kabir at the airport. Harshad confronts Nandini about the truth. Harshad traps Manik in the drama room.

episodesList.title: Red Handed
episodesList.summary: Manik asks Nandini to change and run from the drama room. Kabir grabs Harshad's bat. Harshad confesses his crimes which are recorded. Harshad is put into jail for his crimes. Manik and Nandini sign the statement in the police station.

episodesList.title: Getting Together
episodesList.summary: Nandini asks Manik to go to a doctor. Kabir teases Manik about Nandini. Nandini consoles Navya. Fab5 decide to have a celebration for their successful plan. Kabir suggests to invite Nandini over for the party.

episodesList.title: Tell Me More
episodesList.summary: Kabir teases Manik about Nandini. Mukti and Alya talk about Harshad. Navya remembers her moments with Harshad. Manik opens the champagne bottle. Dhruv tells Alya about Nandini's rejection. Manik asks Nandini to confess her feelings.

episodesList.title: First Times
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nandini talk about their respective feelings. Harshad calls Navya to the jail. Nandini asks Dhruv to drop her home. Mukti and Alya talk about Dhruv's kiss. Manik kidnaps Nandini. The principal calls the Fab5 to the office.

episodesList.title: Manik Kidnaps Nandini
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nandini talk about their respective feelings. Harshad calls Navya to the jail. Nandini asks Dhruv to drop her home. Mukti and Alya talk about Dhruv's kiss. Manik kidnaps Nandini. The principal calls the Fab5 to the office.

episodesList.title: Taking Sides
episodesList.summary: Manik tries to woo Nandini into forgiving him. Navya calls Nandini to talk about Harshad. Nandini goes into a room and cries. Kabir calls Manik to tell him about the albums. Navya goes to the police station as a witness for Harshad.

episodesList.title: Not So Easy
episodesList.summary: Manik irritates Nandini to get her to talk to him. Nandini tells Manik the truth about her not forgiving him. Manik gets unconscious and falls down. Kabir goes to meet his mother. Nandini takes Manik to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Sorry Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini informs Dhruv about Manik's condition. Doctor tells Manik's friends about the condition of his hand. Nandini apologizes to an unconscious Manik. Alya calls Manik's mother to inform her about Manik's condition.

episodesList.title: Hard Ground
episodesList.summary: Nandini checks on Manik in the hospital. Manik's mother goes to meet Harshad in the jail. The doctor gives Nandini and her aunt hopes about Rishabh's condition. Manik's mother comes to meet him at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Hapless Corners
episodesList.summary: Manik has a dream about Nandini. Abhimanyu scares Mukti in the children's ward. Navya comes to the hospital to bid Nandini goodbye. Manik is taken for treatment by a specialist. Harshad calls Alya to the jail.

episodesList.title: Four Walls
episodesList.summary: Manik's operation is successful. Manik kicks Dhruv out of the room. Dhruv asks Nandini to go to Manik's room. Kabir's mother tries to convince him into staying with him. Nandini goes to Manik's room and does not find him there.

episodesList.title: Mixed Bag
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik have an argument. Alya goes to the jail to meet Harshad. Nandini's aunt spots Manik in the hospital. Abhimanyu offers to drop Nandini and her family home. Kabir and others plan a welcome for Manik.

episodesList.title: Back With A Bang
episodesList.summary: Nandini's aunt asks him about Manik. Fab5 return with a comeback show. Manik is angry with Abhimanyu. Abhimanyu asks Nandini about her and Manik. Nandini goes to the instrument room to play an instrument.

episodesList.title: Always in Charge
episodesList.summary: Fab5 decide to perform for Mr. Khurana. Nandini is appointed as the volunteer to welcome Mr. Khurana. Mr. Khurana's daughter tries to convince him to give Fab5 another chance. Harshad calls Alya and shares his emotions.

episodesList.title: Between The Family
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Manik talk about the performance. Alya asks Mukti whether Mukti will ever be able to forgive Harshad. Manik and Nandini have a fight. Mukti goes to the rehab. Alya talks to Dhruv about her emotions.

episodesList.title: In The Zone
episodesList.summary: Kabir talks to Nandini about him and Raghav. Manik and Kabir share their emotions. Manik's mother calls Mr. Khurana and asks him to appoint a manager for Fab5. Soha suggests that everyone should party to celebrate.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Bats For Harshad
episodesList.summary: Dhruv asks Manik to forgive Harshad. Soha tries to flirt with Manik in the music library. Mukti is angry with Abhimanyu. Manik tries to make Nandini feel jealous by talking about Soha. Dhruv tries to convince everyone to forgive Harshad.

episodesList.title: The Blame Game
episodesList.summary: Fab5 fights over the Harshad issue. Everyone blames eachother. Nandini shares her feelings with Abhimanyu. Soha goes to Manik's house to surprise him. Nandini reaches Manik's house too out of jealousy.

episodesList.title: Hidden Agendas
episodesList.summary: Manik flirts with Soha as he knows that Nandini is hiding there. Dhruv explains to Alya why Kabir and Mukti are so upset. Manik tries to find Nandini in the house. Nandini texts the Fab5 to come to Manik's house.

episodesList.title: Patching Up
episodesList.summary: Kabir finds Nandini at Manik's house. Fab5 come together and patch up. Fab5 go to the police station to take their case back. Abhimanyu meets Nandini in the college. Nandini does her job as the manager for Fab5.

episodesList.title: Seeds Of Doubt
episodesList.summary: Manik confronts Nandini about the previous night. Alya gives Dhruv a gift. Kabir and Manik talk about Nandini. Manik flirts with Soha to make Nandini jealous. Navya returns to S.P.A.C.E. Nandini gets angry with Manik because of Soha.

episodesList.title: Emotions At Large
episodesList.summary: Nandini gets irritated and calls Manik. Mukti asks Abhimanyu for a date. Kabir misses his mother. Navya goes to the police station to find Harshad. Everyone goes to the party. Kabir teases Nandini about Manik.

episodesList.title: Frenemies
episodesList.summary: Manik comes to know about Nandini's plan. Soha asks Dhruv to call Manik. Kabir covers for him. Manik gets angry with Nandini when she throws the gift out of the window. Harshad comes to the party. Navya and Harshad talk.

episodesList.title: A New Year
episodesList.summary: Soha gets impatient waiting for Manik at the party. Soha tracks down Manik from Kabir's phone. Everyone celebrates New Year. Soha comes to know about Manik and Nandini. Harshad gets tensed about Navya.

episodesList.title: Short Fused
episodesList.summary: Kabir drops Nandini to her house. Harshad apologizes to Navya over the phone. Alya is angry with Harshad for crashing the party. Soha tries to spoil Manik and Nandini's relationship. Nandini thanks Abhimanyu for the arrangements.

episodesList.title: Anger Galore
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik spend some time in the music room. Soha plans a photoshoot for Fab5. Harshad brings Navya to the hospital for examination. Manik and Nandini fight with each other. Manik is angry with Soha.

episodesList.title: Everybody Talks
episodesList.summary: Manik angrily goes away from the photoshoot. Manik and Nandini talk about their problems. Navya reveals the truth about Harshad on a mike. Nandini consoles Navya. Soha plans an accident for Nandini.

episodesList.title: Ups & Downs
episodesList.summary: Alya defends Harshad. Manik saves Nandini from the wire. Manik goes after Harshad for revenge. Abhimanyu flirts with Mukti. Abhimanyu gets sick. Mukti asks Manik about Nandini and him.

episodesList.title: Fair Unfair
episodesList.summary: Manik tells Fab5 that Nandini and he are just trying to be friends. Soha dreams about Manik. The principal expels Navya from the college. Some guys tease Navya about her pregnancy. Abhimanyu asks Mukti out on a date.

episodesList.title: Opening Up
episodesList.summary: Manik and Kabir talk about Nandini. Kabir's mother comes to meet him at the college. Manik comes to Nandini's place. Mukti waits for Abhimanyu but he is in the hospital. Manik opens the gift sent by Soha to Nandini.

episodesList.title: A Friendly Shoulder
episodesList.summary: Nandini tries to calm Manik down after the blast. Alya is upset as Harshad has disappeared. Dhruv consoles Alya. Nandini and Navya talk about Manik. The principal and Nandini make a deal to bring Navya back.

episodesList.title: Off & On
episodesList.summary: Manik asks Nandini to drop the idea of voting. Manik refuses to help Nandini. Dhruv and Alya confess their feelings for each other. Manik complains to Cabir about Nandini's stubbornness.

episodesList.title: Clearing Out Creases
episodesList.summary: Mukti confronts Abhimanyu for not showing up the previous night. Manik and Nandini go to the washroom to get the glue off. Kabir, Nandini and Manik ask Soha to go home. Manik gets in a fight.

episodesList.title: Friends In Need
episodesList.summary: Mukti confronts Abhimanyu for not showing up the previous night. Manik and Nandini go to the washroom to get the glue off. Kabir, Nandini and Manik ask Soha to go home. Manik gets in a fight.

episodesList.title: I Quit!
episodesList.summary: Manik practices his tunes early in the morning. Manik finds an amazing song from Navya's diary. Abhimanyu quits his job as a peon in the college. Mr. Khurana asks Fab5 about the progress of the songs. Nandini quits her job as the manager.

episodesList.title: Tell Tales
episodesList.summary: Manik explains Nandini about getting back her job. The principal calls Nandini to his cabin. Abhimanyu tells Nandini about him leaving the college. Soha tells everyone about her new plan for practicing music.

episodesList.title: Twisted Times
episodesList.summary: Abhimanyu apologizes to Mukti for leaving. Nandini tells Manik about Soha. Nandini learns about Soha's plans. Kabir's mother creates a scene at the college canteen. Fab5 defends Kabir. Soha reaches the farmhouse and imagines Manik there.

episodesList.title: Close Encounters
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets ready to leave for the farmhouse. Nandini runs and gets inside the car. Dhruv almost tells everyone about Alya and him. Navya's roommate gets her back to the hostel. Soha plans to drug Manik.

episodesList.title: Caught In Action
episodesList.summary: Soha's efforts at getting close to Manik is disrupted by Nandini. Alia and Dhruv's moment is destroyed by Mukti. Manik and Nandini have a moment to catch as Soha readies her plan.

episodesList.title: Missed Chances
episodesList.summary: Kabir changes room to allow Manik and Nandini their time but Soha won't give up so easily. With Dhruv's moment lost, Alia and Mukti engage in some tete-a-tete.

episodesList.title: Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: An inebriated Manik narrowly escapes being discovered by Nupur. Soha has her hands on Nandini's earring and becomes uncontrollable when she discovers about Nandini.

episodesList.title: In The Middle
episodesList.summary: Nandini requests Kabir to help her in keep Soha at bay from Manik. Nandini shares Navya's pregnancy concerns. A reserved Trilok Chaurasiya meets his music student, Nandini.

episodesList.title: Taking The Risk
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Mukti plan for some time together during their rehearsals. Navya tells Mukti she wants to keep the baby. Soha's father tells Nandini her closeness to Manik will risk the album.

episodesList.title: Against The Tide
episodesList.summary: Nandini spends time with Manik despite Mr.Khurana's warning. Mukti learns online that Abhimanyu is no more. Navya struggles with her crisis as Kabir is forced out of home by his mother.

episodesList.title: Jagged Paths
episodesList.summary: Nandini is torn between her love and Mr.Khurana's threat. Navya becomes homeless after being thrown out of the hostel. The sudden disappearance of Kabir becomes a cause of worry for the FAB5.

episodesList.title: In A Spot
episodesList.summary: Kabir is about to take the drastic step when Manik saves him. Navya unknowingly checks into Kabir's house and is adament about living there. Mr.Khurana feels cornered after what Manik tells him.

episodesList.title: The Haunting Truth
episodesList.summary: Soha's condition worsens which worries Mr.Khurana. Mystery deepens when Mukti sees Abhimanyu alive but soon learns from Abhimanyu's father the grave truth that'll haunt her for a long time.

episodesList.title: Missing Peace(s)
episodesList.summary: Peace eludes Kabir with his new flatmate around. Trilok tries to discipline an insincere Nandini before FAB5's performance is judged by a surprize jury. Soha too has some plans.

episodesList.title: UnForeseen Obstacles
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 try to resolve their differences before the performance at S.P.A.C.E while Soha's presence at the venue spells trouble. Soha abducts and sedates Nandini for a violent end.

episodesList.title: Quid Pro Quo
episodesList.summary: An unconscious Nandini is rushed to the hospital by Manik, Soha suffers serious burns. Niyonika tells Mr.Khanna she'll keep Soha's secret but in exchange of Manik's arrest.

episodesList.title: Evident Emotions
episodesList.summary: Manik tells Nandini, Mr.Khurana has accused him of Soha's murder and hence he has gone into hiding. Mukti's happiness is evident when she meets Abhimanyu face to face for the first time.

episodesList.title: Treading Thin Ice
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 gets into deep trouble in connection with Manik's disappearance. Abhimanyu tells Mukti the reason behind his feigned death. Nandini resolves to clear Manik's name off the murder.

episodesList.title: At What Cost
episodesList.summary: Niyonika tells Nandini to do what she asks if she wants to save Manik and uses her as a witness. FAB5 is left clueless when Manik is taken away to custody.

episodesList.title: Breaking Barriers
episodesList.summary: While Niyonika's dirty scheme has parted the two lovers for the time being. Mukti enjoys spending her time with an ailing Abhimanyu. Alia and Dhruv resolve their differences.

episodesList.title: Strange Connections
episodesList.summary: While Niyonika's conspiracy and Nandini's testimony distances the two lovers. Two unusual souls, Kabir and Navya, find friends in each other on the eve of Valentine's Day.

episodesList.title: Break Down, Break Up
episodesList.summary: Niyonika's plan seems to work for her and against Nandini, as Nandini and Manik become arch nemesis. Manik tells his team that it's over between him and Nandini.

episodesList.title: Nandini Gets Expelled
