episodesList.summary: Nyonika Malhotra succeeds in her plan of separating her son, Manik Malhotra from Nandini Murthy. Meanwhile, at the college, Manik Malhotra fumes at Nandini Murthy when she stops him from humiliating her college friend.

episodesList.title: Manik Breaks Up With Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik's compulsion to obey Niyonika under the trying circumstances brings his monstrous nature back. Niyonika's game is far from over when she gets Nandini expelled from S.P.A.C.E.

episodesList.title: In A New Light
episodesList.summary: Trilok gets to know that Nandini is Kishori Murthy's granddaughter. Manik indulges in self-pity. Trilok agrees to stay back at S.P.A.C.E provided Nandini's expulsion is revoked.

episodesList.title: Turn About
episodesList.summary: While Nandini gets ready to leave S.P.A.C.E, Manik demands Niyonika cancel her expulsion. Navya tells everyone how Manik got Nandini's expulsion cancelled as they gather at Kabir's house.

episodesList.title: Close Yet Far Apart
episodesList.summary: A reunion to celebrate Nandini's return at S.P.A.C.E gives Manik and Nandini to come close once again but Manik's temper throws the party out of gear.

episodesList.title: Stay Or Leave
episodesList.summary: Manik's friends caution Nandini to maintain distance from Manik owing to his anger. Manik's state is a concern for Mukti and Abhimanyu too. Alia decides to get Dhruv back in her life.

episodesList.title: Chinese Whispers
episodesList.summary: Manik makes it clear to Nandini that there's hope for the both of them if they sing together at the fusion concert. Alia fails to convince Dhruv about her love for him.

episodesList.title: A Convincing Claim
episodesList.summary: Manik makes it clear to Nandini that there's hope for the both of them if they sing together at the fusion concert. Alia fails to convince Dhruv about her love for him.

episodesList.title: Can't Help It
episodesList.summary: Kabir plans to escape Navya's responsibility by calling her mother to Mumbai and peps himself up for his first day on the job. Abhimanyu's condition jolts Mukti, who can't hide her helplessness.

episodesList.title: Sinking It In
episodesList.summary: RJ Kabir is in high spirits and energy on his first day at job but when the news about Abhimanyu's terminal condition sinks in, everyone is left in a sombre state.

episodesList.title: Play Along
episodesList.summary: Manik calls up Nandini's aunt and informs her that he is very sick so as to lure Nandini into playing Holi with him. Meanwhile, Alya's manager makes her work along with Dhruv.

episodesList.title: Colorful Ideas
episodesList.summary: Mukti is with Abhimanyu at the hospital but he doesn't want her to be with him as he wants her to enjoy Holi. For the evening, Mukti's friends plan a surprise for her.

episodesList.title: Unraveling The Future
episodesList.summary: Nyonika comes up with a plan to make Manik jealous. At the party, when Alya tries to apologise to Dhruv, one thing leads to another and they share an intimate moment.

episodesList.title: SmokeScreen
episodesList.summary: Under the influence of cannabis, Dhruv shows his insecurity towards Manik. The next day at the college, Manik tries to hinder Nandini's practice session with Professor Pandit.

episodesList.title: Dream & Nightmares
episodesList.summary: Nandini surprises Manik with a terrace decorated with lightings all over for star gazing. Navya meets her mother in the college, out of panic, she tells her that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Manik's Place In The Concert
episodesList.summary: Nandini asks Manik to apologise to Professor Pandit. The professor requests Nyonika to ban Manik form the college festival. FAB5 on the other hand plans for a private party in the college.

episodesList.title: Spill The Beans
episodesList.summary: A changed Mukti shocks the FAB5 out of their senses when she walks in with a stranger, Rocky, instead of Abhimanyu. Low self-esteem compels Dhruv to spill his bitterness on Manik.

episodesList.title: Cross Conections
episodesList.summary: Dhruv's outburst shatters Manik but Nandini stands rock steady by him. Abhimanyu's disappearance makes Mukti care less about anything other then her idea of fun. Manik tries to connect with Dhruv.

episodesList.title: Sudden Changes
episodesList.summary: Trilok uses the rift between Dhruv and Manik to drop Manik from the fusion concert. Nandini is surprised to find a changed Dhruv and not the friend she knew earlier.

episodesList.title: Growing Apart
episodesList.summary: Dhruv's growing indifference for his friends worries Nandini. For the concert, Trilok finds bringing Dhruv and Nandini together a challange. Mukti is a cause of concern too.

episodesList.title: To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Manik and his friends comes to rescue Mukti from Rocky and his group. Dhruv prefers to stay away when the rest of the group come together. Manik has a plan to get back at the concert.

episodesList.title: Bad Influences
episodesList.summary: Manik and Kabir executes their joint plan to change Dhruv's mind. Rocky brings his influences to S.P.A.C.E to take revenge from Mukti and humiliates her.

episodesList.title: Gone Forever
episodesList.summary: Manik decides to make Rocky pay for Mukti's humiliation and Nandini takes the initiative to form the plan. The FAB5 are faced with a rude shock when nothing seems to bring the old Dhruv back.

episodesList.title: Lean On Me
episodesList.summary: Kabir kicks off their campaign to support Mukti on the radio station but is shocked to know, Navya's mother wants to get him married to her daughter. Nandini's chances at the concert hangs in limbo.

episodesList.title: Catching Cons
episodesList.summary: While the rest put efforts for the campaign, Dhruv doesn't participate. Rocky and Suraj takes the bait and FAB5 films their actions. The campaign finds voice in the support of a special person.

episodesList.title: On The Bright Side
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 feels assured with the success of their campaign. Niyonika discovers Nandini and Manik are back together. Manik, clever from experience, decides to sheild Nandini from Niyonika now.

episodesList.title: Venerable Vows
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik vouch to have no misunderstandings between them anymore. Kabir and Navya are unclear in the midst of their mothers' expectations. Manik plans again to bring Dhruv back to FAB5.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Interrupts Manik & Trilok's Altercation
episodesList.summary: Manik is shocked to see Nandini unconscious in a smoke filled room, alongside Trilok. Manik tries to attack Trilok, but Dhruv interrupts the fight. Later, Nyonika tells Trilok to be close to Nandini.

episodesList.title: Behind The Masks
episodesList.summary: Nandini finds out from her grandma that Trilok was her student. Nandini practises music with Dhruv and then meets Manik. Kabir is disguised as an old man and meets Dhruv. Dhruv is still angry with him.

episodesList.title: Unhappy Endings
episodesList.summary: Manik is sad as he is not able to make Dhruv understand. Nandini consoles him. Mukti misses Abhimanyu a lot. Manik and Nandini try to reconcile friendship with Dhruv but they end up fighting.

episodesList.title: Unsure Territory
episodesList.summary: Manik worries that he'll never be able to be friends with Dhruv again. Nandini takes Trilok home to meet her aunt and uncle. Dhruv tells Aliya that Manik had left Nandini for him. Aliya is shocked.

episodesList.title: Tensed Liasons
episodesList.summary: Manik is angry with Nandini. Nandini's aunt finds Manik outside the house and invites him inside. Navya's mother questions Sunny. There is tension between Manik and Panditji at Nandini's house.

episodesList.title: Indecent Exposure
episodesList.summary: Manik finds out Trilok is at Nandini's place and that she has lied to him. Trilok calls up Nandini's grandma and says that her attention is diverted. Manik tries to expose Trilok in front of Nandini.

episodesList.title: Un-Dead Ends
episodesList.summary: Kabir tells Mukti and Alya that Dhruv is not ready to understand. Sunny meets Navya at the college. Panditji gifts a chain to Nandini. Manik is worried about Nyonika creating problems.

episodesList.title: Information Overload
episodesList.summary: Nandini asks Dhruv to be friends with Manik again but he refuses. Trilok over hears their conversation. Manik tells Nandini that he found out that Trilok is at her home from his mother.

episodesList.title: For The Worse
episodesList.summary: Dhruv insults Nandini in front of everyone. Manik thrashes him and this worsens the situation. Nandini's grandma witnesses all that. Nandini's grandma sees Nandini and Manik together and is furious.

episodesList.title: A Spectrum Of Woes
episodesList.summary: Nandini introduces Manik to her grandma. She is against her relationship with Manik. Manik with the help of Mukti plans to expose Trilok. Nandini is worried because of her aunt.

episodesList.title: Forced Measures
episodesList.summary: Kabir's mother goes at Navya's place to meet her. Nandini sneaks out of the house to meet Manik but her grandma finds out. Trilok is happy to see Manik and Nandini apart.

episodesList.title: Where's The Way Out ?
episodesList.summary: Nandini's grandma is upset with her and goes back to Mangalore. Navya's parents fix up her marriage with Sunny. Principal informs Kabir and Mukti about their performance.

episodesList.title: Emran Hasmi's Sweet Surprise
episodesList.summary: Nandini is about to confess her feelings for Manik. Dhruv performs at the Fusion concert. Nyonika comes to know about Manik's and Nandini's relationship. Emraan Hashmi is the chief guest.

episodesList.title: Missed Connections
episodesList.summary: Panditji bribes the goons to beat Manik. Alya and Mukti discuss that Nandini has affected Manik. Nyonika confronts Manik about the truth. Manik tries to talk and apologize to Dhruv.

episodesList.title: Peace Out
episodesList.summary: Manik tells Nandini that he has made peace with Dhruv's behavior. Navya tells Kabir about her mother's plans. Mukti tells Manik that Nandini has planned a surprise for him in the basement.

episodesList.title: Manik Gets Attacked
episodesList.summary: Manik is being beaten up by goons and Dhruv and Harshad help Manik.

episodesList.title: Manik & Nandini Sings
episodesList.summary: Manik asks Trilok if knows who Riddhima is and insists to tell him the name of the couple who will sing. Trilok declares that Manik and Nandini would perform the song.

episodesList.title: Riddhima Feels Manik Was Right
episodesList.summary: Riddhima feels that Manik was right and that she shouldn't be afraid of her past and let it slip into oblivion. Pandit asks Riddhima if she spoke to anyone about him. Riddhima tells him that they need to talk.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Takes Manik's Case
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 take Manik's case. Manik meets Nandini who has planned a surprise for him.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Failed Plan
episodesList.summary: Nandini's plan to surprise Manik flops miserably after which he expresses his love for her.

episodesList.title: Nandini Accepts Manik's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Nandini accepts Manik's proposal. On the other hand Kabir tells Navya that he is going to marry her.

episodesList.title: Nandini Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Nandini has gone missing and Manik looks for her. FAB5 calls the police. It is revealed that Prof Pandit has kidnapped her.

episodesList.title: Prof Pandit's Evil Intentions
episodesList.summary: Manik blackmails Nyonika into helping him. Kabir and Navya find Riddhima who tells them about Prof Pandit's evil intentions.

episodesList.title: Prof. Pandit Kidnaps Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik saves Nandini from Prof Pandit's clutches, but she suffers a great shock. FAB5 and Navya inform Nandini's family about the same.

episodesList.title: Manik Consoles Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik attempts to help Nandini heal after her traumatic experience with Trilok. Kabir advises him to use caution. Harshad feels happy to learn about Nandini. Manik talks to Nandini's parents.

episodesList.title: Trilok Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Manik continues to console Nandini after her ordeal. Dhruv discovers a disturbing connection with Rishabh. Later, Nandini's parents go to the police station to complain against Trilok.

episodesList.title: Riddhima's Double Cross
episodesList.summary: Riddhima turns her back on Manik and Nandini at the police station. Prof Pandit asks for proof, Manik gets Aryaman to support him.

episodesList.title: Nandini Vists College
episodesList.summary: Nandini resolves to forget the past to return to her daily routine and college. Harshad criticises Nyonika's sympathy for Nandini and tells her to stop pretending. Nandini feels sad.

episodesList.title: Kabir Declares Marrying Navya
episodesList.summary: Navya confronts both her and Kabir's mother. To shut them up, Kabir declares marrying Navya.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Insecurity
episodesList.summary: Dhruv feels insecure as Aryaman tries to get close to Alya. Harshad tries to manipulate Mukti and Alya's thoughts.

episodesList.title: Dhruv's Strange Connection
episodesList.summary: Dhruv gets a strange feeling whenever he's around Nandini's brother. Kabir suggests Navya to put her child for adoption.

episodesList.title: Harshad Tries Wining Navya
episodesList.summary: Harshad tries winning Navya back. Dhruv helps his friends to let off some steam. Later, he tells him that he is going out of town.

episodesList.title: Aryaman Tries To Impress Alya
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini protect Navya from Harshad. Aryaman tries to make an impression on Alya.

episodesList.title: Aryaman & Harshad Purana Rishta
episodesList.summary: FAB5 uses music to help Nandini get rid of her trauma. Aryaman and Harshad turn out to be childhood friends who want to destroy FAB5.

episodesList.title: Mukti Talks About Navya's Child's Future
episodesList.summary: Manik arranges for a classical workshop in Mangalore as he learns that Nandini is going to the same place. Mukti talks to Navya about her unborn child's future.

episodesList.title: Anything For Love
episodesList.summary: Nandini learns that Manik has followed her to Mangalore. Manik tries different ways to get Nandini's attention.

episodesList.title: Manik's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: The trip faces a roadblock so the gang looks for a place to stay. Finding Harshad in the same hotel and shortages of rooms, Manik decides to share a room with him.

episodesList.title: Nandini Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Nandini tries to lead a normal life, but her trauma grips her and she experiences a nervous breakdown.

episodesList.title: The Pool Party
episodesList.summary: Manik argues with Nandini about the distances being generated in their relationship. Later, everyone gathers around the pool. Friction escalates between the FAB5 and Harshad.

episodesList.title: Harshad Trap For Kabir
episodesList.summary: Harshad tricks Manik and Nandini to go to her room as he fakes drowning. It is later revealed that it was his plot to trap Kabir.

episodesList.title: Manik's Attempt To Convince Amma
episodesList.summary: Nandini's grandmother decides to cancel the course as she sees Manik at her hotel. Later, he convinces her to resume the workshop.

episodesList.title: Harshad Insecure About Alya
episodesList.summary: Kabir gives relationship tips to Manik and Nandini tries getting answers from him. Later, Harshad asks Aryaman to stay away from his sister.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Grandmother Punishes Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini's grandmother punishes Manik for being late. Nandini learns that her grandmother has locked Manik and helps him with his punishment.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Horrifying Recall
episodesList.summary: Nandini's grandmother talks to Nandini and reminds her of the incident with Prof Pandit.

episodesList.title: Manik Plans To Help Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini's grandmother come up with a plan to help Nandini get better. Harshad finds Manik's phone and uses it as a medium to cause damage to FAB5.

episodesList.title: Kabir Gets Violent With Harshad
episodesList.summary: Nandini's grandmother feels good when Nandini plays Sitar. Kabir gets violent and Harshad blames the FAB5 for the mess.

episodesList.title: It's Bad Day For Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini finds Manik in an unconscious state. Kabir blames Manik for his insensitive games.

episodesList.title: Manik's Suprise Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Kabir decides to talk with Raghav. Kabir also talks about it with Manik. Nandini surprises Manik with a birthday party.

episodesList.title: Nandini Loves Manik
episodesList.summary: Manik is looking through the telescope when suddenly Nandini confesses that she loves him. She gifts him a heart shaped box. When asked by Manik, Nandini accepts that she loves him.

episodesList.title: Manik & Nandini Spend The Night
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini spend the night together on Nandini's birthday. Later, Mukti clicks a picture of Harshad while he was sleeping.

episodesList.title: It's Official For Manik & Nandini!
episodesList.summary: Its officially declared that Manik and Nandini are dating. Manik visits Harshad and they quarrel. Later, Manik and Kabir have made plans to spoil Harshad's plan.

episodesList.title: Aryman Learns The Truth About Harshad
episodesList.summary: Aryaman overhears the FAB5's plan but asks them to trust him. He later gets to know about Harshad and Mukti's past from Alya. He is upset to know Harshad's bad side.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Expose Harshad
episodesList.summary: The FAB5, excluding Manik, expose Harshad in front of Guruma who punishes him. Later, Manik appears in traditional attire that astonishes Nandini.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Performs For Nandini
episodesList.summary: Alya catches Harshad making someone else clean the stable and gets angry. The FAB5 perform for Nandini and Guruma praises them.

episodesList.title: Will Manik Survive ?
episodesList.summary: Maniks falls unconscious and Nyonika flies him down to a reputed hospital. She prohibits the entry of his friends, but Nandini gets into Manik's room to see him.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Split
episodesList.summary: The Talent Hunt announcement is made at the college and the FAB5 are unhappy that they are not together.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Shocking Secret
episodesList.summary: Kabir stumbles upon a shocking secret that could potentially blow Aryaman's cover.

episodesList.title: Kabir Gets Fired
episodesList.summary: Navya confronts the radio station producer for firing Kabir from the job because he is gay. Later, Nyonika gets furious at Nandini for sharing information with the media.

episodesList.title: Harshad & Mukti's Face Off
episodesList.summary: Despite Nyonika's open disapproval, Nandini goes to great lengths to be by Manik's side once he regains consciousness, while Mukti boldly faces off with Harshad.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Deadly Strike Against Manik
episodesList.summary: Fuelled by his desire for revenge, Aryaman makes a deadly strike against Manik in the hospital in order to defeat FAB5 and win the talent hunt.

episodesList.title: Stay By My Side
episodesList.summary: Manik convinces Nandini to stay by his side at the hospital despite her misgivings while Mukti attempts to help Alya sort out her love life.

episodesList.title: Manik's Life In Danger
episodesList.summary: Manik spends quality time with Nandini and his friends unaware of the fact that a deadly plot is being hatched against him that could put his life in danger.

episodesList.title: Manik's Being Treated
episodesList.summary: Aryaman informs Harshad about the tracking chip he has implanted on Manik.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Jam Session
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 have a jam session together. Mukti tries to get the facts which Harshad is hiding.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Plan Gets Bumped Off
episodesList.summary: Manik is at college and Aryaman has planned to remind him the death of his sister. Aryaman's plan gets bumped off as Nandini walks closer to Manik.

episodesList.title: Truth Behind Soha's Death Revealed!
episodesList.summary: Nandini tells Aryaman the truth behind Soha's fatal death. Nyonika orders the principal to keep the FAB5 away from the competition.

episodesList.title: Manik Defends Nandini
episodesList.summary: Aryaman and Manik try to damage each other's confidence but Manik defends Nandini's honour.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Performs At Bar
episodesList.summary: Harshad provokes Aryaman against Manik. To help increase his self-respect Dhruv performs at a bar. Meanwhile, Aryaman finds something shocking at Manik's house.

episodesList.title: Nandini Helps Injured Manik
episodesList.summary: Harshad stops Mukti from contacting Dhruv at the bar. Nandini helps Manik remove the glass piece from his back.

episodesList.title: Hidden From Sight
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik spend some romantic time together. Mukti asks Harshad about Aryaman. Alya is scared as she imagines food around her. Harshad tells Aryaman about Soha's photo in Manik's room.

episodesList.title: All In Day's Work
episodesList.summary: Nandini talks to Navya about previous night. Kabir pranks Manik by making a mike announcement. Nandini makes a deal with Aryaman for proving Manik innocent. Alya faints and falls down.

episodesList.title: Unfinished Business
episodesList.summary: Harshad takes Alya home after she regains consciousness. Aryaman asks Nandini to bring Manik to the construction site. Nandini and Manik checkout the construction site.

episodesList.title: In Your Face
episodesList.summary: Nandini brings Manik to the spot planned. Dhruv catches Alya eating chocolates in the kitchen. Harshad and Manik come face to face with each other after the attack. Nandini confronts Aryaman about the attack.

episodesList.title: Point Ends
episodesList.summary: Manik goes to Alya's house to confront Mukti. Manik tells Nandini to withdraw her name from the competition. Navya comes to know about the disqualification. She confronts Nandini for the same.

episodesList.title: Feuding Friends
episodesList.summary: Manik apologizes to Nandini for his rude behavior earlier. They then argue over Nandini's decision. Aryaman hurts his hand because of Manik. Alya has a stress burst on Dhruv. Nandini consoles Manik.

episodesList.title: Hand in Hand
episodesList.summary: Aryaman tells Nandini about him not performing at the talent hunt. Manik and Nandini spend some romantic time together. Navya applies a home remedy to Aryaman's injured hand.

episodesList.title: Alya Wants To Quit
episodesList.summary: Manik plans a surprise for Fab5. Everyone tries to cheer Alya. Alya has another stress burst and decides to leave Fab5. Aryaman tricks Nandini into thinking that he just wants to be a friend.

episodesList.title: All Will Be Well
episodesList.summary: Kabir tries to be optimistic about Alya's stress burst. Dhruv also leaves Fab5. Manik is in a shock. Kabir and Mukti try to talk to Manik. Kabir and Mukti tell Nandini that everything is fine.

episodesList.title: Here & There
episodesList.summary: Manik tells Nandini that he cannot share his problem with her. Kabir follows Dhruv to the club. Alya thinks about her time with Fab5. Nandini takes Aryaman to the doctor.

episodesList.title: Things That Matter
episodesList.summary: Dhruv gets ready to perform in the club. Nyonika spies on Aryaman. Manik feels emotional due to the fight. Nandini stays back with Aryaman at the hospital. Manik reaches the hospital.

episodesList.title: Domino Effect
episodesList.summary: Aryaman's plan fails. Kabir comes to Dhruv's rescue at the club. Mukti tries to talk to Alya about Fab5. Kabir also tries to do the same. Manik comes to know the truth about Aryaman.

episodesList.title: Truth Prevails
episodesList.summary: Manik catches Nyonika and Harshad together in the bed. Kabir tells Navya about Dhruv's decision. Kabir and Mukti find the truth about the club. Manik reveals the truth about Soha to Aryaman.

episodesList.title: Sharing Is Caring
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Mukti go to the airport to reveal Harshad's plan to Dhruv. Nandini tries to console Manik. Kabir shares his feelings with Navya. Harshad goes to meet Mukti.

episodesList.title: Wishful Thinking
episodesList.summary: Manik wishes Nandini goodluck for the competition. Nandini prays to god for Fab5. Badshah comes and performs. Aryaman apologizes to Manik for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Getting It Right
episodesList.summary: Nandini, Navya, and Aryaman perform in the talent hunt. Everyone is excited about Fab5's performance. Fab5 have an argument again. Manik tries to explain how important this competition is for them.

episodesList.title: Spoilt Sport
episodesList.summary: Fab5 go on the stage and perform. Harshad tries to spoil Fab5's performance. Fab5 win the talent hunt. Aryaman invites everyone to his home for a party. Nyonika and Aryaman have a conversation.

episodesList.title: Up To The Test
episodesList.summary: Dhruv comes to Nandini's house to apologize to her. Rishabh has an attack once again. Dhruv explains about Rishabh's condition. Navya and Kabir interview parents for the adoption of the baby.

episodesList.title: Sorry Seems To Be The Hardest Word
episodesList.summary: Kabir's mother comes to meet him and apologize. Dhruv comes and apologizes to everyone. Manik and Nandini spend romantic time with each other.

episodesList.title: Getting Together
episodesList.summary: Dhruv apologizes to everyone. Nandini remember her moments with Manik. Alya goes to Aryaman's house to help him. Manik and Kabir reach Aryaman's house for the party.

episodesList.title: The Big Bang
episodesList.summary: Nyonika asks the driver about Nandini. Navya, Kabir and Mukti reach the party. Aryaman apologizes to everyone. Nandini tells Rishabh about the party. Kabir and Manik get into an accident. The car blasts.

episodesList.title: Manik's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Navya is doing great at her job but her boss is not happy with her. Nandini sends messages to the team mates to inform them about Manik's birthday celebration which puts them in a fix.

episodesList.title: Nandini Wants Reunion Of Friends
episodesList.summary: Manik's birthday celebration is Nandini's attempt to reunite the FAB5. Harshad burns down the bribe offered by Nyonika. Nandini plays a prank in order to make Mukti, Navya and Alya attend the party.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Enemy, Maddy Enters
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 is shocked to hear Maddy playing Manik's favourite tune. Next day on the 'Rakshabandhan' festival, Alya doesn't tie the band on Harshad's hand as she's disgusted by his deeds.

episodesList.title: Mukti Wants To Thrash Maddy
episodesList.summary: Agitated with Maddy, Mukti decides to hit him with her bike, Nandini stops her. Mukti and Alya convince Maddy to join them in the jam in session. Maddy manages to dodge them.

episodesList.title: Space Academy Presidential Election
episodesList.summary: Harshad and Nandini are announced as the candidates for the President's post. Maddy tries convincing Nyonika to let him contest. Harshad blackmails Nyonika to make him the President.

episodesList.title: Maddy Is Threat To Nandini
episodesList.summary: Maddy loses the first competition to Nandini. Mukti takes all her frustration out on little Abeer. Dhruv is ready with a song but is upset with his team mates for not supporting him.

episodesList.title: Presidental Elections Commence
episodesList.summary: Manik, Mukti, and Alya console each other. Navya gives Sahil the permission to spend some time with Abeer. Harshad makes Alya realise her feelings for Varun.

episodesList.title: Nandini Challenges Maddy
episodesList.summary: Nandini asks Maddy to put cow dung on his face if she wins the elections.

episodesList.title: Rebellious Mukti
episodesList.summary: Dhruv informs his friends that FAB5 has been banned from O2. Mukti rebels against her owner's conventional thoughts.

episodesList.title: Harshad Conspires Against Maddy
episodesList.summary: Harshad deletes Maddy's records from the data room to pull him out of election and Nandini finds his records.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Wants Alya's Support
episodesList.summary: The election results are going to be announced in Space Academy, Dhruv wants Alya to motivate him to dance.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Attempt To Reunite FAB5
episodesList.summary: Nandini tries to reunite the team FAB5 for the Talent Hunt being held in the Academy, but fails. She recalls her passion for music and takes part in the competition.

episodesList.title: Maddy Torment's Nandini
episodesList.summary: Maddy stops his performance after he notices Ustaad Mukesh; he is invited by Nandini. Maddy torments Nandini by singing Manik's song.

episodesList.title: Maddy Locks Nandini
episodesList.summary: Maddy locks Nandini up in the music room and leaves. Her friends rescue her and try really to cheer her up.

episodesList.title: Rishabh Starts Speaking
episodesList.summary: Nandini figures out that Rishabh is with Maddy and she rushes to Maddy's house. Maddy's song makes Rishabh speak which overwhelms Nandini. The secretary helps Navya and Mukti cure Abeer.

episodesList.title: Nandini Delcared As President Of Space Academy
episodesList.summary: Nandini wins the Presidential elections of Space Academy. After much partying, the Fab Five get a note from the society asking them to empty the flat. The next day, Nandini hears Nyonika talking about the Fab Five being warned and not banned.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Gets Banned
episodesList.summary: Nandini is informed that FAB5 has been banned by Nyonika. Mukti decides to apply for Abeer's adoption.

episodesList.title: Navya Upset With Mukti Over Adoption
episodesList.summary: Navya is upset with Mukti for having posted an advertisement for Abeer's adoption.

episodesList.title: Nyonika Suspends Nandini
episodesList.summary: The cops visit Mukti and Navya for the interrogation related to Abeer. Nandini and Aryaman finds the details of the driver.

episodesList.title: Mukti & Navya Saved From Cops
episodesList.summary: The driver escapes before Nandini and Aryaman find him. The society chairman saves Mukti and Navya from the cops and reminds them that they need to vacate the house.

episodesList.title: Maddy Saves Nandini
episodesList.summary: Maddy saves Nandini from an accident, Nyonika threatens Harshad for his involvement. Dhruv explains to his friends that the Band's success was Manik's dream.

episodesList.title: Harshad At His Best
episodesList.summary: Nandini is informed that O2 wants FAB5 to perform. Harshad creates misunderstanding between the team mates by accusing Aryaman for the blast.

episodesList.title: Aryaman Held Responsible For Blast
episodesList.summary: All the evidence are against Aryaman and the teammates have no option but to hold him responsible for the blas.

episodesList.title: Nyonika, The Culprit!
episodesList.summary: Aryaman finds the driver, who reveals that Nyonika paid him to plant the bomb in the car.

episodesList.title: Aryaman Threatens Harshad
episodesList.summary: Nandini is informed that Nyonika resigned from her post, Aryaman threatens Harshad to stay away from Nandini.

episodesList.title: Maddy Interrupts FAB5 Jam Session
episodesList.summary: Their jam-in session is interrupted by Maddy as he informs them that he has allotted the music room to another team for practice.

episodesList.title: FAB5 In Search Of Lead Singer
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 is not allowed to perform without Manik at the O2 recording. The team decides to find their lead singer and find Maddy having the same voice as Manik.

episodesList.title: Maddy Rejects FAB5's Offer
episodesList.summary: Maddy rejects the offer to become the lead singer of FAB5. Nandini reminds him about his promise to support FAB5.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Nasty Comment
episodesList.summary: Navya receives a call for Abeer's adoption. Maddy is restless because Nandini called him an imposter. Nandini finds a band that she gifted to Manik.

episodesList.title: Nandini Break's Down Remembering Manik
episodesList.summary: Ustaad Mukesh asks Maddy to join him in the Kerala trip. Navya hosts the upcoming show of FAB5.

episodesList.title: Manik Has A Look-Alike
episodesList.summary: A guy who looks like Manik is seen listening to FAB5. Maddy is irritated by Ustaad's decision to not let him pursue rock music.

episodesList.title: Maddy Saves FAB5
episodesList.summary: Maddy enters when it's the singer's turn in the performance and saves FAB5. Manik returns and is upset to witness Maddy on the stage.

episodesList.title: Manik Is Alive !
episodesList.summary: Nandini and friends are startled to see Manik playing guitar in the music room, they are ecstatic to see him alive.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Sweet Attempt
episodesList.summary: Maddy taunts his grandfather by telling him about his mind boggling rock music performance. Nandini meets Manik and consoles him.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Finally Reunites
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 team has finally united. Ustaad Mukesh disowns Maddy because he chose rock music over classical music.

episodesList.title: Manik's Jealousy
episodesList.summary: Aryaman offers Maddy to stay with him. The FAB5 is celebrating Manik's return and they think about Kabir. Manik is jealous as Aryaman gets close to Nandini.

episodesList.title: A Wish From The Bucket list
episodesList.summary: During the game, Aryaman's closeness toward Nadini makes Manik jealous. They sneak out from the group and spend some romantic moments together.

episodesList.title: A Business Proposal For Madhyam
episodesList.summary: While Alya, Dhruv, and Mukti are busy discussing their future, Madhyam is approached by a businessman who wants him to sing in one of the upcoming events.

episodesList.title: Maddy Humilates Manik
episodesList.summary: Manik comes to know that Maddy is responsible for Steve's recovery. Maddy replaces Manik's position in the band and humiliates him for it. Meanwhile Mukti convinces Navya to give Abeer up for adoption.

episodesList.title: Madhyam Keeps An Eye On FAB5
episodesList.summary: Madhyam tells Nandini that he will keep an eye on the FAB5. He also accepts the businessman's deal. Navya tests the capability of Sahil and Kiran if they want to adopt Abeer.

episodesList.title: Manik Confronts Maddy For Stealing FAB5's Song
episodesList.summary: Manik gets angry at Maddy for stealing the FAB5's song and Navya agrees to give her baby up for adoption. Later, Manik and Nandini spend some romantic moments together.

episodesList.title: Manik Gets His Band To Perform
episodesList.summary: Bhai questions Alia's passion for music. Meanwhile Manik's influence gets his band the chance to perform at the event.

episodesList.title: Maddy Loses To Manik In Challenge
episodesList.summary: Maddy loses to Manik in the guitar solo challenge. He also offers to perform for free and requests the organizers to cancel their contract with Manik.

episodesList.title: The Stage Fight
episodesList.summary: For his own benefit, the businessman tries to showcase both the performances but unfortunately Maddy and Manik start fighting on the stage.

episodesList.title: Manik's Head Injury
episodesList.summary: The Doctor reveals Manik's injury, this makes the FAB5 and Nandini worried. They decide to take revenge on Maddy. Meanwhile Navya checks the capabilities of Abeer's adoptive parents.

episodesList.title: Revival Of Love On Diwali
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini revive their love on the occasion of Diwali. Meanwhile Maddy refuses to accept Nandini's apology.

episodesList.title: Harshad Becomes President
episodesList.summary: Manik and his friends are shocked at seeing Harshad as the new president of Space Academy. Meanwhile Nandini presents Manik his old guitar as a Diwali gift and asks him to complete the song.

episodesList.title: Nandini & Manik Get Romantic
episodesList.summary: While everyone is celebrating Diwali, Manik and Nandini find a romantic spot to spend the time together. Harshad provokes Aryaman so much that he reveals his love for Nandini.

episodesList.title: Harshad & Manik Talk
episodesList.summary: Harshad challenges Manik for the upcoming Musicana festival. Harshad taunts him that the FAB5 do not have a drummer after Cabir's death. Harshad suggests that Manik add Aaryaman to his band.

episodesList.title: Manik Livid With Nandini Because Of Aryaman
episodesList.summary: Manik is furious at Nandini for showing up late because of Aryaman. Navya is becoming dubious about Sahil and Kiran. FAB5 breaks down while playing Kabir's tune.

episodesList.title: Sahil Spotted With His Boyfriend
episodesList.summary: Manik fulfils one wish from Nandini's bucket list; they notice Sahil hugging a guy inside a car. The guy is Sahil's boyfriend, but Sahil cleverly lies to them.

episodesList.title: Revelation About Sahil
episodesList.summary: Nandini is restless and Manik tells her to relax. Later, they inform Navya that Sahil is gay and that they are concerned about Abhir's future.

episodesList.title: Sahil Has A Boyfriend ?
episodesList.summary: Alya comes with Raima's footage to show it to everyone. Manik informs them that Sahil has a boyfriend and Kiran isn't his wife.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Find Out About Shail & Kiran
episodesList.summary: The FAB5 and Nandini find out about Sahil and Kiran's true colours and realize that Sahil is homosexual. In the meantime, Harshad requests Aryaman to join his band.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Breaks Up With Alya
episodesList.summary: Aaryaman explains to Nandini about his changed behavior towards her. Meanwhile, Dhruv realizes that Alya would be happier with Varun and decides to leave her.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Expresses His Anguish To Alya
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik spend time with a prostitute and make her feel special. Dhruv expresses his anguish to Alya and decides to move on in life. Meanwhile, Manik, Nandini and Mukti console Alya.

episodesList.title: Where Has Dhruv Gone ?
episodesList.summary: hruv has suddenly cut off from everyone and disappeared. FAB5 is shattered by this. They reminisce his memories.

episodesList.title: Kiran Tries To Convince Navya
episodesList.summary: Manik faints recalling something of the accident. Sahil's boyfriend, Kiran meets Navya to convince her. He even calls on her show to ask for a solution.

episodesList.title: Can FAB5 Impress Ustaad Mukesh ?
episodesList.summary: Harshad announces the music mentor of college, Ustaad Mukesh. He announces that there will be a music competition. FAB5 is worried as they are aware that Mukesh hates them.

episodesList.title: FAB5 Face The Challenge Heads On
episodesList.summary:
Everyone but Dhruv decide to stay confident and face the challenge. Mukesh starts with the first Qualifier Round where the students give their solo performances.

What's Up Next?

episodesList.title: Mukti, Manik & Alya Confront Ustaad
episodesList.summary: Ustaad Mukesh got everyone through the first round except Mukti, Manik, and Alya. This agitates them; they go and confront him.

episodesList.title: Nandini Tries To Cool Down Manik
episodesList.summary: Manik hurts himself in anger; Nandini tries to console him. Varun calms Alya down. Mukti and Alya try making Manik realise that they aren't accepting the facts.

episodesList.title: Love Is Blooming
episodesList.summary: Manik, Mukti, and Alya console each other. Navya gives Sahil the permission to spend some time with Abeer. Harshad makes Alya realise her feelings for Varun.

episodesList.title: Competition Time
episodesList.summary: Nandini has been asked to take care of Manik by his doctor. Mukesh decides to hold another competition between the selected candidates.

episodesList.title: Manik Is Prone To Severe Diseases
episodesList.summary:
Ustaad Mukesh isn't happy with the music students. Varun teases Alya as he feels that she's attracted to him. Nandini learns that Manik is prone to Alzheimer or partial Amnesia.

What's Up Next?

episodesList.title: Nandini Is Lost In Curing Manik
episodesList.summary: Nandini hides the truth from Manik and tells him that the stress is making him forget things. Navya motivates Mukti to grab the opportunities coming her way. Ustaad Mukesh scolds Nandini.

episodesList.title: Nandini Is In Fix
episodesList.summary: Nandini is given another chance by Ustaad Mukesh. Navya decides to give Kiran and Sahil a second chance to win her confidence. The doctor informs Nandini that Manik's case is getting complicated.

episodesList.title: Manik Consoles Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik tells Nandini that it shouldn't bother her if someone dislikes her. All the students are given a task to create music with the help of nature. They are restricted from using musical instruments.

episodesList.title: Manik Is Upset About His illness
episodesList.summary: Manik has a rare mental disease. He is losing his memory. As he returns home, Nandini tries cheering him up as she finds him a bit upset.

episodesList.title: Manik Talks About His Condition With Nandini
episodesList.summary: Manik tries explaining to Nandini about the disease from which he is suffering. Ustaad Mukesh sets up a test in the class which qualifies the students for the competition.

episodesList.title: Alya's Face-Off With Varun
episodesList.summary: Nandini and her friends qualify for the 'Music Gana'. Alya confronts Varun about him cheating on her.

episodesList.title: Aryman Shares His Feeling
episodesList.summary: Nandini has arranged a party. Aryaman confesses his feelings for Nandini. Nandini tells everyone that Manik is suffering from partial amnesia.

episodesList.title: Manik & Nandini's Eternal Love Story
episodesList.summary: Revisit the eternal love story of Manik and Nandini. Here's how it all began and flourished into the love story of a lifetime. If anyone gave all of us relationship goals, it was this adorable jodi of Manik and Nandini.

episodesList.title: 'Will You Marry Me?'
episodesList.summary: Here's the moment we've all been waiting for - the most romantic proposal ever! And guess what? It's Nandini taking the lead. Will Manik be swept off his feet?

episodesList.title: Relationship Status: It's complicated
episodesList.summary: From being committed to it's complicated, Nandini and Manik's relationship status has changed dramatically! Will love get another chance?

episodesList.title: Conscious Uncoupling
episodesList.summary: Manik is giving exclusive dating tips to Nandini! Does Manik want to push Nandini away just so he can move on?

episodesList.title: The Date War
episodesList.summary: The war between Nandini and Manik just got real and it's all going down at Mukti's engagement party. Nandini's date? Safe and dependable Smaran. Manik's date? The wild and seductive Inaya!

episodesList.title: Nothing hurts quite like love
episodesList.summary: Memories don't heal what's broken but even 'unfollowing' doesn't confirm a break-up! It's not over till it's really over!

episodesList.title: Love or just hand in glove?
episodesList.summary: It's Mukti's Mehendi ceremony and our bride has come up with the perfect plan to fix #MaNan forever. Will Mukti's ploy work? Will Manik and Nandini finally be able to sort things out?

episodesList.title: Hold me love, one last time
episodesList.summary: No matter how much they try, Manik & Nandini just cannot live without each other. Witness the classic tug of war of MaNan wala love right here.

episodesList.title: Sometimes, love is just not enough
episodesList.summary: Just when we thought that an intimate night might change things between #MaNan, a shocking confession from Manik almost blows their world apart!

episodesList.title: If storms don't last forever, can love?
episodesList.summary: By breaking up, Manik just wanted to protect Nandini. But there is a glimmer of hope on the heartbreak horizon. Is it time for a #MaNan reboot?

episodesList.title: It's raining love
episodesList.summary: While their world crumbles around them, Manik and Nandini are holding on to each other just a little longer! Will this #SizzleInTheDrizzle change things?

episodesList.title: Dream a little dream with me
episodesList.summary: What happens when Manik and Nandini must pretend to be a married couple? Hint: It's the #MaNan feels all over. Watch their love bloom and HOW!

episodesList.title: Truth over love?
episodesList.summary: Nandini is about to drop a bomb on Manik, knowing fully well that she might lose him forever! Can love survive a falsehood?

episodesList.title: Is love in the pyaar, forever?
episodesList.summary: They fought in love, they lost in love, they almost found heaven on earth! Such is the circle of #MaNan love. But the big question still remains - will they have their happily-ever-after?

episodesList.title: Kuch Baaki Hai
episodesList.summary: Two years after promising each other 'hum', Manik and Nandini are distinctly 'main' and 'tum'. But when fate makes their paths cross once more, will they give love another chance?

episodesList.title: Monster! Monster!
episodesList.summary: To defeat the wicked witch Nyonika, Manik is forcing Nandini to stay by his side. Will she give in to his demands? Or will Nandini walk away from Manik once and for all?

episodesList.title: Home Coming
episodesList.summary: Nandini moves in with Manik, but the past still haunts them. Can they find peace or will their shared pain overwhelm them?

episodesList.title: Old Habits
episodesList.summary: Annoyed by Manik's attempts to force her hand, Nandini plans a party to exact her revenge. Is the night headed for a disaster? Or is this the first thaw in the ice between #MaNan?

episodesList.title: Hum Kho Gaye Kaahan
episodesList.summary: Broken dreams leave scars, just like broken glass. Can Manik and Nandini mend their wounds and find solace in each other?

episodesList.title: Sea Glass
episodesList.summary: Delving into Nandini's memories, we learn what had gone wrong between her and Manik seven months ago.

episodesList.title: Hi, New Neighbour!
episodesList.summary: When dealing with Sehar and her baby, Manik reveals a side of him that was previously unknown to even Nandini. Was she wrong about Manik all along?

episodesList.title: Savera Ho Raha
episodesList.summary: Nandini's quest for answers leads her to the place where it had all gone wrong. We finally discover Manik's side of the story.

episodesList.title: Surprise Gone Wrong
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Manik reunite, yearning for a fresh start. But can a special night truly erase their painful past?

episodesList.title: I Am The Monster!
episodesList.summary: Nandini's secret threatens Manik's love. Can their bond withstand the truth she reveals?

episodesList.title: Nyonika Ka Khabri
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini, with their secrets exposed, yearn for a fresh start. But a hidden enemy threatens their future. Can they uncover the spy before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Noor Kaha Hai?
episodesList.summary: Manik takes Noor for her vaccination, hoping it will help Seher concentrate on her music. Will this outing stir painful memories or create new ones for MaNan?

episodesList.title: Teri Meri Roohdaariyaan
episodesList.summary: Harmony reigns in Manik and Nandini's lives, with Musicana approaching. Is this the calm before the storm, or are MaNan's troubles truly over?

episodesList.title: We Are In Deep Trouble
episodesList.summary: SPACE Goa's fate hangs in the balance as Vibe's big night arrives. Manik and Nandini must face their inner demons before they can save the day.

episodesList.title: Secrets And Confessions
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini confront their hidden truths, thanks to Vibe's intervention. But Seher's proposition throws them back into familiar uncertainty.

episodesList.title: The Trinity
episodesList.summary: Manik and Nandini rebuild their shattered dreams, creating a more beautiful future. But can they achieve ultimate happiness together?

title: Kanamachi
summary:
Kanamachi was a Kolkata-Bengali TV series that premiered on 9 June 2014 on the channel Star Jalsha.
The series starred Farhan Imroze and Joyeeta Goswami in lead roles and Anindita Bose, Sudip Mukherjee, Monoj Ojha and Mohua Halder in supporting roles. It was directed by Suman Das and Tamal Maity.
plot:
The series stars a young IPS officer Abhimanyu (Farhan Imroze) and a young girl Kotha (Joyeeta Goswami) from the Robin Hood Gang. The Robin Hood Gang is a team of Seven members led by the Master, Indrajit Roy (Sudip Mukherjee). The squad was formed by the Master specifically to exact severe retribution against particular people from the past, even though it was intended to serve the interests of underprivileged people. Abhi's task was to apprehend the Robin Hood Gang, and by discovering the way to join the squad, he almost succeeds. Abhi, eventually realizes that the team was full of mystery, and his curiosity fastened him to disguise as a member of the team until he is accomplished in revealing the truth that the team members are actually good people with a tragic past and they are not hardcore criminals. Delaying of the arrest sent threat to Abhi from the police department, and finally the order comes to killing all the members of the team. Abhi does not do so – rather he keeps on finding the mystery behind the team. As a result, the department suspends Abhi. In fact, the act of suspending was committed by a Minister.
The Minister, a lawyer (Ramen Shikder) and a doctor (Kamalesh Chatterjee) was once involved in a crime of framing two persons, one was the father of Kotha (Shounak Mitra) and the other was the Master himself. As a matter of fact, Master was an IPS officer who was assigned to investigate the incidents of the Banerjee NGO where secret antisocial activities were being done by the evil minister and the lawyer. Indrajeet tried to expose the real truth behind the conspiracy act against Kotha's father as well, but the three of the master-villain framed him in an act of molestation over a woman, which results in execution. But fortunately Master survives and undergrounds himself for a while and creates the Robin Hood team for retribution.
Abhi tried to help find Kotha's mother, who was lost from her when she was a child. As the case was related of Kotha's father and the Master was the same, Abhi seems to reach to uncover the truth at an astonishing pace. The whole mystery was related to the Banerji NGO. Master tries to scare the three villains by untraceable threat calls, which leads to a thought to the Minister that the whole problem of prank was done by Abhi due to suspending him, consequently trying to kill him. But every time he tries to do so, he fails to accomplish because of Abhi's quick-witted talents. Eventually Doctor Kamalesh, one of the three villains, was killed by the Minister. Furthermore, he killed Jiban Shomaddar (uncle to Kotha), who was the only evidence of the Banerji NGO in Abhi's opinion – later Abhi realizes that that was not the only option. Minister's wishes to kill Abhi and Kotha brings an officer Bhashkor in the series, who constantly attempts to do so for in vain.
Eventually Abhi solves the whole mystery and learns what actually instigated Master to form Team Robinhood. Abhi's paternal aunt, Malabika Banerjee, who was the head of the Banerjee-NGO, along with the Minister, the Lawyer (Ramen) and the dead doctor (Kamalesh) was engaged in trafficking. Sounak Mitra, Kotha's father, had somehow learnt the truth and so the three had caused ample harassment to him – got him arrested on false charges of molestation, following which Sounak had committed suicide. The three had also molested Amrita Das Majumder, a woman working in the NGO. Indrajit Roy (Master), who was then an honest police officer was investigating the case but the minister and his troops had even trapped Indrajit and Indrajit was prosecuted. But Indrajit somehow escaped death and formed team Robinhood in order to punish the Minister and help the common masses. Later we come to know that Master is Abhi's real father and Abinash Mukherjee had saved him before Master's (Back then Indrajeet) house was burned down and adopted him as his own son.
After completing the investigation, Abhi vows to punish the actual criminals and give justice to Master. Master disguises as an old man and visits abinash mukherjee's house where he discovers that Abhi is an IPS officer and he had undercovered himself to be a part of the robinhood gang, an infuriated master returns to his hideout and reveals the truth to the team leaving katha and others heartbroken of abhi's betrayal.Eventually master realizes that they cannot hide anymore and they flee their hideout and go to another one. Master wears his old uniform and prepares the team for a final showdown against the minister and the lawyer. Minister and lawyer are eventually caught on road by the robinhood gang and master holds both his offenders at gun point. Eventually IPS abhimanyu arrives with full police force and asks the gang to surrender but master and the entire team refuses. Abhi convinces the master that killing the minister would make the entire team face death penalty which ofc master doesn't want. Master and the entire team surrenders and Abhi is forced to arrest them and everyone is presented at the court. Meanwhile, Abhi interrogates the team but soon realizes that ramen's life is at stake because minister is about to kill him as ramen's death will remove all evidence against the minister, but Abhi tricks the minister and succeeds to gather evidence against him.In the court the minister and ramen are eventually proven guilty and they get sentenced to lifetime imprisonment. Leela, Kotha's mother, who, after her husband's death, had been forced to take up prostitution, shoots the Minister to death. At the end the entire robinhood gang sentenced to 1 – 2 years of imprisonment for their petty crimes and robberies and Abhi introduces Kotha to her mother.
Kotha, after a year, gets released from the jail, which brings a new plot to the story. While returning to her convent school in Darjeeling, she comes across Anindya and Tanaya. They meet with a car accident and so by twist of fate (in which Tanaya dies), Kotha has to come back to Kolkata as Tojo's (Tanaya's son) governess. There she wins the heart of everyone. In the meantime, Ananya (sister to Tanaya) and Shima (mother to Tanaya) tries to trigger conspiracy on Kotha, but Kotha is intelligent enough to fight back. Meanwhile, Anindo falls for Kotha and wants to marry her, to which Kotha agrees for Tojo's sake, although she loves Abhi. But later, Anindya sacrifices Kotha after realizing her love for Abhi and then, Abhi finally marries Kotha. However, the actual identity of Master, that is, Master or Indrajit Roy is himself Abhi's real father was not revealed to Abhi.

title: Kumkum Bhagya
summary: Kumkum Bhagya (transl. Vermillion in My Fate) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms. It aired from 15 April 2014 to 21 September 2025 on Zee TV and digitally streams on ZEE5. It starred Sriti Jha, Shabir Ahluwalia, Mugdha Chaphekar, Krishna Kaul, Rachi Sharma, Abrar Qazi, Pranali Rathod and Namik Paul in lead roles. One of the longest running Indian television soap opera, the concept of the show was originally based on Jane Austen's novel Sense and Sensibility.
plot:
The series begins with Pragya Arora, a college lecturer, and Abhishek “Abhi” Mehra, a wealthy rock star, whose marriage is arranged through family intervention. Their relationship is initially strained due to manipulations by Abhi’s sister Aliya and his former partner Tanu. The narrative follows repeated misunderstandings, conspiracies, memory-loss incidents, and separations. Despite numerous obstacles, Pragya and Abhi reconcile multiple times. The birth of their twin daughters, Prachi and Rhea, coincides with another major separation, leading to the children being raised apart.
After a twenty-year leap, the story focuses on Prachi Arora and Rhea Mehra, who grow up unaware they are twin sisters. Prachi develops a relationship with Ranbir Kohli, while Rhea’s feelings for him create rivalry. Family interference and concealed truths complicate their lives until the sisters’ true parentage is revealed. Although Abhi and Pragya briefly reunite with their daughters, continued misunderstandings affect the family. Prachi eventually marries Ranbir, but their relationship faces many challenges arising from Ranbir's family, Rhea's obsession for Ranbir and many other misunderstandings.
A further leap introduces Prachi and Ranbir’s daughters, Khushi and Poorvi. Raised in different circumstances due to family conflict, the sisters’ lives unfold amid hidden identities and inherited tensions. Poorvi’s relationship with Rajvansh Malhotra becomes central to this phase. As past grievances resurface, the family once again confronts separation and reconciliation.
Another generational transition introduces new protagonists, including Prarthana Parikh and Shivansh Randhawa, whose lives intersect through family and business alliances connected to earlier characters. Their relationship is shaped by mistrust, rivalry, and concealed motives. While legacy figures appear intermittently, the storyline centres on the younger generation navigating conflicts rooted in the family’s past, continuing the series’ recurring themes of destiny and reunion.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series is a love story produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor under the banner Balaji Telefilms that airs on Zee TV. Ekta Kapoor considers the letter K to be lucky and has named many of her productions starting with K.
Kapoor rejected 19 costumes while selecting the look of character Pragya.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak in India. The outbreak caused the halt of filming of television shows and movies on 19 March 2020, and they were expected to resume on 1 April 2020. But shooting remained suspended and the remaining episodes were aired up to 24 March 2020. After three months, the production and filming of the series resumed on 29 June 2020 and airing resumed on 13 July 2020.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Shabbir Ahluwalia, who was also cast in Ekta's TV series Kayamath, was selected to portray the lead role of Abhishek Prem Mehra. Ahluwalia made his comeback after Zee twenty years. Actress Sriti Jha landed the lead role in the show. while Arjit Taneja was cast opposite her. In May 2014, Shikha Singh entered the show as the main antagonist Alia Mehra, while Madhurima Tuli was cast to portray the negative role of Tanu. Later, Tuli had to shoot for her film Baby so, this role was later played by Leena Jumani from September 2014. Actor Faisal Rashid was selected to portray the role of Suresh (Pragya's fiancé) who played an important role in April–May 2014, but in May 2015 he quit the series. Actress Supriya Shukla was cast to play the role of Sarla Arora, while Madhu Raja played the role of Daljeet Arora. Other supporting cast members include Samikssha Batnagar, Ankit Mohan, Charu Mehra and Amit Dhawan. Bhatnagar, who portrayed the supporting role of Mitali was replaced by Swati Anand within the month of launch while Anurag Sharma replaced Amit. In 2015, Neel Motawani (who was also cast in other shows of Ekta) was selected to play the negative role of Neel; while in June 2015 Nikhil Arya entered the series playing the role of main male antagonist Nikhil Sood.
In December 2015, Mrunal Thakur opted out from the show and was to be replaced by Kajol Shrivastava, however the character of Bulbul was phased out of the series after Mrunal's departure. In August 2016, Ankit Mohan quit the show so his character left as well. In September 2016, Arjit Taneja quit the show and was replaced by Vin Rana. In October 2016, Nikhil Arya was replaced by Rujut Dahiya. In July 2017, actress Ruchi Savarn entered the show as Purab's new love interest. Mishal Raheja as King Singh and Kaurwakee Vashista as Kiara Mehra entered the show after the leap. Actor Abeer Adil was cast in 2018 as King's cousin Tarun and Roma Bali as Tarun's mother.
In March 2019, a twenty-year leap was introduced with which several new characters entered in the show and became pivotal characters. In March 2019, Mugdha Chaphekar, Krishna Kaul and Naina Singh were introduced as leads of the second generation who play Prachi, Ranbir and Rhea respectively alongside Sriti and Shabbir. In August 2020, Naina left the show as she was not happy playing a negative role anymore and Pooja Banerjee replaced Singh as Rhea. In February 2022, Pooja Banerjee quit the show due to her pregnancy, and she was replaced by Tina Ann Philip. In February 2022, Jha and Ahluwalia officially quit the show after seven and half years as the story progressed on from their characters. They had last shot for the show in November 2021.
The show then took another generation leap of twenty years in November 2023, with Rachi Sharma and Abrar Qazi roped in as the new leads of generation three with Sharma portraying Prachi and Ranbir's younger daughter Poorvi Kohli while Qazi as Rajvansh Malhotra respectively.
Simran Budharup was roped in to play grown-up version of Prachi and Ranbir's elder daughter Khushi Kohli Randhawa replacing Trisha Rohatgi who played childhood version of same. Later Budhraup quit the show owing to less screenspace and was replaced by Jyotsna Chandola. Later, Chaphekar and Kaul who portrayed leads of generation two, their role roles came to an indefinite end in June 2024 and in September 2024 media confirmed the news that both are no longer part of the show. In an Interview from 2025, Chaphekar and Kaul said that they weren't aware that their shoot in June 2024 would be their last for show and that they were informed much later that their characters will not be brought back to the show causing the second generation story to end without any conclusion.
In February 2025, the show again took a 20-year generation leap, with Pranali Rathod and Akshay Bindra as new generation leads. However later Bindra's character was sidelined as Supporting character and Namik Paul stepped in as new male lead.
Abrar Qazi and Rachi Sharma and other supporting casts marked their exits due to the generation leap. In March 2025, Rachi Sharma was again roped in to reprise her role of Poorvi Malhotra as a cameo to revive dipping TRPs. She was again roped in for a second appearance in April 2025. Soon after it was also confirmed that Shraddha Arya and Shakti Anand would also be joining Kumkum Bhagya reprising their characters Karan and Preeta from Kundali Bhagya. However soon after their roles also ended and the show eventually went off air in September 2025 owing to low TRPs over a year.

articleSections.title: Kundali Bhagya
articleSections.text: A spin-off series Kundali Bhagya premiered on 12 July 2017 and ran till 6 December 2024. The series narrated the story of Pragya's sisters, Preeta and Srishti and their attempt to find their mother Sarla and how they meet the rich and famous Luthra family. Later that show too took a generation leap and story shifted to Preeta's sons Rajveer and Shaurya.

articleSections.title: Bhagya Lakshmi
articleSections.text: A similar series Bhagya Lakshmi premiered on 3 August 2021 and ran till 29 June 2025. It traces the love story of Pragya's best friend, Lakshmi and Rishi. It stars Aishwarya Khare and Rohit Suchanti.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
Reruns of Kumkum Bhagya premiered on Zee Anmol from 2017 and received high ratings in the BARC rural chart when Zee Anmol was FTA. It began running on the network again from episode 1 from 10 June 2020, due to the return to DD Free Dish.
The show also managed to strike a chord with West Africans too. Actor Kartik Aaryan also watched the show during the lockdown.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
Kumkum Bhagya premiered on 15 April 2014, climbed to Top 5 most-watched shows across all GECs, after only a few weeks of its launch. It was touted as the biggest fiction launch of 2014.
The show topped the TRP chart in week 43 of 2015 with 4.5 points, ahead of Saath Nibhaana Saathiya and Yeh Hai Mohabbatein. By week 11 of 2016, it had slipped to second with 3.8 points, behind Naagin.
Mid-2016 it recorded peak TRPs, led the chart in weeks 28 and 29, and by week 34 had held the top spot for six consecutive weeks. The following week ( Aug– Sep) it drew 12.6 million viewers, up from 12.2 million, still at number one. By week 37 it had topped the chart a seventh time, at 12,636 points. It fell out of the top five the week after. In week 27 of 2017, it got 12,209 impressions at first place. Throughout 2017, it recorded ratings of 2.7, 3.3, 3.4, 3.2 in weeks 35, 37, 38, 52 respectively.
In July 2020, the show occupied second position with 4.9 million impressions. By December 2020, it fell to fifth position with 5,409 impressions. By January 2021, it rose back to fifth with 6,288 impressions.

plotHtml:
The series begins with Pragya Arora, a college lecturer, and Abhishek “Abhi” Mehra, a wealthy rock star, whose marriage is arranged through family intervention. Their relationship is initially strained due to manipulations by Abhi’s sister Aliya and his former partner Tanu. The narrative follows repeated misunderstandings, conspiracies, memory-loss incidents, and separations. Despite numerous obstacles, Pragya and Abhi reconcile multiple times. The birth of their twin daughters, Prachi and Rhea, coincides with another major separation, leading to the children being raised apart.
After a twenty-year leap, the story focuses on Prachi Arora and Rhea Mehra, who grow up unaware they are twin sisters. Prachi develops a relationship with Ranbir Kohli, while Rhea’s feelings for him create rivalry. Family interference and concealed truths complicate their lives until the sisters’ true parentage is revealed. Although Abhi and Pragya briefly reunite with their daughters, continued misunderstandings affect the family. Prachi eventually marries Ranbir, but their relationship faces many challenges arising from Ranbir's family, Rhea's obsession for Ranbir and many other misunderstandings.
A further leap introduces Prachi and Ranbir’s daughters, Khushi and Poorvi. Raised in different circumstances due to family conflict, the sisters’ lives unfold amid hidden identities and inherited tensions. Poorvi’s relationship with Rajvansh Malhotra becomes central to this phase. As past grievances resurface, the family once again confronts separation and reconciliation.
Another generational transition introduces new protagonists, including Prarthana Parikh and Shivansh Randhawa, whose lives intersect through family and business alliances connected to earlier characters. Their relationship is shaped by mistrust, rivalry, and concealed motives. While legacy figures appear intermittently, the storyline centres on the younger generation navigating conflicts rooted in the family’s past, continuing the series’ recurring themes of destiny and reunion.
tagline: The series begins with Pragya Arora, a college lecturer, and Abhishek “Abhi” Mehra, a wealthy rock star, whose marriage is arranged through family intervention.

title: Kalyana Parisu
summary:
Kalyana Parisu (transl. Wedding gift) is a 2014 Indian Tamil-language soap opera that aired on Sun TV.The show was produced by Vision Time India Pvt Ltd and directed by Harish Adhitya. It premiered on 10 February 2014 and ended on 27 March 2020 for 1840 episodes.
The first season focused on Gayathri, Subbulakshmi and Surya, who were married. The second season premiered on 10 September 2018 and ended on 27 March 2020 for 1840 episodes. The second season sequel and next generation story of Kalyana Parisu 1 reflect the lives of Vidhya and Ashok (son of Gayathri).
plot:
;Season 1 This season is a family and triangular love story. Gayathri, Renuka and Subbulakshmi (Subbu) are good friends, but their friendship does not last long. Surya is married to both Subbulakshmi and Gayathri, due to unexpected circumstances. How life turns chaotic for all three is the story.
; Season 2 This season is a village family romance revenge story. Vidya strives to take care of her family while working at Ashok's home. Though she is in love with her childhood friend Ashok, he does not understand Vidya and his stepmother Subbulakshmi 's feelings and wants to marry Shwetha (Keerthi Jai Dhanush) who falls in love with him. Later he marries Vidya due to unexpected circumstances. How Ashok and Vidhya live together is the story.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Season 1 Season 1 is a family story produced by Vision Time Pvt Ltd which airs on Sun TV. Kannada TV actress Neha Gowda was selected to portray the lead role of Gayathri. Sridevi was chosen after her great performances in many shows on Tamil television. Later Sruthi Shanmuga Priya replaced the role of Subbulakshmi in Episode 1080. Amulaya makes her debut in Tamil serials as Renukha. Later Akila replaced the role of Renukha in Episode 440. Eshwar was selected to portray the lead role of Surya. Sreeja of Bommalattam serial fame was selected to portray the main role of Anbarasi in Episode 1198. Other supporting cast members include Sadhana, Narasimha Raju, Anuradha, Sudha, Kalaranjini and Bhavani.
Season 2 Season 2 is a village family romance revenge story. Srithika Saneesh was selected to portray the new lead role of Vidhya, who is known for the serials Nadhaswaram and Kula Deivam. Arnav was chosen due to his performance in Sakthi and Keladi Kanmani. Other supporting cast members include Vanitha Krishnachandran, Shanthi, Sathyapriya, Androos Jesudas, Birla Bose and C. Ranganathan.

title: Kabhi Kabhi
summary: Kabhi Kabhi was a 2013 Pakistani drama serial penned by Samira Fazal, directed by Anjum Shehzad and broadcast on ARY Digital in 2013. It was also broadcast  in India on Zindagi from 23 June 2015.
plot: Kabhi Kabhi has been directed by Anjum Shehzad and has been written by Samira Fazal. ‘Kabhi Kabhi’ is a love story that revolves around Ariz and Ishal. Ariz belongs to a lower-middle-class background, a family of limited means and is also the sole breadwinner of the family. Ishal, on the other hand, comes from an upper-class family. She is studying abroad and wishes to escape the mechanical life that her father has provided her. Ishal's filthy rich father wants his daughter to marry Shahraiz as he has all the qualities that he wants in a son-in-law, he is rich, educated and very spoilt. Ishal also has a dominating brother-in-law, Rehbar, who wants her to marry Shahraiz. Though Ishal and Ariz marry despite everyone's disapproval, they have many troubles in their life because of Ariz's wicked mother and sister. Plus, Ishal's father keeps creating trouble in their life because he wants to get his daughter out of the middle-class house. The story is based on the struggles of their love life because of their difference in status in society.

title: Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi
summary:
Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi (international title: Life of Ami) is an Indian drama television series that premiered on 9 September 2013 on Zee TV. It was produced by Essel Vision Productions and stars Ulka Gupta, Helly Shah, Gautami Kapoor and Manav Gohil.
Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi follows the story of 14-year-old girl Ami (Ulka Gupta / Helly Shah) whose father has died. Her mother Shruti (Gautami Kapoor) was forced to take up the dual responsibility of both mother and father. Shruti's family friend Sanjay (Manav Gohil) falls in love with her and expresses to marry her. Shruti first refuses but due to family pressure marries him.
The show began production on 6 September 2013. It was originally scheduled to begin airing on 9 September 2013, but was delayed. In December 2013, Helly Shah replaced Ulka Gupta as Ami.
The show is dubbed in English and aired on Zee World as Life of Ami.

title: Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara
wikiTitle: Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara
summary:
Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara (transl. The Heart Says Live a Little) is a Hindi-language Indian drama television series which premiered on Sony TV on 15 August 2013. The series starred Sangita Ghosh and Ruslaan Mumtaz.
The series was dubbed into Tamil as Kadhal Mayam and broadcast on Polimer TV.
plot:
The story revolves around the life of 34-year-old women, Sanchi Prabhu, who struggles to manage her deceased father's strawberry farm in Panchgani, secure the futures of her two younger siblings and care for her grandmothers. Dhruv Goyal, a 27-year-old, charming, wealthy lawyer, arrives on holiday from Mumbai and stays with Sanchi's neighbour. Sanchi initially finds Dhruv irritating but they later become friends. Dhruv realizes he loves Sanchi during her sister Prachi's marriage. However, Prachi's uncle-by-marriage seeks to marry Sanchi. This engagement is avoided when Dhruv reveals the uncle's bad intentions.
Sanchi's elder brother, Pradeep, files a lawsuit for control of the farm, which he wants to sell to an industrialist. Dhruv tries to console her but inadvertently confesses his love. Sanchi becomes upset, fearing another man is trying to take advantage of her. Dhruv tries to convince Sanchi that she loves him, but becomes frustrated at her refusals. Only when he sets to return to Mumbai does Sanchi stop him and confess her love. They share romantic moments before her family break them apart, and try to marry Sanchi to a fifty-year-old man. Dhruv becomes enraged with how Sanchi is treated and gets into a fight over her honour, moving her to stand with him.
The next threat to their future comes from Dhruv's family, as his mother schemes to marry him to his childhood friend, Ankita. Sanchi becomes jealous, though Dhruv insists he loves only her. When Ankita learns of their relationship, she tells Sanchi that Dhruv had several ex-girlfriends, and Sanchi fears that Dhruv might leave her. Dhruv is upset she would think this, but Sanchi makes up with him.
Dhruv is called to meet with the industrialist, who turns out to be his older brother. It turns out that Dhruv is a silent partner in the company buying the farm. He is unable to explain the situation and, feeling betrayed, Sanchi calls-off their engagement. Dhruv tries to convince his father to stop the sale and accept Sanchi as his bride, but his father instead tries to buy-off Sanchi with ₹20 crore and the farm if she will leave Dhruv forever. Sanchi refuses; and the father apologizes, saying it was a test. However, at a family dinner, Dhruv's mother tells Sanchi that their marriage will create a rift between Dhruv and his brother, tearing their family apart; she asks Sanchi to leave Dhruv forever.
Sanchi capitulates and accepts ₹25 crore from Dhruv's father, telling Dhruv nothing as she leaves for Panchgani. Dhruv calls Sanchi demanding the truth, and she claims that after seeing the cheque she could not stop herself from taking it. Dhruv cannot hide his disappointment as he disconnects the call. But then Dhruv learns that Sanchi had not encashed the cheque and had done all this on his mother's insistence and therefore he apologizes to Sanchi for not trusting her and marries her. After marrying they have a blast on their honeymoon in Goa and spend quality time with each other. Later the couple shift to Dhruv's house in Mumbai. Everyone in the family except dhruv's father and his sister-in-law, Suparna, accept their marriage.
Suparna instigates her sister Ankita against Sanchi into believing that Sanchi is the reason why she was not able to marry Dhruv. Both the sisters create various hurdles for Sanchi but all go in vain. Finally on the night of Dhruv's niece, Shruti's birthday, Sanchi exposes Ankita and she is thrown out of the Goyal house. This angers Suparna who vows revenge on Sanchi. Advait comes to goyal house for his studies after Dhruv's suggestion but due to the rude behaviour of Goyal's towards him and wrong allegations charged against him he leaves the goyal house. Sanchi's sister Prachi suffers miscarriage and is thrown out of the house. Dhruv brings Prachi to his house and upon checkup the doctor reveals that Prachi can conceive and there are no compilations in her case however as doctor said that it becomes a bit difficult for women to conceive after they cross age of 30, Sanchi doubts her conceiving chances and wants to start a family with Dhruv before it is too late.
Prachi soon reconcile with her husband Sunil. On the other hand, Dhruv however feels that it is too early for him to take father's responsibility and condemns Sanchi's proposal. But Sanchi is determined to go family way. After various arguments finally Dhruv agrees to have kids. Sanchi has conceived naturally but Suparna changes Sanchi's reports with fake reports and as a result doctor tells Sanchi that she is infertile. Sanchi and Dhruv are heartbroken. Suparna instigates Dhruv's mother, Neena against Sanchi. Neena tells Sanchi to leave the house as she has now become a curse for Dhruv as she can never give him and his family the happiness they want. Dhruv however supports Sanchi. Sanchi asks for six days from Neena and tells her that in these six days she'll prove her that she is suitable partner for Dhruv. Suparna tries to terminate Sanchi's pregnancy through various means but all goes in vain. At last Sanchi falls from the stairs as planned by Suparna. The doctor reveals that Sanchi will be fine and the news of Sanchi being eight weeks pregnant shocks the whole family. Dhruv catches Suparna trying to burn Sanchi's pregnancy reports. Dhruv and the whole family insult Suparna on doing such shameless act. Sanchi also gets to know about Suparna's act. Suparna asks for forgiveness from Sanchi. Sanchi doesn't want to forgive Suparna but gives her a last chance to correct her mistakes. Later Sanchi and Dhruv share some romantic moments. As the months pass by Sanchi delivers twin babies. The whole family comes together for celebration and the show ends on a happy note.
reception: The Indian Express rated two stars and reviewed, "Jee Le Zara has all the right elements — the smart sets, the wardrobe, the middle-class lifestyle, even the actors — but its heart is somehow misplaced in the drama dye. As cool as the concept sounds, the show is playing to the gallery, pandering to popular culture with long pregnant pauses, silly facial expressions, that funny ringtone of a background score and needless exaggeration."
