episodesList.summary: Tulsi is suspected by Daksha and Savita of stealing the necklace. Kiran has complete faith in Tulsi, but her innocence is in jeopardy.

episodesList.title: The Viranis Defend Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Daksha and Gayatri accuse Tulsi of stealing the necklace, but the other members of the family defend Tulsi. Later, Jamnadas catches Raghu with money.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Innocence is Proved
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas apologises to Tulsi and Mihir, revealing it was Gayatri who had stolen the necklace. Later, Daksha reveals Savita's entire plan against Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Convinces Govardhan
episodesList.summary: Amba gets worried about the differences between Tulsi and Mihir's relationship. Meanwhile, Tulsi tries to convince Govardhan to forgive Raghu for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Sejal's Life is in Danger
episodesList.summary: When Sejal and Anand meet with an accident, Payal finds them and quickly rushes them to a hospital. Elsewhere, Savita chooses not to inform Tulsi about it.

episodesList.title: Payal tries to impress Mihir
episodesList.summary: Savita lies to Mihir about Tulsi's phone and turns him against Tulsi while Payal tries to win Mihir's heart. Later, Sejal returns home from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Returns Home
episodesList.summary: While Govardhan is worried about the strike at the factory, Tulsi returns home to find Payal doing her duties. Later, Mihir expresses his anger towards Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Aarti learns the truth
episodesList.summary: Kiran informs Aarti that it was Gayatri who stole the necklace and not Tulsi. While Aarti wishes to join the Virani business, Anand proposes to Sejal.

episodesList.title: Suhasi and Rakesh get married
episodesList.summary: Rakesh and his family come to the Virani house to discuss his marriage to Suhasi. While JD decides not to speak to Gayatri, Daksha and Savita try to resolve the issue.

episodesList.title: Kiran's Secret Mission
episodesList.summary: Kiran goes to the Virani factory disguised as a labourer to find out what is really going on behind the Viranis' back. Elsewhere, Tulsi and Mihir share a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Mihir Berates Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi tries to tell Mihir that Savita tries to frame her for stealing the necklace. However, Mihir berates her for trying to turn him against Savita.

episodesList.title: Amba's Plea to Savita
episodesList.summary: Kiran finds out at the factory that Ramesh Yadav has complete control over it despite being in jail. Later, Amba tries to convince Savita of Tulsi's innocence.

episodesList.summary: Kiran manages to get the job as the servant of the factory manager and learns about how they keep the Viranis in the dark. Later, Tulsi sees Mihir with Payal.

episodesList.title: Savita Invites Payal
episodesList.summary: While JD announces the Viranis' plans to celebrate Navaratri, Savita invites Payal to come to the celebration. Later, The Viranis enjoy doing Garba.

episodesList.title: Tulsi to Apologise Payal
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi surprises Daksha, Gayatri, and Savita with her decision to apologise to Payal, Amba feels happy. Later, the Viranis fix Suhasis's marriage with Rakesh.

episodesList.summary: When the Virani family receives Rakesh, Mihir makes fun of him. Later, Rakesh and Suhasi exchange their wedding vows and perform rituals.

episodesList.summary: Payal seeks help from Deepak to bring trouble into Tulsi's life and fulfil her intention. Elsewhere, Suhasi mentions to Rakesh that she cannot accept him as her husband.

episodesList.title: Savita Misunderstands Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Savita feels isolated when Tulsi consoles Daksha as she breaks down, missing Chirag. Later, she misunderstands Tulsi and blames her for cornering her.

episodesList.title: Mihir Stands by Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi shares the tragic incident with Mihir and reveals that Savita tried to slap her. However, Mihir stands by Tulsi and confronts Savita.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Accompanies Sejal
episodesList.summary: Savita asks Tulsi to accompany Sejal during her dance performance as a part of her sinister move. Will Tulsi be able to handle the responsibility?

episodesList.title: Suhasi Adopts a Child
episodesList.summary: Suhasi decides to adopt a child without any consent from her husband and family. While everyone is upset about her decision, Suhasi's husband supports her.

episodesList.title: The Viranis are Grateful
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are grateful to the audience for watching the serial, as it celebrates its second anniversary and recall the good old days. Govinda, Anu Mallik and the entire team of Star Plus celebrate the second anniversary of Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi.

episodesList.title: Baa Enjoys at School
episodesList.summary: Baa and her friends enjoy the company of each other at the school and have food together. Later, Suhashi's parents-in-law argue about the baby on the way.

episodesList.title: Shobha Makes a Request
episodesList.summary: Mihir tells Tulsi that he will give the property to Gautam after he completes his five years of marriage. On getting a letter from a stranger, Shobha requests Vishal to abruptly end their honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Sejal's Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: As Tulsi complains about Savita not assigning any work to Mihir, he tries to calm her down. Later, Jamnadas discusses Sejal�s marriage proposal with Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Shobha Is Nervous
episodesList.summary: Shobha calls Payal and expresses her fear about the secret admirer. While Payal calls up Tulsi, the latter suspects her to be behind Shobha�s issue.

episodesList.title: Chirag's First Salary
episodesList.summary: Daksha is excited about her son, Chirag working with a famous TV serial with actor Rajat Kumar. Tulsi comes in between and tells Daksha that Savita is not at all happy about Chirag's job.

episodesList.title: Suhasi�s Fidelity Suspected
episodesList.summary: Suhasi is still upset with Rakesh for having left her alone with the newborn as she thinks that he never really cared for the family except for himself. Rakesh�s parents confront Suhasi and doubt her fidelity.

episodesList.title: Tulsi�s Ultrasound Reports
episodesList.summary: Mihir and Tulsi visit the doctor and the ultrasound reports confirm that there are no issues with the development of the child. Savita and Mihir insist Tulsi be on complete rest due to her health condition.

episodesList.title: Suhasi to be a Foster Mother
episodesList.summary: When Suhasi asks Rakesh about Aniket's mother, he opens up with his history about the baby and Monisha. Elsewhere, Anand requests Rajeev for a loan for his wedding with Sejal.

episodesList.title: Daksha Gets Fooled
episodesList.summary: Amba gets excited as her design gets selected for India�s fashion week. As Daksha serves food hastily to Amba�s friends, Amba and Tulsi make fun of her.

episodesList.title: Jamnadas Supports Sejal
episodesList.summary: When Sejal tells about her boyfriend to Jamnadas, he stands by her. Elsewhere, Tulsi supports Suhasi as she adopts her husband�s child.

episodesList.title: Savita Cospires Against Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Savita tells Tulsi to leave the house and conspires against her with Mihir. When Rajeev shows his wedding card to Pooja, she gets worried about the name on the card.

episodesList.title: Gautam, Teesha Fall in Love
episodesList.summary: As Gautam and Teesha fall in love, Mansukh and Himmat talk to Gautam about his marriage with Ganga. Later, Payal warns her husband not to interfere in her matters.

episodesList.title: Aarti Creates Misunderstandings
episodesList.summary: As Gautam tells Aarti that he wants to marry Teesha, Aarti gets delighted thinking that her plan is working. Further, Aarti creates misunderstandings between Gautam and Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Payal Gives Away the Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Payal tells Vishal she has to go to Mumbai and gives the house keys to Shobha. As Aarti blackmails Teesha, Payal provokes Gautam to marry Ganga.

episodesList.title: Pratap Protects Shobha
episodesList.summary: Gautam misunderstands Tulsi and agrees to marry Ganga to take revenge. As Payal plays tricks against Shobha and troubles her, Pratap protects her from Payal.

episodesList.title: Karishma at Virani House
episodesList.summary: As Harsh is caught doing drugs and debarred from school, he blames Karishma. Later, Tulsi, Jamnadas and Harsh take Karishma to the Virani house.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Invites Teesha
episodesList.summary: Prajakta slaps Savri for insisting on going to Chirag's shooting. While Teesha and Gautam share their feelings, Ganga invites Teesha for the wedding.

episodesList.title: Gautam Invites Aarti
episodesList.summary: The Viranis get busy with the wedding arrangements, and Gautam spends time with Teesha. While he invites Aarti, Tulsi asks him not to invite her to their house.

episodesList.title: Payal Invites Aarti
episodesList.summary: Payal restricts Shobha from attending Gautam's marriage. Although Gautam wants Aarti to attend his marriag, the Viranis oppose it. Meanwhile, Payal arrives for the function and invites Aarti to the rituals.

episodesList.title: Aarti wants to see Karishma
episodesList.summary: Tulsi applies mehendi on Karishma’s hands. The Virani family members stop Aarti at the door and send her back, making Gautam angry. Aarti wants to see Karishma so Payal arranges an invitation card for her to attend the wedding.

episodesList.title: Mihir Expresses His Disapproval
episodesList.summary: As Tulsi slips and falls down, Savita complains to Mihir that Tulsi does not take care of her health. Mihir tells Tulsi that he is not interested in knowing what happens between Tulsi and Savita.

episodesList.title: Gautam Dances with Teesha
episodesList.summary: As the Viranis organise a garba dance, Gautam drinks and dances with Teesha, shocking everyone. Meanwhile, Kabir and Kamya explore the Virani's house and talk about making their position in the Virani industry.

episodesList.title: Shobha Attends Gautam's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Teesha misunderstands Tulsi and tries to instigate Gautam against her. When Shobha calls up Gautam, he insists she attends his marriage, and Shobha attends Gautam's wedding.

episodesList.title: Teesha Gets Disappointed
episodesList.summary: Teesha cries on seeing Gautam and Ganga together in their wedding. Payal and Aarti discuss Gautam and Teesha's relationship. Tulsi and Jamnadas are concerned about Karishma's health.

episodesList.title: Anand, Sejal's Big Day!
episodesList.summary: The Viranis enjoy Anand and Sejal's marriage, but Jamnadas get angry with Sejal. Later, Rajeev attends the marriage, and introduces himself as Pooja's husband.

episodesList.title: Gautam, Teesha Spend Time
episodesList.summary: Gautam asks Ganga to take Tulsi's signature on a cheque book, and later meets Teesha at a restaurant.Laer, Gautam feels Teesha's presence around Ganga.

episodesList.title: Kamya, Kabir's Plot
episodesList.summary: Savita objects to giving the house keys to Ganga. Meanwhile, Anupam appreciates the business proposal of Kamya and Kabir, who are plotting against Mihir's business.

episodesList.title: Ganga Finds Out the Truth
episodesList.summary: As Teesha goes to Bangalore to try to get a loan, Ganga notices that Gautam and Teesha's rings are similar. She realises that Gautam lied to her about meeting Anupam in Bangalore.

episodesList.title: Worrying News for Mihir
episodesList.summary: While Daksha has a nightmare about Chirag, Prajakta and Chirag get worried about their future. Later, Mihir receives worrying news about his business.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Request to Mansukhbhai
episodesList.summary: Tulsi asks Mansukhbhai to convince Savita to attend the inauguration of Amba Bhavan, but Savita refuses to come. Later, Savita makes a plan against Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Baby Shower Ceremony
episodesList.summary: As her due date approaches, the Viranis arranges a baby shower ceremony for Tulsi. Later, Hemant gets a shocking revelation.

episodesList.title: Pooja, Hemant's Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Hemant confronts Pooja and accuses her of playing with his emotions by giving him false hopes. Later, Tulsi tries to sweet talk Daksha.

episodesList.title: Sejal Narrates Her Woes
episodesList.summary: Sejal discloses that living life after marriage has been difficult for her due to her in laws' financial conditions. Later, Mihir invites the Gandhis for the inauguration.

episodesList.title: Hemant Invites Puja
episodesList.summary: As Hemant invites Rajiv and Puja to the inauguration of Amba Bhawan, Rajiv agrees to attend. Later, misunderstanding ensues as to who invited Payal.

episodesList.title: A Tiff between Savita, Daksha
episodesList.summary: As Savita is entrusted with the inauguration of the Amba Bhawan, Daksha feels betrayed. Later, Payal reveals that she has enrolled for classes in Amba Bhawan.

episodesList.title: Mihir Worries for Hemant
episodesList.summary: As Gayatri amd Mihir worry about Hemant's state of mind, Mihir decides to divert Hemant's mind with work. Later, a tiff ensues between Sejal and Dheeraj

episodesList.title: Savita Doubts Hemant
episodesList.summary: While Payal apologises to Gayatri for her misconducts, Gayatri accepts her as a student. Later, Savita expresses her doubts on Hemant's capabilities.

episodesList.title: Disagreement between Sejal, Anand
episodesList.summary: Anand finds out that Sejal intends to participate in the dance competition and has a disagreement with her. Later, Chirag and Prajakta meet.

episodesList.title: Payal's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: Payal hatches a devious plan to infiltrate the Virani family by building a reationship with Gayatri. Later, the Viranis lose a huge client.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Rebukes Payal
episodesList.summary: As Payal calls Gayatri, the latter rebukes her, unaware of the fact that Savita is eavesdropping on her. Later, a tiff ensues between Dheeraj and Sejal.

episodesList.title: Payal Brainwashes Aarti
episodesList.summary: Aarti meets Payal at a restaurant and the latter slowly keeps on brainwashing Aarti. Later, Mihir faces a tough challenge in Virani Industries.

episodesList.title: Daksha Feels Betrayed
episodesList.summary: Daksha feels betrayed by Savita as the latters behaviour towards her has completely changed. Later, Aarti complains Ganga aboutTulsi.

episodesList.title: Hemant Expresses His Grief
episodesList.summary: Bharti overhears Daksha discussing her marriage to Chirag with Gayatri and Savita. Meanwhile, Hemant expresses to Tulsi his sentiments for Pooja.

episodesList.title: Sejal's Father Apologises to Anand
episodesList.summary: After Hemant sends Sejal an expensive gift, her father apologises to Anand and his mother. Later, Tulsi resolves to meet Savita late at night.

episodesList.title: Savita Becomes Suspicious
episodesList.summary: After cutting the cake, everyone gathers in Tulsi's room to celebrate Savita's birthday. Payal wishes Savita on the phone, which makes Savita and Daksha suspicious.

episodesList.title: Payal Approaches Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Payal meets Tulsi with a devious intention after Mihir and Tulsi visit the temple. Hemant's father later cautions him to keep out of Sejal's life for her good.

episodesList.title: Sejal Disputes with Anand
episodesList.summary: While talking to her husband, Savita blames Tulsi for her fight with Daksha. Meanwhile, Sejal has a disagreement with Anand about her position in the house.

episodesList.title: Payal to Destroy Mihir, Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Savita and Daksha engage in a brawl as the latter continues to mock her. Payal, meanwhile, vows to destroy Mihir and Tulsi's marriage before she gets married.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Speaks with Savita
episodesList.summary: Following a quarrel between Savita and Daksha, Tulsi resolves to speak with Savita. Meanwhile, Hemant calls Pooja's phone and swears retribution.

episodesList.title: Mihir Meets Daksha
episodesList.summary: Savita overhears Amba and Govardhan discussing the will. Meanwhile, before leaving town, Mihir meets Daksha and apologises on Savita's behalf.

episodesList.title: Savita, Daksha Sort Out Their Conflicts
episodesList.summary: Tulsi becomes concerned after Mihir fails to respond to her phone calls since he left. Later, Savita and Daksha sort out their disagreements.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for the Viranis!
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas receives a phone call regarding an accident after everyone becomes concerned about Mihir. Later, the Viranis arrive at the accident site.

episodesList.title: Baa Informs Savita the Truth
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas, heartbroken, notifies Mansukh that Mihir is no longer alive. Later, Amba tries to notify Savita of Mihir's unfortunate demise.

episodesList.title: The Truth Is Kept from Tulsi
episodesList.summary: The Viranis resolve to keep Mihir's awful news from Tulsi. Baa and Tulsi subsequently go to the temple to prevent Tulsi from finding out about Mihir.

episodesList.title: Savita Refuses to Accept the Truth
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas calls Hemant and urges him to bring Mihir's body home�before Tulsi arrives home. Later, Savita denies believing that Mihir is no longer alive.

episodesList.title: The Viranis Begin the Funeral Rites
episodesList.summary: While visiting the temple with Baa, Tulsi continues to speak about Mihir. Meanwhile, as Mihir's body arrives, the Viranis begin the funeral rituals.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: Tulsi crashes to the ground upon witnessing Mihir's lifeless body, resulting in her hospitalisation. Later, Savita falls unconscious as she makes sense of reality.

episodesList.title: Gautam Is Born
episodesList.summary: Tulsi turns hysterical upon realising Mihir isn't alive to witness the birth of their son, Gautam. Later, Baa tries to calm her down by reminding her of Mihir's memories.

episodesList.title: Gautam Arrives Home
episodesList.summary: Despair ensues as Tulsi returns home with Gautam from the hospital. Later, Baa consoles a grieving Savita and asks her to get rest while she looks after Gautam.

episodesList.title: Anupam Visits the Viranis'
episodesList.summary: Mansukhbhai is taken aback as Anupam pays a surprise visit to them. Meanwhile, while talking to the members, Anupam expresses his condolences to the family.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Spends Sleepless Nights
episodesList.summary: Savita walks into Tulsi's room in the middle of the night and chats with her. Later, while speaking with Mansukhbhai, a teary-eyed Savita evokes Mihir's memories.

episodesList.title: The Viranis' Meet Anupam
episodesList.summary: As the Viranis meet with Anupam, he informs them that he had invested a huge sum in Mihir's project. The next day, Anupam brings the documentation to the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Anupam Meets Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Anupam meet to express their sorrow for Mihir's death. Anupam makes an attempt to give Gautam a gift. Amba seems concerned for Tulsi for spending a life like a widow.

episodesList.title: Daksha Grows Concerned
episodesList.summary: Chirag and Prajakta are worried about keeping their relationship together. Later, Daksha grows concerned as Bapuji intends to talk about their will.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Seems Worried
episodesList.summary: Savita is advised by Tulsi to sell her wedding jewellery after the death of Mihir. When Tulsi seems concerned about the project, Amba consoles her.

episodesList.title: Aarti Plans to Handle the Business
episodesList.summary: As Mihir's family chooses to carry out Mihir's final desire of finishing his dream project, Aarti expresses an interest in handling the business.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Upset
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi expresses her thoughts over the second marriage, Savita holds a family discussion. Payal manages Aarti's finances and asks for a loan.

episodesList.title: Mansukh Tries to Convince Savita
episodesList.summary: Hemant approaches Pooja to congratulate her on her wedding and extends his friendship. Mansukh tries to convince Savita about Tulsi's second marriage.

episodesList.title: Anupam Helps the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Anupam makes an effort to assist the Viranis with their business. Mansukh approaches Aarti for assistance with the project.

episodesList.title: Savita Persuades Tulsi
episodesList.summary: When Amba meets Savita to discuss Tulsi's second marriage, Savita declines. Meanwhile, Savita meets Tulsi and tries to persuade to take Mihir's place.

episodesList.title: Anupam Thinks About Tulsi's Marriage
episodesList.summary: As Payal arrives at the rituals, Daksha is dissatisfied with Gayatri's approach of Payal. Later, Tulsi's wedding is on Anupam's mind.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Daksha and Gayatri are both dissatisfied with one other's behaviour. Meanwhile, Tulsi appears heartbroken when Savita suggests her second marriage to her.

episodesList.title: A Marriage Proposal For Tulsi
episodesList.summary: The family members are overjoyed as Anupam proposes to marry Tulsi. Later, as Tulsi is informed of this developement, she is taken aback and refuses to remarry.

episodesList.title: Good News for the Viranis!
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are filled with joy as Sejal delivers a baby and Anand becomes a father. Later, Mansukh informs Anupam that his marriage proposal to Tulsi is granted.

episodesList.title: Mihir Regains Consciousness!
episodesList.summary: While Tulsi recalls the moments spent with Mihir, he comes back to his senses, leaving Mandira shocked. Later, Tulsi gets engaged with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Daksha's Silly Daydreams
episodesList.summary: Kiran and Aarti are happy that everyone is equally contributing to Mihir's project. Elsewhere, Daksha dreams about winning lots of prize money from crorepati.

episodesList.title: Mandira Cheers up Mihir
episodesList.summary: Mandira tries to boost the spirit up in Mihir as he feels lonely and miserable at the hospital. Meanwhile, Daksha decides to get Chirag engaged to Bharti.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Savita Break Down
episodesList.summary: When Tulsi continues recollecting the memories she spent with Mihir, Savita bursts into tears. Elsewhere, Mihir is anxious as he gets flashes from the past.

episodesList.title: Savita Makes Tulsi Understand
episodesList.summary: Savita tells Tulsi that Gautam should recognise Anupam as his father, rather than struggling with Mihir's legacy. Elsewhere, Suhasi is appreciated for telling the truth.

episodesList.title: Daksha Begins Preparations
episodesList.summary: Bharti helps Daksha with reading books to prepare for her Crorepati game. Later, Hemant tells his family that Payel has returned the important files.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Anupam are Welcomed
episodesList.summary: Anupam's mother greet Tulsi and Anupam to their home. On the occassion of Baa's birthday, Govardhan makes wishes for her and but she gets emotional.

episodesList.title: Chirag Rebukes Daksha
episodesList.summary: Daksha is excited to participate in the Crorepati game and awaits a call from them. Later, Chirag argues with her as he is not willing to get engaged.

episodesList.title: Baa's Generous Decision
episodesList.summary: Savita, Baa and Govardhan decide to buy new ornaments for Tulsi on her marriage. Elsewhere, Daksha asks Chirag about the questions to be asked at Crorepati platform.

episodesList.title: Baby Naming Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Daksha pampers Sejal's daughter, and dresses her up. Later, the Viranis take part in the naming ceremony of Sejal's daughter and Mihir's son.

episodesList.title: Chirag Gets Engaged
episodesList.summary: Everyone comes together to celebrate Chirag's engagement. In the meantime, Rakesh and Suhasi lose custody of their kid in court to his mother, Monisha.

episodesList.title: Payal's Diabolical Intentions
episodesList.summary: After Payal purchases shares in their industry, the Viranis become suspicious. Hemant later meets Payal to discover the reason for her investment.

episodesList.title: Savita Becomes Sceptical
episodesList.summary: When Payal calls to wish Hemant Diwali greetings, Savita becomes suspicious. Jamnadas later offers Anand a job at Virani Industries.

episodesList.title: Rakesh Promises Suhasi
episodesList.summary: Rakesh vows Suhasi that he will bring their son Aniket to their house. Meanwhile, as Amar goes missing, Dr Mona decides to seek help from the police.

episodesList.title: Anupam Greets the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Anupam arrives at the Virani mansion to take Tulsi with him. Meanwhile, Savita is overcome with emotion after missing Mihir during the Diwali celebration.

episodesList.title: Anupam Invites Mona
episodesList.summary: Anupam calls his sister Mona to invite her to Tulsi's marriage. After hearing Tulsi's name, Amar, who happens to be Mihir, becomes sceptical.

episodesList.title: Mona, Mihir Arrive in Mumbai
episodesList.summary: After Mona is late to reach Mumbai, Tulsi decides to return home without meeting her. Later, Anupam welcomes Amar to their house.

episodesList.title: Savita Expresses Her Concern
episodesList.summary: After Anupam visits Tulsi for work, Amar feels sceptical. Savita later expresses her concerns about Hemant and Payal becoming close.

episodesList.title: Payal's Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas and Gayatri argue over Payal and Hemant's bonding. Payal, meantime, informs her mother about the man she wishes to marry.

episodesList.title: Amar Struggles to Recall His Past
episodesList.summary: Anupam invites Mansukh to meet Amar, who is waiting in the car for him. Later, as Amar struggles to recollect his past, Mona tries to reassure him.

episodesList.title: Payal's Confession to Arati
episodesList.summary: Himmat, Manuskh other family members discuss Anupam and Tulsi's marriage. Meanwhile, Payal tells Arati that she wants to marry Hemant and asks for her help.

episodesList.title: Anand Praises Sejal
episodesList.summary: Anand receives his first earnings and gives all credit to Sejal and her father. Meanwhile, the Virani family is getting ready for Anupam and Tulsi's grand wedding.

episodesList.title: Anupam,Mona discuss Amar
episodesList.summary: Anupam asks Mona about Amar's health conditions and asks her to get Mona into his marriage. Meanwhile, Payal visits the Viranis and decides to help them in Tulsi and Anupam's marriage.

episodesList.title: Gayatri, Tulsi Make a Wish
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Tulsi tell Jamnadas that she wishes to see Payal as her daughter-in-law. Meanwhile, Payal and Hemant worry as they discuss the future of their relationship.

episodesList.title: Rakesh, Suhasi miss Aniket
episodesList.summary: Suhasi is shattered as tells Rakesh that she misses her son Aniket. Elsewhere, Tulsi recalls her memories with Mihir while she attends an opening ceremony with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Daksha Tricks Godhavari Dadi
episodesList.summary: As Godhavari Dadi calls Daksha, the latter tricks her by disguising herself as a telecaller. Meanwhile, Hemant asks Baa about her view on Payal and his relationship.

episodesList.title: Jamnadas Praises Anand
episodesList.summary: As Anand spends his time working, Jamnadas appreciates his dedication. Elsewhere, Mona shows Mihir the gifts she selected to gift Tulsi on her marriage.

episodesList.title: Mihir is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Mihir is surprised as Mona tells a photographer that she is soon going to marry him. Later, Govardhan gets emotional and asks Jamnadas to repay Payal's debt with a cheque.

episodesList.title: Hemant, Payal Discuss Their Relationship
episodesList.summary: After clearing Payal's cheque, Hemant and Payal discuss their relationship. Later, Sejal is worried as Anand spends most of his time in the company.

episodesList.title: Hemant, Payal's Engagement Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are excited as they celebrate Hemant and Payal's grand engagement. Meanwhile, Savita gets worried as she shares Arati's perspective with Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Govardhan Confers Tulsi's wedding preparations
episodesList.summary: Payal discusses with Arati her future plans of having a baby with Hemant. Elsewhere, Govardhan discusses Tulsi and Anupam's marriage function with his sons.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Tulsi decides to keep Gautam with Savita as she is concerned about Savita's emotions. Meanwhile, Payal and Hemant about Tulsi's firm decision regarding Gautam.

episodesList.title: Amar Advises Mandira
episodesList.summary: Mandira pushes Amar to accompany her to meet Anupam on her way, but Amar advises Mandira to leave him behind and let him finish his treatment without fail.

episodesList.title: Mihir Tries to Remember His Family
episodesList.summary: Mihir struggles to recollect the memories of his family members during his medical treatment, while Tulsi and her family enjoy the Garba dance together.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Sees Mihir
episodesList.summary: When Mihir shows up at Tulsi and Anupam's wedding, Tulsi can't stop crying when she sees Mihir during her nuptials with Anupam. After this incident, Mihir goes unconscious.

episodesList.title: Anupam is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Anupam and Mandira feel distraught after the incident at the wedding. Meanwhile, Mihir tries to identify his family members. Everyone is hoping Mihir will recover quickly.

episodesList.title: Mandira Remembers Her Love
episodesList.summary: Mandira reveals her eternal love for Amar when Anupam advises her to forget her past and move on with her life. Mandira then meets Mihir and tells him about her pain.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Seems Concerned for Mihir
episodesList.summary: When Tulsi asks her uncle about Mihir's condition, he calms her and tells her not to worry about him. Meanwhile, Mihir remembers an incident from his past.

episodesList.title: Mihir Remembers Everything
episodesList.summary: Mihir recalls everything and embraces Tulsi to express his love for her. Mihir's family members are overjoyed when he returns to normalcy. Meanwhile, Mihir seemed perplexed by Payal and Hemant's engagement.

episodesList.title: Payal Meets Mihir
episodesList.summary: Payal sees Mihir after he regains his memory and wants his opinion on her relationship with Hemant. Mandira talks to Mihir and reveals her affection for him. Savita seems worries about Aarti and Kiran.

episodesList.title: Anupam Congratulates Mihir
episodesList.summary: Anupam congratulates Mihir on his recovery and promises him their friendship will last forever. Further, Mandira commits to love Mihir forever.

episodesList.title: Anupam Worries About Mandira
episodesList.summary: Anupam shows his concerns for Mandira for her condition and behaviour. Meanwhile, Payal prays to ruin the ecstatic life of Mihir and Tulsi.

episodesList.title: Mihir Shows His Concern for Sejal
episodesList.summary: When Mihir expresses his concerns about Sejal to J.D Virani, he is reassured and advises him to wait. Hemant confronts Anand thereafter and warns him about Sejal.

episodesList.title: Mihir Remembers Mandira
episodesList.summary: Mihir remembers Mandira when he visits the temple with Tulsi, Amba, and Bapuji. Anupam advises Mandira to forget about Mihir and concentrate on finding her healing. Gayatri starts preparing for Hemant and Payal's wedding.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Concern for Hemant
episodesList.summary: Hemant goes to work with Pooja upsetting Gayatri. Amba and Govardhan get emotional during a conversation. Meanwhile, Anupam and Kesar spend quality time at a restaurant.

episodesList.title: Anupam's Letter to Kesar
episodesList.summary: Prajakta asks Chirag to take her out for a movie, but he denies. Tulsi slaps Chirag for his rude behaviour with Prajakta. Later, Anupam writes a letter to propose to Kesar.

episodesList.title: Aarti, Kiran Adopt Gautam
episodesList.summary: Anupam arrives in the Virani house and congratulates Tulsi. Tulsi and Mihir hand over Gautam's responsibility to Aarti and Kiran. However, Aarti does not allow Tulsi to take care of Gautam.

episodesList.title: Hemant to Forget Pooja?
episodesList.summary: The Viranis enjoy playing cricket and flying kites on the terrace. On the other hand, Gayatri tells Hemant to leave Pooja. Will he agree?

episodesList.title: Tulsi Misses Gautam
episodesList.summary: Savita sees Tulsi while she misses Gautam. Tulsi and Mihir purchase dresses for Gautam and Shobha. Nonetheless, Tulsi feels insulted after Aarti refuses to accept the dresses for Gautam.

episodesList.title: Pooja Declines Divorcing Hemant
episodesList.summary: Pragya discusses Tulsi about Vikram and Kesar's marriage. Meanwhile, Mihir is unhappy as Kiran has adopted Gautam legally. Later, Pooja tells Gayatri that she cannot divorce Hemant.

episodesList.title: Mihir Screams at Kiran
episodesList.summary: Jamnadas meets a priest to get Hemant's horoscope matched with Pooja's. Aarti is furious at Tulsi as she takes Gautam out without her permission. Later, Mihir loses his temper at Kiran.

episodesList.title: Vikram's Love for Vaishali
episodesList.summary: Kesar and Anupam meet at a restaurant as Vikram with Vaishali are there. Kesar sadly learns that Vikram loves Vaishali. Later, Gautam is admitted to the hospital and Tulsi visits him.

episodesList.title: Kesar to Marry Anupam?
episodesList.summary: While Savita and Pragya discuss about Vikram and Vaishali's wedding, Kesar accepts Anupam's marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Gayatri apologises to Pooja for her rude behaviour.

episodesList.title: Mihir, Tulsi Visit Kesar's Home
episodesList.summary: Savita decides to get Vikram married to Vaishali and shares it with the family. Mihir and Tulsi reach Kesar's residence to discuss about Kesar's marriage proposal with Anupam.

episodesList.title: Mihir Is Angry at Aarti
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Mihir take responsibility of Kesar's nuptails While Aarti receives a phone call about her uncle's heart attack at Chandigarh. Later, Mihir is furious with Aarti.

episodesList.title: The Unexpected Guest!
episodesList.summary: While Amba asks Pooja to apply Mehndi on Kesar's hand, Anupam and his family visit the Virani mansion for the pre-wedding rituals. Later, the gathering see an unexpected guest.

episodesList.title: Anupam, Kesar Tie the Knot
episodesList.summary: Anupam arrives at the Virani house and receives a warm welcome from the family. Later, Kesar and Anupam perform all the wedding rituals and get married.

episodesList.title: Aarti, Kiran Go Missing
episodesList.summary: The Virani family worries as Kiran and Aarti go missing from the house. While Mihir and Hemant lodge a police complaint, Anupam and Kesar arrive.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Breaks into Tears
episodesList.summary: Kesar is worried about Tulsi's life and discusses it with Anupam. While Tulsi recalls her old memories with Gautam, Rakesh and Suhasi discuss Aniket's future.

episodesList.title: Aarti, the Mastermind?
episodesList.summary: At the police station, Gautam's kidnapper reveals the name of the mastermind. Later, the Virani family is taken aback to know that the mastermind is Aarti.

episodesList.title: The Viranis in a Predicament
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are worried as their company shares are bought in the market by a new person. Meanwhile, Mr. Mehra takes charge as the Chairman of the Virani industries.

episodesList.title: Hemant, Pooja are Tensed
episodesList.summary: Pooja and Hemant are upset as complications may occur during the former's delivery. Meanwhile, Mr. Mehra and Payal enjoy the downfall of the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Govardhan Makes a Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Govardhan suggests mortgaging the house in order to get out of the business crisis. Later, he puts forward a request before the Virani employees.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for the Viranis!
episodesList.summary: Govardhan shares with Baa that he has now more shares than Payel and Mr. Mehra. Later, the family members are startled to see Govardhan in a shocking state.

episodesList.title: Govardhan's Last Rites
episodesList.summary: While performing the last rites, the Viranis breaks down recalling their memories with Govardhan. Later, Govardhan's advocate finds a letter for Baa.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Savita Get Emotional
episodesList.summary: During Govardhan's death ritual, Tulsi and Savita are sad that Gautam and Kiran could not see Govardhan for the last time. Later, Baa shares her feelings with Pooja.

episodesList.title: Baa's Birthday Celebration!
episodesList.summary: Baa gets upset as nobody wishes her on her birthday. Later, the Virani family offer prayers on her birthday and arrange a surprise birthday party.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Concern for Mihir
episodesList.summary: Shobha convinces Savita that she wants to bunk her computer class and go to a movie. Later, Tulsi expresses her concern for Mihir to Baa.

episodesList.title: Shobha Faces Harassment
episodesList.summary: At the college, Vicky and his friends viciously harass Shobha, leaving her embarrassed. Later, Tulsi gets infuriated and lodges a complaint against them.

episodesList.title: Shobha's Warning to Vicky
episodesList.summary: Baa searches for Shobha as she had promised that she would help them with the household chores. Elsewhere, Shobha gives Vicky a stern warning.

episodesList.title: Baa Bumps into Gautam
episodesList.summary: Gautam misbehaves with Baa after they accidentally meet at a shop. Later, Gautam refuses to keep Vicky's request as he finds Aarti and Kiran's photo.

episodesList.title: Gautam Plans to Ruin Shobha's function
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Savita discuss about Kiran. Indira asks Amba about her and Govardhan�s marriage. Meanwhile, Gautam and Vicky plan to ruin Shobha�s function.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Warns Gautam
episodesList.summary: When Gautam attempts to disrupt Shobha's event, Tulsi intervenes and threatens him with a complaint. Gautam then rags Shobha in college.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Amba
episodesList.summary: Kiran contacts Aarti to wish her a late birthday greeting. Pooja appreciates Tulsi's help in cleaning the room. The Virani family intends to surprise Amba.

episodesList.title: Sahil Warns Gautam
episodesList.summary: The Virani's are pleased to have Sahil back in their house. Later, Sahil goes to college with Shobha. Shobha tells him about the three college boys, who bother her. Sahil then warns Gautam not to bother Shobha.

episodesList.title: Sahil Is Hospitalised
episodesList.summary: When Amba inquires about Sahil, Bavri mistakenly informs her that he is in the hospital. After hurting Sahil, Vicky is scared.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Learns About Gautam
episodesList.summary: According to the doctors, Sahil suffers a significant head injury. Tulsi learns about her son Gautam's role in the incident at the police station. Tulsi later bails Gautam out.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Informs About Gautam
episodesList.summary: Gautam's presence in the guest room surprises the Virani family. Tulsi then reveals that Gautam is her son. Amba asks Tulsi not to tell Mihir about Gautam.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Confirms Gautam's Identity
episodesList.summary: Shobha and Tulsi become emotional as they express their concern for Gautam. Tulsi confirms Gautam's identity by seeing his passport.

episodesList.title: Kiran Returns His Home
episodesList.summary: As Kiran arrives home, all the family members are taken aback. Gautam realises he has forgotten his passport at Tulsi's residence.

episodesList.title: Kiran Meets Sahil
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Kiran meets up with Sahil and his family. Meanwhile, Gautam is identified as the one who hit Sahil on the head.

episodesList.title: Gautam Gets Bail
episodesList.summary: Pooja chooses to withdraw the complaint, and Gautam is granted bail. Gautam is enraged by Tulsi's arrival and hides his identity from the Virani family.

episodesList.title: Kiran Persuades Gautam
episodesList.summary: As Kiran persuades and asks Gautam to stay with him, he refuses. Meanwhile, Shobha reveals to Tulsi that Gautam plans to leave India.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Files a Complaint
episodesList.summary: After the police arrest Gautam, he gets enraged with Tulsi for complaining against him. Meanwhile, the Virani family plans to celebrate Gautam's birthday.

episodesList.title: Gautam Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Gautam refuses to accept Tulsi as his mother after learning about his family. Tulsi, on the other hand, is upset with Gautam's behaviour and intends to bring him home.

episodesList.title: Gautam Decides to Return Home
episodesList.summary: Kiran urges Savita to give Gautam another chance to correct his mistake. After learning Vicky's cunning strategy, Gautam decides to return home to get his passport.

episodesList.title: Gautam Searches His Passport
episodesList.summary: Gautam grows furious as he finds it difficult to get used to the new environment at home. Later, Gautam starts looking for his passport in Tulsi's room.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Gets Angry on Gautam
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Pooja worry about Gautam and expect changes in him with Sahil's fellowship. Meanwhile, Tulsi slaps and warns Gautam against spoiling the homely environment.

episodesList.title: Vishal's Plan For Shobha
episodesList.summary: Tulsi is angry at Gautam and asks him to leave as he consumes alcohol in the house. Meanwhile, Vishal informs about the national level dance competition to all and dances with Shobha.

episodesList.title: Savita Confesses Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Savita confesses to Tulsi of giving money to Gautam for buying cigarettes. Meanwhile, Shobha invites Vishal to her house to celebrate the festival of colours.

episodesList.title: The Viranis Celebrate Holi
episodesList.summary: Gautam is angry when Tulsi applies colour to him, but later he joins everyone to play Holi. Meanwhile, Shobha introduces Vishal as her friend to Amba and others.

episodesList.title: Gautam Is Angry At Sahil
episodesList.summary: Tulsi tells Savita that Sahil should do the rituals instead of Gautam as she saw a whisky bottle in his room. Later, Gautam learns that Sahil has placed a whisky bottle in his room.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Misunderstands Gautam
episodesList.summary: Tulsi regrets misunderstanding Gautam regarding his conduct. Meanwhile, Amba wishes Gautam to light the candle in front of Govardhan's photo.

episodesList.title: Vishal Impresses Shobha
episodesList.summary: The Viranis are delighted as Gautam lights a lamp before Govardhan's photo. Meanwhile, Vishal tries to impress Shobha but she does not reciprocate her feelings.

episodesList.title: Gautam Demands His Passport
episodesList.summary: Payal decides to meet Shobha and discusses it with Vishal. Meanwhile, Gautam asks Tulsi to give him his passport, but she refuses to handover.

episodesList.title: Gautam Completes His MBA
episodesList.summary: The Viranis feel proud that Gautam has completed his MBA and they ask him to join the family business. Later, Gautam gets irritated when he overhears the family making plans about his future.

episodesList.title: Gautam Grows Furious
episodesList.summary: Gautam grows furious and he wants to avenge the Virani for his past. Later, Shobha informs Indu about her relationship with Vishal and asks her to keep it a secret.

episodesList.title: Gautam Disagrees With Himmat
episodesList.summary: Amba informs Tulsi about Shobha's relationship with Vishal. Meanwhile, Gautam agrees to join the family business but has a disagreement with Himmat during a meeting.

episodesList.title: Shobha To Meet Payal
episodesList.summary: Gayatri turns down a marriage proposal for Sahil. Meanwhile, Vishal visits the Viranis and tells them that her mother, Payal, wants to meet Shobha.

episodesList.title: Payal Accepts Shobha
episodesList.summary: Sahil advises Jamnadas to consider Gautam's proposal. Later, Payal learns that Shobha is Mihir and Tulsi's daughter, and approves of Shobha.

episodesList.title: Gautam To Lead The Project
episodesList.summary: Mansukh and Jamnadas inform Tulsi about Gautam deciding to handle the new project all by himself. Later, Amba and Savita advise Tulsi not to give Gautam his passport.

episodesList.title: Shobha goes to a discotheque
episodesList.summary: Vishal invites Shobha to a discotheque. Shobha decides to go without informing Tulsi. How will Gautam react to Shoba�s indifference?

episodesList.title: Vishal meets Anupam
episodesList.summary: Anupam is introduced as a rich businessman. Vishal visits Anupam to persuade him for an out of court settlement with regards to their company dispute. Will Anupam agree to this proposal?

episodesList.title: Tulsi meets Ganga
episodesList.summary: Tulsi meets Ganga and requests her to tutor Savri and Bavri. Later, Shobha tries to convince Tulsi to forgive Kiran. Will Tulsi forgive Kiran?

episodesList.title: Gautam enquires about Anupam
episodesList.summary: Gautam enquires about Anupam and plans a business deal with him. Will Gautam and Anupam work together?

episodesList.title: Kiran apologises to Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Kiran decides to wind up his business in New Zealand and come back. Later, Kiran apologises to Tulsi for his mistakes. Will Tulsi forgive Kiran?

episodesList.title: Doubts raised about Gautam
episodesList.summary: Himmat and Jamnadas are concerned that Gautam is refusing to sign company vouchers. Is Gautam involved in a scam?

episodesList.title: Gautam meets Payal
episodesList.summary: Tulsi, Savita and Amba discuss Gautam's marriage with Ganga. Later, Gautam meets Payal to talk business. Will Payal, use this chance to take revenge on Tulsi?

episodesList.title: Gautam returns Tulsi�s money
episodesList.summary: Gautam returns Tulsi the money he had borrowed earlier. Aniket proposes that Tushar should work with Rakesh. Will Rakesh agree?

episodesList.title: Gautam justifies his actions
episodesList.summary: Mansukh informs Tulsi that Gautam is trying to find certain crucial financial details. Tulsi confronts Gautam and he justifies his actions. Will Gautam tell the truth?

episodesList.title: Virani's orders are cancelled
episodesList.summary: Pratap, worries when he learns that Shobha belongs to the Viranis. Meanwhile, Mansukh receives news that their orders have been cancelled. Who is working against the Viranis?

episodesList.title: Mihir returns home
episodesList.summary: Mihir returns home and relieves Gautam of his duties in the company. Jamnadas tries to convince Mihir to be more patient with Gautam. Will Mihir's return change Gautam's mind?

episodesList.title: Will Mihir apologise to Gautam?
episodesList.summary: Mihir is surprised to know that Gautam is his son. Later, Anupam informs Mihir about Gautam's work at their office. Will Mihir apologise to Gautam?

episodesList.title: Mihir and Guatam reconcile
episodesList.summary: Mihir and Gautam reconcile and accept each other. Meanwhile, Pratap gets angry at Payal for using Vishal, against the Viranis. What is Payal planning against the Viranis?

episodesList.title: Savita Gives Tulsi the Necklace
episodesList.summary: At the wedding, the daughters-in-law are asked to take care of the priest's requirements. Savita gives the responsibility of the necklace to Tulsi. What is Savita's plan?

episodesList.title: Aarti returns to India
episodesList.summary: Aarti returns to India and meets Gautam in a restaurant. Later, Payal is elated about Aarti and Kiran's separation. Will this help Payal avenge the Viranis?

episodesList.title: Aarti Meets Payal
episodesList.summary: Vishal informs Mihir that his mother, Payal, is going to meet the Viranis with his marriage proposal. Later, Aarti is shocked to see Payal after so long.

episodesList.title: Payal Meets the Viranis
episodesList.summary: Aarti and Payal team up against the Viranis and Aarti tells Payal about returning back to New Zealand. Later, the Viranis are shocked to see Payal as Vishal's mother.

episodesList.title: Shobha Rebels Against Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi tells Shobha about Payal's past but she refuses to believe and rebels against Tulsi. Later, Tulsi feels that Payal might use Shobha as a bait and take her revenge.

episodesList.title: Shobha Remains Adamant
episodesList.summary: Gautam tells Shobha that he will meet Payal and apologise to her. Later, Payal she refuses to forgive them and wants Shobha�s parents to come with the marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Vishal Visits Shantiniketan
episodesList.summary: After failing in his exams, Tarun informs Chirag that he is interest in sports and not in studies. Meanwhile, Vishal goes to Shantiniketan with a marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Pratap Ridicules Payal's Plans
episodesList.summary: Shobha and Vishal discuss the problems in their marriage and how to overcome them. On the other hand, Pratap ridicules Payal for her plan to harm the Viranis.

episodesList.title: Shobha Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Mihir tells Jamnadas that Payal plans to destroy the Virani family and decides to search a better match for Shobha. Later, Shobha goes missing from the Virani house.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Wants to Protect Shobha
episodesList.summary: Shobha informs Mihir that she was not with Vishal as he is in Delhi. Even though Tulsi wants to protect Shobha, Vishal and Shobha sign their registration papers.

episodesList.title: Shobha Does the Unexpected
episodesList.summary: Mihir asks Tulsi to give Gautam his passport, but Tulsi fears that he might land up in New Zealand. Meanwhile, Shobha agrees to meet her prospective bridegroom.

episodesList.title: Gautam Leaves for America
episodesList.summary: Gautam advises Shobha to stick to her decision before leaving for America. Later, Shobha is faced with a difficult choice when another man wishes to marry her.

episodesList.title: Gautam, Payal Pair Up
episodesList.summary: Tulsi gets furious when Payal tells her that Shobha visited her after being pressurized to marry someone else. Later, Shobha runs away and Gautam supports her wish.

episodesList.title: Shobha Weds Vishal
episodesList.summary: Savita enquires about Shobha when she is unable find her in the room. Later, Shobha weds Vishal without informing the family and Amba asks Tulsi to accept the marriage.

episodesList.title: Tulsi Feels Scared
episodesList.summary: After Shobha's registry to Vishal, Tulsi is afraid that Payal might harm Shobha to get her revenge. Tulsi informs Payal that they are coming to Delhi for the wedding.

episodesList.title: Payal Ridicules Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Tulsi, Mihir, Savita and Mansukh visit Payal�s house to discuss Shobha and Vishal�s wedding date. Later, Amba and Savita invite their family members to the wedding.

episodesList.title: Gautam Tries to Convince Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Prajakta argues with Chirag regarding his photo with Mansi and later calls her up. Gautam tries to console Tulsi even as everyone gets busy in wedding arrangements.

episodesList.title: Aarti Likes to Stay With Gautam
episodesList.summary: Tulsi and Kiran observe Aarti enjoying Gautam. Pragya insults Gayatri as she destroys an antique piece she brought.

episodesList.title: Payal Denigrates Tulsi
episodesList.summary: As Payal insults Tulsi in front of everyone, she supports Aarti. However, Amba, Savita and Gautam try to convince Tulsi as she gets angry at Aarti.

episodesList.title: Kiran Seems Angry With Aarti
episodesList.summary: When Kiran finds Aarti at his residence, he seems furious with Aarti. Meanwhile, Tulsi meets and expresses her gratitude to Gautam for handling the situation.

episodesList.title: Tulsi, Savita get emotional
episodesList.summary: During the wedding rituals, Gautam enjoys a good time with Ganga and the rest of the family. When Tulsi and Savita talk about relationships, they both feel emotional.

plotHtml:
'''' Set in Mumbai, the series focuses on the wealthy Gujarati Virani family, who live in their lavish house, Shantiniketan, where the three daughters-in-law, Savita, Daksha and Gayatri, control the entire family and create trouble for their wise and kind-hearted mother-in-law, Amba, called Baa by everyone. Savita arranges her son Mihir's marriage to the arrogant Payal, but he falls in love with and marries the family priest's kind-hearted and caring daughter, Tulsi. Savita despises Tulsi and wants to make her life a misery. The Viranis eventually accept Tulsi as their daughter-in-law, and she ultimately wins over Savita after many hardships, resolves various issues within the family, and has a son, Gautam. Mihir is involved in an accident and is presumed dead by his family.
Alive, Mihir suffers from memory loss and his caretaker, Dr Mandira, falls in love with him. Her brother Anupam proposes marriage to Tulsi, who agrees for Gautam. The wedding is canceled when Mihir is discovered to be alive. He gradually regains his memory. Obsessed with Mihir, Mandira plots against Tulsi, but she is unsuccessful. She is presumed dead in a plane crash. Payal also plots against the Viranis in order to avenge Mihir's rejection, but is ultimately exposed as well. Tulsi gives birth to a daughter, Shobha and gives Gautam to Mihir's brother, Kiran, and his wife, Aarti, who are childless. Aarti and Kiran leave India with Gautam fearing that Tulsi might reclaim him.
Tulsi and Mihir have another son, Harsh, who was raised along with Shobha. Gautam returns to India with Kiran and Aarti, who now have a daughter, Karishma. He learns about his birth parents and, after some initial hesitation, accepts them. Tulsi wants Gautam to marry Ganga, but he marries his love, Teesha, instead. Gautam's cousin, Sahil, marries Ganga to save her honour, while Shobha marries Payal's son, Vishal. Tulsi is shocked to discover that Mihir has been cheating on her for many years with an alive Mandira, with whom he has an illegitimate son, Karan. Mandira and Karan try to trouble the Viranis and take over their industries, but fail. Payal and Vishal reform because of Shobha. Teesha and her unborn child die in an accident planned by Mandira that was intended for Tulsi. Tulsi accepts Karan, who comes to love her more than Mandira, after learning the truth.
Harsh marries the greedy Mohini, who frequently causes trouble for the family. Gautam remarries Damini, who later becomes pregnant at the same time as Ganga. Ganga miscarries, while Damini gives birth to twins, Mayank and Nakul. Damini and Gautam give Nakul to Sahil and Ganga. Vishal dies, leaving Shobha widowed. Harsh is revealed to be the son of Tulsi's cousin, Kesar. Kesar had switched Harsh with Tulsi's real son, Ansh, who was then raised by Aditya Gujral. Ansh is spoilt and ruthless, and becomes obsessed with Karan's lover, Nandini. Shobha marries Vishal's friend, Abhishek. Although Karan and Nandini are in love, he marries her to Ansh, who sexually abuses her within the marriage. The lawyer handling the rape case and Tulsi's friend, Meera Singhania, becomes fond of Mihir. Tulsi fights against her own son to secure justice for Nandini and ultimately shoots Ansh dead when he attempts to kill Nandini, who gives birth to their daughter, Bhoomi, before lapsing into a coma. Karan marries his friend Tanya to help care for Bhoomi.
Tanya is pregnant. Nandini awakens from the coma and lives with Karan. Shobha leaves Abhishek after discovering that he and Rathi had killed Vishal. Nandini, who is pregnant with Karan's child, kills Aditya to save Bhoomi from being kidnapped and is imprisoned for 14 years. Ganga and Sahil have a son, Lakshya, while Karan remarries Tanya and they have a son, Manthan. Gautam adopts Eklavya, the son of Ansh and his first wife, Shraddha. Sahil falls in love with Tripti, and they begin an extramarital affair.
Meera falls for Mihir and conspires with Mandira against Tulsi. Savita discovers their conspiracies and vows to expose them, but suffers an accident planned by the two women. Left paralyzed, she asks Tulsi to disconnect her life support and dies. Meera convinces Mihir that Tulsi killed Savita in purpose. Believing Meera, Mihir expels Tulsi from Shantiniketan. Heartbroken, she is later presumed dead in a bus accident. The Viranis are left devastated, and Mihir becomes an alcoholic, blaming himself for Tulsi's death. Ganga leaves Sahil after discovering that he has cheated on her with Tripti. Tulsi travels to Haridwar, where she sees a newborn child being abandoned by her father. Tulsi rescues the child and raises her, naming her Krishna Tulsi.
Tulsi's grandchildren are all grown up. Tulsi lives in Haridwar with Krishna Tulsi, who later comes to Mumbai for her education and stays with the Viranis. Tulsi eventually reunites with the Viranis and Mihir exposes Meera, who gets imprisoned for Savita's murder. Mihir and Tulsi remarry. Tanya plots to keep Karan close to her, but eventually divorces Karan after realizing that he still loves Nandini. Karan and Nandini remarry and attempt to find their lost son, who was taken away by Mandira after his birth, but fail. Sahil divorces Tripti after realizing her true intentions, and reunites with Ganga, who is now a successful businesswoman. Krishna Tulsi and Lakshya are in love. Mayank, who is mentally unstable, is arrested for attempting to molest Krishna. Krishna Tulsi is forced to marry Eklavya, who resembles his father Ansh and he mistreats her. Bhoomi loves Abir but ends up marrying Joydeep because of family turmoil, while Abir marries Mohini's daughter, Archita. The sisters eventually accept their respective marriages and live happily.
Damini joins forces with Tripti and Tanya to avenge her son's arrest. They create situations that make Tulsi appear mentally unstable and send her to a mental hospital, from which she tries to escape and meets with an accident. Juhi Thakral enters, claiming to be Tulsi and revealing that she had undergone plastic surgery after the accident and is allied with Mandira. Eventually, she is exposed, and the real Tulsi, who had temporarily lost her memory, returns home and regains her rightful place while Mandira and Juhi's crimes are revealed. Lakshya unknowingly marries Tripti's adopted daughter, Vaidehi, who initially tries to sow discord within the family but later reforms. Tulsi battles various enemies, including Tripti, Mandira, Juhi and Shiv (Ganga's obsessive lover), in order to protect her family from harm, and defeats them, while Damini also has a change of heart. The Viranis are reunited after a prolonged separation. Baa sadly dies, leaving her entire inheritance to an unknown person in her will.
Mihir and Tulsi live with an orphaned girl, Sugandhi, while Mihir suffers from Alzheimer's disease. After learning about Baa's will, all the children leave Shantiniketan because they receive nothing from it. In the final episode, Tulsi's best friend Parvati Agarwal reunites with Tulsi and reveals that she has raised the inheritor of Baa's property, Parth (Karan and Nandini's long-lost son).

title: Koshish – Ek Aashaa
summary: Koshish – Ek Aashaa is an Indian soap opera that aired on Zee TV from 7 March 2000 till 3 June 2002. It won the award for 'Best Soap Opera' at the RAPA Awards in 2001.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: Kajal is a young woman who gets married on the insistence of her mother. She has not met the man prior to the wedding. However, on the wedding night, Kajal discovers that the man is actually a mentally challenged person who has the mind of an eight year old. She realises that she has been tricked into marrying him by her in-laws. This makes her furious. Kajal wants to tell her mother, but cannot because her mother is a heart patient. Kajal is unwilling to accept this marriage and blames her in-laws for ruining her life. Neeraj is innocent and childlike. Kajal finds it hard to tolerate his behaviour, because of which their relationship has quite a turbulent start. After spending some time together, however, Kajal and Neeraj become close. Kajal's mother finds out about the situation and forces Kajal to come back home. Neeraj panics since he cannot stay without Kajal, who also does not want to leave him. Kajal's mother files a case against Neeraj's family. But, Kajal refuses to leave Neeraj. This strengthens their bond. Kajal comes back and starts her mission to cure Neeraj. She consults a specialist doctor who assists her in treating Neeraj. Gradually, Kajal becomes suspicious that someone in the family doesn't want Neeraj to get cured, but she isn't sure who the person is since everyone seems to love Neeraj a lot. Neeraj's doctor advises Kajal to take Neeraj to a medical camp which could help cure him. Kajal and Neeraj go, although Neeraj's father opposes the idea. When they come back, everyone is surprised at how much Neeraj has improved. All is going well, until on Neeraj's birthday, someone attacks him and he gets hurt on his head. This causes him to regress back into his earlier condition. Kajal is shattered, yet, she refuses to give up hope. She takes Neeraj to the United States for treatment. When they return, Neeraj is fully recovered. He is able to attend office, make his own decisions and understand everything. Kajal and Neeraj are able to live their marital life properly, and express their love to each other. Kajal becomes pregnant, because of which everyone is overjoyed. However, some misunderstandings occur between Kajal and Neeraj, which leads to them having an argument. Kajal has an accident and loses her child. She also loses her memory partially. Soon, it is revealed that Kajal was only pretending to have lost her memory to protect herself from the person who was responsible for Neeraj's condition. That person is Neeraj's mother, who is actually his stepmother. She was the person who killed Neeraj's grandfather, and made him mentally unstable. The reason behind all of this was that Neeraj is the heir to all of his grandfather's property, which his stepmother wanted for herself and her real children. Neeraj's stepmother dies as a result of poisoning, and so does his father. A few years later, Kajal and Neeraj are shown talking to each other about their lives. Neeraj thanks Kajal for supporting him and never giving up on him. They also have a daughter, who they named Asha. The show concludes on a happy note that everything is fine now, all because of Kajal's efforts (koshish).

title: Krishnadasi
summary:
Krishnadasi is an Indian Tamil-language soap opera. It aired on Sun TV from 14 February 2000 to 25 October 2001. The show stars Gemini Ganesan alongside Nalini, Vietnam Veedu Sundaram, Ranjitha, Aravind Akash, and Suja Raghuram. The show was produced by Prabhoo Nepaul. It is based on the novel written by Indra Soundar Rajan. The title track was composed by D. Imman and sung by Nithyasree Mahadevan.
Krishnadasi notably marked the last performance of Gemini Ganesan in a character role. It also marked the re-entry of actress Nalini into the media after a post-marriage 14-year hiatus, the debut of choreographer Raghuram's daughter Suja Raghuram as an actress and choreographer in television.
The title sequence is the first song composed by the music director D. Imman.
plot:
This serial revolved around the Devadasi practice that prevailed in Tamil Nadu almost a few years after India's independence and how the dasi women are treated by society. The story followed the rivalry between Rudramuthi Sastri, a very powerful Brahman in that village and his family and Manonmani, the dasi of the village and her family in the small hamlet of Kandhanallur on the banks of the river Kaveri.
Manonmani, a dasi comes back to her ancestral village of Kandhanallur with her daughter, Krishnaveni after 15 years of exile from the village where she, her daughter and baby granddaughter, Meenaatchi, were exiled by the village's people. As soon as she arrives, she goes to meet Rudhramoorthi Sastri and his son Saminatha Sastri and vows that she will wreak havoc in their perfect lives like they wrecked hers 15 years ago.
Meanwhile, Saminatha Sastri's son, Sunderesan falls in love with Meenaatchi while they are studying at the college. Krishnaveni never revealed who was Meenatchi's father to anyone for reasons only known to her but Meenaatchi is determined to find out the truth. Pachiamma, the village midwife extorts Manonmani to safeguard a secret known only to them.

articleSections.title: Remake
articleSections.text: Krishnadasi was remade in Hindi under the same title, starring Shravan Reddy and Sana Amin Sheikh on Colors with significant changes in the story.

title: Kora Kagaz
summary: Kora Kagaz (Blank Paper) is an Indian television series which ran on Star Plus from 27 October 1998 until 17 January 2002. It was directed by Asha Parekh. The series had 169 episodes which starred Renuka Shahane, Salil Ankola and Amit Behl. The serial was first telecasted on every Tuesday at 8.30 pm IST and later shifting to every Thursday at 9 pm IST.
plot:
The wedding of Mahesh and Pooja is held with all the pomp and tradition associated with Indian weddings. The night after the wedding, Pooja, a nervous bride, waits for her husband to join her. He comes very late, and when he does, it is to tell her that he is in love with another girl. He tells Pooja bluntly that he never wanted to marry her in the first place and walks out, leaving behind a distraught and confused young bride trying to come to grips with this new reality.
Pooja refuses to return to her parents. She continues to reside with Mahesh's family, consisting of his parents and younger brother Ravi. She decides to continue her studies, find a job and get her life back together again. All members of Mahesh's family are supportive and well-disposed towards Pooja. They were unaware of his affair with the other girl. In particular, Pooja gets tremendous moral and emotional support from her brother-in-law Ravi, and an attraction forming between them becomes evident as the serial progresses. Where will this attraction lead them, and what does Pooja do when Mahesh suddenly arrives back into her life?
What does Pooja do? What choices does she make? Will she find fulfillment?

title: Kadhal Pagadai
summary: Kadhal Pagadai (transl. The Love Dice) is a 1996 Indian Tamil soap opera aired on Sun TV. The show was directed by veteran Tamil film director K. Balachander. The show stars Rahman and Mohini making their appearances in a television series for first time with T. V. Varadarajan, Renuka, Venu Arvind, Kavithalaya Krishnan, Vatsala Rajagopal and Mohan V. Ram portraying supporting roles. That serial has both comedy and romance and was shot in a residential neighbourhood called Konar Colony.
plot:
Kadhal Pagadai revolves around middle-class families in Konar Colony, in Chennai, in the late 1990s. The show showcases the struggles revolving in middle-class families and the youngsters love live, through emotional outbursts, with comic reliefs here and there. Though there is no main characters, the story mainly revolves around a family living in Konar Colony. The family is led by Mohanbabu, a clerk in a government office, though his wife Vanja is the one leading the family as the only woman. Mohanbabu younger brother, Rajbabu, is a clerk in a chit fund company. He has a girlfriend named Sithara, who is an orphan. Rajbabu hides this fact from his family, as he want to settle first before marrying Sithara. But Sithara's flashback from her college days involving Ramana, forces Rajbabu to introduce her to his family, and his elder sister, Girija gets an instant dislike for Sithara. Girija comes down to Chennai from Saudi, seeking money from her brothers, to release her husband from jail back in Saudi. At the same time, Rajbabu losses the chitfund money, due to a sinister plan laid by his office peon, Sanjeevi. Ramana comes forward to offer money to help Rajbabu and Sithara but has a condition that Sithara should stay with him in his Cunnor Estate for 10 days. If Sithara stills loves Rajbabu after their mutual stay, Ramana would not trouble them anymore. Having faith in Sithara and desperately in need for money, Rajbabu convinces a reluctant Sithara to go with Ramana. But soon, his faith turns into a possessive behavior and Rajbabu refuses to trust Sithara.
Though, this is the main gist of the plot, Kadhal Pagadai also revolves around other families in the Colony. One such family is the ultra rich and arrogant woman who bought the house that she stayed in. A strict old man with 2 daughters, who is the only man in the colony to have a telephone, which irritates him as he has to pass messages to the people in the colony. His elder daughter, Nandhini who loves her neighbour, a mechanic and the duo runs away when her father opposes. A Palakad Brahmin family, who is one of the main comic relief in the show. A disabled helper around the colony, named Ayyappan. A struggling cinema actor, also a fraud, with whom Sithara's friend Sundari was in love with, but breaks up after knowing his fraudulent nature.
How all these families overcome their daily challenges? Would Ramana win Sithara's heart? Or would Rajbabu and Sithara unite again? forms the climax.

title: Kash-m-kash
summary:
Kash-m-kash is a TV show broadcast on Doordarshan's DD Metro channel in 1995. The show stars Javed Jaffrey, Suchitra Krishnamoorthi, Aly Khan, Nisha Singh, Aparna Kumar and others. Kash-m-kash TV series made it to the Top 10 series on DD Metro for many weeks running.  The music and songs from Kash-m-Kash were released independently to popular demand on then newly privatized Radio Channels.
It was a 26-episode series, written by Haseena Moin and produced and directed by Chanda Narang. Chanda Narang was a Delhi-based Director-Producer of documentary films. Her most popular one being on the Ayodhya and Babri Masjid controversy, released under the title Ayodhya; a City Under Siege. Narang's documentary India's elections '91; The Temple Or The Mosque was released on Englands Channel 4 on 19 May 1991. Narang had extensive coverage of the congress president Rajiv Gandhi's final Electoral trail. Rajiv Gandhi's last interview before his travel to Chennai had been aired on Channel 4 just 3 days before his untimely death. Chanda Narang's topical and salient coverage of the elections and Congress president Rajiv Gandhi, was replayed many times by channel 4 following the assassination of India's Former Prime Minister, Rajiv Gandhi. Narang's documentary found multiple releases in channels about the world, catapulting the young Director and Producer in to visual media's big league.
Kash-m-Kash came four years later after Narang had set up a private video production studio in her home town of New Delhi, and clocked 8 more documentaries; 11 corporate films as well as, over 36 advertising films. Channel 4 in London financed Narang's first maiden feature film based on the darker side of the fictionalized Indian Circus. Kash-m-Kash came as a welcome relief to this director and producer as a light-hearted romance-comedy, with the cast from Mumbai and the crew from New Delhi. New Delhi in the early nineties had seen the advent of the Film City in NOIDA, with film-makers planning big budget shoots in the professional film studios of NOIDA. Studio Images and its Promoter and Chief, Chanda Narang, subsequently shot the first of her next series, Laxmi LLB, at the new Film City, continuing with her successful theme of romance-comedies. Narang's last documentary in 2001 is on the controversial Kashmiri shawl called Shahtoosh, or referred to by animal activists as the 'blood-shawl'.

Actors Aly Khan and Nisha Singh form the other romantic pair in this series. Well known character actors, Sushma Seth and Roshan Seth, play the single parents to the main lead actress-characters, Suchitra Krishnamoorthi and Nisha Singh.

summary: Kirdaar is an Indian television series aired on DD National directed by Gulzar. It starred Om Puri playing various characters in all the episodes and different actors in each episode like Surekha Sikri, Irrfan Khan, Reema Lagoo and Neena Gupta.

title: Kanoon
summary:
Kanoon is an Indian television courtroom drama/crime series. The 111-episode Hindi series had its original run from 1993 to 1996 on DD Metro. It was produced by B. R. Chopra and directed by his son Ravi Chopra. The music was composed by Ravi. Make-up for the series was done by Vimal Devkar. The concept of the story was given by Satish Bhatnagar, Sachin Bhowmik, Kulwant Jain and Hasan Kamal. Four seasons of the show were telecasted.
Each episode ran for approximately 25 minutes and began with a title song rendered by Mahendra Kapoor.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text: This TV serial by the Bollywood producer B. R. Chopra is styled after several of the movies he made and named after the famous movie, Kanoon (1960). The protagonist is a lawyer, assisted by a secretary and an assistant. The serial features several crime cases, which run to multiple episodes each.

title: Khana Khazana
summary:
Khana Khazana (transl. Food treasure) was an Indian Hindi-language cookery show hosted by Indian chef, Sanjeev Kapoor. The show was primarily based upon Indian cuisine.
The show was directed by Hansal Mehta.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: The first episode of the show was hosted by Harpal Singh Sokhi. The subsequent episodes were hosted by Sanjeev Kapoor. Occasionally, Chef Kapoor brought in various celebrity guests and viewer recipes are also displayed. Over the course of the show, Chef Kapoor had become more conscious and concerned about food-related diseases and cooked low-fat and healthy meals.

title: Kashish (serial)
summary: Kashish (Attraction) is an Indian romantic drama television serial broadcast on Doordarshan between 1992-93. It starred Sudesh Berry and Malvika Tiwari as the male and female lead of the show. The story was written by Kamna Chandra. The serial consisted of 8 episodes.
plot:
Mona lives with her stage actress friend Priya, who encourages her to seriously pursue acting and makes her go for the audition of a new TV show. On her way, Mohana helps a random unwell woman who introduces herself as Mrs. Anand, drops Mrs. Anand at her lavish bungalow, and then rushes for the audition where despite being late, she gets selected for the role by Rahul Anand who was watching her audition from behind the scenes. However, Mona did not meet Rahul by then.
Mrs Anand invites Mona & Priya over tea as she grows fond of her helpful, humble, and self-respecting nature where she also gets to know Mona is doing her son's TV show but doesn't tell Mohana about it. She later invites the girls to her 50th Birthday Party.
At the party, Rahul behaves rudely with Mona thinking she used unfair influence to get to their party but later realizes his mistake when Mrs. Anand announces to all the guests that it was with Mona's help that she survived the other day. After the party, Priya gets a lift from the family doctor cum friend of Mrs Anand, Dr Merchant to her stage rehearsal venue, who also happens to be falling for her. Whereas Rahul drops Mohana home on insistence from his mother. On the way as he apologizes for his rudeness but he also makes it clear to her that he's aware his mother expects Mohana to be Rahul's bride but that Mona shouldn't even dream of a love affair let alone a wedding.
On the first day of the shooting, Mona had to rush Priya to Dr. Merchant's hospital due to appendix pain instead of going for the shoot. She tries to leave a message which isn't delivered to Rahul by an envious co-actress. Rahul fumes & packs up and decides to sack Mohana from the show. He's later informed by Mrs Anand about the medical emergency at Mona's end as she coincidentally happened to be at the same hospital for her regular checkups where Priya was admitted. Rahul meets Mona at the hospital & offers to drop her home. On the way they have a tensed conversation, however Rahul takes back his decision of sacking her.
During the shoots Rahul starts falling for Mohana for her grace, acting skills & helpful & composed nature, whereas Mohana also feels attracted to Rahul due to his professionalism.
On the end of the shoot, a shivering & sick man named Mohit Appears at the door of Mohana's room at the shooting site & asks for her help. Mona soon rushes him to the hospital while leaving a message with Rahul's production manager. Rahul sees her leaving with this unknown man and gets enraged & jealous as he expected Mohana to have informed him personally before leaving. However the Production Manager informs Rahul that she left the message to him since Rahul had a Do not disturb sign hanging on his door.
A frustrated and jealous Rahul disrespects Mohana when she visits to collect her pay cheque indirectly pointing towards Mohit & her other friends. Mohana refuses to take the cheque & leaves in rage while telling Rahul to learn some humanity.
Meanwhile their show is a success & launches Mohana to huge popularity & demand. While, Priya & Dr Merchant get married. Mrs Anand calls Mohana to congratulate & celebrate her & Rahul's success & calls for a party to which Mohana declines the offer and ends the call abruptly.
A disheartened Mrs Anand discusses this with Priya who tells her that Mohit is Mohana's brother who had a nervous breakdown post their parents' death & turned into a drug addict & is being treated at Dr Merchant's hospital now. Mrs Anand tells this to Rahul & he tries to mend terms with her but Mohana is too angry to listen however he tells her to not be angry with his mother for his wrong doings. Rahul meets with an accident that night and gets a temporary vision loss.
Mona incidentally visits Mrs Anand & gets the news about Rahul which shocks her & makes her realise & confess her love for Rahul to Mrs Anand. On being convinced by Mrs Anand, she affirms to take care of a temporarily blind Rahul till the bandage over his eyes are taken off, acting as a mute maid to see if Rahul confesses his love for her at any point of time while she gets to spend time with him. She wants to hear it from Rahul because he was the one who clearly told her in the beginning, to not even dream of them being together.
However Rahul could sense that the maid is Mohana but since he couldn't see her he isn't sure & though he reluctantly shares his feelings about Mona with the maid but never openly takes her name which frustrates Mona who wants to hear it loud and clear from him. Day before his bandage was to be removed Mona leaves disappointed that Rahul will never confess his love for her.
After getting his eyesight recovered the next day, Rahul gets schooled by Priya about his ego & not admitting his love for Mona, that's when he decides to finally see her. The show ends when Rahul meets a lonely Mona at a beachside and both hold hands.
